&eKronwerke:&r Ein Laser auf Eisen ist d: &eKronwerke:&r A laser on iron is the most comfortable iron source in the pack. Behind an ore tripling it turns into steel for the goal &6The Furnace Never Sleeps&r.
&eKronwerke:&r Ein Trichter sammelt die: &eKronwerke:&r A hopper collects the gems in a chest that you carry to the obelisk. Each one counts &e4 points&r for the magic pillar.
&eKronwerke:&r Ein guter Anlass für eine: &eKronwerke:&r A good reason for a joint trip on stream. Whoever finds a catacomb shares the coordinates in chat.
&eKronwerke:&r Eine &6Imbuement-Kammer&r: &eKronwerke:&r An &6Imbuement Chamber&r no more than 2 blocks from the jar, hoppers for amethyst on top and gems below, and the Source Gems for the obelisk come on their own. See the &dArs Nouveau&r chapter (Source).
&eKronwerke:&r Für das Stufenziel zählt: &eKronwerke:&r Nothing here counts directly toward the stage goal. Whoever gets their gear here fights better in the End and in the Gaia fights on stream.
&eKronwerke:&r Geladenen Certus macht si: &eKronwerke:&r It does not make charged certus here. Attach it as a block to a provider, then it pulls straight from the network, and put dense energy cells next to it.
&eKronwerke:&r Hier geht es bis zum Mana: &eKronwerke:&r This chapter goes up to the Mana Pool. Runic Altar, Manasteel and Terrasteel open with &6stage 2&r, continued in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter.
&eKronwerke:&r Häng eine Kiste hinten an: &eKronwerke:&r Hook a chest to the end. What you carry from it to the obelisk counts for you towards the 4,000 steel ingots of stage 3.
&eKronwerke:&r In Stufe 1 reicht Silent: &eKronwerke:&r In stage 1, Silent Gear goes up to diamond. The Nether metals (Crimson Iron, Blaze Gold, Crimson Steel) and steel come in stage 2, the azure metals from the End in stage 4.
&eKronwerke:&r In Stufe 3 haben feindlic: &eKronwerke:&r In stage 3 hostile mobs have &d70 percent&r more health, &d45 percent&r more damage and &d4&r extra armor points. Without full armor the bogs and catacombs get tight quickly.
&eKronwerke:&r In Stufe 4 haben feindlic: &eKronwerke:&r In stage 4 hostile mobs have &d120 percent&r more health, &d75 percent&r more damage and &d7&r extra armor points, the inhabitants of this dimension too. Do not go without full armor.
&eKronwerke:&r In Stufe 4 will der Obeli: &eKronwerke:&r In stage 4 the obelisk wants &e128 Gaia Spirits&r and &e30 Mystic Staffs&r on the magic side. Against the Gaia Guardian's minions a Linger field or a Wall helps.
&eKronwerke:&r Jeder &6Stahlkern&r, der: &eKronwerke:&r Every &6Steel Core&r, the milestone of stage 3, needs four. The obelisk wants eight Steel Cores.
&eKronwerke:&r Jeder Block im Obelisken: &eKronwerke:&r Every block in the obelisk counts 50 points. Still put a few aside, the next quests need some.
&eKronwerke:&r Jeder Ruf eines Unbound A: &eKronwerke:&r Every summoning of an Unbound Afrit costs one Iesnium ingot, see &5Occultism: Afrit and Marid&r. With Theurgy one find is enough for five summonings.
&eKronwerke:&r Jeder Stahlbarren zählt a: &eKronwerke:&r Every steel ingot counts at the obelisk for &6The Furnace Never Sleeps&r.
&eKronwerke:&r Every steel ingot counts at the obelisk for &6The Furnace Never Sleeps&r. A SAG Mill for powdered coal in front, a chest behind: a small steel line.
&eKronwerke:&r Lass die Incubators durch: &eKronwerke:&r Keep the Incubators running and bring the iron to the steelmakers. Every ingot not lost in the furnace counts toward the 4,000 steel.
&eKronwerke:&r Lava aus Feuersamen ist e: &eKronwerke:&r Lava from Fire Seeds is an endless fuel source for Iron Furnaces and later for the Mekanism Heat Generator, without any Nether at all.
&eKronwerke:&r Lava aus Feuersamen und F: &eKronwerke:&r Lava from fire seeds and flint from the millstone make andesite in the press, and the mixer turns it into andesite alloy for the obelisk.
&eKronwerke:&r Leite Messing und Manaper: &eKronwerke:&r Send brass and mana pearls from the leftovers chest into a chest of their own for the obelisk. What you hand in from it by hand counts for you towards the goal of stage 2.
&eKronwerke:&r Mehr Eisen aus jedem Erz: &eKronwerke:&r More iron from every ore means more steel, and the coal goes straight into the smelter.
&eKronwerke:&r Mehr Eisen heißt mehr Sta: &eKronwerke:&r More iron means more steel for &6The Furnace Never Sleeps&r. Hang a Foundry with coal dust behind it, and the ore line becomes a steel line.
&eKronwerke:&r Messingbarren und Präzisi: &eKronwerke:&r Brass ingots and precision mechanisms in this stage, steel in the next: the goals want large amounts, and a train brings them without walking.
&eKronwerke:&r Mit &6Stufe 3&r öffnen Af: &eKronwerke:&r &6Stage 3&r opens Afrit and Marid. The magic goal then wants &e150 Afrit Essences&r, each one a summoned and defeated Afrit, and every Elven Star two. Continue in the chapter &5Occultism: Afrit and Marid&r.
&eKronwerke:&r Mit Absicht so stark wie: &eKronwerke:&r Deliberately as strong as Mekanism's tripling, only with fire instead of power. The stage goal wants &e4,000 steel&r, and every steel ingot starts as iron.
&eKronwerke:&r Pulverizer für Kohlestaub: &eKronwerke:&r Pulverizer for coal dust, Foundry behind it, chest at the end: the small steel line is done.
&eKronwerke:&r Seelenstahl ist das Binde: &eKronwerke:&r Soulstained Steel is the link to Ender IO. Build up a stock, the tech people will surely ask.
&eKronwerke:&r So läuft Eisen für die St: &eKronwerke:&r That way iron keeps flowing for the steelmakers even while you are offline.
&eKronwerke:&r Stell ein Quickening-Tote: &eKronwerke:&r Put a Quickening totem in your furnace hall. It fits the stage goal "The Furnace Never Sleeps".
&eKronwerke:&r Stufe 4 frisst Strom: Fus: &eKronwerke:&r Stage 4 eats power: igniting fusion, filling Draconic cores, and in stage 5 the SPS runs for days for the obelisk's antimatter. A fission reactor is a good base load.
&eKronwerke:&r Was im Obelisken zählt, s: &eKronwerke:&r What counts at the obelisk is ingots. A quarry in an iron vein feeds the steel line for a long time.
&eKronwerke:&r Wer die Rolle &dArkanist&: &eKronwerke:&r Whoever picks the &dArcanist&r role starts with this book already.
&eKronwerke:&r Zellen nehmen ihren Inhal: &eKronwerke:&r Disks take their contents along when you travel to another world, even inside a Disk Drive you carry with Carry On.
&eKronwerke:&r Zwei stecken in jedem &6Q: &eKronwerke:&r Two go into every &6Source Keystone&r, the magic milestone of stage 1. In stage 2 the Manasteel ritual needs it, every Terrasteel craft, and every sin rune needs two.
&eKupferadern&r liegen zwischen Y 0 und: &eCopper veins&r lie between Y 0 and 50 in granite, &eiron veins&r between Y -60 and -8 in tuff. They contain ore and whole raw blocks.
&eLegierungsofen:&r 3 Deepsilver Ingots: &eAlloy furnace:&r 3 Deepsilver Ingots and 2 Golem Steel Nuggets make another Golem Steel Ingot. Deepsilver, Golem Steel, Malarite and Soul Dew make &6Unrealium&r.
&eMacht es:&r der Chemische Injektor aus: &eMade by:&r the Chemical Infuser from 2 mB sulfur dioxide and 1 mB oxygen, gives 2 mB.
&eMacht es:&r der Chemische Oxidierer, 1: &eMade by:&r the Chemical Oxidizer, 100 mB per sulfur dust. The Pressurized Reaction Chamber gives sulfur from coal.
&eMacht es:&r der Elektrolyseur aus &e10: &eMade by:&r the Electrolytic Separator from &e10 mB brine&r: 1 mB chlorine and 1 mB sodium.
&eMacht es:&r der Elektrolyseur, nebenbe: &eMade by:&r the Electrolytic Separator, alongside chlorine.
&eMacht es:&r die Druckreaktionskammer a: &eMade by:&r the Pressurized Reaction Chamber from bio fuel, water and hydrogen.
&eMacht es:&r die Wärmeverdampfungsanlag: &eMade by:&r the Thermal Evaporation Plant from brine, 10 to 1, as a fluid. The Rotary Condensentrator turns it into gas.
&eMacht ihn:&r der Chemische Injektor au: &eMade by:&r the Chemical Infuser from 1 mB hydrogen and 1 mB chlorine. Salt straight into the Chemical Injection Chamber gives 2 mB.
&eMacht ihn:&r der Elektrolyseur aus &e2: &eMade by:&r the Electrolytic Separator from &e2 mB water&r (2 mB hydrogen, 1 mB oxygen). The Pressurized Reaction Chamber makes it from coal, water and oxygen.
&eMacht ihn:&r der Elektrolyseur, 1 mB p: &eMade by:&r the Electrolytic Separator, 1 mB per 2 mB of water. A flint in the chemical slot gives 10 mB.
&eMacht ihn:&r der Rotationskondensator: &eMade by:&r the Rotary Condensentrator in decondensing mode from water, 1 to 1.
&eMacht ihn:&r der Thermoelektrische Dam: &eMade by:&r the Thermoelectric Boiler from water and heat. The Rotary Condensentrator turns steam from other mods into Mekanism steam. In stage 5 the fission reactor.
&eMacht sie:&r der Chemische Injektor au: &eMade by:&r the Chemical Infuser from 1 mB each of sulfur trioxide and water vapour. Sulfur dust straight into the Chemical Dissolution Chamber gives 2 mB.
&eMacht sie:&r der Chemische Oxidierer a: &eMade by:&r the Chemical Oxidizer from salt, 15 mB each. From stage 3 the Thermal Evaporation Plant from water, 10 to 1.
&eMagnetisierungslinse&r: formlos Linse,: &eMagnetizing Lens&r: shapeless lens, iron ingot, gold ingot. The burst seeks out the nearest block that accepts mana on its own.
&eMana pro Stück:&r Kohle oder Holzkohle: &eMana per piece:&r coal or charcoal 1,200 (40 s). Block of coal 12,000. Dried kelp block 3,000. Log or planks 225. Stick 75. Blaze rod 1,800 (from stage 2).
&eMana wächst durch Benutzen&r wie ein M: &eMana grows with use&r like a muscle. It slowly comes back on its own, faster on a full stomach. Sleeping gives back half the bar at once.
&eManapuder&r, &eManastahlbarren&r, &eKn: &eMana Powder&r, &eManasteel ingot&r, &ebone meal&r, &esugar cane&r, &efishing rod&r. &d5,200 mana&r, gives &e2 runes&r.
&eManapuder&r, &eManastahlbarren&r, &eNe: &eMana Powder&r, &eManasteel ingot&r, &eNether brick&r, &egunpowder&r, &ecoal&r or charcoal. &d5,200 mana&r, gives &e2 runes&r.
&eManapuder&r, &eManastahlbarren&r, &eSt: &eMana Powder&r, &eManasteel ingot&r, &estone&r, &emud&r, &ebrown or red mushroom&r. &d5,200 mana&r, gives &e2 runes&r.
&eManapuder&r, &eManastahlbarren&r, ein: &eMana Powder&r, &eManasteel ingot&r, a &ecarpet&r, a &efeather&r, a &estring&r. &d5,200 mana&r, gives &e2 runes&r.
&eMisch Preußischblau und Schutztrank: &eMix Prussian Blue and a Protection Potion
&eModi:&r &eExtract&r zieht aus dem Bloc: &eModes:&r &eExtract&r pulls out of the block, &eInsert&r puts into it, &eStock&r keeps a stock. Cards find each other through their &echannel&r: Extract on channel 0 delivers to Insert on channel 0. Priorities and round robin spread the load.
&eModi:&r Seiten konfigurieren, Inhalt a: &eModes:&r configure sides, empty contents, rotate blocks, wrench (dismantles machines with their contents).
&eMotor:&r 16 Stahlblechblöcke, 9 Leicht: &eMotor:&r 16 Steel Sheetmetal, 9 Light and 4 Heavy Engineering Blocks, 3 Radiator Blocks, 6 Steel Scaffolding, 1 Redstone Engineering Block. &eWheel:&r 9 steel blocks, 20 Steel Scaffolding. Hammer on the rear middle Heavy block.
&eNahkampf:&r Berühren, Schaden, Verstär: &eMelee:&r Touch, Harm, Amplify, Amplify. &eRanged:&r Projectile, Harm, Amplify. &eField:&r Touch, Harvest.
&eNether-Tipp:&r Eine Lohenrute gibt hie: &eNether tip:&r A blaze rod gives four blaze powder here instead of two.
&eNeue Kugel:&r Werkbank, &65 Blue Starl: &eA new orb:&r crafting table, &65 Blue Starlight Crystal Shards&r as a cross, &64 glass&r in the corners.
&eNoch mehr Essen:&r &6Schlafffrüchte&r: &eMore food:&r &6Droopfruit&r hangs from the glowing Droopvines on the ceiling, &6Blisterberries&r grow on bushes. Do not eat Rotten Blisterberries, they are for throwing.
&ePresse:&r Kalkulationsdruck oben, Kons: &ePress:&r calculation press at the top, engineering press at the bottom, a &6Singularity&r in the middle of the Inscriber. After that you copy it with an iron block.
&ePriorität:&r Im Laufwerk stellst du ei: &ePriority:&r In the drive you set the order in which the network stores. Higher number first. With filters in the drive a disk only gets certain things, for example only ores.
&eProjektil, Magielicht beschwören&r set: &eProjectile, Conjure Magelight&r places a permanent light on the wall. With &dAmplify&r it shines like glowstone. &eSelf, Magelight&r gives you night vision.
&eProjektil, Verweilen, Verdorren&r mitt: &eProjectile, Linger, Wither&r right into a group of endermen.
&eProzessor:&r Himmelsstahl unter der Pr: &eProcessor:&r sky steel under the press, then &6fluix dust&r in the middle and printed silicon at the bottom.
&eRechnung:&r 16 Common Gems Niter (aus: &eThe math:&r 16 Common Gems Niter (from lapis or quartz) and 5 Purified Gold per diamond. Expensive, but without ore.
&eRechnung:&r 64 Blöcke im Ziel sind 16: &eThe math:&r 64 blocks in the goal are 16 fusions, so &e16 dragon fights&r. Agree on who summons the dragon when.
&eRechnung:&r 9 mal 9 Felder Inferium mi: &eThe math:&r 9 by 9 tiles of Inferium with four accelerators below give 81 essence per round. That is ten new seeds or twenty Prudentium Essence, once stage 2 is open. The sooner the farm stands, the more you have by then.
&eRechtsklick&r auf das &6Blaupausenbünd: &eRight click&r the &6Blueprint Package&r from your starting inventory. You get blueprints for rod, pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe and sword.
&eRedstone-Link&r: der Zug wartet, bis e: &eRedstone Link&r: the train waits until a frequency of the redstone links is on or off. That way a switch in your base sends the train off from the other end of the line.
&eRedstone:&r Staub 10 mB, Block 90 mB,: &eRedstone:&r dust 10 mB, block 90 mB, enriched redstone 80 mB. Most recipes need 10 mB per piece, the circuit 20 mB.
&eRegeln:&r ein Controller pro Netz, er: &eRules:&r one controller per network, it may be made of several blocks, all within 7 x 7 x 7. It needs &d6 AE/t&r per block. If a block turns red, the shape is wrong.
&eRein:&r &d128 FE/t&r am linken Anschlu: &eIn:&r &d128 FE/t&r at the left connector, a redstone signal at the middle one. &eOut:&r the same signal at every tower on the same frequency (128 to 384 kHz) in range. Higher and more open means farther.
&eRein:&r &d128 FE/t&r rechts und &6Papi: &eIn:&r &d128 FE/t&r on the right and &6paper&r on the left, one sheet lasts 60 seconds. &eOut:&r machines within about 32 blocks keep running, even when nobody is nearby.
&eRein:&r &d4 096 FE/t&r über die drei A: &eIn:&r &d4,096 FE/t&r through the three connectors on the side, one Diesel Generator per Excavator. &eOut:&r ore at the back of the motor. A vein gives at most &e38,400&r ores, the farther from the center, the more waste rock.
&eIn:&r fuel at the bottom corners. &eOut:&r &d4,096 FE/t&r to up to three connectors above the generator. It only runs when something draws power.
&eRein:&r Eisen und Koks von oben durch: &eIn:&r iron and coke from above through the hopper. &eOut:&r steel at the front, slag at the back, straight into chests or onto conveyor belts. This is the first steel line that runs without you.
&eRein:&r Fermentiertes Erzfleisch und &: &eIn:&r Fermented Ore Meat and &6sand&r. &eOut:&r dust of the ore everything started with. &d40 FE/t&r. You smelt the dust into ingots in a furnace.
&eRein:&r Flüssigkeit unten an der Strom: &eIn:&r fluid at the bottom by the power input, items at the back through two hatches. &eOut:&r at the front. 2 sand, 1 gravel, 1 clay in 500 mB of water give 500 mB of &6Liquid Concrete&r, 1 redstone in 250 mB of water the same amount of &6Redstone Acid&r. Potions in tanks too.
&eRein:&r Gegenstand aufs Band, Flüssigk: &eIn:&r item on the belt, fluid into the tank (8 buckets). &eOut:&r filled at the end of the belt. It fills buckets, bottles and jerrycans and casts resin and graphite into press molds.
&eRein:&r Holzlagerkisten (acht Behandel: &eIn:&r Wooden Storage Crates (eight Treated Wood Planks in a ring), Reinforced Storage Crates or shulker boxes by right click. Every level has its own window. A hopper at the front fills two crates, at the side a row of four, from above a column of three.
&eRein:&r Rohes Erzfleisch. Sie versiege: &eIn:&r Raw Ore Meat. It seals once the set fill level is reached, and ferments. &eOut:&r Fermented Ore Meat: double after 5 seconds, triple after 45, quadruple after 2 minutes, fivefold after 5 minutes. &d40 FE/t&r.
&eRein:&r Zutaten und Flüssigkeiten an d: &eIn:&r ingredients and fluids on the input side, 18 storage slots. &eOut:&r the finished parts. Three recipes in a row, the result of the first may be an ingredient of the second. &d80 FE&r per part.
&eRein:&r bis zu &e16 Kohle&r oder &e8 S: &eIn:&r up to &e16 coal&r or &e8 logs&r per load. &eOut:&r coke or charcoal, plus &bCreosote Oil&r in the tank: 500 mB per load of coal (5 minutes), 250 mB per load of logs.
&eRein:&r durch die zwei blau markierten: &eIn:&r through the two blue marked hatches at the back. &eOut:&r items at the orange hatch, fluid below it. &6Hemp seeds&r give 120 mB of Plant Oil, wheat seeds 80 mB. Wooden Barrel: three treated wood slabs over five treated planks.
&eRein:&r ein Erz und &6Flüssigfleisch&r: &eIn:&r an ore and &6Liquid Meat&r from the slaughter factory. &eOut:&r &6Raw Ore Meat&r of that ore. It draws &d60 FE/t&r.
&eRein:&r eine einzige Sorte Gegenstand,: &eIn:&r one single kind of item, through the grate on top or at the bottom. &eOut:&r at the bottom, by itself with a redstone signal. It holds as much as &e24 chests&r, good for cobblestone, seeds or slag.
&eRein:&r hinten durch die blauen Luken:: &eIn:&r at the back through the blue hatches: potatoes, sugar cane, apples, melons, berries, beetroot, honey. &eOut:&r Ethanol below the orange hatch. One potato gives 80 mB for 6,400 FE.
&eRein:&r je eine Flüssigkeit an den Sei: &eIn:&r one fluid on each side, &6Nitrate Dust&r as a catalyst by hand (not used up). &eOut:&r at the orange port at the front. 8 mB of oil and 8 mB of Ethanol give &e16 mB of Biodiesel&r.
&eRein:&r jede Flüssigkeit, oben oder un: &eIn:&r any fluid, top or bottom. &eOut:&r only at the bottom in the middle, with a redstone signal it pumps out by itself. A comparator there shows how full it is. Any sheetmetal works, not just iron.
&eRein:&r oben &6Eisen&r, darunter &6Kok: &eIn:&r &6iron&r on top, &6coke&r below. &eOut:&r one &6steel ingot&r per minute, plus &6slag&r. One coke burns for exactly one minute, charcoal for a quarter of that.
&eRein:&r oben drei Elektroden, links du: &eIn:&r three electrodes at the top, up to 12 inputs through the hatch on the left, 4 additives on the right. &eOut:&r 6 outputs from the basin at the front, slag at the back. Power through the three connectors at the back.
&eRein:&r oben in die Walzen. &eRaus:&r: &eIn:&r at the top into the rollers. &eOut:&r at the bottom front. An ore block gives 2 dust (plus 10 percent nickel dust), raw ore 1 dust plus a one in three chance of a second, cobblestone gravel, sandstone sand and Nitrate Dust. Power at the top on the shoulder.
&eRein:&r zwei Metalle in die beiden Ein: &eIn:&r two metals into the two inputs, fuel such as coal or coke below. &eOut:&r electrum, constantan, bronze and insulating glass. It does not make brass on Kronwerke.
&eReine Ender-Essenz:&r Im End gibt der: &ePure Ender Essence:&r In the End the Soulscribe gives the pure form on endermen, see &aBotania: Alfheim&r.
&eResistenzlinse&r (Erde): der Stoß flie: &eResistance Lens&r (Earth): the burst flies much longer before it loses mana.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke, Weg 1:&r &6Imbue: &eRecipe on Kronwerke, way 1:&r the &6Imbuement Chamber&r from Ars Nouveau, a &6Certus Quartz Crystal&r inside, two pedestals next to it with &6redstone dust&r and &6glowstone dust&r. &d2,000 source&r per crystal.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke, Weg 2:&r &6Energ: &eRecipe on Kronwerke, way 2:&r the &6Energizing Orb&r from Powah, one crystal and one redstone give &etwo&r charged crystals for &d20,000 FE&r.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &62 Fortgeschr: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &62 Advanced Control Circuits&r, &62 Reinforced Alloys&r and &61 draconium dust&r at the crafting table make one &6Elite Control Circuit&r. There are no other recipes.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &62 Fortschrit: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &62 Advanced Control Circuits&r, &62 Reinforced Alloy&r and &61 draconium dust&r. There is no other way.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &64 Draconiumb: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &64 Draconium Blocks&r in the core. In seven Wyvern injectors: &64 Draconium Cores&r, &a2 Gaia Spirit Ingots&r, &c1 Dragon Heart&r. Makes &54 Awakened Draconium Blocks&r.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &64 Stahlbarre: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &64 steel ingots&r in the corners, &64 stone&r on the sides, &61 ender pearl&r in the middle. That makes the &6Catalyst&r.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Enderperle&r: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6ender pearl&r into the pool, &d6,000 mana&r, but only with a &6brass casing&r directly &eunder the pool&r. Without the casing the pearl just stays there.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Erwachtes Dr: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Awakened Draconium&r is a fusion of 4 Draconium Blocks, 4 Draconium Cores, a &5Dragon Heart&r and &a2 Gaia Spirit ingots&r. Save your Dragon Hearts.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Himmelsstein: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Sky Stone Blocks&r in the four corners, a &6Spirit Attuned Gem&r from Occultism at the top centre, &6Fluix Crystals&r left, right and bottom centre, an &6Engineering Processor&r in the centre.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Infused Iron: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Infused Iron&r into the Mana Pool, &d3,000 mana&r per ingot. An iron ingot just stays in the pool.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Manaperlen&r: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Mana Pearls&r from Botania in the corners, &6Atomic Alloy&r at the top and bottom, gold left and right, a diamond in the middle.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Netherit&r m: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r The Foundry does not make &6netherite&r, that stays with the smithing table. No &6brass&r either, that only comes from Create's mixer.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Nickel&r obe: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Nickel&r at the top and sides, a &6copper ingot&r in the middle, at the bottom &6Magnetic Coil&r, an &6Andesite Casing&r from Create, Magnetic Coil.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Präzisionsge: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Precision mechanism&r, &6brass casing&r and &6crafting table&r on top of each other make three &6Mechanical Crafters&r.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &6Quelljuwelbl: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &6Source gem blocks&r from Ars Nouveau in the corners, &6diamonds&r on the sides, a &6Draconium Core&r in the middle.
&eRezept auf Kronwerke:&r &bCertus-Quarz: &eRecipe on Kronwerke:&r &bCertus Quartz Crystal&r into the chamber, &eredstone&r and &eglowstone dust&r on the pedestals, &d2,000 source&r. One charged crystal.

64 &6Iron Sulfur&r und 4 &6Gold Sulfur&r: 64 &6Iron Sulfur&r and 4 &6Gold Sulfur&r in your inventory.

Abras' Conjure: one ore, four dusts.
Keep your distance, never into the spikes.

Eight times as much from one coal.

Every chapter of stage 1, by group.

Base, iron and your first delivery.

Tree Fertilizer for the saw wheel farm.

At &e98 percent&r the obelisk takes nothing more. Then the team sets a date, all streamers go live together, and the last items go in together. At that moment the next stage opens for everyone.
At &e98 percent&r the obelisk takes nothing more. The team sets a date, all streamers go live, the last items go in together, and the next stage opens &efor everyone at once&r.

Bei beiden stellst du den Bereich im Fen: With both you set the area in the window. The Chunk Destroyer needs one of them.
Bei dir oder beim Server, das ist der Un: On your side or the server's, that is the difference.

Beide auf einer &6Runewood&r-Totembasis,: Both on a &6Runewood&r totem base, three runes:

Both go into the accessory slot.

Beim Kampf gegen den Drachen dabei: Took part in the fight against the dragon

Beim ersten Betreten wählst du eine &6He: When you first join you choose an &6origin&r and a &6role&r. New to modpacks? &6Crown Citizen&r and &6Millchild&r are easy to play.
Beispiel: &eBerühren, Brechen&r vor eine: Example: &eTouch, Break&r in front of a cobblestone generator on a redstone clock.

Benutzt beschwört die Rute aus Mana unzä: Used, the rod summons countless magic projectiles from mana that seek random targets. Strongest against large groups.
Benutzt zeigt sie dir eine Weile &6Knosp: Used, it shows you &6budding amethyst&r through stone for a while and makes magical creatures within &e75 blocks&r glow. It only has a limited number of uses.
Beschleuniger unten, Essenz-Ackerland, S: Accelerators below, essence farmland, scythe in hand.

Betritt jedes der &d20&r Biome des Under: Enter each of the &d20&r biomes of the Undergarden, including the &6Barren Abyss&r, the three seas and, below, the &6Depths&r, the &6Infected Depths&r and the &6Rogdorium Grove&r.

Betten, Türen, Prüfungsspawner und Treso: Beds, doors, trial spawners and vaults can't be packed.
Beute mit zufälligen Affixen, Edelsteine: Loot with random affixes, gems in sockets, the enchanting table and spawners. In stage 1 up to the Rare rarity.
Loot and Essence without a sword.

Bindung neben einem Sternbunkel, dann da: Binding next to a Starbuncle, then use the script.

Bis zu &e4 Kerzen&r passen in einen Bloc: Up to &e4 candles&r fit in one block, lit they burn for about &e35 minutes&r. With planks, selenite or a redstone block in the crafting grid they get a base.

Bis zu acht Zutaten und eine Flüssigkeit: Up to eight ingredients and a fluid.
Up to a million FE per tick.
Bis zur MekaSuit in Stufe 4 ist das die: Until the MekaSuit in stage 4 this is Mekanism's strongest armour.

Blitze, die von Monster zu Monster sprin: Lightning that jumps from monster to monster.

Flowers and bone meal without a hand.
Flowers, mana and the first Mana Pool.
Blumen, die Mana verbrauchen und arbeite: Flowers that use mana and do work.

Drills on the engine, chests in the carriage.

Frying on the stove or in your hand.

Der &bItem-Dislocator&r zieht Gegenständ: The &bItem Dislocator&r pulls items near you to you. A key turns it on and off, handy at the monster farm or when mining in the End.
Der &bPermafrost&r ist eine Kühlanlage a: The &bPermafrost&r is a cooling plant made of several Freezes. It spits icy saliva that freezes the ground and throws Frozen Tubes in all directions. Keep moving.
Der &cNether&r öffnet sich mit Stufe 2 l: The &cNether&r opens with stage 2, live on stream, through the portal at spawn. Until then, build up a supply of food, torches and iron.
Der Afrit ist ein wütender Feuergeist. &: The Afrit is an angry fire spirit. &eFire resistance&r, good armour and friends help. Defeated, it drops an &cAfrit Essence&r, with Looting III up to three more.
The battery for the Draconic gear.
Der Akzeptor wandelt &d2 FE in 1 AE&r. E: The acceptor turns &d2 FE into 1 AE&r. An &6Energy Cell&r (200,000 AE) next to it catches power spikes when you store things, otherwise the network restarts for a moment.
Der Altar arbeitet nur in seinem Bauwerk: The altar only works inside its structure of stone bricks, planks, chiseled stone bricks and &6Golden Stone Bricks&r (stone bricks and Brilliant Fiber). The book shows the build layer by layer.
The altar for the elves' ritual.
Der Altar ist eine Mehrblockstruktur: ei: The altar is a multiblock structure: one altar and &e8 Infusion Pedestals&r around it. Place the altar, then it shows you with markers where the pedestals go: &e3 blocks&r away in each cardinal direction and &e2 blocks&r away in each diagonal. All at the same height.
Der Altar kommt unter die goldene Schale: The altar goes under the golden bowl. If a ritual wants an animal sacrifice and a Containment Jar with the right animal stands nearby, the altar pays with Source from a Source Jar. The animal lives on.
Der Altar zieht die Aura langsam aus der: The altar slowly draws aura from the area around it until there is none left. If it gets slow, the area is drained. You also need Infused Iron later for Manasteel in Botania.
The start of every Railway Casing.
Der Anker lädt jeden Chunk, in dem ein T: The anchor loads every chunk that holds part of its network. A cable across the chunk border is enough. It works on through quantum bridges, but not across dimensions: the network in the Nether needs its own.
Der Atlas merkt sich Ort, Art und Größe: The atlas remembers place, kind and size of every vein. With it you filter the ore vein finder to exactly the vein you are looking for.
Der Bagger allein braucht &e26&r Gerüste: The Excavator alone needs &e26&r scaffolding, the Crusher 10 scaffolding and 8 fences.
Der Beobachter meldet ein bestimmtes Ite: The observer reports a certain item, the switch turns on when a storage rises above a fill level and off when it drops below. With a clutch the setup stops when the storage is full.
Der Beschleuniger nimmt FE oder AE oben: The accelerator takes FE or AE at the top and bottom, a Wooden Crank will do in a pinch.
The broom comes when you call.
The broom carries your ender chest.
Der Beutel funktioniert wie ein Bündel,: The pouch works like a bundle, but grabs every arcana you pick up. Magical items take up less space in it. After a few hours of harvesting with the scythe your inventory will thank you.
Der Biber lässt dich Holz schneller abba: The beaver lets you mine wood faster and fells small trees that grow from saplings next to it.
Der Blaster feuert Manastöße aus deiner: The blaster fires mana bursts from your hand, with mana from a tablet or ring in your inventory. The bursts are faster than a spreader's but only carry three quarters of the mana.
Der Blazing Furnator macht &e800 FE/t&r,: The Blazing Furnator makes &e800 FE/t&r, forty times as much as the Starter. Feed it coal blocks from a tree farm, or build reactors right away.
Der Block allein ist &eStufe 1&r und spe: The block alone is &etier 1&r and stores &e45,500,000&r energy. It only runs with four stabilizers, those come next.
Der Block direkt vor Lager oder Kolben g: The block right in front of a bearing or piston always belongs to it; everything else needs glue or a chassis.
Der Block gibt ein Redstone-Signal, wenn: The block gives a redstone signal when a player within &e64 blocks&r looks straight at it. Anyone wearing a &6pumpkin&r on their head doesn't trigger it.
Der Block verbraucht sich und wird am En: The block uses itself up and ends as a Certus Quartz Block, on average after about ten crystals. Broken it gives one &6Entro Dust&r. Entro Dust and fluix in water give an Entro Crystal, Entro Dust with gold and lapis an &6Entro Infused Ingot&r.
The block no pickaxe can take.
Der Boden entscheidet über den zweiten S: The soil decides the second seed.
Der Boden ist ein Gewirr aus Spitzen und: The ground is a tangle of spikes and lava holes. Walk slowly, place blocks, and take care of the magma cubes from a distance.
Der Bogen ist die Vorstufe zum Drakonisc: The bow is the step before the Draconic Bow from stage 5, the weapon against the Chaos Guardian. Projectile modules for damage, speed and accuracy already exist in the Wyvern tier.
The fuel for every steel ingot.
Der Builder saugt damit Flüssigkeiten au: With it the Builder sucks fluids out of the area. Each costs 300 RF. Good for a lava lake in the Nether.
Der Chaoswächter ist besiegt, und ich wa: The Chaos Guardian is defeated, and I was there
Der Chaoswächter ist tot, und mit ihm en: The Chaos Guardian is dead, and with it &6Kronwerke Season 2&r ends. The fireworks go up.
Der Chemische Oxidierer und später Robit: The Chemical Oxidizer and later the Robit and QIO need it as an ingredient.
Der Crude Mixer mischt beliebige Materia: The Crude Mixer mixes any materials into a &6crude alloy&r, even metal with a gem. It carries the &cCrude&r trait and has only &e80 percent&r of the mixed stats.
Der Crystal Assembler macht zwei &6ME Wi: The Crystal Assembler makes two &6ME Wireless Connectors&r from machine frames, smart dense cables, wireless receivers and boosters. With the &6ME Wireless Setup Kit&r (needs a singularity) you click both one after the other.
Der Crystal Fixer macht Certus wieder ma: The Crystal Fixer makes certus flawless again.
The steam is made in the boiler.
Der Dolch wird durch Treffer satt und da: The dagger gets fed by hits and grows stronger.
Der Effekt &6Reinheit&r senkt die Infekt: The &6Purity&r effect lowers the infection a little every second. Carry a few nuggets on every trip.
Der Einfache Würfel in die Mitte, Osmium: The Basic Energy Cube in the middle, osmium left and right, Energy Tablets at the top and bottom, alloy in the corners. &d6.4 million FE&r, &d6,400 FE/t&r output.
The way into AE2, two at a time.
The electric motor, 64 SU per RPM.
Der Enderdrache spuckt Feuerbälle, die e: The Ender Dragon spits fireballs that leave a purple cloud. Click into the cloud with an empty &6glass bottle&r.
Der Enderman lässt immer eine &6Enderper: The Enderman always drops an &6ender pearl&r, the Ghast always a &6ghast tear&r, the Blaze Nether plants and Nether blocks. The bee for Cursed Honey is in the Afrit chapter.
Der Endermite reist mit dem Foliot ins E: The endermite travels with the Foliot to the End and back. Defeated, it always drops &6end stone&r. The End only opens with stage 4; until then it is your source for purple chalk.
Der Energiegeladene Schmelzer mit Instal: The Energized Smelter with an installer, or at the crafting table: the smelter in the middle of the installer pattern.
Der Ernter läuft mit Kohle oder Holzkohl: The harvester runs on coal or charcoal, puts the harvest into its own inventory and can be switched off with redstone. Machine upgrades make it faster.
Der Extender sitzt an der Maschine oder: The extender sits on the machine or on another extender and gives new slots. How many work depends on the quality of the cores, shown at the top left of the window.
The External Heater replaces the coal.
Der Extraktor (rotes Band) zieht aus sei: The extractor (red band) pulls from its block, the inserter (green band) pushes in. For fluids there are both with blue dye.
Der Filter hat &e9 Plätze&r. Whitelist h: The filter has &e9 slots&r. Whitelist means only these items, blacklist everything except these. An empty filter on blacklist takes everything.
Der Flashjack späht in seinem Revier, ma: The Flashjack scouts its territory, marks enemies and can take over spell turrets to fire at them. Flashpine grows on &6Flashing Archwood&r: any archwood sapling with Air Essence.
Der Foliot gräbt ziellos und bringt alle: The Foliot digs aimlessly and brings everything it finds. It is slow but spares the lamp. Without a Mineshaft it does nothing, so carry straight on.
Der Fund leuchtet durch die Wände. Weiße: The find glows through the walls. White crystals mean nothing found; the more purple, the closer. Set to leaves or wood, it leads you to an Otherworld Grove.
Der Funksender sitzt am Kabel und reicht: The Wireless Transmitter sits on the cable and reaches &e16 blocks&r, each &6Range Upgrade&r (five enriched iron, three ender pearls, an Upgrade) adds 8 blocks. It needs 16 FE/t. Several transmitters cover a whole base.
Der Funkturm braucht &e90 Beton&r, der R: The Radio Tower needs &e90 concrete&r, the Resonanz Observer 9. The stonecutter turns concrete into bricks, tiles and slabs.
Der Gaia-Geistbarren ist das Bindeglied:: The Gaia Spirit Ingot is the link: the mages hand it in, the techs need it for every fusion of Awakened Draconium.
Der Geist ändert das Wetter einmal und v: The spirit changes the weather once and disappears. You need thunderstorms for charged creepers and some mob farms. Say so in chat beforehand.
Der Geist ändert die Welt einmal und ver: The spirit changes the world once and disappears. Time and weather apply to everyone; coordinate on the server. Rain and thunderstorms are only summoned by Afrit (stage 3).
Der Gem steckt in der Wünschelrute, den: The gem goes into the Divination Rod, the lenses, the Magic Lamp and, four in a square, into the &bSpirit Attuned Crystal&r for big pentacles.
The ghast cries when it falls.
Der Glücksspieler tauscht Edelsteine geg: The gambler trades gems for random gems or nuggets, rarely Iesnium, and leaves after 30 minutes. The partner cooks food and extends potions; the bond is permanent.
Der Golem erntet Amethyst in &e10 Blöcke: The golem harvests amethyst within &e10 blocks&r of its home, turns amethyst blocks into budding amethyst and makes buds grow faster. The bookwyrm extends the &6Storage Lectern&r (lectern, 4 chests): &e8&r more connected inventories per wyrm, up to &e30 blocks&r away.
Der Golem erscheint in der Nähe. Leite i: The golem appears nearby. Guide it with water to a spot where lava hits it. A golem drops &e3 to 5 iron ingots&r, a hopper below collects them.
Der Grundbaustein aller großen Maschinen: The building block of every large machine.
Der Guardian-Vertraute opfert ein Glied,: The Guardian Familiar sacrifices a limb when you would die. The possessed Shulker needs dragon's breath and comes in stage 4.
Der Gürtel bremst jeden Fall stark ab, u: The belt slows every fall a lot, and fall damage drops to a &dquarter&r. Anyone who builds a lot in caves and on towers takes it first.
The hammer for dirt and sand.
Der Hammer hält &e100&r Anwendungen. Er: The hammer lasts for &e100&r uses. It also makes plates and sets the sides of accumulators, so build a second one right away.
The trade has to run automatically.
Der Heimweg führt immer durchs &6Portal: The way home always leads through the &6portal at the arrival square&r, or through any Mine Portal you build over there yourself. You come out in front of the portal you went through.
Der Hirsch gibt Tempo und Sprungkraft un: The deer gives speed and jump boost and lets you walk up whole blocks. Whoever travels on foot a lot takes it first.
Der Ignited Revenant trägt den Schlüssel: The Ignited Revenant carries the key.
Der Importbus zieht alles aus dem Invent: The Import Bus pulls everything out of the inventory in front of it into the network, the Export Bus pushes the items you set out of it. Together they automate a furnace: export in at the top, import out at the bottom.
Der Incubator macht aus jedem Sulfur mit: The Incubator makes one &6diamond&r from each Sulfur with Mineral Salt and a Mercury Shard. A finished diamond only gives one Sulfur back, so never dissolve diamonds, always the ore.
Der Infusionsaltar startet nicht nur mit: The Infusion Altar does not only start with the &6Wand&r: a &eredstone signal&r on the altar does the same once the recipe lies on the pedestals.
Der Inhalt bleibt beim Hochstufen an der: The contents stay when you upgrade at the crafting table.
Der Jäger lässt &6Wilden-Hörner&r fallen: The Hunter drops &6Wilden Horns&r, the Stalker &6Wings&r, the Guardian &6Spikes&r. Wings go into Air Essence and Leap, horns into Conjuration Essence and the Drygmy.
Der Kampf findet in der Luft und über de: The fight takes place in the air and over the abyss. The Guardian's shield has &e16,000&r points, and Draconic Evolution itself says that a fast, strong bow melts it best.
Der Kampf, wie Draconic Evolution ihn ba: The fight as Draconic Evolution builds it.
Der Katalog verwaltet eine Kette aneinan: The catalog manages a chain of Repositories placed next to each other as a single inventory and is easy on the server while doing so. For large storage it is better than many single chests at the lectern.
Der Kern allein tut nichts. Auf ihn komm: The core on its own does nothing. In the next step the apparatus goes on top of it.
The core of the wireless cells.
Der Kernsynthesizer macht aus &e64 Leere: The Nucleosynthesizer makes one &3UU Matter&r from &e64 Empty Crystals&r and 2 mB of antimatter.
Der Klassiker: Ein ME-Tunnel braucht sel: The classic: an ME tunnel needs a channel itself, but carries all 32 channels of the dense cable at its input. That way you bring many channels through a thin cable. ME tunnels cannot be nested in each other.
The button that swaps the world.
Der Koksofen macht aus zwei Kohleblöcken: The Coke Oven turns two blocks of coal straight into one block of coke, with ten times the creosote of a load of loose coal.
Der Kollektor saugt aus allen Gläsern in: The collector draws from every jar within &e5 blocks&r, the depositor fills every jar within &e5 blocks&r. Collector at the link farm, depositor in the workshop, done.
Der Konstruktionskern steckt in allem, w: The Construction Core goes into everything that gives out of the network (Exporter, Constructor), the Destruction Core into everything that pulls in (Importer, Destructor). The Grid wants both, the Autocrafter on Kronwerke only the Destruction Core.
Der Konstruktor setzt den Block aus sein: The Constructor places the block from its filter into the world in front of it, the Destructor breaks what stands in front of it and puts it into the network. 3 FE/t each.
Der Kopf bestimmt Haltbarkeit, Tempo, Sc: The head decides durability, speed, damage and mining level. An iron head has 250 durability and speed 6 and mines diamond ore.
Der Kopf für den ersten Tag. Kostet nich: The head for the first day. Costs nothing.
Der Kristall lässt sich nicht abbauen, s: The crystal cannot be mined as long as the Guardian lives.
Der Kristall verdichtet Essenz: &e4 Infe: The crystal condenses essence: &e4 Inferium Essence&r around the crystal give &e1 Prudentium Essence&r, and so on tier by tier. But &cPrudentium&r is locked until &cstage 2&r, so you can build the crystal now and get started right away once the Brass Works opens.
The Copper Casing for everything fluid.
Der Köcher fasst &d6&r Stapel Pfeile, au: The quiver holds &d6&r stacks of arrows, tipped arrows too. Picked up arrows go into it on their own; you choose the kind to shoot with the quiver key.
Der Kürbis schränkt die Sicht ein. Für d: The pumpkin limits your view. For the dragon fight you swap it for a helmet.
Der Laser reicht weiter, du baust aus si: The laser reaches further, and you mine from a safe distance, across lava for example or at the ceiling of a large cave. Range II is also there in stage 3 already.
Der Laser zieht &d4 000 FE/t&r und brenn: The laser draws &d4,000 FE/t&r and burns everything away, you too. Lasers fire into the amplifier, which collects and fires at the Laser Focus Matrix, controlled by redstone and a threshold in its window.
Der Laser zielt auf Mobs statt Blöcke. &: The laser aims at mobs instead of blocks. &eShift&r right click with the designator to switch: all mobs, hostile and neutral, hostile only. Loot lands in the laser, experience does not.
Der Lederrucksack hat &e27 Plätze&r und: The leather backpack has &e27 slots&r and &eone upgrade slot&r. Open it with right click in hand or with &eB&r while it is in your inventory. A sneaking right click on the ground sets it down, the contents stay inside. Dyes in the crafting grid colour it.
Der Legierungsofen ist der billigste Mul: The Alloy Kiln is the cheapest multiblock of the mod and melts two metals into one.
Der Lichtbogenofen braucht 8 Blöcke und: The Arc Furnace needs 8 blocks and 14 slabs, the Excavator 16 blocks. From the Metal Press on, the plates come by themselves.
Der Link verbrennt alles, was brennt, un: The link burns anything that burns and fills the nearest jar with it. &6Archwood logs&r give a bonus, &cBlazing archwood&r the biggest.
The Logic Adapter saves your base.
The Blaze Burner heats for you.
The magnet from stage 4, only stronger.
Der Magnet sammelt alles ein, Void Junk: The magnet collects everything, Void Junk destroys cobblestone, dirt and the like. Remember: cobblestone counts for the obelisk only in stage 1. Against lava and water the &6Freezing&r upgrade helps.
Der Mahlstein mahlt kein Netherrack, daf: The millstone doesn't grind netherrack; you need the wheels for that.
Der Manaverzauberer ist ein Bauwerk von: The Mana Enchanter is a structure of about 11x7 blocks from &e17 obsidian&r, &e10 Mystical Flowers&r, &e6 Mana Pylons&r and a &6lapis block&r in the middle. The Lexica shows the exact plan. A right click with the Wand of the Forest on the lapis block awakens it.
Der Marid kommt aggressiv. Ruft ihn zu m: The Marid arrives aggressive. Summon it in a group. Defeated, it drops &9Marid Essence&r, more with Looting.
Der Markt verkauft Samen, Setzlinge, Blu: The market sells seeds, saplings, flowers and fertilizer for emeralds, including the wild plants from Farmer's Delight.
The milestone of the magic pillar.
Der Meilenstein der Magier, der &6Elfens: The mages' milestone, the &6Elven Star&r, needs one. The mages cannot make it themselves, bring them some. In stage 4 it goes into the Elite Control Circuit.
The milestone of the tech pillar.
The milestone of the Brass Works.
The milestone of the Steel Works.
Der Messingrahmen, Gerüst jeder schlauen: The brass casing, frame of every smart machine.
The engine of the pipe network.
The trash can that gives something back.
The Nether supplies what brass needs.
Der Obelisk will &e12&r, eine feste Zahl: The obelisk wants &e12&r, a fixed number. One counts &e250 points&r, as much as 125 Andesite Alloy. The twelve make up about half of the tech pillar.
Der Obelisk will &e12&r, fest. Einer zäh: The obelisk wants &e12&r, fixed. One counts &e250 points&r, as much as a good 60 Source Gems. The twelve make up almost half of the magic pillar.
The obelisk counts every single one.
Der Ofen braucht drei, und sie verschlei: The furnace needs three, and they wear out.
Der Ofen gibt sein Kreosot nicht selbst: The oven does not give its creosote away by itself, the pump pulls it out. With power it pumps much faster. Set the sides to input, output or closed with the hammer.
The furnace in the spell book.
Der Ofen schläft nie, der Autohersteller: The furnace never sleeps, and neither does the Autocrafter.
Der Ofen schläft nie, die Gravurmaschine: The furnace never sleeps, and neither does the Inscriber.
Der Oxidierer macht aus einem Stück 500: The Oxidizer turns one piece into 500 mB of UU Matter as a chemical. The replicators live on that.
Der Pfeil in der Mitte stellt die Richtu: The arrow in the middle sets the direction: out of the cell into the network or out of the network into the cell. Finished cells move to the output slots. That is how you move a full 1k cell over to a 16k cell.
Der Pfeil zeigt die Richtung, umgekehrte: The arrow shows the direction; reversed rotation pumps backwards. The more RPM, the more flow, at &d4 SU per RPM&r.
Der Piglin lässt &6Demonic Meat&r fallen: The Piglin drops &6Demonic Meat&r. Eaten, it gives fire resistance; three of them make pink chalk for Osorin's Unbound Calling.
The plus button puts the ingredients in.
The price of the first brass.
Der Provider schickt Zutaten und Rezept: The provider sends ingredients and recipe over, the assembler crafts and hands the result back. One provider can serve several assemblers around it. &6Acceleration Cards&r make it faster.
Der Provider schiebt die Zutaten einer S: The provider pushes the ingredients of a pattern into the block next to it and takes the result back. It needs one channel. Put your crafting pattern into it.
Der Rahmen für Kondensatoren und Garteng: The frame for accumulators and the Garden Cloche.
The frame for the gate to the farm world.
The frame for every machine of the mod.
Der Reaktor ist ein Quader. Alle Kanten: The reactor is a cuboid. All edges casing, the faces casing or glass. The smallest is 3 by 3 by 3. For 5 by 5 by 5 you need 98 shell blocks.
Der Reaktor macht aus Wasser und Samen,: The reactor turns water and seeds, saplings, dyes and heads into &dBiofuel&r. One kind gives 80 mB per piece, four different kinds 110 mB each. The generator makes &d160 FE/t&r from it and stops when its buffer of 1 million is full.
Der Reaktor spürt über das Myzelnetz dei: The reactor finds your other Mycelial Generators through the mycelial network. It produces huge amounts of power, but only while one of &eevery kind&r is running at the same time.
Der Ring ist selbst nur ein Rohling. Im: The ring itself is only a blank. In the apparatus it becomes the &6Ring of Lesser Discount&r (4 diamonds, 2 ender pearls, 2 Source Gems), which makes every spell cheaper, or the &6Ring of Jumping&r.
Der Ring senkt die Kosten jedes Zaubers: The ring lowers the cost of every spell and gives a little more mana and regeneration on top.
Der Ritus webt einen &eRite Locus&r, ein: The rite weaves a &eRite Locus&r, a wandering spark. Furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers it passes over smelt faster. The fuel lasts just as far as usual.
Der Ritus webt einen &eRite Locus&r. Übe: The rite weaves a &eRite Locus&r. Over crops it makes time run faster, other plants grow as if with bone meal. Over farmland it works on the plant on top.
Der Robit folgt dir, sammelt Gegenstände: The Robit follows you, picks up items and charges itself on a Chargepad. Above all it is the heart of the Digital Miner.
The raw material for every Source Gem.
Der Rohstoff, um den sich diese Stufe dr: The raw material this stage revolves around.
The body of the basic machines.
Der Schild blockt wie der aus Vanilla, s: The shield blocks like the vanilla one, its durability comes from the material. It is repaired with a Repair Kit like every Silent Gear part.
Der Schild des Chaoswächters schmilzt la: According to Draconic Evolution the Chaos Guardian's shield melts fastest under a strong bow that fires fast.
Der Schild des Wächters hat 16 000 Punkt: The Guardian's shield has 16,000 points and can be hit as fast as you shoot. The more bows fire at once, the shorter the fight.
Der Schraubenschlüssel stellt ein Signal: The wrench switches a signal. The &eentry signal&r lets a train into the next free section. The &echain signal&r waits until the way is free up to the signal after next.
Der Seelenstein steckt in Zauberstäben u: The soul gem goes into wands and the Sanguine Amulet. With a Soul Gem on the brazier you recharge empty wands.
Der Shadow Gem ist der Kern des Soulfire: The Shadow Gem is the core of the Soulfire Wand and of the Wicked Weave for the Warlock armor.
Der Sitz kommt in den Satchel-Platz. Ein: The seat goes into the satchel slot. A second player can get on and fly along. If you sit alone, you sit on it and look ahead.
Der Soul Binder macht Spawner-Rezepte un: The Soul Binder makes Ender IO's spawner recipes and soul items. Build it yourself or bring the ingots to the tech people.
Der Spawner schaut in die &6Eindämmungsg: The spawner looks into the &6Containment Jars&r near it and creates the same creatures. Each creature costs source from jars next to it, a different amount depending on the kind.
The storage bus turns chests into cells.
Der Stab schaltet Logistik-Blöcke an und: The wand turns logistics blocks on and off and picks the side they push into or pull from.
Der Stab verflucht das Ziel mit eisigem: The wand curses the target with an icy grip: as with a Wraith's claws, it no longer regenerates health. You recharge empty wands with a Soul Gem on the brazier.
Der Stand braut Tränke wie ein Braustand: The stand brews potions like a brewing stand but needs no &6blaze powder&r as fuel. Handy as long as you have no blaze farm yet. You make the healing potion for the Ritual of Purifying and the harming potion for the Sanguine rituals right here.
Der Standard für Stufe 1. Baut Diamanter: The standard for stage 1. Mines diamond ore.
Der Staub gibt nur 10 mB. Schick ihn ers: The dust gives only 10 mB. Send it through the Enrichment Chamber first, &6Enriched Obsidian&r gives 80 mB, enough for two alloys.
Der Staub ist die Hauptzutat der Limette: The dust is the main ingredient of lime chalk, and that goes into every Djinni pentacle.
Der Staub schmilzt im Ofen oder Hochofen: The dust smelts in a furnace or blast furnace into one &6netherite scrap&r each. One find thus gives two or three scraps instead of one.
The stone for pools and altars.
The stuff magicians are made of.
The stuff journeys are made of.
The power for the whole network.
The ammeter sits in series in the circuit. That way you see whether the generator sags under load or a wire carries too much.
Der Stutzer fällt ganze Bäume mit Laub a: The Truncator fells whole trees with leaves in one hit. While sneaking it works like a normal axe.
The stator makes the magnetic field.
Der Tachometer zeigt die Drehzahl an sei: The speedometer shows the speed at its spot, the stressometer the free capacity of the whole network. Both give a redstone signal that a comparator reads.
Der Tank behält seinen Inhalt beim Abbau: The tank keeps its contents when mined. A tank of lava next to the Heat Generator is a good reserve.
The tech pillar of the Chaos Works.
The part you hold in your hand.
Der Timer feuert von selbst, ab Werk jed: The timer fires by itself, every second by default. Right click longer, hit shorter, while sneaking in 10 second steps. Projectile, Touch, Sensitive and Redstone Signal cost it nothing.
Der Trümmerer saugt Mana auf wie eine Ta: The Shatterer soaks up mana like a tablet in a pool and rises in rank from D to SS as it does. A sneaking right click switches on its ability: from rank C it mines a narrow column, from B a square, after that ever larger areas.
Der Turm löst die Kombos seines Fokus au: The turret triggers the combos of its focus, and spells with a glyph of its school cost it &e65 percent&r less source. A &dFlashjack&r can hijack it and aim it at enemies itself.
Der Umhang halbiert Magie- und Withersch: The cloak halves magic and wither damage. The hat gives &d50 percent&r more magic and wither damage, the boots make you immune to slowness.
Der Vertraute kommt mit neuem Körper zur: The familiar returns with a new body. In the same circle a Vex becomes an Allay with redstone, glowstone, silver and gold dust and sugar as the start.
Der Vorteil: Er braucht keinen Strom. Mi: The advantage: it needs no power. With coal blocks from a tree farm it heats up the boiler before the turbine even runs.
Der Weg geht Stufe für Stufe: ein &6Quar: The way goes tier by tier: a &6quartz block&r at the top, two capacitors of the new tier left and right of the casing, the rod below at the bottom. First Blazing, then Niotic, then &aSpirited&r.
Der Weg zum Erzmagier führt durch einen: The way to archmage leads through a boss fight.
Der Wireless Router reicht veröffentlich: The Wireless Router passes published channels on to other Wireless Routers without a cable. With the antenna it reaches &e100 blocks&r, with the &6Antenna Dish&r (iron trapdoors, ender pearl, iron) &e500&r. Every channel costs 20 or 50 RF per tick.
Der Wixie füllt &e3 Dosen&r pro Durchgan: The Wixie fills &e3 doses&r per round into the jar. The &6Alchemical Sourcelink&r (brewing stand instead of lava bucket) makes Source from potions in jars next to it; complex potions give more.
The Wyvern Tree Harvester for the axe.
The guardian of the trial chambers.
Der Zauberer schützt am wenigsten, hat a: The Sorcerer protects least but has the best thread slots: chest and leggings already have a size 2 slot without an upgrade. Battlemage is the opposite, Arcanist in between.
Der Zerkleinerer mit Installateur. Gut f: The Crusher with an installer. Good for bio fuel and obsidian dust.
Der Zusammenbautisch des Mods: bis zu &e: The mod's assembly table: up to &eeight items&r and &eone fluid&r, shapeless. Frames, lenses, addons and Pink Slime Ingots are made here. It draws &d90 FE/t&r.
Der Zusatz wählt das Ziel: Netherziegel: The addition picks the destination: Nether bricks fortress, polished blackstone bricks bastion, emerald outpost, mossy cobblestone jungle temple, sandstone desert temple, deepslate bricks ancient city, Source Gem Wilden den. The Wayfinder then shows the way.
Der beste Kondensator, den du bauen kann: The best capacitor you can craft. In chests you sometimes find &6Loot Capacitors&r with values of their own, the tooltip shows them.
Der blaue Balken unten links ist dein Ma: The blue bar at the bottom left is your mana. A spell costs the sum of its glyphs, and mana refills on its own.
The only way to Cursed Honey.
The only way to Source Gems.
Der erste Einsatz merkt sich das Werkzeu: The first use remembers the tool you are looking at. Each further use gives you a copy with little durability. Costs &d1,000 mana&r per use.
Der erste Manastahl wächst an einem Baum: The first Manasteel grows on a tree.
The first step of the ore line.
The first step into Nature's Aura.
The first step towards the blaze cake.
The first step toward Quantum Alloy.
The first shared boss of the season.
Der gibt 10 Seelen für jeden, 16 für den: That one gives 10 spirits each, 16 for the last hit, plus runes, Manasteel, Mana Pearls, lotus blossoms and a &6Dice of Fate&r for one of the relics of the Aesir.
Der graue Stein, aus dem fast alles hier: The grey stone almost everything here is made from.
Der große Fokus verstärkt seine Schule,: The greater focus strengthens its school without weakening the others. &cFire&r: Spell Damage II while you burn. &bWater&r: mana regeneration when you are wet. &fAir&r: mana regeneration above Y 200. &aEarth&r: mana regeneration below Y 0.
Der große Ring senkt die Kosten jedes Za: The greater ring lowers the cost of every spell a bit more than the lesser one. With the long spells of the archmage book you notice it with every cast.
The heated mixer can cook too.
The last bush in the garden.
The next heat sink after water.
The right hook for every catch.
The quick way back, free of charge.
The fastest broom in the sky.
Der schnellste der drei. Als Item ist er: The fastest of the three. As an item it is fireproof like netherite. That does not protect you when flying through lava, the netherite tip is for that.
The strongest spirit you can summon.
The strongest shield of the season.
Der teuerste der drei, und der wichtigst: The most expensive of the three, and the most important.
Der zerbrechliche Seelenstein trägt ein: The fragile soul gem carries a creature once, then it breaks. It goes into the real Soul Gem. The compass points to a creature you clicked with it. The tablet stores your experience (right click) and gives it back (sneaking right click).
Der zweite Weg ist die Imbuement-Kammer: The second way is the Imbuement Chamber from Ars Nouveau: 2,000 source, redstone and glowstone on the pedestals, only one per run.
The same storage, made from essence.
Derselbe Trick vermehrt Certus: ein gela: The same trick multiplies certus: a charged crystal and a &6Certus Quartz Dust&r in water give two normal crystals.
Deshalb kommt der Motor erst nach dem Ge: That is why the motor only comes after the generator.
Diamanten brauchst du für Zaubertisch, O: You need diamonds for the enchanting table, obsidian, Silent Gear and some magic devices.
Diamantstaub macht der Zerkleinerer aus: The Crusher makes diamond dust from a diamond.
Die &2Fae&r schweben nahe Leylinien, ihr: The &2Fae&r float near leylines, their laughter sounds like little bells. You can only see them with Fay Sight. Defeated, they drop &2Fae Essence&r. With a powder they can be bred.
Die &5Chaosinseln&r liegen im End in ein: The &5Chaos Islands&r lie in the End on a grid of &e10,000 blocks&r, each with about a 160 block radius, with the &5Chaos Crystal&r at height 80. For the finale the obelisk takes everyone there.
Die &5Wächterkristalle&r rund um die Ins: The &5Guardian Crystals&r around the island protect the Guardian. Each has a shield of &e512&r. If an attack by the Guardian itself hits it, the shield is unstable for &e10 seconds&r. Then strike.
Die &6Bohrmaschine&r steht über einer Er: The &6drilling machine&r stands over an ore vein, gets a drill and rotation and brings up raw ore as long as it turns. The veins are inexhaustible on Kronwerke.
Die &6Breithacke&r pflügt Ackerland, grä: The &6mattock&r tills farmland, digs dirt and fells wood. A bit slower than shovel or axe, but more durable, and it counts wherever a hoe is asked for.
Die &6Chaining Prism Lens&r (Apparat: Qu: The &6Chaining Prism Lens&r (apparatus: quartz, Manipulation Essence, source gem block, blank parchment) is inscribed at the table and attaches its glyphs to every projectile that passes through. That costs source depending on the spell.
Die &6Codex Entry&r aus der Truhe bringt: The &6Codex Entry&r from the chest teaches you a random glyph when used.
Die &6Drakonische Brustplatte&r mit mind: The &6Draconic Chestpiece&r with at least one &6Draconic Undying Module&r: it catches one deadly hit, then recharges. Fill the rest of the grid with shield modules and energy.
Die &6Einfache Kondensatorbank&r fasst &: The &6Basic Capacitor Bank&r holds &e500,000 µI&r. Several next to each other become one storage. Advanced holds 2 million, Vibrant 4 million, both also as an upgrade of the bank below them.
Die &6Extended Inscriber&r arbeitet vier: The &6Extended Inscriber&r works four inscriptions at the same time. There are also the &6Extended Molecular Assembler&r (eight jobs at once) and the &6ME Extended IO Port&r (eight times as fast).
Die &6Farmwelt&r ist eine eigene Welt zu: The &6farm world&r is a world of its own for digging. There you may make as many holes as you want, and the overworld stays beautiful.
Die &6Feldflasche&r (Zinn um eine Schüss: You fill the &6Canteen&r (tin around a bowl) with it and drink on the way. Later there is a MekaSuit module for it.
Die &6Fernsteuerung&r (sechs Holzknöpfe: The &6Linked Controller&r (six wooden buttons around a Redstone Link) transmits each key on its own frequency.
Die &6Flammende Erchidee&r macht dasselb: The &6Orechid Ignem&r does the same with netherrack, but only in the Nether.
Die &6Formkarte&r in die Mitte, oben ein: The &6Shape Card&r in the middle, a &6water bucket&r at the top, a &6lava bucket&r at the bottom, an empty &6bucket&r left and right, &6redstone&r in the corners.
The &6Shape Card&r in the middle, a &6diamond pickaxe&r at the top, a &6diamond shovel&r at the bottom, &6iron&r left and right, &6redstone&r in the corners.
Die &6Gießkanne&r in die Mitte, &e4 Infe: The &6Watering Can&r in the middle, &e4 Inferium Ingots&r left, right, top and bottom, &e4 Mystical Fertilizer&r in the corners: the &6Inferium Watering Can&r is done.
Die &6Herstellungskonsole&r hat ein Werk: The &6Crafting Grid&r has a crafting area that pulls straight from the network. Shift clicking the result crafts a whole stack. It needs 14 FE/t.
Die &6Hängematte&r (Wolle, Faden, Stöcke: The &6Hammock&r (wool, string, sticks) does the same for the day. Any color works.
Die &6Ignitium-Vorlage&r: Netherit-Schmi: The &6Ignitium template&r: netherite smithing template in the middle, &64 blaze powder&r on the sides, &64 Nether brick blocks&r in the corners. At the smithing table, with an Ignitium ingot it turns netherite armour into Ignitium armour.
Die &6Infused Lenses&r stecken in den &6: The &6Infused Lenses&r go into the &6Otherworld Goggles&r from the chapter &5Occultism: Afrit and Marid&r. Binding them now saves you a step in stage 3.
Die &6Konfigurationskarte&r speichert di: The &6Configuration Card&r stores a device's settings, with filters and modes, and transfers them to another device of the same kind. That way you set up twenty Exporters with the same filter in a minute.
Die &6Konsole&r zeigt alles im Netz. Lin: The &6Grid&r shows everything in the network. Left click takes a stack, right click one item, shift click from the inventory puts in. It needs 10 FE/t.
Die &6ME Extended Import Bus&r und &6Exp: The &6ME Extended Import Bus&r and &6Export Bus&r move &d8 times&r as much as the normal ones and have more card slots. Just right for the quarry that dumps into your network.
Die &6Machete&r ist vor allem ein Schwer: The &6machete&r is above all a sword, a bit faster and weaker than the normal one. On top of that it fells wood and mows plants around the block like a sickle, just over a smaller area. Just right for the jungle.
Die &6Prosperiumsamenbasis&r in den Alta: The &6Prosperity Seed Base&r into the altar. On the pedestals alternating &e4 Inferium Essence&r and &e4 stone&r (smelted stone, not cobblestone). Wand on the altar, and the &6Stone Seeds&r are done.
Die &6Ruined Citadel&r von Cataclysm ste: Cataclysm's &6Ruined Citadel&r only stands in the End Highlands and Midlands. Inside wait Ender Golems, Endermapteras and at the end the &cEnder Guardian&r.
Die &6Schnittstelle&r ist ein voller Blo: The &6Interface&r is a full block with slots of its own: a row where everything goes that should go into the network, and slots where it keeps configured items ready from the network. Hoppers, Create belts or Mekanism transporters use it like a chest. It needs 4 FE/t.
Die &6Seed Mixture&r ist das Lieblingsfu: The &6Seed Mixture&r is the crows' favourite food and the way to tame them.
Die &6Sichel&r (3 Diamanten im Bogen, ei: The &6Sickle&r (3 diamonds in an arc, a stick bottom left) is the counterpart: it mows away grass, leaves and plants around you. The Prudentium Scythe harvests 9 by 9, from stage 2.
Die &6Sternlicht-Ladestation&r sammelt n: The &6Starlight Charger&r collects charge at night when it can see the sky. Catalyst I is Blaze Gold dust, II Azure Silver dust, III starmetal dust.
Die &6Steuerungsschiene&r (Gold, Stock,: The &6Controller Rail&r (gold, stick, Electron Tube, six pieces) sets its speed by signal strength. For short routes in the mine it is cheaper than a train.
Die &6Synergie&r im Tooltip sinkt, je un: The &6synergy&r in the tooltip drops the more different the materials are. &6Rustic&r (paper, terracotta) lifts a low synergy, &6Synergistic&r (emerald) rewards a high one.
Die &6Trankflasche&r hält &d8 Ladungen&r: The &6Potion Flask&r holds &d8 charges&r of one potion. You fill it shapeless: flask and potion together at the crafting table. From stage 2 a Potion Jar fills it too.
Die &6Urn of Endless Waters&r kommt aus: The &6Urn of Endless Waters&r comes from the &dArs Nouveau&r Enchanting Apparatus: &6flower pot&r in the middle, &6Source Gem&r, &e2 Water Essences&r and &e2 prismarine shards&r on the pedestals.
Die &aMyzel-Generatoren&r sind eine Fami: The &aMycelial Generators&r are a family: each kind eats a different fuel, and all of them together drive the Mycelial Reactor in the end.
Die &bManadiamanten&r infundierst du im: You infuse the &bMana Diamonds&r in Botania's Mana Pool, &d10,000 mana&r each. The Gold Leaf comes from your golden tree.
Die &eBossleiste&r oben zeigt das aktive: The &eboss bar&r at the top shows the active goal. In stage 1 it is called &6The Foundation of the Kronwerk&r and has three pillars: &7Stone&r, &6Tech&r and &dMagic&r.
Die 1x1-Schublade speichert genau &eeine: The 1x1 drawer stores exactly &eone kind&r, &e32 stacks&r of it, so 2,048 cobblestone. &eRight click&r puts in, &edouble click&r everything matching from the inventory, &eleft click&r takes one, &esneaking left click&r a stack.
Die 63 Typen bleiben. Große Zellen lohne: The 63 types stay. Large cells pay off for a few kinds in huge amounts: cobblestone, ores, everything from the quarry.
Die 64k-Komponente will einen Himmelsbar: The 64k component wants a sky ingot from Nature's Aura. From 16M on it needs awakened draconium, which comes in stage 5.
The shelf the stamp comes down on.
The antimatter from the SPS is a gas. The &6Chemical Crystallizer&r makes an &5antimatter pellet&r from &e1,000 mB&r.
The work surface for knife and hammer.
Die Artisanal Satchel aus Stufe 3 zeichn: The Artisanal Satchel from stage 3 draws the whole pentacle in one click.
Die Aufzug-Seilrolle hält an Stockwerken: The Elevator Pulley stops at floors.
The outer skin of almost every machine.
Your base works while you chat.
Die Basis für Impetus, Ringe und viele B: The base for Impetus, rings and many parts.
The Bounty Board pays in emeralds.
Die Beschreibung steht direkt im Tooltip: The description is right in the tooltip.
The loot lands right in your inventory.
Die Biene vergiftet immer, sticht schnel: The bee always poisons, stings faster and calls for backup. Come in armour. Defeated, it drops &6Cursed Honey&r, the ingredient of orange chalk.
Die Blockhead-Küche und die besten Mahlz: The Blockhead kitchen and the best meals.
Die Blätter stecken in der normalen Bese: The leaves are in the normal broom brush, the flowers in the Enhanced Brush. Dried, both belong in the crow ankh.
Die Blöcke von Stufe 2 stehen im Kapitel: The stage 2 blocks are in the &6Immersive Engineering&r chapter.
Die Bosse der Oberwelt in der Reihenfolg: The bosses of the Overworld in the order you can beat them. Best with two or three people.
Die Botaniker liefern das Metall des Dra: The botanists supply the dragon's metal.
Die Brille gibt dauerhaften Third Eye oh: The goggles give permanent Third Eye without side effects. With them you see Iesnium ore in netherrack. You can only mine it with an Infused or Iesnium Pickaxe.
Die Bulette brätst du im Ofen aus &6Hack: You grill the patty in the furnace from &6minced beef&r, which the knife cuts from raw beef at the cutting board.
Die Bäume wachsen in vier Farben, jede g: The trees grow in four colours, each belonging to a school of Ars Nouveau. No forest nearby? At the Farming for Blockheads &6Market&r every sapling costs one emerald.
Die CNC Stamper in die Mitte des Install: The CNC Stamper in the middle of the installer pattern (redstone, circuits, iron) gives the &6Basic Stamping Factory&r. With Advanced Control Circuits it becomes advanced.
Die CNC Stamper in die Mitte, Elite-Scha: The CNC Stamper in the middle, Elite Control Circuits left and right, pistons at the top and bottom, Reinforced Alloy in the corners.
Die CPU bleibt ein volles Rechteck. Füll: The CPU stays a full cuboid. If you fill gaps with Crafting Units, it may have any shape.
Die CPU ist ein volles Rechteck ohne Lüc: The CPU is a full cuboid without gaps, with at least one storage. Co-processing units make it faster. One CPU, one order at a time.
Die Chaosinsel ist groß, und der Wächter: The Chaos Island is big, and the Guardian flies.
Die Chaosinsel liegt Tausende Blöcke vom: The Chaos Island lies thousands of blocks from the center of the End. Whoever dies wakes up at their spawn point. Save the island in the Dislocator right on arrival, then you are back quickly.
Die Chemical Card bewegt Mekanism-Gase w: The Chemical Card moves Mekanism gases such as hydrogen or chlorine between machines, with no pressurized tubes at all.
Die Drehzahl holst du mit Zahnrädern zur: You get the speed back with cogwheels: large onto small makes 8 RPM, one more step 16. The SU stay the same.
Die Elite-Stufe macht das noch einmal ac: The Elite tier does that eight times again: 204.8 billion FE per cell, a good 6.5 million FE/t per provider. Just swap old cells, the shell stays standing.
The ender chest in your pocket.
Die Erze liegen in der Oberwelt zwischen: The ores lie in the Overworld between height -60 and 60. &6Uranium&r for fuel, &6boron&r for ferroboron, &6lithium&r for the tough alloy. &6Thorium&r is a second, gentler fuel.
Die Essenz, aus der dieser Mod gemacht i: The essence this mod is made of.
Die Farbe hängt vom Frosch ab: der orang: The colour depends on the frog: the orange frog from the swamp makes &6Ochre Froglight&r, the green one from cold biomes green, the white one from warm biomes pearlescent. Froglight is a bright light source that looks good.
Die Farm füllt die Truhe, du trägst sie: The farm fills the chest, you carry it over.
Die Farmwelt ist dafür ideal, dort bleib: The farm world is ideal for this; there the landscape around the bases stays intact. Whoever only hoards zinc stands at the mixer with an empty copper chest.
Die Farmwelt ist offen. Die anderen Welt: The farm world is open. The other worlds come with the stages: &cNether&r and &bAether&r in stage 2, &2Undergarden&r and &3Otherside&r in stage 3, &5End&r and &bEternal Starlight&r in stage 4.
Die Farmwelt wird &calle drei Tage um 4:: The farm world is reset &cevery three days at 4:45&r. The tab list counts down, and chat warns beforehand. Whoever is over there then travels home with everything they carry.
Die Feuerkerze gehört neben die Lava-Kes: The fire candle belongs next to the lava cauldrons and in the Nether camp, the water candle at the underwater building site. There is no night vision candle in this version, its recipe makes water breathing as well.
Die Feuerrune macht ein Botaniker am Run: A botanist makes the Rune of Fire at the Runic Altar (&aBotania: Runes&r chapter). Trade brass casings for it.
Die Flasche fasst &e24 000 mB Sauerstoff: The tank holds &e24,000 mB of oxygen&r. Filling like the jetpack: put it into the item slot of a Chemical Tank full of oxygen. The Electrolytic Separator supplies the oxygen.
Die Flöte steuert alle Krähen in der Näh: The flute commands all crows nearby or up to 9 chosen ones and sets perches.
Die Frucht zündet &dSpiritfire&r, heilt: The fruit lights &dSpiritfire&r, heals spirits (right click the spirit) and, eaten, gives the &5Third Eye&r with some luck. Lay out a small field right away, you need many.
Die Fusion zieht &e50 Millionen&r Energi: The fusion draws &e50 million&r energy. Hook the injectors to your Energy Core, otherwise you wait a long time.
Die Gangschaltung, vor und zurück per He: The gearshift, forward and back with a lever.
Die Gegenstände der &enächsten Stufe&r s: The items of the &enext stage&r are already in the EMI list, veiled with the dark slot and question mark. With &eR&r you still see their recipe and can &eplan ahead&r: zinc for brass, for example, can already be mined and stored in stage 1.
The generator coupling, 32 SU per RPM.
Die Gleise legst du Stück für Stück vor: The tracks you lay piece by piece in front of it. The &6Mechanical Roller&r from &6Create: Brass&r paves the bed as well.
Die Gravurmaschine (oder der Brecher von: The Inscriber (or Mekanism's Crusher) grinds them into &6Quantum Infused Dust&r.
Die Grundlage aller Leitungen und der En: The base of every conduit and of Energetic Alloy. A stack is gone fast.
The base for hand and mechanism.
The base of everything in Powah.
The base plate of almost every machine.
The base plate for every upgrade.
The base ingredient for almost everything.
Die Güte der Kerne entscheidet, wie viel: The quality of the cores decides how many &6Addon Extenders&r a machine can take. The machine's tooltip names cores and addon slots.
Die Helfer-Fäden aus je 3 Scherben: &6St: The helper threads from 3 tokens each: &6Starbuncle&r 20 percent faster, &6Whirlisprig&r more saturation, &6Wixie&r longer potions, &6Drygmy&r more loot.
Die Herkunft &dQuellgeborene&r gibt &e+5: The &dSourceborn&r origin gives &e+50&r maximum mana in Ars Nouveau and &e+50&r in Iron's Spells. In return you have &cone heart less&r and can't wear iron, gold, diamond or netherite armour.
The shell of the fission reactor.
The shell of the largest battery.
Die Hülle ist ein hohler Quader aus Gehä: The shell is a hollow cuboid of casing and structural glass, at least 3 by 3 by 3. One port takes power in, set a second one to output with the Configurator.
The shell around a piece of world.
Die Induktionsmatrix für Milliarden FE b: The Induction Matrix for billions of FE needs Elite Control Circuits and lithium and comes in stage 4.
Die Infusionsanlage mit Installateur. Al: The Metallurgic Infuser with an installer. All three slots share one tank of infusion type, so one factory per type.
Die Insel hat rund 160 Blöcke Radius, de: The island has a radius of about 160 blocks, the Chaos Crystal stands in the middle at height 80. Save it in the Dislocator right away.
The chamber can do more than gems.
Die Kanone nimmt Tränke aus Flaschen und: The cannon takes potions from bottles and potion flasks in your inventory and fires them as splash potions. Which one, you choose in the selection wheel.
Die Karte führt zu Krypten, Ruinen, eine: The map leads to crypts, ruins, an ancient city and other places of the mod. Taverns come in eleven styles, from oak to mangrove.
Die Karte von AE2 Wireless Terminals läs: The card from AE2 Wireless Terminals lets wireless terminals connect through a quantum bridge, with no range limit.
Die Kette: Bohrer, Mahlstein, Mahlwerkrä: The chain: drill, millstone, crushing wheels. Cobblestone in, sand out. Diorite between the wheels gives Nether quartz with 25 percent.
Die Kette: Bruchstein in den &6Mahlstein: The chain: cobblestone into the &6Millstone&r, the gravel in front of a &6fan&r with water. Gravel washing gives flint with &e25 percent&r and an iron nugget with &e12.5 percent&r.
Die Kiste füllt ihre 9 Plätze von links: The crate fills its 9 slots from top left to bottom right. A placeholder stands for an empty slot. Once all 9 slots are filled, it crafts at once and throws out the result, placeholders and leftovers.
Die Kohle fällt von selbst: The coal falls on its own
The power of the Shadow Gem in your hand.
The war machine of the Nether.
Die Kugel lädt Gegenstände mit Strom, bi: The orb charges items with power until they change. Open it and put the ingredients in, EMI shows all recipes with their FE need under &eEnergizing&r.
Die Lampe kommt in den Mineshaft, die Fu: The lamp goes into the Mineshaft, the finds come out at the bottom. The Djinni searches for ores on purpose and wears the lamp out faster than the Foliot. Empty the Mineshaft with a hopper, otherwise it throws finds away.
Die Lava verbraucht sich dabei nicht. &6: The lava is not used up. &6Fire&r instead of lava smokes food like a smoker.
Die Leitung muss mit dem Reaktor wachsen: The line has to grow with the reactor.
Die Lexica projiziert das Muster auf der: On the Terrasteel page the Lexica projects the pattern into the world as a preview.
Die Lexica rät zu verzauberter &dElement: The Lexica recommends enchanted &dElementium armor&r and a &aTerra Blade&r, plus brews and baubles.
Die Lexica zeigt den Rahmen als Vorschau: The Lexica shows the frame as a preview you can project into the world. Build it block by block.
Die Liste rechts in jedem Inventar ist &: The list on the right of every inventory is &6JEI&r. Hover over an item, whether in the list or in your inventory, and press &eR&r: EMI shows you every way to make it. &eU&r shows you everything it is used for.
The logic in every brass machine.
Die Lohe ist der beliebteste Schaffner,: The blaze is the most popular conductor, it needs nothing and does not run away. A mob on a lead you put on the seat with a click.
Die Loren mit Truhe sind Lootr-Loren. Hö: The minecarts with chests are Lootr minecarts. &6YUNG's Better Caves&r reshapes caves, so expect big halls and deep cracks.
Die Magie-Säule: &e800 Quelljuwelen&r (a: The magic pillar: &e800 Source Gems&r (scaled to the number of players) and &e12 Source Keystones&r. One keystone counts for a good 60 gems: &e4 Source Gem blocks&r, Source Jar, 2 mana diamonds from Botania, andesite alloy, Gold Leaf from Nature's Aura. Recipe in the &6Start here&r chapter.
Die Magier brauchen deine Messingrahmen,: The magicians need your brass casings, you need their Source Gems and Runes of Fire. At 98 percent the obelisk stops; the last load goes in together on the streams.
Die Magier brauchen deine Verstärkte Leg: The mages need your Reinforced Alloy for the Elven Stars, you need their elementium for the Steel Cores.
Die Magierroben aus Stufe 3 zählen nicht: The sorcerer robes from stage 3 do not count as heavy armour. Leather until then, then robes.
Die Maschine läuft &eachtmal so schnell&: The machine runs &eeight times as fast&r until the burst gauge is empty, 12 seconds per addon. After that it runs throttled until it has cooled down. Good for bursts of work, bad for continuous running.
Die Maschine läuft, auch wenn du weg bis: The machine runs even when you are away.
Die Matrix über die Basis an der Werkban: The matrix over the base at the crafting table, done.
