Die MekaSuit gleitet dann wie mit Elytra: The MekaSuit then glides as with an elytra, without giving up the chest slot. Per the config it costs 12,800 FE per second of flight.
Die Mimik-Schriftrolle kommt in einen Ra: The Mimic scroll goes into a frame on a chest: then only items that are already in the chest end up there. That way a Starbuncle sorts a whole storage room.
The mine is there to be cleared out.
Die Mitte jeder Gegenstandsleitung. Acht: The middle of every item conduit. Eight nuggets around a &6diamond&r make the &6Pulsating Crystal&r for the Vacuum Chest and the Travel Anchor.
Die Muster aus Kreide, Kerzen und Schäde: The patterns of chalk, candles and skulls are called &5pentacles&r. On every ritual page in the Dictionary a blue link at the top leads to the matching pentacle, with a preview in the world.
Die Netto-Hitze im Controller muss bei n: The net heat in the controller has to be at zero or below, otherwise it rises until meltdown.
Die Paxel gräbt Stein, Holz und Erde mit: The paxel mines stone, wood and dirt with one tool and saves two hotbar slots. It costs three finished Inferium tools, so 6 ingots and 6 gemstones. With a paxel you no longer need the three single tools.
Die Pellets kommen aus NuclearCraft, sie: The pellets come from NuclearCraft, see the fusion section.
The arrows fit bow and crossbow. The material of the head decides the damage.
Die Pilzvariante kommt ganz ohne Tiere a: The mushroom version needs no animals at all. Dumplings need no bowl, you eat them directly.
Die Podest-Items bleiben liegen. Jede Es: The pedestal items stay put. Each essence only uses up the gem.
Die Ponder-Szenen (&eW&r) zeigen den Auf: The Ponder scenes (&eW&r) show the setup. Hands off the spinning rotor.
Die Pumpe reicht &e16 Blöcke&r je Seite: The pump reaches &e16 blocks&r per side and costs 4 SU per RPM. A &6Spout&r over a depot fills buckets and bottles from it, the mixer takes water for dough and pulp by pipe.
Die Quarzsorten stehen in der Lexica unt: The quartz kinds are in the Lexica under decorative blocks, the elves trade you Elven Quartz for Nether quartz.
Die Quest ist erledigt, wenn du so &e7 0: The quest is done when you cover &e7,000 overworld blocks&r in one go this way.
Die Quest zählt, sobald die Glyphe im In: The quest counts as soon as the glyph is in your inventory. Only learn it with right click after that.
Die Rechnung: 128 Barren für den Obelisk: The math: 128 ingots for the obelisk and 32 for the fusions are 160 ingots, so &e640 Gaia Spirits&r. With four people per fight that is a good 25 fights.
Die Reihen von oben nach unten: &eStein&: The rows from top to bottom: &estone&r, &ewood&r, &efields&r, &eanimals&r, &emonsters&r, &ewater and lava&r, &emagic&r. Each row stands on its own; start with the one you are missing right now.
Die Reinigungsfabrik allein bringt wenig: The Purifying Factory alone does little if basic machines are waiting behind it. Upgrade the &6Crushing Factory&r, &6Enriching Factory&r and &6Smelting Factory&r to advanced too, each with the Advanced Tier Installer.
Die Reise kostet &eErfahrungslevel&r: et: The trip costs &eexperience levels&r: about one level per 100 blocks in a straight line, at most 27. Into another dimension it is always 27 levels. Global waystones, warp plates and return scrolls cost nothing. What a destination costs is shown next to it in the selection menu.
Die Reise kostet etwas Erfahrung, je wei: The trip costs some experience, the farther the more. More in the chapter &6Tips and Tricks&r.
Die Reittiere (Pferd, Esel, Lama, Kamel,: You summon the mounts (horse, donkey, llama, camel, strider and more) in the same pentacle with &e2 hay bales&r, apple, golden apple, carrot, golden carrot, cactus and warped fungus.
Die Relikte Ring des Thor, Loki und Odin: The relics Ring of Thor, Loki and Odin only come from the Dice of Fate from Gaia II, stage 5.
Die Rezepte stehen in den Kapiteln &6Cre: The recipes are in the &6Create&r, &aBotania&r, &dArs Nouveau&r, &aMystical Agriculture&r, &6Food and Farming&r and &6Cooking&r chapters. This one only says how to put them together into a farm.
Die Richtung hängt davon ab, wie herum d: The direction depends on which way you place it; the wrench flips it. It takes one item at a time, a redstone signal stops it.
Die Rolle &dArkanist&r passt dazu: &e+1&: The &dArcanist&r role fits with it: &e+1&r mana per second, potions last 25 percent longer. You choose on your first login, later only with the orb.
Die Rolle bringt dich auf den höchsten f: The scroll takes you to the highest solid block above you, for &d30 mana&r. As a circle without cloth it sends everything up that lies or stands on it, items and animals too. An elevator out of the mine.
Die Rolle ist an dich gebunden. Für jede: The scroll is bound to you. So for each staff one mage gives their own mana.
Die Rolle kostet &d1 000 Mana&r und gibt: The scroll costs &d1,000 mana&r and gives you a &6Treasury Projection Gauntlet&r. It hurls weapons and tools from your inventory, some bags and your ender chest at the block you are looking at, &d120 mana&r per weapon.
Die Rotoren stehen als Säule in der Mitt: The rotors stand as a column in the middle, each carries up to two blades (right click), and the complex sits on top.
Die Runen werden hier &cverbraucht&r. Pl: The runes are &cused up&r here. Plan one of each elemental rune and one Rune of Mana just for the plate.
Die Runen werden verbraucht. Messingblec: The runes are used up. Create's Mechanical Press presses brass sheets.
Die Rute lässt Erze in einem kleinen Umk: The rod briefly makes ores within a small radius glow through the walls, the same ores in the same colour. Give it to the avatar, supply it with a spreader, and it shows the ores near it permanently. Redstone stops it.
Die Röhren vorne leuchten je nach Ladest: The tubes at the front glow according to the charge. A comparator next to it gives the charge as a redstone signal.
Die Rüstung läuft mit Strom statt Haltba: The armor runs on power instead of durability and grows with modules. Eight Polonium Pellets and four Induction Cells for the full set.
Die Schalen müssen irgendwo im Umkreis v: The bowls have to stand somewhere within &e8 blocks&r of the middle; the exact spot doesn't matter. Crafted with copper or silver ingots you get prettier variants.
Die Schaltkreise ersetzen die Fluix-Glas: The circuits replace the fluix glass cables of the original: storage networks need Mekanism. The drive holds up to &e10 cells&r and needs one channel.
Die Schmiede steht in Netherödnis, Karme: The forge stands in Nether wastes, crimson forest, warped forest or soul sand valley. You get the scraps from ancient debris.
Die Schriftrolle sucht sich ein Ziel in: The scroll picks a target nearby: a temple, a stronghold, an ancient city, a Wilden den, a Nexus tower or an Arcane Library. If the frame is damaged, repair it. Then throw the scroll in, and the portal opens without source.
Die Schublade gibt ein Signal aus, das m: The drawer outputs a signal that rises with its fill level. With it you switch off a Create setup through a clutch as soon as the storage is full.
Die Schublade nimmt weiter an, wenn sie: The drawer keeps accepting when it is full and deletes the surplus. No conveyor line clogs up anymore. Behind a cobblestone machine it stays at 2,048; bring the stock to the obelisk first.
Die Schädel holst du vom Possessed Skele: You get the skulls from the Possessed Skeleton. Let the Ritual Satchel draw; it saves a lot of counting.
The scythe from the Monstrosity's loot.
Die Sichel räumt Pflanzenmaterial in ein: The sickle clears plant material over a large area, the Inferium Sickle farther than the diamond one. Ideal for removing grass and flowers before building a farm, or getting leaves off trees. For ripe essence crops stay with the scythe, it does not uproot them.
Die Sonnenkerze hat einen eigenen Hexere: The sun candle has a Hexerei effect of its own against rain. The Potion of Luck cannot be brewed, it only comes from chests or other mods.
The game pieces of the Dandelifeon.
Die Spitzhacke ist sehr zerbrechlich. Si: The pickaxe is very fragile. It is only meant to fetch the first Iesnium, from which you build a durable Iesnium Pickaxe.
Die Spule sitzt direkt an einem SPS-Port: The coil sits directly on an SPS port, otherwise the SPS does not form. The power flows in through it.
Die Statusseite zeigt den Obelisken auch: The status page shows the obelisk even when you are not online.
Die Steinbruchkarte in die Mitte, &6Dime: The Quarry Card in the middle, &6Dimensional Shards&r in the corners, plus a &6ghast tear&r, &6emerald&r, &6diamond&r and &6redstone&r. It mines like a pickaxe with Fortune.
Die Steinbruchkarte, umringt von acht &6: The Quarry Card surrounded by eight &6glass blocks&r. It leaves air behind. Good for a basement, a hall or a pool.
Die Stiefel laufen mit Strom: Du steigst: The boots run on power: you step up a block without jumping, and they swallow fall damage completely as long as there is power in them. Each half heart costs &e50 J&r, full they hold &e64,000 J&r.
The tier sits in the capacitor.
Die Stufe öffnet sich erst, wenn &ealle&: The stage only opens when &eall&r pillars are full. A server that only builds machines or only casts spells gets nowhere.
Die Stufen darüber, DU und Elite, schaff: The tiers above, DU and Elite, manage 448 and 1,792 FE/t.
Die Stämme fallen zu Boden, ein Band mit: The logs fall to the ground; a belt with a funnel below collects them. Every saw costs 4 SU per RPM more.
Die Stücke brauchst du für Sandwiches, W: You need the cuts for sandwiches, wraps and skewers. &eTip:&r A knife with &6Fortune&r raises the chance of rare results at the board by &d10 percent&r per level.
Die Symbole unten zeigen dir, ob dein Mi: The icons at the bottom show whether your microphone is muted. Muting is not on any key so it does not happen by accident; in the menu it takes one click.
Die Säge fällt den ganzen Baum auf einma: The saw fells the whole tree at once. It costs durability per log.
Die Säulen brauchen &eTechnik und Magie&: The pillars need &etech and magic&r. If you can't decide, ask around what is missing right now. Chapters of later stages appear once their stage is open.
Die Terrastahl-Straße aus dem Kapitel &a: The Terrasteel line from the chapter &aBotania: Runes&r supplies them on the side. Put the ingots in a chest at the arena, then the next fight starts within a minute.
Die Terrastahlrüstung entsteht aus Manas: Terrasteel armour is made from Manasteel armour, Terrasteel, twigs and one season rune per piece. Every ingot here is missing from the obelisk.
The animals breed on their own.
Die Torreya-Bäume stehen nur im &6Torrey: The Torreya trees only grow in the &6Torreya Forest&r.
Die Truhen sind Lootr-Truhen, jeder beko: The chests are Lootr chests, everyone gets their own loot, often enchanted diamond gear. Shulkers sit in the walls. Build railings where you fight.
Die Träne fällt gern in Lava. Kämpf über: The tear likes to fall into lava. Fight over solid ground. You need it for potions of regeneration and in stage 4 for the &5End crystals&r that make the dragon appear again.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht E: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight iron blocks&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht G: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight glass&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht K: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight copper blocks&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht S: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight logs&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Gegenstände von Extended AE: Extended AE's upgrade items swap a placed device for its Ex version with a sneak right click, settings and contents stay.
The dungeons of Dungeons and Taverns.
Die Verpackungsformen pressen 4 oder 9 g: The packing molds press 4 or 9 identical items into their block, Unpacking reverses it. That way ingots land in storage as space saving blocks, or sand becomes sandstone.
Die Verzauberung &dMana-Boost&r bringt &: The enchantment &dMana Boost&r adds &e+25&r per level, &dMana Regen&r &e+2&r per second and level. So learning glyphs pays off twice.
Die Vorlage liegt in Bastionen. &e7 Diam: The template lies in bastions. &e7 diamonds&r, a netherrack and a template make two templates.
Die Vorlage liegt in den Truhen der Gole: The template lies in the chests of the Golem Forge and the Cursed Garden. Copying: template, 7 Glacite Shards and 1 Eternal Ice make 2.
The template lies in the chests of the Golem Forge and the Cursed Garden. Copying: template, 7 Springstone ingots and 1 Starcore block make 2.
Die Vorlage verschwindet nach einem Teil: The template disappears after one part. Good for parts you only need once, or when you are out of blue dye.
Die Welt ist größer und seltsamer als in: The world is bigger and stranger than in vanilla.
The crafting table you always have with you.
Die Werkzeuge zeigen auf natürlichem Ges: On natural stone the tools roughly show where a vein lies. The drill takes a &6Core Sample&r at &d40 FE/t&r: which ores are in it and how saturated. Placed while sneaking, the sample marks the vein on a map.
Die Wilde Jagd lässt mit hoher Chance &6: The Wild Hunt has a high chance to drop &6wither skeleton skulls&r. You need them for Witherite Dust and Tibira's Attraction.
Die Wurzel steckt in jeder Besenbürste,: The root is in every broom brush, every broom and the crow amulet. The flowers you need for the Enhanced and the Moon Dust Brush.
The forests of the star world.
Die Zahlen gelten für &e30 aktive Spiele: The numbers are for &e30 active players&r. Active means more than an hour of play in the last 7 days. When a stage opens, the amount is multiplied by that share, at least 0.4 and at most 1.5, and then stays fixed.
Die Zahnradform presst vier Barren zu ei: The gear mold presses four ingots into a metal gear for other mods, the wire mold one ingot into two wires, no wire cutters needed.
The cell that only takes radioactive things.
Die Zucht beginnt mit Vanilla-Bienen aus: Breeding starts with vanilla bees from the nest and a feeding slab. Everything step by step in the &eProductive Bees&r chapter.
Die anderen Upgrades: Erkennen gibt Reds: The other upgrades: detection gives redstone, dropping drops, bouncing throws, blinking teleports, splitting distributes in the set ratio.
Die betroffenen Quests nennen das Rezept: The quests concerned name the recipe as &eRecipe on Kronwerke&r. Settle early who takes on what.
Die drahtlose Konsole ohne Reichweitengr: The wireless terminal without a range limit.
The rotating mass, 32 SU per RPM.
Die drei Metalle, die du in Stufe 2 brau: The three metals you need in stage 2.
Die einzige Quelle für die Cloggrumkampf: The only source of the Cloggrum Battleaxe.
The first setup that runs on its own.
The first half of every chalk.
Die erste Maschine, das Herz von Mekanis: The first machine, the heart of Mekanism.
The first armor of the star world.
The first of the seven sin runes.
Die gegenüberliegende Seite dreht anders: The opposite side turns the other way. Lying down it is called a &6Vertical Gearbox&r; you turn one into the other in the grid. Gearboxes cost no stress capacity.
Die gelbe Umrandung der Keulen ist deine: The yellow outline of the drumsticks is your saturation. As long as it is there, hunger does not drop. Meals from &6Farmer's Delight&r give a lot of it, Ultimine and sprinting use it up quickly.
Die große Tasche gibt dem Besen &e27 Plä: The large bag gives the broom &e27 slots&r. It goes into the satchel slot, so only one bag per broom.
Die großen Multiblöcke aus Ingenieursbau: The large multiblocks made of engineering blocks follow in stage 3.
Die großen Neuerungen sind die Verstärku: The big new things are the augments: AOE, Pierce, Extend Time, Dampen, Fortune, Extract. They turn your old spells into tools. Many recipes want Nether ingredients; plan a trip together.
The biggest factory of the season.
The highest tier you can build.
Die kleinen Mods, die den Tag leichter m: The small mods that make the day easier.
Die leere Karte baut nichts ab. Sie ist: The empty card does not mine anything. It is the base of all the others.
Die letzten Maschinen und der letzte Kam: The last machines and the last fight.
Die meisten Kräfte wirken von allein. Ak: Most powers work on their own. Active ones need a key: the Starshard's &eStar Leap&r is on the first ability key (&eZ&r), the Trader's &epack bag&r on the role key (&eH&r), the Deepdigger's night vision on &eK&r.
Die meisten Maschinen haben seitlich zwe: Most machines have two upgrade slots on the side: the first takes Energy Upgrades, the second Speed Upgrades, up to 64 per slot. Each Speed Upgrade makes the machine faster, but power use grows with the square.
Die mit Kiefern lassen einen &6Leerenkie: The ones with jaws drop a &6Void Jaw&r. A jaw over a spectral arrow makes &e2 Void Scatter Arrows&r.
Die seltenste Sorte. Für Totembasen und: The rarest kind. For totem bases and the Rite of Quickening.
The most expensive machine of this stage.
Die verstärkten Relais halten mehr Quell: The strengthened relays hold more Source and pass it on faster. Worth it anywhere many links or chambers hang on one relay.
Die vielseitigste Essenz: Block platzier: The most versatile essence: Place Block, Interact, Rotate, Delay, the rune chalk and later many relays and rituals.
The second half of every chalk.
The second tier for every machine.
Die übrigen zwölf Blumen mit ihren Zahle: The other twelve flowers with their numbers are in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter.
Diese Spitzhacke dreht die Härte um: Har: This pickaxe flips hardness around: hard blocks like &6obsidian&r break fast, soft ones like dirt or sand slow it down. Use it for obsidian and deepslate, not for dirt.
Diese Tasten gehören EMI selbst und steh: These keys are EMI's own and are not in the controls settings. Change them with the &eEMI&r button at the bottom left.
Diese drei brauchst du zuerst: Hex Ash,: You need these three first: Hex Ash, Hallowed Gold, Soulstained Steel. The other five are on the right as a checklist.
Dieselbe &6Mechanische Pumpe&r, das offe: The same &6Mechanical Pump&r, the open pipe end into a &clava lake&r, &6Fluid Tanks&r behind it. An &6Item Drain&r in the belt also empties lava buckets from the mine into the tank.
Dieselbe Kammer macht aus Kohle, Wasser: The same chamber makes hydrogen and sulfur dust from coal, water and oxygen, and later HDPE for the MekaSuit.
Dieselbe Komponente, ein anderes Gehäuse: The same component, a different housing.
The same parts, a different load.
Dieses Kapitel hat zwei Wege, die du par: This chapter has two paths you follow side by side: the &dspell book&r at the top, the &6first Source Gem&r below.
Dieses Kapitel ist deine erste Woche: Ru: This chapter is your first week: backpack, drawer wall, upgradeable barrels, a vault for Create. &cKronwerke:&r Copper and iron backpacks open in stage 2, gold and diamond in stage 3, netherite in stage 4. The tooltip says which stage is missing.
Dieses Kapitel sammelt die Mods, die Din: This chapter gathers the mods that move things without a tangle of pipes: &6Integrated Dynamics&r (programmable), &6XNet&r (everything on one controller), &6LaserIO&r (lasers in place of cables), plus the &6Mining Gadget&r. The sections can be done in any order.
Dieses Kapitel setzt &eApplied Energisti: This chapter continues &eApplied Energistics 2&r. With &6stage 4, the Star Works&r, 64k and 256k, the quantum bridge, spatial storage, &6MEGA Cells&r up to 4M, &6Advanced AE&r without the quantum computer and the Ex machines of &6Extended AE&r open.
Dieses Kapitel: neue Glyphen, Quelle übe: This chapter: new glyphs, Source over long distances, rituals, familiars, turrets and Create.
Direkt an der Quelle pumpt es nur diese: Right at the source it only pumps out that fluid. Further down the line it only lets that fluid through. That way you separate water and lava coming from the same tank or basin.
Djinni sind die meistgerufene Klasse: sc: Djinni are the most summoned class: faster than Foliot, good for possessing stronger creatures and more valuable bindings.
Djinni that act once and leave.
Djinni-Pentakel haben Stellen, an die ke: Djinni pentacles have spots where no white chalk may go. Light grey belongs there; grey or black work too. Light grey may also stand anywhere white is asked for.
Dominion-Zauberstab von zwei Trankgläser: Dominion Wand from two Potion Jars to the melder, those are the inputs. Then from the melder to a third jar, that is the output. The melder takes doses from both jars and fills a potion with both effects. Each mix costs Source.
Dominion-Zauberstab: erst auf das Kohlen: Dominion Wand: first on the brazier, then on the &6Ritual Brazier Relay&r. The ritual then works at the relay, while the original brazier keeps paying the Source. Range &e15 blocks&r, several braziers may use the same relay.
Dominion-Zauberstab: erst das Glas, dann: Dominion Wand: first the jar, then the relay, then the relay, then the target (jar or next relay). Range &e30 blocks&r. Clicking while sneaking clears, redstone switches it off.
Dominion-Zauberstab: erst die Truhe, dan: Dominion Wand: first the chest, then the lectern. At the lectern you see all connected inventories together, take things out and craft straight from them. Inventories may be up to &e30 blocks&r away.
Twice as long in the air.
Doppelt so schnell wie der Foliot und me: Twice as fast as the Foliot and more gems per ore. It also breaks down amethyst and quartz blocks.
Twice as fast as a furnace.
Doppelte Legierung, ein Viertel des Mate: Double the alloy, a quarter of the material.
Dorfbewohner vergessen schneller, was du: Villagers forget faster what you did to them.
Dort stehen die fünf Bosse von L_Ender's: That is where the five L_Ender's Cataclysm bosses stand in the right order, plus the dark towers of Born in Chaos and the creatures of Mowzie's Mobs.
Drachenatem fängst du mit einer leeren F: You catch dragon's breath with an empty bottle from the Ender Dragon's purple cloud. More speed means more power per second, check your supply line.
Dragon's breath for the enchanting table.
Dracheneier brauchst du für Rezepte von: You need dragon eggs for &5Draconic Evolution&r recipes and for the &6Productive Bees&r heated centrifuge. Whoever does not want to wait for the next dragon hatches one here.
Drachenstein brauchst du für Corporea, d: You need Dragonstone for Corporea, the Crystal Bow and four times for every &dElven Star&r. Gaia armor and Gaia Spreader only come in stage 4.
Draconium at the heart of the large cells.
Draconium-Erz gibt es auf Kronwerke nur: On Kronwerke draconium ore only exists in the &5End&r, it drops 2 to 4 dust. With &6stage 4, the Star Works&r, Elite and Ultimate, the Induction Matrix, QIO, fusion and the MekaSuit open.
Draconiumbarren in die Ecken, &6Diamantä: Draconium Ingots in the corners, &6diamond axes&r at the top and bottom, Draconium Cores left and right, a Module Core in the middle. Also fuse a &6Wyvern Axe&r like the pickaxe, with a diamond axe in the core.
Draconiumbarren in die Ecken, ein &6Tote: Draconium Ingots in the corners, a &6Totem of Undying&r at the top, Draconium Cores left and right, Module Core in the middle, a &6Wyvern Shield Module&r at the bottom.
Draconiumbarren oben links und rechts, R: Draconium Ingots at the top left and right, redstone below them, at the bottom &6Awakened ingot&r, &6Item Dislocator&r, &6Awakened ingot&r.
Draconiumstaub, der nicht in Schaltkreis: Draconium dust that does not go into circuits becomes an ingot in the furnace and counts there.
Drakonische Stufe. Katalysator: der &6Wy: Draconic tier. Catalyst: the &6Wyvern Capacitor&r. In eight injectors: &64 Awakened ingots&r, &63 Draconic Energy Controllers&r and a &6Draconic Core&r. Costs 32 million energy.
Drakonische Stufe. Katalysator: die &6Wy: Draconic tier. Catalyst: the &6Wyvern Pickaxe&r. In eight injectors: &64 netherite ingots&r, &61 Wyvern Core&r, &62 Awakened ingots&r, &61 Draconic Energy Controller&r. Costs 32 million energy.
Drakonische Stufe. Katalysator: ein &6Dr: Draconic tier. Catalyst: a &6Draconic injector&r. In nine injectors: &64 diamonds&r, &64 Large Chaos Fragments&r, a &5dragon egg&r. Costs 8 million energy.
Draconic tier. Catalyst: a &6Draconic Core&r. Into the injectors: Draconic &6pickaxe, shovel and sword&r, a &6Draconic Energy Controller&r, &66 Awakened ingots&r. Costs 256 million energy.
Drakonische Stufe. Katalysator: ein &6Gr: Draconic tier. Catalyst: a &6Large Chaos Fragment&r. In twelve injectors: &64 Awakened ingots&r, &64 Draconic Cores&r, &64 Large Chaos Fragments&r. Costs 100 million energy.
Drakonische Werkzeuge haben acht Zutaten: Draconic tools have eight ingredients, so you need eight. A Draconic injector charges in 7 seconds instead of 11.
Drehbewegung statt Strom: so läuft hier: Rotation instead of power: that is how every machine runs here.
Dreht in Separator, Assembler und Crushe: Turns in the separator, assembler and crusher.
Drei &6Andesitlegierungen&r um einen &6E: Three &6Andesite Alloys&r around an &6iron ingot&r with an &6Andesite Casing&r below make the &6Mechanical Drill&r. It breaks the block in front of its tip as long as it turns.
Drei &6Behandelte Holzbretter&r und vier: Three &6Treated Wood Planks&r and four &6Treated Sticks&r make a &6Windmill Blade&r. Eight blades around an &6iron ingot&r make the &6Windmill&r.
Drei &6Behandelte Holzstufen&r oben, &6B: Three &6Treated Wood Slabs&r on top, &6Treated Sticks&r left and right, a normal &6crafting table&r in the middle make the &6Engineer's Crafting Table&r.
Drei &6Bretter&r und eine &6Andesitlegie: Three &6planks&r and one &6Andesite Alloy&r make a &6Hand Crank&r. Hold the right mouse button on it: it gives &d32 RPM&r and &d256 SU&r.
Drei &6Dorfbewohner&r mit Betten in eine: Three &6villagers&r with beds in a small room, next to them a &6zombie&r they can see but not reach. The villagers get scared and call an &6iron golem&r for help.
Drei &6Eisen&r oben, zwei Basic-Kondensa: Three &6iron&r at the top, two Basic capacitors left and right of the casing, iron, the &6Starter Furnator&r, iron at the bottom.
Drei &6Eisenbleche&r über drei &6Andesit: Three &6Iron Sheets&r above three &6Andesite Alloy&r make eight &6Metal Girders&r. Placed next to and on top of each other they join into supports and beams.
Drei &6Eisenbleche&r, ein &6Eisenbarren&: Three &6Iron Sheets&r, an &6iron ingot&r and an &6Andesite Casing&r make the &6Mechanical Saw&r. Facing up it processes whatever lands on it or passes on the belt.
Drei &6Goldbleche&r, ein &6Zahnrad&r und: Three &6Golden Sheets&r, a &6Cogwheel&r and a &6stick&r make the &6Wrench&r. Right-click turns a Create block, sneak and right-click picks it up at once.
Drei &6Item Pipes&r oben, &6Flüssigkeits: Three &6Item Pipes&r at the top, &6Fluid Pipe&r, &6Motor&r, Fluid Pipe in the middle, three Item Pipes at the bottom make the &6Pipe Booster&r.
Drei &6Kohle&r oder Holzkohle, zwei &6To: Three &6coal&r or charcoal, two &6clay&r and a &6lava bucket&r give &e24&r paste. With &6Blaze Powder&r in place of lava (two coal, one clay, one Blaze Powder) it is 16, with no bucket at all.
Drei &6Kupferbarren&r oben, &6Flüssigkei: Three &6copper ingots&r at the top, &6Fluid Pipe&r, glass, Fluid Pipe in the middle, three copper ingots at the bottom make the &6Portable Tank&r.
Drei &6Kupferbarren&r und ein &6Zinnbarr: Three &6copper ingots&r and one &6tin ingot&r make &e4 bronze ingots&r in the Alloy Kiln. Tin comes with Mekanism.
Drei &6Leder&r oben, &6Eisen&r, &6Redsto: Three &6leather&r on top, &6iron&r, &6redstone&r, iron below make eight &6Conveyor Belts&r.
Drei &6Messingbleche&r, &6Andesitlegieru: Three &6brass sheets&r, &6andesite alloy&r, &6precision mechanism&r and &6brass casing&r make the &6Mechanical Arm&r. Before placing it, click its targets: once for &einput&r, twice for &eoutput&r.
Drei &6Nickel&r oben, drei &6Stahl&r in: Three &6nickel&r at the top, three &6steel&r in the middle, three nickel at the bottom make &efour&r &6Magnetic Coils&r.
Drei &6Photoelectric Panes&r oben (Glass: Three &6Photoelectric Panes&r at the top (a glass pane with lapis and paste), two Tiny left and right of the casing, three paste at the bottom.
Drei &6Podeste&r höchstens &e1 Block&r n: Three &6pedestals&r no more than &e1 block&r next to the chamber: &6iron ingot&r, &6seeds&r, &6dirt&r. One Source Gem inside, &d2,000 Source&r, done.
Drei &6Polierte Schwarzsteindruckplatten: Three &6polished blackstone pressure plates&r on top, below them steel, &6Energy Tablet&r, steel.
Drei &6Quarzglas&r als Schale, ein &6Sou: Three &6Fused Quartz&r as a bowl, a &6Soularium Ingot&r on top: the &6Soul Vial&r.
Drei &6Silikon&r oben, Eisen, &6Gehäuse: Three &6Silicon&r at the top, iron, &6Void Chassis&r, iron in the middle, gear, &6crafting table&r, gear at the bottom make the &6Crafter&r.
Drei &6Solarmodule&r (Glasscheiben, Reds: Three &6Solar Panels&r (glass panes, redstone, alloy, osmium) over alloy, iron, osmium and an Energy Tablet. &d20 FE/t&r by day under open sky.
Drei &6Stahlbarren&r oben, &6Constantanb: Three &6steel ingots&r on top, &6Constantan Plate&r, &6Copper Coil Block&r, Constantan Plate in the middle, three Constantan Plates at the bottom make the generator.
Drei &6Stahlbarren&r und zwei Stöcke, wi: Three &6steel ingots&r and two sticks, like any pickaxe. Mekanism Tools has whole sets from osmium, bronze, steel, glowstone and obsidian.
Drei &6Stahlbarren&r, eine &6Mechanische: Three &6steel ingots&r, an &6Iron Mechanical Component&r and two &6Wooden Grips&r make the &6Engineer's Skyhook&r. Wooden Grip: five Treated Sticks and a copper nugget.
Drei &6Stöcke&r diagonal, dazu &6Kupfer&: Three &6sticks&r diagonally, plus &6copper&r in the middle and a &6Mercury Shard&r at the top right.
Drei &6Uran-235&r und sechs &6Uran-238&r: Three &6uranium 235&r and six &6uranium 238&r at the crafting table make three &6HEU-235&r. Thorium fuel &6TBU&r: one thorium 230 and eight thorium 232 give three.
Drei &6Vorlagenbretter&r oben, zwei &6St: Three &6Template Boards&r on top, two &6sticks&r vertically below. Same shape as the blueprint.
Drei &6Weizen&r und ein &6Ei&r, formlos:: Three &6wheat&r and an &6egg&r, shapeless: &ethree wheat dough&r. Wheat and a water bucket work too.
Drei Flauschbälle in einer Reihe ergeben: Three Fluffy Puffs in a row make a &6Fluffy String&r. As a binding it brings Flexible III, as a cord +5 percent ranged damage at a slightly slower draw. Four in a square make &6Fluffy Fabric&r, five diagonally a &6Fluffy Feather&r.
Drei Glas oben, ME-Laufwerk, Glaskabel,: Three glass at the top, ME Drive, glass cable, ME Drive in the middle, iron, Logic Processor, iron at the bottom.
Three belts for speed and footing.
Drei Herzen mehr, aus Platten und Biosta: Three more hearts, from plating and Biosteel.
Drei Kupfer und ein Zinn geben vier Bron: Three copper and one tin give four bronze.
Three copper, a touch of tin.
Three modes for cables, orb and blocks.
Drei Paste oben, zwei Tiny links und rec: Three paste at the top, two Tiny left and right of the casing, paste, &6furnace&r, paste at the bottom.
Three paste at the top, two Tiny left and right of the casing, three &6Thermoelectric Plates&r at the bottom (Blaze Powder and redstone around a Tiny).
Drei Plätze mit je bis zu drei Items. Re: Three places with up to three items each. Right click hangs up, right click takes down what is done. Hoppers fill and empty it too. Rotten flesh dries to &6leather&r here, wet sponges become dry.
Drei Raumpylone oben, Glaskabel links un: Three Spatial Pylons at the top, glass cable left and right, a &6128³ Spatial Component&r in the middle, iron and an Engineering Processor at the bottom.
Three rounds, then it drops off the belt.
Three tubes per recipe, at the workbench.
Drei Schädel auf Seelensand beschwören d: Three skulls on soul sand summon the &cWither&r. Keep them until the server is ready together (next quest).
Drei Schädel, vier Seelensand, ein Nethe: Three skulls, four soul sand, one Nether star.
Three stacks of scrolls in one hand.
Three cloaks, one Gaia Spirit each.
Three guards, one line per flower.
Three ingredients in, one ingot out.
Three ingredients in, two crystals out.
Drei davon stecken in jedem Satz Schwere: Three of them go into every set of Heavy Engineering Blocks. You build the workbench and blueprint as described in the stage 2 chapter.
Three new biomes between the islands.
Three times Wicked, once a day.
Thirty people, one world, seven weeks.
Drin leben Piglins, die &6Piglin-Barbare: Inside live piglins, the &6piglin brutes&r (gold doesn't distract them) and hoglins in stables. Every chest makes the piglins angry, even with gold armour.
Druckreaktionskammer: &6Substrat&r mit 5: Pressurized Reaction Chamber: &6Substrate&r with 50 mB of liquid ethene and 10 mB of oxygen gives one &6HDPE Pellet&r. Three pellets in the Enrichment Chamber give one &6HDPE Sheet&r.
Drüben liegen die &eäußeren Inseln&r, et: Over there lie the &eouter islands&r, about a thousand blocks from the center. A way back appears next to your landing spot. Put a waystone next to it, there are wild waystones here too.
Drück &eF3&r. Oben links steht &eFPS&r,: Press &eF3&r. Top left shows &eFPS&r, your frames per second. If they are low, the lag is on your side: render distance in the video settings to &e8 chunks&r, particles to &eDecreased&r, clouds off. That does more than any other setting.
Drück &e{key:key.ftbchunks.map}&r für di: Press &e{key:key.ftbchunks.map}&r for the &6FTB Chunks&r map or &e{key:key.journeymap.map_toggle_alt}&r for JourneyMap. Both record everything you have seen.
Drück &e{key:key.inventory}&r für dein I: Press &e{key:key.inventory}&r for your inventory. At the top left there is a small &6book&r; clicking it opens the quest book. The chapters are on the left, the quests in the middle, and a clicked quest opens as text on the right.
Du brauchst &e27&r Stück, also 27 Stahlb: You need &e27&r of them, so 27 Steel Plates. Your Crude Blast Furnace supplies the steel.
Du brauchst ein Gehäuse unter dem Perlen: You need a casing under the pearl pool, an ingot in the Runic Altar and two casings in the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate. Without a brass line of your own: trade Manasteel or Runes of Fire with the engineers.
Du brauchst ihn für den Stab, für Module: You need it for the staff, for modules, for the Chaotic Core (four) and the Chaotic Energy Controller. Collect the stars while you farm Withers.
Du brauchst ihn zu Hunderten. Später ver: You need it by the hundreds. Later a press over a basin compacts new andesite from flint, gravel and lava (quest &6Compact andesite&r).
Du brauchst sie für Vorlagen, für Repara: You need them for templates, repair kits, the modkit and the blueprint book.
Du brauchst sie öfter, als du denkst: &e: You need it more often than you think: &e2&r for the Djinni Wandering Trader, &e4&r for every revival in Susje's Simple Circle, &e3&r for every chalk repair.
Du brauchst viele: der Rotor will vier,: You need many: the rotor wants four, the electromagnet five, the motor six.
Du erntest Seelen, infundierst am Altar,: You harvest souls, infuse at the altar, focus in the Crucible and let totems work.
Du gleitest wie mit Elytren, der Brustpl: You glide as with elytra, the chest slot stays free for the robe. Needs a thread slot of &esize 3&r.
Du hast &e500 Chunks&r. Das ist viel, ab: You have &e500 chunks&r. That is a lot, but not the whole valley: a chunk is 16 by 16 blocks, and 500 are enough for a big base with fields and a factory.
Du hast eine gesicherte Basis, Eisen und: You have a secured base, iron, and you have already delivered something to the obelisk. That is more than most people have after their first evening.
Du kannst den Topf mit Inhalt abbauen un: You can mine the pot with its contents and set it up again somewhere else.
Du kennst jetzt das Buch, EMI, die Karte: You now know the book, EMI, the map, the rules and the keys. Everything else you learn while playing, and nobody expects you to know 230 mods.
Du kennst jetzt sieben Pentakel: Aviar,: You now know seven pentacles: Aviar, Hedyrin, Eziveus, Ophyx, Strigeor, Ihagan and Susje. Crusher, Smelter, Transporter and Lumberjack work for you.
Du landest auf einer Plattform aus Obsid: You land on an obsidian platform next to the main island. &eYUNG's Better End Island&r rebuilds the island: a new platform, a tower in the middle, its own gateway portals.
Du siehst an der Truhe, ob du sie schon: You can see on the chest whether you have opened it already. Whoever mines it takes the loot away from everyone after them. Barrels, minecarts with chests and frames with elytra work the same way.
Du vermehrst Erze, machst Salz aus Bruch: You multiply ores, make salt from cobblestone, heat with flux and turn lapis into quartz and iron into gold.
Du weißt jetzt, wie Kronwerke funktionie: Now you know how Kronwerke works: the server works together toward the obelisk, every stage opens for everyone, and this book shows you the way through every chapter.
Du wählst einen Slot der Maschine, und a: You pick one slot of the machine, and everything that goes into or out of the addon only affects that slot. Handy on the Assembler.
Dunkles Feld, Fragezeichen, drei Zeilen: Dark slot, question mark, three tooltip lines.
Through the bottom of the world.
See through, and some of it glows.
Duroplast isoliert und zählt als Kunstst: Duroplast insulates and counts as a plastic sheet. Duroplast blocks replace terracotta in connectors.
Dynamic FPS bremst, sobald du woanders h: Dynamic FPS slows down as soon as you click somewhere else.
EMI zeigt alle Rezepte unter dem Katalys: EMI shows all recipes under the catalyst. A functional flower thrown into a pool with a catalyst gets smaller for some mana: same effect, smaller area.
Ebenfalls aus den Handwerkseinheiten: &6: Also from the crafters: the &6Extendo Grip&r for more reach and the &6Wand of Symmetry&r, which mirrors every placed block.
Ebenso gibt es den großen Elektrolyseur,: There are also the large Electrolytic Separator, Rotary Condensentrator, Solar Neutron Activator, Heat and Gas Generator. Look at the recipes in EMI. The large Wind Generator comes in stage 5.
Ecken &6Goldnuggets&r, oben und unten Mi: Corners &6gold nuggets&r, top and bottom middle &6sourcestone&r, middle gold ingot, &6diamond&r, gold ingot. Place it on the Arcane Core.
Ecken und unten Mitte &6Messingbarren&r,: Corners and bottom middle &6brass ingots&r, top middle &6Electron Tube&r, left and right a &6cogwheel&r, the calibrated mechanism in the middle.
Edelsteine sitzen oben und unten in jede: Gemstones sit at the top and bottom of every Inferium tool and in the middle of every Growth Accelerator recipe. Three diamonds are enough to start: two for the first tool, one for three accelerators.
Edelsteine, Sockel, Zerlegen, Umschmiede: Gems, sockets, salvaging, reforging and world tiers are in the &6Apotheosis&r chapter.
Eggs and milk without chasing after them.
Your own pictures on the wall.
Eigene Wegsteine, Warpsteine und Schrift: Your own waystones, warp stones and scrolls are shown in the chapter &aExploration&r.
You need no buckets any more.
Eimer in der Hand und Rechtsklick füllt: A bucket in hand and right click fills or empties it. Create pipes can fill and empty it as well.
Bucket into the window, full bucket back.
Ein &5Erwachter Draconiumblock&r an der: An &5Awakened Draconium Block&r at the crafting table gives 9 &5Awakened ingots&r, an ingot 9 &5nuggets&r.
Ein &6Agglomerat&r ist ein Zwei-mal-zwei: An &6Agglomeratio&r is a two by two recipe: the element top left, &6gravel&r top right, &6dirt&r bottom left, a &6clay ball&r bottom right. As the element you use a &eglass bottle&r (air), &egrass&r (earth), a &ewater bucket&r or a &elava bucket&r (fire).
Ein &6Andesit&r und ein &6Eisen-&r oder: One &6andesite&r and one &6iron&r or &6zinc nugget&r into the basin: the mixer makes &etwo Andesite Alloys&r from them.
Ein &6Barren&r und der &6Ingenieurshamme: An &6ingot&r and the &6Engineer's Hammer&r together in the crafting table make a &6plate&r. The hammer loses one point of durability.
Ein &6Basic Filter&r und ein &6Beobachte: A &6Basic Filter&r and an &6observer&r, shapeless, give the &6Counting Filter&r.
Ein &6Bleibarren&r und ein &6Eisenbarren: A &6lead ingot&r and an &6iron ingot&r, shapeless: &etwo Pewter Blend&r. In a furnace they become ingots.
Ein &6Buch&r oben, &6Diamant&r, &6Lesepu: A &6book&r on top, &6diamond&r, &6lectern&r, diamond in the middle, three &6Dark Steel&r at the bottom.
Ein &6Buch&r und ein &6Hebel&r an der We: A &6book&r and a &6lever&r at the crafting table make the &6Engineer's Manual&r. Right click opens it.
Ein &6Buch&r und ein beliebiger &6Setzli: A &6book&r and any &6sapling&r, shapeless at the crafting table, make the &6Lexica Botania&r.
Ein &6Connector&r neben jede Maschine od: A &6Connector&r next to every machine or chest, &6Network Cables&r from there to the controller. Four colours, different colours do not connect, so two networks run close beside each other.
Ein &6Diamant&r durch die Anreicherungsk: A &6diamond&r through the Enrichment Chamber becomes an &6Enriched Diamond&r, which gives &e80 mB&r of diamond in the Metallurgic Infuser. Diamond dust gives only 10 mB.
Ein &6Diamant&r im Becken wird für &d10: A &6diamond&r in the pool becomes a &bMana Diamond&r for &d10,000 mana&r. A block of diamond becomes a Block of Mana Diamond for 90,000 mana.
Ein &6Diamant&r mit &e4 Prosperiumsplitt: A &6diamond&r with &e4 Prosperity Shards&r gives a &6Prosperity Gemstone&r. With &e2 Inferium Essence&r, shapeless, it becomes an &6Inferium Gemstone&r.
Ein &6Diamantwerkzeug&r in die Mitte, &e: A &6diamond tool&r in the middle, &e2 Inferium Ingots&r left and right, &e2 Inferium Gemstones&r top and bottom: an &6Inferium tool&r. That works with a diamond pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword, and the same way with normal shears, a bow, a crossbow or a fishing rod.
Ein &6Display Panel&r am selben Netz zei: A &6Display Panel&r on the same network shows the value as soon as the card lies in it. All readers work like this: Block, Fluid, Inventory, Entity, Machine.
Ein &6Drachenkopf&r über einem &6Endrega: A &6dragon head&r over an &6Endshelf&r and &65 ender pearls&r below make a &6Draconic Endshelf&r.
Ein &6Druckluftbehälter&r, zwei &6Holzgr: A &6Pressurized Air Tank&r, two &6Wooden Grips&r, a &6Heavy Engineering Block&r, a &6fluid pipe&r and a &6bucket&r make the &6Chemical Thrower&r.
Ein &6Ei&r im Antiprotonischen Kernsynth: An &6egg&r in the Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer becomes a &5dragon egg&r with &e4 mB of antimatter&r.
Ein &6Eimer&r in der Mitte, &6acht Brett: A &6bucket&r in the middle, &6eight planks&r around it. 1x2 and 2x2 exist with two and four buckets.
Ein &6Einsatzgerät&r mit Setzlingen in d: A &6Deployer&r with saplings in hand replants at the saw carousel what the saw felled, then the tree farm runs without you. The Mekanism &6Precision Sawmill&r makes 6 planks per log and drops sawdust with a little luck.
Ein &6Einsatzgerät&r mit einer &6Schere&: A &6Deployer&r with &6shears&r in front of the sheep pen shears everything standing 2 blocks in front of it. In punch mode (wrench) with a sword it kills animals and monsters. The Reliquary &6Pedestal&r does the same without rotation: a sword in it strikes 5 blocks far, shears shear sheep.
Ein &6Eisen-Filetmesser&r aus zwei Eisen: An &6Iron Fillet Knife&r from two iron ingots and a stick. Knife and fish together in the crafting table: &6Raw Fish Fillet&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r auf den Altar, &e4 R: An &6iron ingot&r on the altar, &e4 Refined Soulstone&r on the stands, plus &e3 Wicked&r, &e1 Earthen&r and &e1 Arcane&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r mit &e4 Prosperiumsp: An &6iron ingot&r with &e4 Prosperity Shards&r on the four sides gives a &6Prosperity Ingot&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r oben, &6Kolben&r neb: An &6iron ingot&r on top, &6pistons&r next to the chest upgrade base, at the bottom &6redstone&r, iron ingot, redstone.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r oben, darunter Plank: An &6iron ingot&r on top, below plank, &6andesite&r, plank. The planks decide the kind: willow, mahogany or witch hazel.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r und ein &6Goldbarren: An &6iron ingot&r and a &6gold ingot&r become two &6Energized Steel&r for &e10,000 FE&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r und ein &6Kohlestaub: An &6iron ingot&r and a &6Powdered Coal&r give one &6Steel Ingot&r from Oritech.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r und ein &6Kupferbarr: An &6iron ingot&r and a &6copper ingot&r give two &6Conductive Alloy Ingots&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r und eine &6Enderperl: An &6iron ingot&r and an &6ender pearl&r give two &6Pulsating Alloy Ingots&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r und zwei &6Behandelt: An &6iron ingot&r and two &6Treated Wood Slabs&r on top, below the &6Engineer's Crafting Table&r and a &6Treated Wood Fence&r make the &6Engineer's Workbench&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r über einem &6Stock&r: An &6iron ingot&r over a &6stick&r. Gold or diamond work the same way.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r, ein &6Kohlestaub&r: An &6iron ingot&r, a &6Powdered Coal&r and an &6obsidian&r give two &6Dark Steel Ingots&r. Without the powder, two regular coal work too.
Ein &6Eisenblech&r oben, Glasscheibe, &6: An &6Iron Plate&r on top, glass pane, &6Incandescent Light Bulb&r, glass pane in the middle, a &6Copper Wire&r at the bottom make the &6Powered Lantern&r. Light bulbs are made at the workbench with the Components blueprint.
Ein &6Empty Heat Sink&r mit vier &6Redst: An &6Empty Heat Sink&r with four &6redstone dust&r in a cross makes a &6Redstone Heat Sink&r.
Ein &6Enderauge&r, ein &6Dielectric Casi: An &6eye of ender&r, a &6Dielectric Casing&r and a Tiny capacitor give an &6Ender Core&r for &e50,000 FE&r.
Ein &6Endermankopf&r oben, Energetische: An &6enderman head&r on top, Energetic Alloy, Soularium, Energetic Alloy in the middle, Soularium, &6Ensouled Chassis&r, Soularium at the bottom. The sword &6The Ender&r sometimes takes enderman heads along.
Ein &6Energetischer Legierungsbarren&r,: An &6Energetic Alloy Ingot&r, an &6ender pearl&r and a &6glowstone dust&r give two ingots.
Ein &6Faden&r im Becken wird für &d1 250: A &6string&r in the pool becomes &6Mana Infused String&r for &d1,250 mana&r.
Ein &6Faden&r oben in der Mitte, &6siebe: A &6string&r at the top middle, &6seven flax&r around it. Flax grows wild, you can farm the seeds.
Ein &6Faden&r oben, &e2 Stöcke&r und ein: A &6string&r on top, &e2 sticks&r and a &6wooden slab&r below. That is the &6Drying Rack&r.
Ein &6Faden&r über einem &6Tallow&r ergi: A &6string&r over a &6Tallow&r makes a &6Large Candle&r. Candles from Minecraft or other mods count in pentacles just the same.
Ein &6Fusionsreaktorrahmen&r mit vier Re: A &6Fusion Reactor Frame&r with four redstone in a cross. It sits in the plus of a side, like glass and ports.
Ein &6Gemälde&r und eine &6Werkbank&r er: A &6painting&r and a &6crafting table&r make the &6Crafting Blueprint&r. Hang it on a wall like a painting; every field on it is its own recipe.
Ein &6Generatorgehäuse&r (Eisenbleche, K: A &6generator casing&r (iron sheets, copper sheet, conductive casing) connects windings around a corner.
Ein &6Goldbarren&r auf den Altar, &e4 Qu: A &6gold ingot&r on the altar, &e4 quartz&r on the stands, plus &e2 Sacred&r and &e1 Arcane&r.
Ein &6Goldbarren&r und ein &6Silberbarre: A &6gold ingot&r and a &6silver ingot&r make &e2 electrum ingots&r in the Alloy Kiln.
Ein &6Goldener Apfel&r mit &e4 Inferiume: A &6Golden Apple&r with &e4 Inferium Essence&r on the four sides gives an &6Inferium Apple&r.
Ein &6Gummiklumpen&r im Ofen ergibt eine: One &6Dry Rubber&r in a furnace gives one &6Plastic&r.
Ein &6HV-Kondensator&r, ein &6Holzgriff&: An &6HV Accumulator&r, a &6Wooden Grip&r, two &6steel ingots&r, two &6Electrum Coil Blocks&r and an &6Advanced Electronic Component&r make the &6Railgun&r.
Ein &6Hebel&r in der Mitte, &6vier Stöck: A &6lever&r in the middle, &6four sticks&r top, bottom and on the sides: the &6Basic Tier Upgrade&r.
Ein &6Heuballen&r oder Reisballen, zwei: A &6hay bale&r or rice bale, two &6apples&r and a &6golden carrot&r, see EMI.
Ein &6Höhenmesser&r und eine leere &6Kar: An &6Altimeter&r and an empty &6map&r make a &6Slice Map&r. It shows the world as a cross section at the height where you open it, with all caves and tunnels.
Ein &6Infusionssockel&r ist der Altar oh: An &6Infusion Pedestal&r is the altar without a base: &e2 gold sheets&r from the Create press, &e1 red wool&r between them, below &e2 stone&r on top of each other. You need &e8&r, so 16 gold sheets, 8 wool and 16 stone in total.
Ein &6Inventory Reader&r (Input-Transfor: An &6Inventory Reader&r (an Input Transformer under three chests) aimed at a buffer chest at the end of the steel line reads with &eInventory Count&r what lies in it. Put the card into the Display Panel and you see the count from afar.
Ein &6Kaputter Spawner&r (fällt beim Abb: A &6Broken Spawner&r (drops when you mine a spawner) takes any soul and becomes the heart of the &6Powered Spawner&r.
Ein &6Klebriger Kolben&r oben, &6Faden&r: A &6sticky piston&r on top, &6string&r left and right of the upgrade base, &6three redstone&r at the bottom.
Ein &6Kohlestaub&r wird &6Carbon Fibre S: One &6Coal Dust&r becomes &6Carbon Fibre Strands&r. You need carbon fibre for the Processing Unit, the laser and the better cores.
Ein &6Kolben&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarren&: A &6piston&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, at the bottom &6redstone&r, a &6wooden chest&r and &6redstone&r.
Ein &6Kompass der Natur&r findet dir die: A &6Nature's Compass&r finds the missing ones for you, it knows the Undergarden's biomes too.
A &6Nature's Compass&r finds the missing ones. For the seas take a boat and water breathing potions.
Ein &6Kompass&r auf einem &6Andesitgehäu: A &6compass&r on an &6Andesite Casing&r makes the &6Speedometer&r. Put on its own into the grid it becomes the &6Stressometer&r and back.
Ein &6Kompass&r in der Mitte, &64 Holzst: A &6compass&r in the middle, &64 logs&r on the sides, &64 saplings&r in the corners make the &6Nature's Compass&r.
Ein &6Kompass&r oben, darunter Stock, &6: A &6compass&r on top, below stick, &6copper ingot&r, stick make the &6Engineer's Multimeter&r.
Ein &6Komposter&r frisst Samen, Blätter,: A &6composter&r eats seeds, leaves, saplings and plant leftovers. When it is full, it gives one &6bone meal&r. A hopper on top refills it, a hopper below takes the bone meal out.

A battery for tools and armor.
A battery that fits into the drive.

An arm travels across the area.
An arm that sweeps across the field.
Ein Aufzug fährt genau drei Stockwerke,: A lift travels exactly three floors, a gate opens by 90 degrees.

One ingot makes every ring bigger.
An ingot with four shards around it.
Ein Barren und der Hammer geben ein Blec: An ingot and the hammer give a plate.
Ein Baum in einem Block, alle zwei Minut: A tree in one block, logs every two minutes.
A tree that turns golden over time.
Ein Bauwerk im End gefunden: Found a structure in the End
Ein Bauwerk von Dungeons and Taverns gef: Found a Dungeons and Taverns structure

One look, and it stands still.

One block of Nether, eight blocks of overworld.

One block here is eight blocks up top.

A floor where mobs spawn fast.
A bow made of living wood.
Ein Bohrer mit Strom, &d1 000 FE&r pro V: A drill with power, &d1,000 FE&r per operation, charges the first ore or fluid laser base in its work area. Several drills around one base make it faster.
Ein Bohrer, der mit Strom immer größer w: A drill that grows with power.
Ein Boot und Blöcke zum Hochbauen helfen: A boat and blocks to build up help with boarding.
A book about souls, gods and the undead.
Ein Buch, das dir jeden Multiblock Schic: A book that shows you every multiblock layer by layer.

One clump, three small ones, nickel on top.
A diamond into the full Mana Pool.

One diamond, three hundred thousand FE.
A diamond, four shards, two essence.
A Djinni fills it up again.
A Djinni in the gem breaks Iesnium.
Ein Dorn oder ein heißer Wind statt dein: A thorn or a hot wind instead of your sword.

A bucket of water to take along.

An ore that looks like netherrack.

A field that keeps you fed.
A field that casts again and again.

Ein Feuer, das verwandelt statt verbrenn: A fire that transforms instead of burning.

A curse that grows with you.

A spark that makes fields grow.

A brew for a 30 block radius.

A spirit in the magic lamp.
A gift from the Starfire Birds.
A thunderstorm from the spell book.

A gold nugget for a friend.

A chicken egg and 4 mB of antimatter.
Ein Kabel ist so stark wie sein schwächs: A cable is only as strong as its weakest piece. A Basic cable (2,000 FE/t) between a Blazing reactor and a cell slows everything down to a fifth.
A box, a rod, a lot of cooling.
Ein Klick mit dem Stab, und die Mitte le: One click with the wand and the middle lights up.
One click, and the altar works.
One click, and the backpack is empty.
Ein Knopf neben dem Altar spart den Grif: A button next to the altar saves reaching for the wand. If you make many seeds in a row, put the ingredients on, press and take the seed out.
Ein Komparator daneben gibt ein Signal n: A comparator next to it gives a signal by fill level.
Ein Komparator liest den Füllstand, ein: A comparator reads the fill level, a redstone signal stops the output. With the slider in the window you limit how much it gives.
A compass that points in the Nether too.
One chop, two strips of bacon.
Ein Krater aus Himmelsstein mit Certus d: A crater of sky stone with certus inside.
Ein Kreis auf dem Boden, und du bist Mag: A circle on the ground, and you are a mage.
Ein Kristall macht im Akkumulator aus ei: In the accumulator one crystal turns a bucket of water into a whole bucket of solvent instead of only 100 mB.
Ein Käfig für eine Lohe, mit Magie versc: A cage for a blaze, sealed with magic.
A storage in its own dimension.
A laser in place of a pickaxe.
Ein Lastenaufzug, eine Bergbauplattform: A freight lift, a mining platform or a drilling rig that eats its way down layer by layer. The elevator with floors comes in stage 2.
Ein Laufwerk fasst &e16 000 Gegenstände&: One drive holds &e16,000 items&r in &e128 types&r. All QIO blocks on the same frequency are one network. The large drives need plutonium and antimatter from stage 5.
Ein Laufwerk mit acht 16k-Zellen hält üb: A Disk Drive with eight 16k disks holds over 130,000 items. That is enough for a whole stage.
Ein Lavablock gibt &e30 Sekunden&r lang: A lava block gives 45 mana per tick for &e30 seconds&r, so &d27,000 mana&r. After that it cools down for &e5 minutes&r. Lava it touches during the pause it swallows without mana and restarts the pause.
A delivery service on four paws.
Ein Manastoß zündet die Ladung. Daraus w: A mana burst ignites the charge. It becomes a &cManastorm Epicenter&r that hurls explosive mana bursts in all directions for a while.
A metal that does not disturb magic.
Ein Mixer über einem Becken, darunter ei: A mixer over a basin, below it a Blaze Burner kept &csuperheated&r with cake. &6Two copper&r and &6one zinc&r make &etwo brass ingots&r.
A mob fits into a bottle.
Ein Mobfanggerät mit Mob hinein, dazu &a: A Mob Imprisonment Tool with a mob inside, plus &aEssence&r and &d5,000 FE&r per operation. It spawns copies around itself and stops when there are too many nearby. With the Mob Crusher next to it, that is a mob farm without a spawner.
One multiblock instead of a hundred assemblers.
A name on paper is a leash.
A Nether Star and four Wyvern Cores.
One network for everyone in one colour.
Ein Netz mit allen drei Sorten ersetzt R: A network with all three kinds replaces pipes, cables and conveyor belts in a workshop.
A network as long as you like.
Ein Niotic Furnator macht &e2 000 FE/t&r: A Niotic Furnator makes &e2,000 FE/t&r and buffers 2 million FE.
Ein Ofen daneben macht aus den restliche: A furnace next to it turns the remaining logs into &6charcoal&r, the fuel for the Endoflames below.
A furnace with room for an upgrade.
A furnace on power instead of coal.
A place where you are heard.
Ein Pellet braucht also eine Million mB: So one pellet needs a million mB of polonium. The obelisk wants a hundred of them, each counts 30 points. That means: several fission reactors and power from everything you have.
Ein Pellet ist der Anfang, hundert will: One pellet is the start, the obelisk wants a hundred. Bring together &e10 antimatter pellets&r before they go into the chest.
Ein Pfosten ist &e4 Blöcke&r hoch, also: A post is &e4 blocks&r high, so you need that much room above it. The hammer on one side of the topmost block adds an arm. On it you hang connectors, relays, transformers or lamps.
A mushroom that counts as a petal.
Ein Platzierer pflanzt nach, ein Rohr br: A Placer replants, a pipe takes the wood away: the wood farm is done.
A portal between two block faces.
Ein Prosperiumbarren schluckt zwei Essen: A Prosperity Ingot swallows two essence.
A buffer for the whole base.
Ein QIO-Dashboard umringt von sieben &6P: A QIO Dashboard surrounded by seven &6Polonium Pellets&r and a Teleportation Core at the bottom. With it you have the network in your pocket.
Ein Quader von 3 bis 7 Blöcken pro Kante: A cuboid of 3 to 7 blocks per edge: edges of &6Assembler Matrix Frame&r, sides of Wall or Glass, the cores inside. At least one &6Pattern Core&r (36 crafting patterns) and one &6Craft Core&r (eight jobs).
Ein Quanteninfundierter Staub und 4 000: One Quantum Infused Dust and 4,000 mB of water make 1,000 mB of &6Quantum Infusion&r in the chamber. From that, with four copper ingots, four Shattered Singularities and &efour singularities&r, one &6Quantum Alloy&r ingot.
Ein Rad liefert &d8 RPM&r und &d256 SU&r: One wheel gives &d8 RPM&r and &d256 SU&r (32 SU per RPM). Several wheels on one shaft add up their SU, not their speed. Four wheels on a stream are a solid start.
Ein Raum ohne jedes Licht, mindestens &e: A room without any light, at least &e24 blocks&r from where you stand, platforms with open &6trapdoors&r at the edges, between them a shaft &e22 blocks&r deep. Monsters take open trapdoors for floor, step on them and fall.
Ein Raw Iron gibt &e3 Iron Sulfur&r, ein: One Raw Iron gives &e3 Iron Sulfur&r, an ore block &e5&r, an ingot only one. Each operation costs 10 mB of Sal Ammoniac, a bucket lasts for a hundred.
Ein Raw Iron gibt fünf Shards, zehn Bruc: One Raw Iron gives five shards, ten cobblestone or three crops give one. You need one shard per ingot. All devices also take input by hopper.
Ein Reaktor braucht 4 Stabilisatoren, al: A reactor needs 4 stabilizers, so four of everything.
A reactor that does not melt.
Ein Rechtsklick auf den gesetzten Emitte: A right click on the placed emitter shows whether everything is connected.
Ein Rechtsklick mit dem Stab des Waldes: A right click with the Wand of the Forest crafts at once and throws out the contents, a dispenser with the wand can do that too. Patterns on the crate lock fixed slots like placeholders.
Ein Redstone-Signal schaltet ihn ab, ein: A redstone signal turns it off, a comparator reads its progress.
Ein Redstone-Signal schaltet ihn ab, wen: A redstone signal switches it off when the herd gets too small. Flower and pool are in the &aBotania&r chapter.
Ein Repository fasst so viel wie eine Do: A Repository holds as much as a double chest and keeps its name when mined. Named inventories get their own &etab&r in the lectern.
Ein Rezept braucht so viele Injektoren,: A recipe needs as many injectors as it has ingredients. With Draconium injectors a fusion charges for 15 seconds and crafts for 15 seconds.
Ein Ritual für den Altar, ein Bauwerk dr: A ritual for the altar, a structure around it.
Ein Robenteil auf Stufe 2 gebracht: Brought a robe piece to tier 2
Ein Robenteil auf Stufe 3 gebracht: Brought a robe piece to tier 3
Ein Robit, der dir in die Mine folgt, sa: A Robit that follows you into the mine collects the drops, smelts the ore and mends the pickaxe.
Ein Rohes Eisen wird ein &6Eisenstaub&r: One raw iron becomes one &6iron dust&r and three small ones, nine small ones make a whole: about &e1.33 ingots&r instead of one. An ore block becomes two raw ores.
Ein Rohes Eisen wird ein &6Pulverisierte: One raw iron becomes one &6Powdered Iron&r and, at 80 percent, a second one. Coal becomes &6Powdered Coal&r, sand gives &6Silicon&r at 50 percent.
Ein Rohr daran liefert Wasser für Wascha: A pipe on it supplies water for washing, mixer or concrete, without any source in the ground.
Ein Samen mit &6Nährlösung&r gibt laufen: A seed with &6nutrient solution&r gives a steady harvest, wheat five per run. The Dissolution Chamber makes nutrient solution from Bio Fuel and Nutritional Paste (Nutritional Liquifier, stage 3).
A checkerboard of lapis and Livingrock.
Ein Schalter im Fenster wählt die Richtu: A switch in the window picks the direction: &econdensing&r turns gas into fluid 1 to 1 (fillable into buckets), &edecondensing&r turns water into water vapour or liquid gas back into gas.
Ein Schaltkreis, mit Feen-Essenz angekli: A circuit clicked with Fae Essence may be used by everyone. That way several mages fill one shared storage.
Ein Schild blockt die Feuerkugeln, Schne: A shield blocks the fireballs, snowballs damage blazes. Position yourself so they come to you. The Mekanism Crusher makes 4 blaze powder from one rod instead of 2.
A shield in front of you.
A shield that throws projectiles back.
Ein Schild, der so viel hält wie sein Ma: A shield that holds as much as its material.
One cut, the whole tree falls.
A sword that makes stars fall.
Ein Schwung schießt helle Energieblitze,: A swing fires bright bolts of energy that do solid damage to almost any target. Your first real ranged weapon from Eidolon.
Ein See in der Oberwelt ist endlich, die: A lake in the overworld is finite, the pump empties it block by block. Lava only becomes infinite with the lava ocean in the Nether (stage 2) or with fire seeds, next quest.
Ein Setzling jeder Farbe: rot, blau, grü: One sapling of each colour: red, blue, green, purple.
A signal right across the base.
Ein Sockel nimmt genau einen Gegenstand,: A pedestal takes exactly one item, right click puts it in and takes it out again. For a clear overview: essence on the four straight pedestals, material on the four diagonal ones, or the other way round.
A spawner that runs on power.
Ein Speed Addon gibt &e+50 Prozent Tempo: A Speed Addon gives &e+50 percent speed&r and &e20 percent more usage&r. On this server addons add up: two give +100 percent.
A storage bus that can read tags.
Ein Spirited Furnator macht &e8 000 FE/t: A Spirited Furnator makes &e8,000 FE/t&r. Nitro with 40,000 FE/t comes in stage 4.
Ein Spirited-Stab schiebt &e40 000 FE/t&: A Spirited rod pushes &e40,000 FE/t&r. Four of them charge a Spirited Crystal in a few seconds. The line to the rods has to carry that: Blazing cables manage 20,000 FE/t, Niotic 50,000.
A jump to your fellow player.
A jump back to a fixed place.
Ein Stahlgehäuse in der Mitte, &6Atomleg: A Steel Casing in the middle, &6Atomic Alloy&r in the corners, &6Polonium Pellets&r at the top, bottom, left and right. Gives four frames.
Ein Stapel Kohle reicht so für über 250: That way a stack of coal is enough for over 250 steel ingots instead of 32. Always send your steel line's coal through the chamber first.
A stack of steel for stage 3.
Ein Starter ersetzt pro Gärung den Zucke: One starter replaces the sugar or the crop per fermentation.
Ein Starter-Reaktor macht bis &e250 FE/t: A Starter reactor makes up to &e250 FE/t&r.
Ein Starter-Stab schiebt &e100 FE/t&r. M: A Starter rod pushes &e100 FE/t&r. Several rods work together.
A beam that mines and brings power.
Ein Stück brennt &e4 Minuten&r, macht &e: One piece burns for &e4 minutes&r, makes &e50 heat&r and &e240 power per tick&r. &6HEU-235&r (three to six) makes much more heat, &6TBU&r from thorium very little. With oxygen in the Fluid Infuser it becomes oxide fuel, more power, more heat.
Ein Stück brennt halb so lange wie im Of: A piece burns half as long as in the furnace and gives &d3 mana every 2 ticks&r, so 30 mana per second. Then a 2 second pause. Its buffer holds 300 mana; when it is full, it eats nothing new.
A saw carousel for big trees.
Ein Tank im Rucksack, den du mit Eimern: A tank in the backpack that you fill and empty with buckets. Together with the &6Pump Upgrade&r (glass, bucket, piston, sticky piston) it sucks up fluid or places it.
Ein Tauschkreis liegt neben meinem Schal: An exchange circle lies next to my circuit
Ein Team teilt sich die &eClaims&r (500: A team shares its &eclaims&r (500 chunks for the whole team, not per head) and its &equest progress&r: what one does is done for everyone. Each still claims the reward themselves.
A pond, a pipe, a tank.
Ein Teleportationskern, zwei Energietabl: A Teleportation Core, two Energy Tablets, two circuits. It jumps to every teleporter on your frequencies.
Ein Topf kocht mehrere Portionen nachein: A pot cooks several servings one after another if you put in enough ingredients.
Ein Totem mitten in der Tierfarm lohnt s: A totem in the middle of the animal farm is worth it.
A totem that recharges every night.
One potion for the whole base.
Ein Transporter auf der Seite, aus der g: One transporter on the side it pulls from, one on the side it inserts into. Right click the middle to switch direction, filter in the window.
Ein Treffer in einer Menge löst eine Bli: A hit in a crowd triggers a lightning chain that strikes hostile mobs nearby.
Ein Treffer reicht für einen Ghast. Das: One hit is enough for a ghast. At this distance it works better than any bow.
Ein Trichter vom Weizentopf oben in den: A hopper from the wheat pot into the top of the trough, and the supply comes on its own. A fence and a gate, that is all the pen needs.
A carrier who never gets tired.
A detour through the fission reactor.
One upgrade of this kind per storage.
Ein Verkäufer liefert, was im Netz liegt: A seller delivers whatever is in the network.
Ein Verlies von Dungeons and Taverns gef: Found a Dungeons and Taverns dungeon
Ein Vorrat, damit kein Abend am Barren s: A stock so no evening fails for lack of an ingot.
A sentry like an iron golem.
A crafting table recipe on paper.
A tool for the stone anvil.
Ein Werkzeug ohne Haltbarkeit bleibt als: A tool without durability stays in your inventory as &ebroken&r. Parts, enchantments and materials stay.
A tool that grows with you.
Ein Wyvern-Injektor kann auch alle Draco: A Wyvern injector also handles every Draconium recipe and charges faster (11 instead of 15 seconds). With eight you can replace the old ones completely.
A tooth from the Thirst Walker.
A spell on a redstone pulse.
Ein Zauber hat höchstens zehn Glyphen. W: A spell has at most ten glyphs. When it gets tight, split it up or take a wand.
Ein Zerkleinerer in die Mitte, Osmium li: A Crusher in the middle, osmium left and right, Advanced Control Circuits at the top and bottom, alloy in the corners.
Ein Ziel, mehrere Säulen, alle müssen vo: One goal, several pillars, all of them have to fill up.
Ein Zombie erscheint auf der Brazier. Mi: A zombie appears on the brazier. With bones a skeleton, with phantom membrane a phantom, with soul sand in the focus a wither skeleton.
Ein Zug fährt nur in die Richtung, in di: A train only runs in the direction its &6Train Controls&r point. For a line without a turning loop it needs a second set at the other end, with the front facing out.
An intermediate part for Wyvern recipes.
Ein abgenutztes Eisen- oder Goldmesser s: A worn iron or gold knife smelts into a nugget in the furnace.
Ein anderer Spieler benutzt den Kodex un: Another player uses the codex and learns every glyph from it they are missing. The codex is used up in the process. Ideal for a team in which one person collects the glyphs.
Ein beliebiges &6Alchemical Salt&r und e: Any &6Alchemical Salt&r and a &6water bucket&r, shapeless: &6Crystallized Water&r. With a lava bucket: Crystallized Lava.
Ein besessener Warden aus Posuc's Convoc: A possessed Warden from Posuc's Convocation counts as the sacrifice. The ritual is still only worth it if you have no steel. The block frames the portal to the Otherside, see the chapter &5Deeper and Darker&r.
Ein besserer Brennstoff für Öfen und Feu: A better fuel for furnaces and fire bowls, for example for Theurgy.
Ein brennendes Kolosseum in der Netheröd: A burning colosseum in the Nether wastes.
Ein chaotischer Injektor lädt in 3 Sekun: A Chaotic injector charges in 3 seconds. You get a new dragon egg from every dragon.
Ein dichtes Kabel durch alle Dimensionen: A dense cable through every dimension.
Ein echtes Netz mit Suche bringt erst &b: A real network with search only comes with &bApplied Energistics 2&r in stage 3.
Ein eigener Infusor nur für diese Mischu: An infuser just for this mix saves you rewiring.
Ein einziger Kiesel, ein einziger Treffe: A single pebble, a single hit.
Ein freier Platz für den Markt oder die: A free space for the market or the workshop, without building walls.
Ein freier Platz, sonst nimmt der Beacon: A clear space, otherwise the beacon accepts nothing.
A whole field in one breath.
A whole pentacle with one click.
Ein gefangener Mob, beliebig viele Kopie: One captured mob, as many copies as you like.
Ein gemeinsamer Hauptbahnhof mit mehrere: A shared main station with several tracks and chain signals is nicer for thirty players than thirty stub tracks.
Ein gemeinsamer Tunnel aus Bruchstein au: A shared cobblestone tunnel at Y 100 to 120 is usually quieter than the plain below. Coordinate with the others, and the server gets small.
Ein gezähmter Wolf, der es frisst, bekom: A tamed wolf that eats it gets effects for a while. Which ones is in the tooltip.
Ein gezähmtes Reittier bekommt davon für: A tamed mount gets effects from it for a while, which the tooltip lists.
Ein goldenes Blatt gibt mit 75 Prozent C: A golden leaf gives a Gold Leaf with a 75 percent chance. Keep the tree; you need Gold Leaf for each of the next steps and for the Source Keystone.
Ein großer Ritus mit vier Runen: &5Eldri: A greater rite with four runes: &5Eldritch&r, &dArcane&r and two &bAqueous&r, on Runewood.
A greater rite with four runes: &5Eldritch&r, &dArcane&r and two &eSacred&r, on Runewood.
Ein großer Schild vor dir. Monster prall: A large shield in front of you. Monsters bounce off, projectiles vanish, sneaking you can jump on it yourself. Costs &d300 mana&r.
Half a pool for one ingot.
Half a pool in your pocket.
A hard core at the edge.
Ein kleiner Garten mit allen vier spart: A small garden with all four saves you many trips later.
A small portal for quick trips.
A new material from two old ones.
Ein normaler Kompass dreht sich im Nethe: A normal compass only spins in circles in the Nether. The lodestone compass always points to its lodestone as long as you are in the same dimension. Put one next to your Nether portal, and you always find your way back.
Ein paar Dinge versteht sich von selbst:: A few things go without saying: leave other people's bodies alone (anyone can open them, see below). Thanks to &6Lootr&r, chests in structures have their own contents for every player, so there is no reason to empty them. Respect claims, even if there is a gap somewhere.
Ein paar Leute mit Spitzhacke im End, ei: A few people with pickaxes in the End, a circuit line at home, and the bar fills up.
Ein paar Stapel &6Rohzink&r in der Truhe: A few stacks of &6raw zinc&r in a chest, and on opening day you are right in.
Ein paar Treffer lang wird erlittener Sc: For a few hits, damage taken turns into mana. Costs &d40 mana&r.
Ein schöner Zug ist die Visitenkarte dei: A handsome train is your base's calling card on stream.
A rare catch from the deep.
Ein tödlicher Treffer löst es aus: &d6 L: A deadly hit triggers it: &d6 health points&r back, &d2 seconds&r of invulnerability and a strong shield boost. After that it recharges for &d120 seconds&r with 5 million energy.
Ein verbrauchtes LEU-235 gibt vier Uran-: One spent LEU-235 gives four uranium 238, one each of &6plutonium 239&r, plutonium 242 and americium 243, plus strontium and caesium. The uranium 238 goes back into the next mix.
Ein voller Eisensatz gibt 15 Rüstungspun: A full iron set gives 15 armour points. A leather &6lining&r brings Flexible IV.
Ein voller Stapel Eisen und Koks ist in: A full stack of iron and coke is through in a good hour. Steel from Immersive Engineering and from Mekanism is the same ingot, you can use it in both mods.
A second access to the storage.
A second life in the chestpiece.
Eine &6256M-Komponente&r braucht drei 64: A &6256M component&r needs three 64M, each of those three 16M. Together 13 Awakened nuggets and 27 4M components.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r im Steinschnei: An &6Andesite Alloy&r in the stonecutter makes an &6Andesite Table Cloth&r. Click the seller at the Stock Ticker with it, place it, put the goods on top and the price below.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r oben, eine &6W: An &6Andesite Alloy&r on top, a &6wool&r below it and three Andesite Alloys in the bottom row make the &6Nozzle&r. Put it on the front of an &6Encased Fan&r.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r und eine &6Eis: An &6Andesite Alloy&r and an &6iron trapdoor&r make the &6Item Hatch&r. Put it on a vault, a chest or another storage.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r über einem &6g: An &6Andesite Alloy&r above a &6dried kelp&r makes two &6Andesite Funnels&r. On a chest, depot or basin it pulls items out or pushes them in.
Eine &6Chorusblüte&r wächst nur auf Ends: A &6chorus flower&r only grows on end stone. A few blocks at your base are enough for a farm.
Eine &6Elektrische Pumpe&r mit &6Filter-: An &6Electric Pump&r with a &6Filter Upgrade&r gets &e10 mB of Heavy Water&r per water block. The Electrolytic Separator turns 2 mB of it into &e2 mB of Deuterium&r and 1 mB of oxygen.
Eine &6Elektrische Pumpe&r über einem Wa: An &6Electric Pump&r over a water block, power connected: it draws water up to &e80 blocks&r away without the lake getting emptier. The &6Basic Fluid Tank&r holds 32 buckets, &6Basic Mechanical Pipes&r pump 250 mB per tick.
Eine &6Elektronenröhre&r ist &6Polierter: An &6Electron Tube&r is &6Polished Rose Quartz&r on an &6iron sheet&r. The mixer makes rose quartz from Nether quartz and eight redstone, it is polished with sandpaper.
Eine &6Enderperle&r oben, &6drei Obsidia: An &6ender pearl&r on top, &6three obsidian&r around the upgrade base, &6two redstone&r in the bottom corners.
Eine &6Enderperle&r oben, &6zwei Eisenba: An &6ender pearl&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, at the bottom &6redstone&r, a &6wooden chest&r and &6redstone&r.
An &6ender pearl&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, one &6lead&r each bottom left and right.
Eine &6Enderperle&r und eine &6Amethysts: An &6ender pearl&r and an &6amethyst shard&r make &e4 Warp Dust&r.
Eine &6Formkarte&r in die Mitte, oben ei: A &6Shape Card&r in the middle, a &6water bucket&r at the top, a &6lava bucket&r at the bottom, &6iron&r left and right, &6redstone&r in the corners.
Eine &6Goldene Karotte&r oben, links ein: A &6golden carrot&r on top, a &6golden apple&r on the left, a &6glistering melon slice&r on the right, an &6ender pearl&r at the bottom, the upgrade base in the middle.
Eine &6Handkurbel&r und ein &6Zahnrad&r: A &6hand crank&r and a &6cogwheel&r make the &6crank wheel&r, a crank that meshes with cogwheels next to it.
Eine &6Holztruhe&r in die Mitte, &6acht: A &6wooden chest&r in the middle, &6eight planks&r around it. Every kind of wood works, it only changes the look.
Eine &6Holztruhe&r umgeben von &6acht Ei: A &6wooden chest&r surrounded by &6eight iron nuggets&r.
Eine &6Holztür&r und ein &6Zugrahmen&r e: A &6wooden door&r and a &6Railway Casing&r make a &6Train Door&r, a trapdoor and a Railway Casing a &6Train Trapdoor&r. They slide aside and fit into narrow carriages.
Eine &6Inferiumessenz&r oben rechts, ein: An &6Inferium Essence&r top right, a &6stick&r in the middle and a &6stone&r bottom left give the &6Wand&r.
Eine &6Infundierte Legierung&r mit &e20: An &6Infused Alloy&r with &e20 mB of diamond&r gives a &6Reinforced Alloy&r.
Eine &6Jukebox&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarre: A &6jukebox&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, a &6redstone&r at the bottom.
Eine &6Kartoffel&r im Becken wird für &d: A &6potato&r in the pool becomes a &6Tiny Potato&r for &d1,337 mana&r.
Eine &6Kohle&r und &e2 Inferiumessenz&r: One &6coal&r and &e2 Inferium Essence&r shapeless give &6Inferium Coal&r. It burns &e120 seconds&r, normal coal 80. Nine of them give an &6Inferium Coal Block&r.
Eine &6Lagerverbindung&r und ein &6Präzi: A &6Stock Link&r and a &6precision mechanism&r make two &6Factory Gauges&r. Tune them to your storage network and place them on the machine that makes an item.
Eine &6Lohenrute&r an der Werkbank gibt: A &6blaze rod&r at the crafting table gives two &6blaze powder&r. Blazes in Nether fortresses drop rods.
Eine &6Lohenrute&r oder vier &6Lohenstau: A &6Blaze Rod&r or four &6Blaze Powder&r give one &6Blazing Crystal&r for &e120,000 FE&r. A single Starter rod needs a minute for that.
Eine &6Mechanische Eisenkomponente&r obe: An &6Iron Mechanical Component&r on top, a &6Basic Engineering Block&r, a &6Conveyor Belt&r at the bottom make the &6Item Router&r.
Eine &6Mechanische Presse&r über einem B: A &6Mechanical Press&r over a basin of lava compacts 2 &6flint&r, 1 &6gravel&r and &b100 mB lava&r into one &6andesite&r. A &6Mechanical Mixer&r over a second basin makes &etwo andesite alloys&r from 1 andesite and 1 iron nugget.
Eine &6Persönliche Truhe&r oder ein Pers: A &6Personal Chest&r or Personal Barrel over a &6Laser Amplifier&r makes the &6Laser Tractor Beam&r.
Eine &6Pewter Inlay&r oben, drei &6viole: A &6Pewter Inlay&r at the top, three &6purple carpets&r, three &6Runewood planks&r from Malum. Pewter Inlay: four Pewter in a ring, gives two.
Eine &6Portable Lagerschnittstelle&r am: A &6Portable Storage Interface&r at the edge takes the harvest as it passes, an andesite funnel pulls it into your chest. With a &6Gantry&r instead of a bearing, the same machine runs back and forth over a square field.
One &6Portable Storage Interface&r on the carriage, one at the platform, facing each other when the train stops. Chests or &6Item Vaults&r on the train are the cargo storage.
Eine &6Sacrificial Bowl&r mit &e8 Goldbl: A &6Sacrificial Bowl&r with &e8 golden sheets&r from the Create press around it makes the &6Golden Ritual Bowl&r. It always stands in the middle.
Eine &6Schublade&r in der Mitte, &6acht: A &6drawer&r in the middle, &6eight obsidian&r around it.
Eine &6Steinstufe&r, &6glatte Steinstufe: A &6stone slab&r, &6smooth stone slab&r or &6andesite slab&r onto the belt. Two &6deployers&r each put an iron or zinc nugget on it, a &6press&r presses it tight. One round, one track.
Eine &6Säge&r schneidet Stein zu Stufen,: A &6saw&r cuts stone into slabs, they run onto the belt, two deployers with nuggets, a press, output into a chest.
Eine &6Truhe&r, Eisenbarren, ein &6Eisen: A &6chest&r, iron ingots, a &6block of iron&r and green dye, kelp or algae on top, see EMI.
Eine &6UU-Materie&r, &6Atomlegierung&r,: One &6UU Matter&r, &6Atomic Alloy&r, 2 &6Ultimate Control Circuits&r and a &6Steel Casing&r. It exists for items, fluids and chemicals.
Eine &6Verstärkte Legierung&r mit &e40 m: A &6Reinforced Alloy&r with &e40 mB of Refined Obsidian&r gives an &6Atomic Alloy&r.
Eine &6Werkbank&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarr: A &6crafting table&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, a &6chest&r at the bottom.
