Eine 16k-Zelle fasst &e130 048&r Stück e: A 16k cell holds &e130,048&r of one kind, &e66,560&r with 63 types. For many kinds in small amounts several small cells are better, the types per cell are always 63.
Eine 1k-Zelle fasst &e1 024 Gegenstände&: A 1k disk holds &e1,024 items&r. And that is all you need to know: RS counts &eno types&r. 1,024 different things one each fit in just as well as 1,024 cobblestone. AE2's 63 type limit does not exist here.
Eine 256k-Zelle fasst &e2 080 768&r Stüc: A 256k cell holds &e2,080,768&r items of one kind. With a Crafting Unit the component becomes 256k Crafting Storage.
Eine 4k-Zelle fasst &e32 512&r Stück ein: A 4k cell holds &e32,512&r of one kind, &e16,640&r with 63 types. A full cell and a larger component at the crafting table swap the component, the contents stay.
Eine 64k-Komponente im &6ME-Flüssigkeits: A 64k component in the &6ME Fluid Cell Housing&r gives the &664k fluid cell&r. With the chemical housing from Applied Mekanistics it becomes a chemical cell.
Eine 64k-Zelle fasst &e520 192&r Stück e: A 64k cell holds &e520,192&r items of one kind, &e266,240&r with 63 types. You upgrade full 16k cells at the crafting table, the contents stay.
Eine Anreicherungskammer davor macht Koh: An Enrichment Chamber in front turns coal into Enriched Carbon. The ore line from the &5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r chapter supplies the iron.
Eine Barriere des Lebensraubs steht: A Boundary of Drain Life stands
Eine Basis, in der man Dinge wiederfinde: A base where you find things again.
Eine Baumfarm mit Zerstörer und Ernte-Fi: A tree farm with a Destroyer and Crop Filter supplies endless saplings and leaves.
Eine Blüte ergibt formlos &e4 Magieblüte: One bloom gives &e4 Magebloom Fiber&r, shapeless. You need it for parchment, rune chalk, threads, robes and the Trinkets Pouch.
Eine Brückenseite ist ein flaches 3 x 3:: A bridge side is a flat 3 x 3: the chamber in the middle, eight rings around it. So you need &e16 rings&r and &etwo chambers&r.
Eine Chimäre ist ein Kampf, &e4 Tribute&: One Chimera is one fight, &e4 tributes&r are an evening with practice. Whoever can do the fights safely takes along someone who is still learning next time.
Eine Crafting-CPU als Multiblock, auf di: A crafting CPU as a multiblock, at most &e7 by 7 by 7&r on this server. Outside &6Quantum Computer Structural Glass&r, inside the &6core&r, units, storage, accelerators.
Eine Create-&6Kupplung&r und eine &6Ande: A Create &6clutch&r and one &6andesite alloy&r make the &6generator coupling&r. It is the base of every generator and sits on your drive shaft.
Eine Elite-Fabrik arbeitet an &esieben&r: An Elite Factory works on &eseven&r items. That also works for MoreMachine's factories.
An ender pearl bedded on brass.
An ender pearl through the hole.
Eine Energy Card schafft bis zu &d1 000: An Energy Card manages up to &d1,000,000 FE/t&r. An extract card at the generator, insert cards at every machine, and the power grid without cables is done.
Eine Fabrik arbeitet an &edrei&r Gegenst: A factory works on &ethree&r items at the same time. The arrow button in the window spreads stacks across all slots. After that: Advanced 5 slots (stage 3), Elite 7 and Ultimate 9 (stage 4).
Eine Farm pro Quest, drei Zeilen Aufbau,: One farm per quest, three lines of setup, and it runs while you talk.
Eine Feuer- oder Wasserkerze getränkt: A fire or water candle soaked
Eine Flüssigkeitszelle hält nur &e5 Type: A fluid cell holds only &e5 types&r, but &d8 buckets&r fit into one byte. Lava, water and oil land straight in the network, and you draw them off in the terminal with a bucket or a tank.
Eine Form: am Ziel entsteht ein Feld, da: A form: at the target a field appears that casts the rest of the spell again and again on everything inside for a while. AOE makes it bigger, Accelerate faster, Extend Time longer, Sensitive hits blocks.
Eine Fortschrittliche Fabrik arbeitet an: An advanced factory works on &efive&r items at once. Elite (7) and ultimate (9) come in stage 4.
Eine Glasflasche füllt eine &6Bottle of: A glass bottle fills a &6Bottle of Tallow&r (250 mB), a full bottle tips the tallow back in.
A hand that uses what it holds.
A witch shows you the way.
A witch that crafts for you.
Eine Hühnerfarm mit einem Tierfütterer d: A chicken farm with an Animal Feeder next to it is enough to start.
A crate with a hole in the bottom.
Eine Kiste voller Batteries, Tabletts un: A chest full of Batteries, tablets and tools, a hopper on it, and everything is full the next morning.
A blade that hits the soul too.
Eine Linse kommt an der Werkbank hinein,: A lens goes in at the crafting table; laid on the grid on its own, it comes out again. With the Bore Lens it becomes a long range drill.
Eine Lohe im Käfig, und Create wird heiß: A blaze in a cage, and Create gets hot.
A blaze rod full of power.
A million FE for your pocket.
A million mana in one place.
A million RF to take along.
Eine Monsterquelle, die du aufstellst, w: A monster source you set up wherever you want.
A pearl turns into dust that sparkles.
One plate per piece, at the smithing table.
Eine Reihe Monitore neben der Tür zeigt: A row of monitors next to the door shows iron, coal and diamonds at a glance. It needs 4 FE/t.
Eine Reihe Töpfe über einer Reihe Schubl: A row of pots over a row of drawers feeds the cooking pot, feeding trough and the Mycelial Sourcelink.
Eine Reihe: &6Atomlegierung&r, Elite-Sch: One row: &6Atomic Alloy&r, Elite Control Circuit, Atomic Alloy. The path through the Metallurgic Infuser is removed on Kronwerke.
Eine Sanfter-Fall-Kerze am Rand einer ho: A slow falling candle at the edge of a high building site saves lives.
Eine Schere am &6Fortress Grouper&r gibt: Shears on a &6Fortress Grouper&r give scraps, on an &6Eyeball Fish&r an eye. Eye and blaze powder make an eye of ender, without any ender pearl.
Eine Schleuse an der festen Schnittstell: A funnel on the fixed interface unloads into the storage or fills the train, depending on which way round it sits.
Eine Schüssel Eintopf, ein Tag Begleitsc: A bowl of stew, a day of escort.
Eine Seele, ein Gegenstand, ein Ergebnis: One soul, one item, one result.
Eine Seite ist Ausgang, die anderen Eing: One side is output, the others input. Turn the output towards the machine line, the generators to an input side.
Eine Silent-Gear-Spitzhacke ist ein &6Ko: A Silent Gear pickaxe is a &6head&r plus a &6rod&r. On top of that come &6binding&r, &6grip&r and &6tip&r if you want. Each part may be made of a different material.
Eine Sonnen- oder Glückskerze getränkt: A sun or luck candle soaked
One kind of fluid per compartment.
One kind, as much as you like.
Eine Spitzhacke, die mit Mana wächst, un: A pickaxe that grows with mana, and an axe for whole trees.
Eine Stufe öffnet für alle zugleich, ode: A stage opens for everyone at once, or not at all.
A bag that is bigger inside than outside.
Eine Thermalilie am Lavatank aus der Feu: A Thermalily at the lava tank of the fire seed farm and a Gourmaryllis at the kitchen replace a whole bed of Endoflames.
A trophy, only with the Elementium Axe.
A chest for witches and crows.
Eine Ultimative Fabrik hat &eneun&r Plät: An Ultimate Factory has &enine&r slots. Upgrade the slowest machine of your line first, that is where things jam.
Eine Vorrichtungs-Steuerung in der Kabin: Contraption Controls in the cabin become the floor selector. The pulley costs &d4 SU per RPM&r.
A wall only you walk through.
Eine Weizen- oder Kartoffelfarm vor dem: A wheat or potato farm in front of the Crusher, and it runs without coal.
A crafting table with four extra slots.
A crafting table that understands hoppers.
A crafting table that builds on its own.
A crafting table you always have with you.
A crafting table that keeps its ingredients.
Eine Zahl an der Wand, ein Griff ins Lag: A number on the wall, a reach into storage.
One cell, flat on the cable.
Eine angeklebte Truhe fängt das Holz, ei: A glued chest catches the wood, a &6Portable Storage Interface&r unloads it as it passes. Without a chest the logs fall to the ground, where hoppers collect them.
Eine ausgewachsene Kolonie erntest du mi: You harvest a fully grown colony with &6shears&r, after that it keeps growing.
Eine automatische Farm pro Quest: Stein,: One automatic farm per quest: stone, wood, fields, animals, monsters, lava and mana in stage 1, the stage 2 upgrades next to them.
A world of your own in a jar.
A floating island from your land.
Eine gesperrte Schublade merkt sich ihre: A locked drawer remembers its kind even when empty, so nothing wrong ever ends up in the iron drawer. &eSneaking right click into the air&r switches the mode (lock, counts, items, upgrades, fill level), &eright click&r on the drawer applies it.
Eine große Anlage mit vielen Etagen, Geg: A large complex with many floors, enemies and chests. Go in a group and take blocks for the way back.
Eine große Bestellung kommt oft in mehre: A large order often arrives in several packages, and other packages can slip in between. Route the packages into a storage, put the Re-Packager on it and give it a redstone signal.
Eine große Mahlzeit, die den Effekt Gesä: A big meal that gives the Nourishment effect.
Half a million µI of buffer.
Eine höhere Maschine entsteht fast immer: A higher machine almost always comes from the machine below it. You lose nothing when you upgrade.
A small sun in the basement.
Eine kurze Netherstrecke verbindet weit: A short Nether line connects bases far apart. Secure it, ghasts think nothing of schedules.
Eine nach der anderen, für alle zugleich: One after another, for everyone at once.
Eine neue Welt jetzt, die Chaosinsel spä: A new world now, the Chaos Island later.
Eine reine Magie-Basis vervielfacht Erz: A pure magic base multiplies ore here just as well as a pure tech base.
A huge chest with its own furnace.
Eine verlassene Schmiede, in der etwas s: An abandoned forge where something sleeps.
Einen &6Mechanischen Schleifstein&r (8 A: Use a &6Mechanical Grindstone&r (8 andesite alloy around a shaft) on an &6Item Drain&r: a grindstone drain. A second grindstone on top grinds &6experience nuggets&r into &b3 mB of liquid experience&r each, the drain empties bottles o' enchanting at &b10 mB&r each.
Einen &6Messingbarren&r per Rechtsklick: Apply a &6brass ingot&r to &6stripped wood&r with right click, that gives a &6Brass Casing&r. The Create mixer over a Blaze Burner makes brass.
Einen &6Monsterspawner&r mit einer Spitz: Mine a &6monster spawner&r with a pickaxe with &6Silk Touch&r (costs 100 durability) and place it at home over a shaft. It spawns up to &e4 monsters&r every 10 to 40 seconds as long as you are within &e16 blocks&r.
Einen &6Tainted Rock Item Pedestal&r (St: A &6Tainted Rock Item Pedestal&r (stonecutter) on the altar, on the stands &e8 Tainted&r and &e8 Twisted Rock&r each. Plus &e16 Sacred, Aerial, Aqueous&r and &e16 Infernal&r each.
See one block through all the others.
Einen Diamanten zerlegst du im Raster in: You break a diamond down into &enine shards&r in the grid.
Einen Dungeon von When Dungeons Arise ge: Found a When Dungeons Arise dungeon
Einen Eisenbarren auf den Altar legen, w: Put an iron ingot on the altar and wait.
Einen Ghast mit einem Feuerball erlegen: Kill a ghast with a fireball
Einen Trank in den Kessel gefüllt: A potion filled into the cauldron
Einen Zauber mit Glyphen der Stufe 3 geb: Built a spell with tier 3 glyphs
Einen Zauber mit Verweilen oder Wand im: Used a spell with Linger or Wall in a fight
Einen Zeit- oder Wettergeist gerufen: Summoned a time or weather spirit
Einen der beiden Riten gestartet: Started one of the two rites
Einen gesattelten Bewohner kannst du rei: You can ride a saddled Dweller and steer it with an &6Underbean on a Stick&r. The hopping &6Gloompers&r give Gloomper legs and leather.
Eines pro Kampf, für den, der zuerst zug: One per fight, for whoever grabs it first.
Einfache Rohre und Router stehen im Kapi: Simple pipes and routers are in the chapter &bPipes and Routers&r, an overview of everything in the chapter &6Checklist: Transport and Storage&r.
Einige Rezepte binden die Seiten aneinan: Some recipes tie the sides together. Already in stage 1: the gearbox needs &6Infused Iron&r, the keystone &bMana Diamonds&r and &6Andesite Alloy&r.
Einmal anklicken, immer wieder hinreisen: Click it once, travel there again and again.
Set up once, paste ten times.
Set it once, apply it everywhere.
Find them once, copy them forever.
Einmal pro Schlaf rettet er dich vor dem: Once per sleep it saves you from death like a totem. Needs a thread slot of &esize 3&r, so a tier 3 robe.
Travel once, free choice of destination.
Einsatzgeräte und sequenzielle Montage l: You learn deployers and sequenced assembly in &6Create: Brass&r. Trains need neither fuel nor rotation and run at up to &e28 blocks per second&r, &e14&r in curves.
You can carry them, not use them yet.
Attuner and an &6emerald&r, shapeless. Holds &d5,000 mana&r.
Einwohner lassen mit &d5 Prozent&r eine: Denizens drop a &6Mysterious Mask&r with a &d5 percent&r chance when you slay them. Looting raises the chance a little. Sometimes one lies in the camp chests.
Eisen brauchst du ständig: Create-Teile,: You need iron all the time: Create parts, buckets, cooking pot, Silent Gear, iron nuggets for andesite alloy. Take copper along right away.
Eisen geht in Sämaschine und Abwassermas: Iron goes into the Plant Sower and the sewage machines, gold into the Plant Gatherer and the Laser Drill, diamond into the Dissolution Chamber, the Bioreactor and every laser base.
Eisen gibt der Axt -0,1 Angriffstempo. F: Iron gives the axe -0.1 attack speed. Flint makes it dangerous in combat with Jagged.
Eisen in Mengen heißt Klumpen für die Le: Iron in bulk means nuggets for the alloy, buckets and tools. &cCareful:&r Protect the zombie from the sun, or it burns on the first morning.
Eisen in die Ecken, &6Eisengitter&r an d: Iron in the corners, &6iron bars&r on the sides, &6glass&r in the middle.
Eisen in die Ecken, Glas oben und unten,: Iron in the corners, glass at the top and bottom, an Annihilation Core on the left, a Formation Core on the right.
Eisen in die Ecken, ein &6Redstoneblock&: Iron in the corners, a &6block of redstone&r at the top, &6buckets&r left and right, a &6furnace&r at the bottom, the Pity Frame in the middle.
Eisen in die Ecken, oben ein &6Eimer&r,: Iron in the corners, a &6bucket&r at the top, &6redstone, diamond, redstone&r in the middle, a &6Marker&r between two iron at the bottom.
Eisen in die Ecken, vier &6Einfache Kond: Iron in the corners, four &6Basic Capacitors&r on the sides, a &6block of redstone&r in the middle.
Eisen in die oberen Ecken, &6vier Kolben: Iron in the top corners, &6four pistons&r around the upgrade base, redstone in the bottom corners.
Iron with a pinch of the End.
Eisen oben und an den Seiten, ein &6Kons: Iron at the top and on the sides, an &6Engineering Processor&r in the middle, three fluix at the bottom. Link them with the &6Memory Card&r: sneak and right click the input, right click every output.
Iron in, steel out, without lifting a finger.
Eisen rundherum, oben ein Kolben, in der: Iron all around, a piston on top, a circuit in the middle. It pulls by filter from the chest behind it and pushes into the transporter in front of it.
Eisen steckt in den Teilen für Create, d: Iron goes into the parts for Create, the first magic devices, the cooking pot and Silent Gear tools. Iron nuggets and andesite make &6Andesite Alloy&r, the material of the tech pillar at the obelisk.
Eisen und Feuerstein geben je +2 Schaden: Iron and flint give +2 damage each. Gold and copper enchant better (enchantability 22 and 15 against 14 for iron).
Iron and powdered coal, one ingot.
Eisen von Dorfbewohnern, die sich fürcht: Iron from villagers who are scared.
Eisen, &6Wägeplatte (Gold)&r, Eisen oben: Iron, &6heavy weighted pressure plate&r, iron at the top, &6cobblestone&r, Pity Frame, cobblestone in the middle, iron, &6piston&r, iron at the bottom.
Iron, copper and gold get flat.
Eisen, Kupfer, Eisen oben, ein Glaskabel: Iron, copper, iron at the top, a glass cable below in the middle. MEGA Cells' &6ME Cell Dock&r holds exactly one cell.
Iron, only three times as durable.
Eisen: +128 Haltbarkeit, +1 Tempo, +1 Sc: Iron: +128 durability, +1 speed, +1 damage, iron mining level. Gold: +6 speed. Redstone: +20 percent speed, +2 damage. Diamond: +256 durability, diamond mining level.
Eisenbleche, Wellen, Legierung und Andes: Iron sheets, shafts, alloy and andesite casing make the &6Rolling Mill&r (8 SU per RPM). A copper ingot becomes two &6copper rods&r, a copper sheet two &6copper wires&r.
Eldritch ist die schwierigste Sorte. End: Eldritch is the hardest kind. Endermen give it most reliably.
Electrum steckt in Energierohren, Gießer: Electrum goes into Energy Pipes, the Foundry, the Powered Furnace, the Processing Unit and the laser.
Elektrolyseur: Wasser zu Wasserstoff und: Electrolytic Separator: water into hydrogen and oxygen.
Elektronenröhren stecken in allem, was b: Electron tubes go into everything that processes signals in Create: Mechanical Arm, Smart Chute, Display Link. On Kronwerke also into the first Mekanism circuit and AE2's smart cables.
Elektrum, &6Redstonesäureeimer&r, Elektr: Electrum, &6Bucket of Redstone Acid&r, electrum on top, &6Nickel Plate&r, &6Basic Engineering Block&r, &6Iron Plate&r at the bottom make the &6MV Accumulator&r.
Elementium brauchst du für Elfen-Verbrei: You need Elementium for Elven Spreaders, the Conjuration Catalyst, elven tools, and the engineers need one ingot each for their &6Steel Core&r, the tech milestone of this stage.
Elfenglas ist sehr klar und sein Muster: Alfglass is very clear and its pattern changes with its position. More important: the flasks for ender essence are made from it.
Elfenquarz ist reine Deko: Blöcke, Säule: Elven Quartz is pure decoration: blocks, pillars, bricks and slabs in green. A good test with cheap goods.
Elite in the middle, atomic on the outside.
Elite-Filter können auch nach &eTags&r f: Elite filters can also filter by &etags&r: clicking a filter slot opens the extended filter with tag selection. The Elite Autocrafter works twice as fast as the normal one, for 5 FE/t.
Empfänger ist ein Spieler oder ein &6Cou: The recipient is a player or a &6Courier Depot&r, the postbox made of Hexerei planks. On a server with many bases the nicest way to send friends something.
Endermanfarm, Förderband zu einem Becken: Enderman farm, belt to a pool with a &6brass casing&r underneath, a Hopperhock at the edge of the pool, a chest. Done.
End stone without travelling to the End.
Energie-Würfel, Tanks und Tonnen stufst: You upgrade Energy Cubes, tanks and bins with Reinforced, then Atomic Alloy. &6Ultimate Cube&r &d102.4 million FE&r, &6tank&r 256,000 mB, &6Chemical Tank&r 8,192,000 mB, &6bin&r 262,144 items.
Energierohre tragen &e10 000 RF/t&r. Der: Energy Pipes carry &e10,000 RF/t&r. The &6Pipe Wrench&r (steel and nickel) cuts single sides.
Energy Upgrades ziehen diesen Mehrverbra: Energy Upgrades take that extra use off again and enlarge the buffer. Mix both instead of going only for speed.
Entfernt alle Trankeffekte vom Ziel und: Removes all potion effects from the target and sends summoned helpers back into their charm. On a &6witch&r at half health or less it gives &6Wixie Shards&r for stage 2.
Entrinde &6Torreya Logs&r mit der Axt. M: Strip &6Torreya Logs&r with an axe. Sometimes &6Raw Amaramber&r drops. A broken Torreya campfire gives some too. Collect 9.
Er &eteleportiert&r sich durch die Arena: It &eteleports&r through the arena, fires &dpurple projectiles&r, lays &dpurple traps&r on the ground and summons &ewaves of monsters&r. Whoever leaves the arena gets pulled back.
Er arbeitet acht Aufträge gleichzeitig (: It works on eight jobs at once (if the CPU has enough co-processors) and twice as fast as a normal one. You do not put patterns in directly, it only gets them from a provider.
It mines what you tell it.
Er baut, gräbt und schlägt mit Strom sta: It builds, digs and hits with power in place of durability, with modes for more speed. In stage 4 it is built into the middle of the &6Meka-Tool&r.
Er bewacht die Zitadelle und lässt einen: It guards the citadel and drops a Void Core.
Er bindet die Seele aus einer vollen Amp: It binds the soul from a full vial to an item. For that it needs power and &aliquid experience&r in its tank: XP Juice from Ender IO or Essence from Industrial Foregoing.
Er braucht &d80 AE/t&r plus etwas mehr f: It needs &d80 AE/t&r plus a little more for every chunk. It also gives random ticks, so certus keeps growing.
Er braucht Platz um sich und freien Himm: It needs room around it and open sky. A cube in between catches the night.
Er braucht beides gleichzeitig: &6Schlei: It needs both at the same time: &6slime balls&r in the slot and &6milk&r in the tank. The Animal Rancher gets milk from cows.
Er braucht freien Himmel und ruht nachts: It needs open sky and rests at night. Set up several, one alone is slow.
Er braucht nur 2 FE/t. Für ein kleines N: It only needs 2 FE/t. For a small side storage in another room that is cheaper than a drive.
Er brennt mit festem Brennstoff wie Kohl: It burns solid fuel like coal and has an internal storage for it. Its advantage is the &eupgrade slot&r: with a machine upgrade it smelts faster.
Er brät bis zu sechs Stücke ohne Brennst: It grills up to six pieces without fuel and is the best heat source for pot and skillet. Campfire, lava or a magma block work too.
Er dreht einstellbar bis 256 RPM, trägt: It turns adjustably up to 256 RPM, supplies up to 16,384 SU and needs &d480 FE per tick&r at full speed. That way a mixer runs even without a stream.
Er erhöht die Chance, dass bei einem Tre: It raises the chance that a fairy appears when you are hit, even without Elementium armor. Strongest together with the armor.
Er ersetzt das Werfen ins Wasser: aus je: It replaces throwing things into water: from four each of charged certus, redstone and nether quartz with water it makes eight fluix. The side with the screen does not connect to the network.
Er erzeugt Quelle, wenn in der Nähe Tier: It makes Source when animals are bred or creatures die nearby, plus a little on its own for every baby animal. The babies grow faster. Next to an animal farm it works on the side.
Er fasst &e1 000 000 RF&r und nimmt und: It holds &e1,000,000 RF&r and takes and gives &e5,000 RF/t&r each. Power goes in on all &agreen&r sides and only out at the &cred&r port. Mined, it keeps its charge.
Er fasst &e128 Itemsorten&r und &e256 00: It holds &e128 item types&r and &e256,000 items&r in total. Pipes and hoppers work with it like with a shulker box. When broken it keeps everything.
Er fasst &e256 Eimer&r und behält den In: It holds &e256 buckets&r and keeps its contents when you mine it. Tanks stacked on top of each other let the fluid flow down, a comparator shows the fill level.
Er fasst bis zu &b2 Eimer&r Flüssigkeit:: It holds up to &b2 buckets&r of fluid: water, lava, tallow, blood or potion. Solid ingredients you throw in from above, push in with a hopper or put into the menu. If everything is right, it mixes by itself.
Er feuert, solange das Ziel Mana aufnimm: It fires as long as the target takes mana, a new burst only when the last one has arrived. Long distances cost mana; the sparks in the aiming beam show where the loss begins.
Er frisst &eKuchen&r, die neben ihm steh: It eats &ecakes&r placed next to it, slice by slice. A cake factory with Create's Mechanical Crafters makes it a strong mana source.
It runs while you are somewhere else.
Er füllt &e6 Hunger&r und gibt &eAbsorpt: It fills &e6 hunger&r and gives &eAbsorption&r for &e3 minutes&r. The apples of the higher tiers add Speed, Resistance and more on top. A good snack before a dungeon when essence is left over.
Er gibt Geräten ohne eigene Klemmen eine: It gives devices without terminals of their own a connection and also feeds FE machines, such as Mekanism's, from your grid.
Er gibt dem Netz &d20 AE/t&r, ohne dass: It gives the network &d20 AE/t&r without you ever refilling anything. More than one per network does not work, the vibrations disturb each other, even through quartz fiber.
He gives you the Orb of Prophecy.
Er gibt genau eine Verzauberung auf Stuf: It gives exactly one enchantment at level I or raises an existing one by one, on enchanted items too. Every step costs levels and Soul Shards.
Er gleitet wie eine Elytra, hält aber we: It glides like an elytra, but takes less and accepts no enchantments. Dives and rockets harm it more. It is repaired with Tough Fabric.
Er gräbt schneller, findet auch Tiefensc: It digs faster, also finds deepslate ores and wears the lamp out more slowly. Echo shards come from the possessed Warden of Posuc's Convocation, or from the chests of the Ancient Cities.
Er hat &e8 Kanäle&r, jeder vom Typ &6Ite: It has &e8 channels&r, each of the type &6Item&r, &6Fluid&r, &6Energy&r or &6Logic&r. In the channel you set which blocks give and which receive. Power: 1 RF/t per active channel, one cable from the grid is enough.
Er hat &e80 Leben&r und Rüstung 12, schi: It has &e80 health&r and armour 12, shoots burning bones and spits ash. Shield up and stay on it.
Er hat zwei Modi: &eMobs spawnen&r oder: It has two modes: &espawn mobs&r or &ecapture mobs&r. If there are too many mobs or too many spawners nearby, it stops and shows the reason in its window.
Er hält 3 Minuten, mit Redstone 8. Der B: It lasts 3 minutes, with redstone 8. The brewing stand runs on blaze powder. A stack of them belongs in your bag for every longer trip.
Er hält chaotische Ausrüstung im Feld vo: It keeps Chaotic gear full in the field without you having to go back to the Energy Core.
Er hält die Chunks um sich herum geladen: It keeps the chunks around it loaded, you choose which in the window. For whole factory halls it is better than an anchor upgrade per machine.
Er hängt an deiner QIO-Frequenz und über: It hangs on your QIO frequency and watches one kind: give it an item and an amount, then its signal lights up as soon as that much is in storage.
Er hängt an denselben LV-Anschlüssen und: It hangs on the same LV connectors and relays, and a stretch may likewise be &e16 blocks&r long at most.
It hangs from the ceiling, often over lava.
Er isst alles, was ein Spieler essen kan: It eats anything a player can eat. Nutrition and saturation decide how much power and for how long. A potato or carrot farm with a Plant Gatherer keeps it fed.
It is the first step of every essence ingot. Make a few in advance: two go into the first tool, four into the Inferium Watering Can.
It is harder than the Wither.
Er ist schön an der Wand, bewegt mit Red: It looks nice on the wall, moves its jaw with redstone, and it is the crown of the best bookshelf for the enchanting table (quest &6Draconic Endshelf&r further right).
Er kann auch eine Truhe regelmäßig ins L: It can also empty a chest into storage at regular intervals.
Er kommt in einen &eRing-Slot&r (Curios): It goes into a &ering slot&r (Curios) and carries the traits of its metal. What a metal brings is in the &6Material Book&r. Bracelet and necklace follow the same principle.
Er liefert &e2 250 000 bis 3 750 000 J/t: It delivers &e2,250,000 to 3,750,000 J/t&r, so 900,000 to 1,500,000 FE/t, and stores 256.6 million J. One antimatter pellet costs a trillion J: a single Large Wind Generator needs about four and a half hours for that.
Er lädt Werkzeuge und Rüstung in deinem: It charges tools and armor in your inventory and holds much more than the Wyvern Capacitor. In the fight against the Guardian the shield eats power, a full capacitor keeps it up.
It charges tools and armor in your inventory. Charge it yourself at a pylon or a charging station.
Er lädt dann die Stromgeräte in deinem I: It then charges the powered items in your inventory, Starter at &e500 FE/t&r. Use the card on an enderman or an endermite, then it becomes the &6Dimensional&r card.
Er lädt die Werkzeuge in deinen Händen u: It charges the tools in your hands and the armor you wear. You wear it as a chest piece, or you combine it with a chestplate at the crafting table.
Er macht &e64 RF/t&r aus &6Biomasse&r un: It makes &e64 RF/t&r from &6Biomass&r and other plant matter, buffer 100,000 RF. The Pulverizer makes biomass from plants, saplings and crops, 16 at once from one Packed Wheat.
Er macht Barren zu Staub, Bruchstein zu: It turns ingots into dust, cobblestone into gravel, obsidian into four obsidian dust (stage 3 needs that). Plants and food become &6bio fuel&r, an apple two.
Er macht aus &eeinem Erz drei Staub&r un: It makes &ethree dusts from one ore&r and is twice as fast as the Foliot. It also crushes ice, packed ice and blue ice into dust without it melting.
Er macht aus &eeinem Erz sechs Staub&r u: It makes &esix dusts from one ore&r and needs only 30 percent of the Djinni time. The Marid Crystallizer (Gray Paste, Iesnium block, budding amethyst, sea lantern, sculk catalyst) even turns obsidian into crying obsidian.
Er macht aus &eeinem Erz vier Staub&r un: It makes &efour dusts from one ore&r and needs only half as long as the Djinni. Iesnium ore now gives four ingots instead of one.
Er macht aus Edelsteinstaub wieder Edels: It turns gem dust back into gems and multiplies gem ores. The Foliot is very slow at it, the Djinni twice as fast.
Er macht aus mehreren Formkarten eine. J: It makes one card out of several shape cards. You can add, subtract or intersect each shape, rotate and mirror it. A sphere minus a smaller sphere gives a dome, a cuboid minus a cylinder a round shaft.
It reports and keeps chunks loaded.
Er merkt sich eine ganze Liste von Orten: It remembers a whole list of places and refuels with ender pearls. It can also &eblink&r: up to 32 blocks, one pearl lasts 4 jumps.
Er nimmt beliebig viele Quellen und Ziel: It takes any number of sources and targets. An &6item scroll&r in its hand or in a frame on the chest filters what it touches.
Er nimmt nur Drehung von &6Windmühle&r o: It only takes rotation from the &6Windmill&r or &6Water Wheel&r of Immersive Engineering, no shafts from Create. &ePlace the dynamo first&r, then the windmill or wheel on its shaft side.
Er pariert Angriffe und wirft Feuerbälle: He parries attacks and throws fireballs. Come with good armor and food. His loot: the book of the dimension, Glistering weapons, Seeking Eyes.
Er presst Barren zu Platten: Blei für di: It presses ingots into plates: lead for the casing, Tough Alloy for the port. Lead plates also work with Immersive Engineering's Engineer's Hammer.
Er presst drei Zutaten zu einem Teil: ge: It presses three ingredients into one part: printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon become a finished &6AE2 processor&r. Also for Applied Flux and Advanced AE.
Er ragt mehrere Blöcke hoch und braucht: It reaches several blocks high and needs free space. A few on a peak, cabled to the cube, replace a coal supply.
Er reicht &e5 Blöcke&r weit und bedient: It reaches &e5 blocks&r and serves depots, belts, chests, basins, Blaze Burners and crafters. It costs &d2 SU per RPM&r.
It tidies up behind the others.
Er sammelt Items vom Boden, erntet Quell: It collects items from the ground, harvests Sourceberries and carries items from chest to chest. No Source, no food. A second charm on the same Starbuncle stacks it: it then carries several stacks.
Er sammelt liegende Items ein und bringt: It collects items lying around and brings them into a target chest. Next to the Crusher it carries the dust away as soon as you enter it in the allowed list (it also starts on whitelist).
Er schießt größere Manastöße, schneller: It fires bigger mana bursts, faster and farther, and loses less on the way. Swap the spreaders at your best flowers, then the pools at the portal stay full.
Er schmilzt alles in einem Zehntel der O: It smelts everything in a tenth of the furnace time, without fuel. In the same pentacle: the &dAfrit Crystallizer&r (Gray Paste, lapis block, amethyst block, quartz block, dripstone block), which puts crushed blocks back together.
Er schmilzt alles, was Ofen, Hochofen, R: It smelts everything a furnace, blast furnace, smoker or campfire can, without fuel and as fast as a furnace.
Er schmilzt mit &e32 RF/t&r alles, was e: With &e32 RF/t&r it smelts anything a furnace smelts and needs one machine core.
Er schmilzt ohne Brennstoff in der halbe: It smelts without fuel in half the time. Placed next to the Djinni Crusher, with Transporter and Janitor in between, ore becomes ingots without your help.
Er schmilzt schnell und verbrennt &6Uran: It smelts fast and burns &6uranium ingots&r as fuel instead of coal. According to NuclearCraft surprisingly safe for a furnace.
Er schmilzt zwei Staube zu einer Legieru: It smelts two dusts into an alloy. Hook it permanently to a dust line, you need it for the whole chapter.
Er schneidet Bleche zu Kabeln und Drähte: They cut plates into wire and take wires down.
Er schneidet Holz und Planken wie eine S: It cuts wood and planks like a stonecutter: connected plank patterns that only exist here, and stairs, slabs and more with less waste than at the crafting table.
Er setzt Blöcke aus seinem Inventar vor: It places blocks from its inventory in front of it, controlled by redstone. Right click with a &6redstone torch&r changes how it reacts to the signal. Together with a quarry or Builder you automate construction work this way.
Er setzt zwei Gegenstände zu einem zusam: It combines two items into one, such as raw ore and cobblestone into an ore block. With the &6Stone Generator Upgrade&r it needs no cobblestone.
Er sitzt in der Wand und zeigt Zellen, M: It sits in the wall and shows cells, moderators, heat sinks and heat. The &6Fission Reactor Designer&r is not available: it needs an &cAnalyzer&r, and that has no recipe in this version. So plan in the controller.
Er speichert &d100 000 Mana&r. Zauber in: It stores &d100,000 mana&r. Spells within at most &e10 blocks&r draw from it. Whoever clicks it first owns it. Right click puts mana in, sneaking you switch it on and off.
Er speichert &e1 000 000 FE&r, je Seite: It stores &e1 000 000 FE&r, &d1 024 FE/t&r per side. Set the sides with the hammer as with the LV Accumulator.
Er speichert &e100 000 FE&r, je Seite &d: It stores &e100 000 FE&r, &d256 FE/t&r per side. Right click with the hammer sets a side to &9blue&r (input), &6orange&r (output) or off, sneaking the opposite side.
Er speichert die Einstellungen einer Mas: It saves a machine's settings, such as side configuration and filters, and transfers them to a second machine of the same kind. Saves a lot of clicking when you want to set up ten Plant Sowers or Plant Gatherers the same way.
Er spricht jede Seite des Blocks an, wic: It addresses every side of the block, which matters for Mekanism machines. Up to &d100,000 RF/t&r in place of 10,000 and &b5,000 mB&r per operation in place of 1,000.
Er sprüht jede Flüssigkeit, auf Wunsch b: It sprays any fluid, burning if you like.
Er steckt im Energiekern (zwei), im Mob-: It goes into the Energy Core (two), the Mob Grinder, the relay crystals and every Wyvern tool. Make more than you think.
Er steckt im Kinetischen Dynamo, im Ther: It is in the Kinetic Dynamo, in the Thermoelectric Generator and in the Charging Station.
Er steht auf einer Wärmequelle: &6Magmab: It stands on a heat source: &6magma block&r 800 degrees, &6lava&r 1,000, Blazing Crystal Block 2,800. As a coolant it takes water. Output like the Solar Panel, but around the clock.
Er sättigt und macht dich beim Abbauen s: It fills you up and makes you faster at mining, ideal for long building evenings.
Er tauscht wie der Otherstone-Händler, n: It trades like the Otherstone trader, only for &6Otherrock&r. Otherrock is good for bowls and building, but not for chalk.
It carries a Totem of Undying.
Er tötet Mobs, als hätte ein Spieler zug: It kills mobs as if a player had struck: loot plus &aEssence&r, &d50 FE&r per operation. In the second mode you get loot with random Looting instead of Essence. Essence fills the enchanting machines, and the Dissolution Chamber makes a bottle o' enchanting from 250 mB.
Er tötet Tiere und Mobs in seinem Bereic: It kills animals and mobs in its area, without loot or experience, for &d400 FE&r per operation. Out come &6Liquid Meat&r and &dPink Slime&r. Peaceful animals give more slime.
Er verbraucht &6Lava&r aus dem Tank zusa: It uses &6lava&r from the tank together with &6redstone&r in the slot. The Fluid Laser Base with an Orange Lens drills lava for you in the Nether.
Er verbrennt &6Lava&r zu &e64 RF/t&r, do: It burns &6lava&r into &e64 RF/t&r, twice as much as the Basic Generator, buffer 100,000 RF. It needs &etwo cores&r. &6Sheol Fire&r from the refinery burns much longer than lava.
Er verbrennt Gas aus seinem Tank. &bWass: It burns gas from its tank. &bHydrogen&r comes from the Electrolytic Separator (&5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r chapter), but splitting costs more power than the hydrogen gives back.
Er verbrennt alles, was im Ofen brennt,: It burns anything that burns in a furnace for &d30 FE/t&r, buffer 100,000 FE. It keeps burning even when the buffer is full. It is enough to start with, later the Biofuel Generator replaces it.
It burns anything that burns in a furnace, makes &e32 RF/t&r and buffers 50,000 RF. It needs no cores and takes no addons. Two or three of them carry the Pulverizer, furnace and Foundry.

It burns everything that burns in a furnace and makes &eheat&r of it in place of power: by the config 400 units per burn tick. Thermodynamic Conductors carry it to the boiler, as with the Resistive Heater.
It burns anything that burns in a furnace. &eEco&r and &eEco Plus&r get more out of the fuel, &ePerformance&r and &eOverdrive&r give more output. Not enough for fusion and the Energy Core, but fine as backup power.
Er verbrennt jeden Brennstoff, den auch: It burns any fuel a furnace takes too. The longer something burns, the more power you get.
Er verwandelt Dinge mit ein paar mB Anti: It transforms things with a few mB of antimatter: coal into diamond (4 mB), egg into dragon egg, plus iron, lapis, redstone, quartz, glowstone, emerald, echo shards, heart of the sea. The two pellets are missing from the obelisk.
Er verzaubert auch Werkzeuge und Rüstung: It also enchants tools and armour directly, up to Mana Boost and Mana Regen. EMI shows every recipe.
Er verzaubert mit &bFlüssiger Erfahrung&: It enchants with &bliquid experience&r instead of levels, without lapis, up to level 30. More in &6Create: Addons&r.
Er verzehrt Essen in der Nähe oder auf P: It eats food nearby or on pedestals next to it; nourishing food gives more, Sourceberry food much more. It turns the ground in the 3x3 below it into mycelium and grows mushrooms.
It taps latex from a log.
Er zaubert Pfeile aus Mana wie mit Unend: It conjures arrows from mana as if with Infinity and repairs itself with mana.
Er zeigt alle laufenden Aufträge und bri: It shows all running jobs and cancels them when a machine gets stuck. The wireless version (monitor, ender pearl, Advanced Processor) does that from your pocket.
It shows you the way to any biome.
Er zeigt wie der Speichermonitor einen G: Like the Storage Monitor it shows an item, but also how fast its amount changes: per second, per minute or per ten minutes. That way you see whether your ore processing keeps up or a farm is weakening.
Er zeigt wie ein Trichter in eine Richtu: Like a hopper it faces one direction and charges all powered items in the chest or container in front of it, Starter at &e500 FE/t&r. It gets power by cable.
It points to the nearest meteorite.
Er zerlegt eingesammelte Mystische Blume: It breaks collected Mystical Flowers down into petals right away and also holds Shimmering Mushrooms. A sneaking right click switches collecting on and off.
Er zieht den Strom aus den Gegenständen: It draws the power out of the items in its slots and gives it to cables and machines next to it. The counterpart of the Energy Hopper.
Er zweigt von durchlaufenden Stapeln ein: It splits single items off passing stacks onto belts or funnels next to it. Only the Brass Tunnel can sort on purpose.
Erde aus dem Nichts, ein Sprung in den H: Dirt out of nothing, a jump into the sky.
Erde und Samen in die Mitte, Wasser hine: Soil and seeds into the middle, water in, &d8 FE/t&r of power. The harvest comes out at the front. It also grows hemp, flowers, nether wart and chorus fruit.
Erde, Karotte, Kartoffel, giftige Kartof: Dirt, carrot, potato, poisonous potato, rotten flesh and nether wart give a &2Kodoku&r.
Erfahrungsklumpen fallen aus Roherz zwis: Experience nuggets drop from raw ore between the crushing wheels. The &6Experience Hatch&r (fluid hatch and block of experience) on the tank is your bank: right click pays in levels, sneaking takes them out again.
Erfahrungsklumpen werden zu &bFlüssiger: Experience nuggets become &bliquid experience&r, enchanted items lose their enchantments to the drain. On the side it polishes rose quartz.
Erledigt sich über den Fortschritt &eHei: Completes through the &eHot Tourist Destinations&r advancement. The Biomes O' Plenty biomes don't count for it.
Erleg &65 Freezes&r in der Golemschmiede: Slay &65 Freezes&r in the Golem Forge. They guard the Permafrost's room.
Erleg &e10 Endermen&r und bring &e16 End: Slay &e10 endermen&r and bring back &e16 ender pearls&r. Stand under a roof two blocks high: there they cannot reach you.
Erleg &e10 Shulker&r. Jeder lässt mit et: Slay &e10 shulkers&r. With a bit of luck each drops a shell.
Erleg &e3 Hoglins&r im Karmesinwald. Sie: Kill &e3 hoglins&r in the crimson forest. They drop pork and leather and are the only real food source down here.
Erleg &e5 Endermapteras&r. Sie haben nur: Slay &e5 Endermapteras&r. They only have 16 health, but come in groups.
Erleg &e5 Lohen&r an ihrem Spawner und b: Kill &e5 blazes&r at their spawner and bring &e8 blaze rods&r along. Each blaze drops up to one rod, Looting more.
Erleg Ghasts, bis du &e2 Ghasttränen&r h: Kill ghasts until you have &e2 ghast tears&r. Easiest with the bow, or hit their fireballs back.
Erleg Shulker, bis du &e4 Shulkerschalen: Slay shulkers until you have &e4 shulker shells&r. Two shells and a chest make a &6shulker box&r, which keeps its contents when mined.
Erleg Witherskelette, bis einer seinen &: Kill wither skeletons until one drops its &6skull&r. Looting helps.
Erleg ein &6Schwein&r mit einem Küchenme: Kill a &6pig&r with a kitchen knife. It drops &6ham&r.
Erleg eine &bBöe&r. Sie springt herum un: Kill a &bBreeze&r. It jumps around and shoots &6wind charges&r that knock you back. It deflects arrows, so get close.
Erleg einen &3Großen Wächter&r im Ozeanm: Kill an &3Elder Guardian&r in the ocean monument. Every monument has three, and as long as one lives, it paralyses you again and again with Mining Fatigue.
Erleg einen &5Ender Golem&r. Er hat &e15: Slay an &5Ender Golem&r. It has &e150 health&r, armor 12, and summons void runes from the ground that deal 7 damage.
Erleg einen &6Ghast&r mit seinem eigenen: Kill a &6ghast&r with its own fireball. Hit the fireball at the right moment with your hand, the sword or an arrow, and it flies back.
Erleg einen &6Ignited Revenant&r in der: Kill an &6Ignited Revenant&r in the arena. It drops &6Burning Ashes&r, the key for Ignis.
Erleg einen &cMagier&r. Er wohnt in Wald: Kill an &cEvoker&r. It lives in woodland mansions and comes in the later waves of a raid on a village.
Erleg einen &cMimic&r. Er sieht aus wie: Kill a &cMimic&r. It looks like a chest until you try to open it, and then it strikes hard.
Erleg einen &cPiglin-Barbaren&r. Sie bew: Kill a &cpiglin brute&r. They guard the bastions with golden axes, attack you despite gold armour and don't come back once dead.
Erleg jede Art einmal. Jede lässt &6Uthe: Slay each kind once. Each drops &6Utheric Shards&r.
Erleuchtetes Quarzglas schmilzt du in de: You smelt Enlightened Fused Quartz in the Alloy Smelter from Fused Quartz and a glowstone block or four glowstone dust.
Ernte &6Grabenknollen&r. Eine Knolle erg: Harvest &6Ditchbulbs&r. One bulb makes one &6Ditchbulb Paste&r, paste over a stick makes &e2 torches&r.
Harvests fields and fells whole trees.
Erntet Pflanzen, Gras und Blumen um den: Harvests plants, grass and flowers around the block you hit. Handy for the Farmer's Delight fields.
Erreich ein schwebendes Bauwerk von When: Reach a floating When Dungeons Arise structure and tick this off: a small airship or one of the three sky fortresses (Heavenly Rider, Challenger, Conqueror).
Erst &6zwei Redstone&r und &6zwei Lapis&: First &6two redstone&r and &6two lapis&r. Then &6four Soul Shards&r and stir twice. Finally a &6Soul Crystal&r from Deeper and Darker.
Erst &6zwei Redstone&r und einen &6Soul: First &6two redstone&r and a &6Soul Shard&r into the boiling Crucible, then &6two gold ingots&r. Out come &etwo&r Arcane Gold.
Only all four pieces bring the bonus.
Erst das &6Lexikon&r: ein Schaltkreis üb: First the &6Dictionary&r: a circuit over a book. Then the &6Oredictionificator&r: top steel, glass pane, steel, middle circuit, Dictionary, circuit, bottom steel, chest, steel.
Erst das Wyvern-Modul: Draconiumbarren i: First the Wyvern module: Draconium Ingots in the corners, &6netherite scrap&r at the top and bottom, redstone left and right, a Module Core in the middle. Then: netherite ingots in the corners, Draconium Core at the top, Wyvern Core at the bottom, Awakened ingots left and right, the Wyvern module in the middle.
Erst der &6ME Import Export Bus&r: Impor: First the &6ME Import Export Bus&r: import bus, Logic Processor, export bus in a row. Then Acceleration Cards in the corners, Quantum Processors at the top, middle and bottom, the Import Export Bus on the left, an &6ME Stock Export Bus&r on the right.
Erst die &5Wächterkristalle&r, dann sein: First the &5Guardian Crystals&r, then its shield with &e16,000&r points, then &e1,000&r health. The bar at the top shows how many crystals still stand and how much shield it has.
Erst die &6Diamantsichel&r: &e3 Diamante: First the &6Diamond Sickle&r: &e3 diamonds&r in an arc, a stick bottom left. Then the sickle in the middle, &e2 Inferium Ingots&r left and right, &e2 Inferium Gemstones&r top and bottom.
Erst die &6ME-Fertigungskonsole&r (forml: First the &6ME Crafting Terminal&r (shapeless: ME Terminal, crafting table, Calculation Processor), from it with an &6Engineering Processor&r the &6ME Pattern Encoding Terminal&r. &6Blank Patterns&r: quartz glass, glowstone, certus, iron and copper, gives two.
Erst die &6Otherworldly Tablet&r: &6Othe: First the &6Otherworldly Tablet&r: &6Otherstone&r in the middle, &e4 gold ingots&r on the sides, &e4 Otherworld Ashes&r in the corners.
First the crystals, then the dragon.
Erst die Quelle anklicken, dann das Ziel: Click the source first, then the target. Sneaking on a helper resets it.
First a mage, later a power plant.
Erst genau eine &aForm&r (wie), dann &aE: First exactly one &aform&r (how), then &aeffects&r (what), behind each link &aaugments&r (how strong). It reads from left to right.
Erst hier gehen die großen Riten: ein Do: Only here do the great rites work: a villager as a sacrifice or turned into a zombie. The light path cures zombie villagers here.
Erst mit allen vier Teilen kosten Werkze: Only with all four pieces do Botania's tools and rods cost much less mana, and the rods get stronger. Anyone who works a lot with rods is best off wearing this robe.
Erst rote Kreide bindet einen Afrit, der: Only red chalk binds an Afrit that works for you.
Erste Zentrifuge ohne Verarbeitungseinhe: First centrifuge without a Processing Unit: three &6glass bottles&r at the top, &6copper&r left and right, a &6Motor&r in the middle, at the bottom iron block, Motor, iron block.
Erwachen neben &6Knospendem Amethyst&r g: Awakening next to &6budding amethyst&r gives an &6Amethyst Golem Charm&r. With a &6book and quill&r as an addition you get &6Bookwyrm Charms&r.
Erwachte Barren in die Ecken, ein &6Wyve: Awakened ingots in the corners, a &6Wyvern Core&r at the top, a &6Draconic Core&r at the bottom, &6Large Chaos Fragments&r left and right, a &6Draconic Shield Module&r in the middle.
Awakened Draconium is the fuel. The injector charges the core to start and then holds the &econtainment field&r. The stabilizers give off the power.
Erz und Flüssigfleisch werden Rohes Erzf: Ore and Liquid Meat become Raw Ore Meat.
Erz und Stein im Vorbeigehen, mit Biodie: Ore and stone in passing, on Biodiesel.
Erz, Flüssigkeiten und Blöcke, mit Strom: Ore, fluids and blocks, with power use.
Ore that falls from the sky.
Erzblock gibt 2 Barren, Rohes Erz 1 plus: An ore block gives 2 ingots, raw ore 1 plus a half chance of a second. It melts Electrum, Constantan and bronze straight from dust. Not brass.
Erzeugende Blumen verbrauchen etwas und: Generating flowers consume something and turn it into &dmana&r. They pass it on to the nearest &6Mana Spreader&r, which they bind to on their own when planted.
Es brennt sechzigmal so lange wie ein Sc: It burns sixty times as long as a sip and gives the effect to all players within &e30 blocks&r. Not every brew works: no instant healing, nothing with several effects.
Es fasst &e128 000 Gegenstände&r in &e25: It holds &e128,000 items&r in &e256 types&r, the normal drive 16,000 in 128. Put it into your Drive Array from stage 4, the network stays the same.
Es fasst deutlich mehr Schild als das dr: It holds clearly more shield than the Draconic one and only fits into Chaotic armor.
Es fliegt zur nächsten &6Burning Arena&r: It flies to the nearest &6Burning Arena&r. That only stands in the &eNether wastes&r. Follow it until you are inside.
Es füttert dich aus dem Rucksack, sobald: It feeds you from the backpack as soon as you are hungry and picks food that won't be wasted. A few stacks from Farmer's Delight last a long time.
Es gibt &b20 Eterna&r und hebt die Grenz: It gives &b20 Eterna&r and raises the limit to &b100&r, the enchanting table's maximum. A few of them replace a whole wall of ordinary shelves.
Es hat den Schaden des alten Schwerts pl: It has the damage of the old sword plus a bonus for the enchantments, and undead flee from it. The compendium explains Emrys, Nobu and Replica.
Es hat so viele Plätze wie das Extended: It has as many slots as the Extended Interface, but each holds &d16 times&r as much: 1,024 items instead of 64. Ideal as a stock next to machines that eat large amounts at once.
Es ist auch die Zutat für das drakonisch: It is also the ingredient for the Draconic Undying Module from stage 5.
Es ist ein Zwischenprodukt für den Stahl: It is an intermediate for steel dust. Make a stack right away; the fusion's reactor glass needs it later too.
Es ist wie eine kleine ME-Truhe ohne Kon: It is like a small ME Chest without a terminal, but a flat cable part: several docks fit on the same piece of cable. Handy as a buffer in a small subnetwork.
Es kommen Witherskelette mit ihren Skele: Wither skeletons come with their skeleton minions. The big spirits are nearly invulnerable until their minions are defeated, so clear the small ones first.
Es kostet keine Belastbarkeit. Damit sch: It costs no capacity. With it a lever switches a press from gentle mode to full power.
Es liefert bei Tageslicht bis zu &d16 µI: In daylight it gives up to &d16 µI/t&r. The &6Vibrant Photovoltaic Module&r as the next tier manages &d64 µI/t&r.
Es liefert bei Tageslicht bis zu &d4 µI/: In daylight it gives up to &d4 µI/t&r and needs a clear view of the sky. Not much, but forever and without upkeep. Good for topping up a capacitor bank during the day.
Es listet jedes Material mit Haltbarkeit: It lists every material with durability, speed, damage and traits and sorts by them. In the inventory, &eCtrl&r over a material shows the same stats.
Es lädt Werkzeuge und Rüstung mit Strom,: It charges tools and armor with power, buffer 500,000 RF, and fills fluids into gear such as the jetpack, up to 16 buckets in its tank.
Es lädt den Schild &e2,5-mal&r so schnel: It recharges the shield &e2.5 times&r as fast as the Wyvern module. In the fight it is not only how big the shield is that counts, but how fast it comes back.
Es macht &e28 FE/t&r, solange es Tag ist: It makes &e28 FE/t&r as long as it is day and the sky is clear. Three of them with four &6Plate Advanced&r, quartz dust and a Coil Copper make a &6Solar Panel Advanced&r with &e112 FE/t&r.
Es presst Items, die ein 2x2-Rezept habe: It presses items with a 2x2 recipe into a block right away, for example clay balls or quartz. 3x3 recipes like nuggets into ingots need the advanced version from stage 2.
Es ruft einen Afrit ohne rote Kreide, ka: It summons an Afrit without red chalk but cannot control it. It only comes to fight. Leave the pentacle standing, you need it hundreds of times.
Es sammelt die Erfahrung, die abgebaute: It collects the experience that mined ores drop.
Es saugt Items auf, die vor der eingeste: It sucks up items lying in front of the set side. Good under cacti, sugar cane or a mob trap.
Es schiebt so schnell, wie der Puller zi: It pushes into the block next to it as fast as the Puller pulls. A drawer full of coal supplies furnaces or a belt that way. Create funnels work without an upgrade too; drawers are normal inventories.
Es speichert &d16 Millionen&r Energie un: It stores &d16 million&r energy and charges at &d256,000&r per tick. Bows, shield and flight draw a lot in the fight, so several belong in the bow and the chestpiece.
Es steckt in Adapter, Elektromagnet, Mot: It goes into adapter, electromagnet, motor, meters and generator casing.
It does not want to be touched.
It only grows in the End now.
Es zeigt alles hinter den Interfaces, mi: It shows everything behind the interfaces, with tabs for items, fluids and power. Search: text in the name, &e@&r by mod, &e#&r in the tooltip, &e$&r by tags. An eye of ender on it unlocks a tab for your ender chest.
Es zeigt alles im Netz, mit Suchfeld und: It shows everything in the network, with a search box and crafting windows. Give it the same frequency as the Drive Array.
Es zeigt die Herstellungsaufträge, die d: It shows the crafting jobs your network is working through. That way you see at a glance whether an order runs or hangs.
Es zieht aus dem Block &eüber&r dem Lage: It pulls from the block &eabove&r the storage and pushes into the block &ebelow&r, each direction with its own filter. Under a farm it collects the harvest, and only the seeds go on down.
Etwa so stark wie Eisen, hält länger, ve: About as strong as iron, lasts longer, enchants better and &erepairs itself&r with mana from tablet or Band of Mana. Right click with the pickaxe places a torch, with the axe a sapling.
Etwas langsamer als die einzelnen Werkze: A bit slower than the single tools, but saves two hotbar slots.
Eulen leben im Dunklen Eichenwald. Zähm: Owls live in the dark oak forest. Tame them with raw &6cod&r or &6salmon&r, best thrown on the ground.
Extra: &6Enderperle&r, &6Lesser Soul Gem: Extra: &6ender pearl&r, &6Lesser Soul Gem&r and &e2 Soul Shards&r.
Extraktoren an die Ausgabe von Cauldron,: Extractors on the output of cauldron, oven and distiller, inserters on the three vessels, all connected with wire. A chest of Raw Iron at the start, one at the end.
FE-Zellen gibt es jetzt bis &64M&r. Bei: FE cells now go up to &64M&r. At 1,048,576 FE per byte a 64k cell holds a good 68 billion FE.
Fackellilien wachsen aus Samen, die der: Torchflowers grow from seeds that the &esniffer&r digs up. Sniffer eggs are found in suspicious sand in the warm ocean ruins. Plant the seeds right away.
Faden gibt Flexibel I, Flachsstrang Flex: String gives Flexible I, Flax String Flexible III and +5 percent speed, Sinew Fiber Flexible IV. Vines only give looks.
Faden spannt 10 Prozent schneller, Sehne: String draws 10 percent faster, Sinew Fiber gives +20 percent ranged damage.
Fahr den Zug an einen Bahnhof und schalt: Drive the train to a station and switch &eassembly mode&r on there. The train falls back into blocks on its bogeys.
Fang deinen Vertrauten mit dem Ring und: Catch your familiar with the ring and wear it as a curio. It keeps working without walking next to you. Whoever gets the ring and releases the familiar becomes its new master.
Fang einen &6Gwibbling&r mit einem Wasse: Catch a &6Gwibling&r with a water bucket. Gwiblings swim in the seas.
Fang mit etwas Einfachem an, zum Beispie: Start with something simple, for example logs to planks. A pattern may also say 8 cobblestone to 8 stone, then the machine works in larger steps.
Fang mit vier Samen an und pflanz jede E: Start with four seeds and plant every essence again until the field is full. 8 essence make one seed, so it pays to start early and harvest later.
Farbe pro Rang: &9Blau&r Foliot, &5Viole: Colour per rank: &9blue&r Foliot, &5purple&r Djinni, &eyellow&r Afrit, &agreen&r Marid. The name in the book doesn't matter, only the rank counts.
Farbstoff, &6Fass&r und &6Andesitlegieru: Dye, &6barrel&r and &6Andesite Alloy&r below each other make a &6Postbox&r. Right click a station with it and set it down nearby, then give it an address.
Farmer's Delight, Farming for Blockheads: Farmer's Delight, Farming for Blockheads and Aquaculture: meals that keep you full for a long time, rich soil, animals and fishing.
Fibre for sails, fabric and plant oil.
Fasst &e32&r Einheiten und repariert mit: Holds &e32&r units and repairs at &e40 percent&r. For hammer and paxel, which wear a lot.
Fast jede Maschine braucht zwei bis vier: Almost every machine needs two to four, a conveyor recipe six. A stack is a good first goal, let the extractors run day and night.
Fast jede Maschine dieser Stufe braucht: Almost every machine of this stage needs something from here: &6blaze rods&r for the Blaze Burner, &6Nether quartz&r for electron tubes, &6glowstone&r for the Aether portal, &6magma&r and Nether bricks for the blast furnace.
Fast jeder Powah-Block hat ein Casing im: Almost every Powah block has a casing in its recipe. Build four right away.
Fast jeder große Mod bringt sein eigenes: Almost every big mod comes with its own handbook.
Fast jeder große Multiblock hat genau ei: Almost every large multiblock has exactly one. A redstone signal on it stops the machine, the screwdriver turns that around.
Fast jedes Gerät braucht einen &eKanal&r: Almost every device needs a &echannel&r. A normal cable carries &e8&r, a &6dense cable&r (four covered cables) carries &e32&r. Build like a tree: dense cables as branches from the controller, normal cables as twigs, at most eight devices per twig.
Fast jedes Rezept in Botania ist eine Li: Almost every recipe in Botania is a list of petals. You need white right away, brown, red and light grey shortly after.
Fast unbegrenzt viele Blöcke einer Sorte: Almost unlimited blocks of one kind.
Fatma's Incentivized Attraction: ein Erz: Fatma's Incentivized Attraction: one ore, six dusts.
Faustregel: Kreuzungssignal vor der Weic: Rule of thumb: chain signal before the junction, entry signal behind it. Otherwise a train stops in the middle of the junction. The goggles show whether a section is occupied.
Feenstaub steckt in den neuen Blumen, im: Pixie Dust goes into the new flowers, the Corporea Spark, the Conjuration Catalyst, the Great Fairy Ring and twice into every &dElven Star&r. The pearl factory from stage 2 (brass casing below the pool) just keeps running.
Felder automatisierst du mit &6Industria: Automate your fields with &6Industrial Foregoing&r or with Oritech's &6Destroyer&r and a harvest filter.
Fermentiertes Erzfleisch und Sand werden: Fermented Ore Meat and sand become dust.
Ferroboron durch die Manufactory zu Stau: Ferroboron through the Manufactory into dust, then &6ferroboron dust&r and &6lithium dust&r in the Alloy Smelter. Gives two &6Tough Alloy&r.
Ferroboron steckt in Servo und Aktuator: Ferroboron goes into the servo and actuator and is the step before the tough alloy.
Fertige Quests klickst du an und holst d: Click finished quests to claim the reward. How the book, EMI and the map work is in the chapter &6Tips and Tricks&r.
Finished quests glow until you click them.
Fest aufgestellt ist er das Herz eines B: Placed in one spot it is the heart of a cobblestone generator. On a piston, bearing or gantry it becomes a tunnel borer.
Feste Blöcke außer Gras ersetzt sie nich: It does not replace solid blocks except grass, nor water. So lay it on flat ground, then it closes cleanly.
Fire and air make falling leaves.
Filter und Stückzahlen kann erst die Mes: Filters and stack sizes only come with the Brass Funnel in stage 2.
Filter by tags instead of items.
Finde den &5Cursed Garden&r, ein Heckenl: Find the &5Cursed Garden&r, a hedge maze full of &6Tangled&r. Slay &610 Tangled&r on the way to the middle.
Finde die &6Aviary&r (Voliere) von When: Find the &6Aviary&r from When Dungeons Arise. It only stands in the End Highlands and Midlands.
Finde ein &6Höhlenlager&r von Artifacts: Find an Artifacts &6campsite&r and tick this off. It lies in caves between &eY -60 and 40&r, with light and a chest.
Find an &6ocean monument&r and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments&r builds it bigger and more varied.
Finde ein Bauwerk von When Dungeons Aris: Find a When Dungeons Arise structure at sea and tick this off: Undead Pirate Ship, Illager Corsair or Galley, the &6Typhon&r, a lighthouse or a fishing hut.
Finde ein Dorf in einem Biom, das in Van: Find a village in a biome that has none in vanilla and tick this off: beach, birch forest, flower forest, jungle, meadow, mushroom island, swamp, badlands and more.
Finde ein Dorf und hak ab. Dorfbewohner: Find a village and tick this off. Villagers trade for &6emeralds&r, which you need for the Warp Stone, the Market and taverns.
Finde ein Verlies von &6YUNG's Better Du: Find a dungeon from &6YUNG's Better Dungeons&r and tick this off: skeleton dungeons, zombie dungeons, spider caves or small dungeons.
Finde ein kleines Bauwerk von &6Formatio: Find a small structure from &6Formations Overworld&r or &6Explorify&r and tick this off.
Finde eine &6Bastionsruine&r aus Schwarz: Find a &6bastion remnant&r of blackstone and bring a &6gilded blackstone&r along.
Finde eine &6Katakombe&r: lange Gänge au: Find a &6catacomb&r: long corridors of Depthrock bricks with burial chambers and altars. Go inside.
Finde eine &6Prüfungskammer&r aus Kupfer: Find a &6trial chamber&r of copper and tuff and defeat the waves of a &6Trial Spawner&r. It ejects a &6Trial Key&r as it does.
Finde eine alte Mine und hak ab. &6YUNG': Find an old mineshaft and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Mineshafts&r builds them from different wood and stone depending on the biome, with ore veins, storage and minecarts.
Finde einen &6Plünderer-Außenposten&r un: Find a &6pillager outpost&r and tick this off. Towns and Towers builds it differently in every biome, from badlands to snowy slopes.
Finde einen Dungeon von &6When Dungeons: Find a dungeon from &6When Dungeons Arise&r on land and tick this off: Foundry, Plague Asylum, Mechanical Nest, Keep Kayra in the swamp, Shiraz Palace in the desert, Thornborn Towers, Illager Fort or Windmill, Bandit Village, Monastery.
Finde einen Wüstentempel, Dschungeltempe: Find a desert temple, jungle temple or witch hut and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Desert Temples&r, &6Jungle Temples&r and &6Witch Huts&r turn them into big complexes.
Finde eines der kleinen Bauwerke von &6F: Find one of the small structures from &6Formations Nether&r and tick this off.
Finde eines dieser Bauwerke und hak ab:: Find one of these structures and tick this off: &6Creeping Crypt&r, &6Undead Crypt&r, &6Stray Fort&r, &6Illager Manor&r, illager hideout, &6Toxic Lair&r, jungle or desert ruins.
Find one of these structures and tick this off: &6Nether Keep&r, &6harbour&r at a lava lake, &6piglin donjon&r, piglin outpost and piglin camp, or a &6skeleton tower&r.
Find one of these structures and check off: the &6End Castle&r, the &6End Lighthouse&r or the &6End Ship&r from Dungeons and Taverns, or the &6End Shipwreck&r from Explorify.
Finde in der Oberwelt eine &6Portalruine: Find a &6portal ruin&r in the Overworld with a frame of &6Chiseled Voidstone&r. Talk to the &bGatekeeper&r, choose &eChallenge&r and defeat him. He drops the &bOrb of Prophecy&r.
Findest du Verhülltes in einer Truhe, ni: If you find something veiled in a chest, take it along. On the day the stage opens it shows its name and you can use it right away.
Findet auch Gold. Die Diamant-Stufe brau: Finds gold too. The diamond tier needs quartz and diamond, the best one, the blaze rod, netherite scrap. Rods built with Sulfur are fixed to one ore group.
Finds what the eye doesn't see.
Fleisch und Leder ohne Schwert, die Kälb: Meat and leather without a sword, the calves stay.
Meat and leather from the Dweller.
Flexibel: das Werkzeug nimmt oft keinen: Flexible: the tool often takes no damage.
Flying without an elytra on your back.
Fliegen wie im Kreativmodus, solange die: Fly as in creative mode, as long as the source lasts.
Flying without taking off the chestplate.
Fliegt im Bogen wie ein geworfener Trank: Flies in an arc like a thrown potion. Each Pierce lets it bounce off the ground once. Good for targets behind walls.
Flowing Grasp im Lager oder an der Baust: Flowing Grasp in the storage room or at the building site: you reach chests and blocks from farther away.
Fluid Addon, water, a wheat field.
Fluix steckt in Kabeln, Kernen, Controll: Fluix goes into cables, cores, the controller and the growth accelerator. You need nether quartz in bulk, put Fortune on your pickaxe.
Fluix-Werkzeuge sind wie Eisen, halten a: Fluix tools are like iron, but last three times as long and hit a little harder. Each works as if it had at least &eFortune I&r or &eLooting I&r, with no enchanting table at all.
Fluid into items and out again.
Flüssigkeiten zählen &e8 Eimer pro Byte&: Fluids count &e8 buckets per byte&r. So a 64k fluid cell holds over half a million buckets of one kind.
Flüssigkeits-Laserbasis über einem Withe: A Fluid Laser Base above a wither.
Fluid Pump and pipes instead of buckets.
Flüssigzellen liegen im selben Laufwerk: Fluid disks sit in the same drive as item disks. Lava, water, oil, Mekanism fluids: everything that fits in a pipe comes into the network with Importer and Exporter. At the top of the Grid you switch between seeing items or fluids.
Folg dem Kompass und grab dich in den Kr: Follow the compass and dig into the crater. Take &616 Certus Quartz Crystals&r and &616 Sky Stone&r with you. In a furnace Sky Stone becomes the &6Sky Stone Block&r for the controller.
Folg einem Seeking Eye zu einer &6Golem: Follow a Seeking Eye to a &6Golem Forge&r and go inside. Collect &64 Frozen Tubes&r from the &6Freezes&r on the way.
Folge der Reihe oben von links nach rech: Follow the row at the top from left to right: secure a base, collect cobblestone, go to the obelisk, deliver. You know Minecraft; this is only about what is different on Kronwerke.
Follow the treasure map to the cross.
Foliot mit Beruf altern nicht. Verletzt: Foliot with a job don't age. If they are hurt, you heal them with a Demon's Dream Fruit.
Formlos aus einem &6Leuchtfeld&r, einem: Shapeless from an &6Illuminated Panel&r, an &6Engineering Processor&r and a &6Pattern Provider&r.
Formlos aus einer &6Fortgeschrittenen Ka: Shapeless from an &6Advanced Card&r and a &6Superdense Energy Cell&r.
Formlos mit &6Laub&r wird es zum &6Horn: Shapeless with &6leaves&r it becomes the &6Horn of the Canopy&r, which clears leaves, with a &6snowball&r the &6Horn of the Covering&r for snow.
Formlos mit einer Kerze gecraftet bekomm: Crafted shapeless with a candle, the candle gets the effect &aGrowth&r. Burning, it lets plants nearby grow faster.
Formlos: &5Ärgerlicher Archwood-Stamm&r,: Shapeless: &5Vexing Archwood Log&r, &e3 Wilden parts&r (spike, horn, wing, mixed), &9lapis block&r.
Formlos: &6Arkanes Podest&r, &6Quelljuwe: Shapeless: &6Arcane Pedestal&r, &6Source Gem block&r, &e3 gold ingots&r.
Formlos: &6Buch&r (oder das Notizbuch),: Shapeless: &6book&r (or the notebook), &6iron sword&r, &6iron pickaxe&r, &6iron axe&r, &6iron shovel&r.
Formlos: &6Schablonen-Provider&r und &6A: Shapeless: &6Pattern Provider&r and &6Accumulation Processor&r give the &6MEGA Pattern Provider&r, &6ME Interface&r and processor the &6MEGA Interface&r.
Formlos: &6Sternbunkel-Charme&r und &6Wa: Shapeless: &6Starbuncle Charm&r and a &6water wheel&r from Create.
Formlos: &6Zauberbuch des Magiers&r, &e3: Shapeless: &6Mage's Spell Book&r, &e3 ender pearls&r, &e2 emeralds&r, &6Totem of Undying&r, &fNether Star&r, &5Wilden Tribute&r.
Formlos: &6Zauberbuch für Anfänger&r, &e: Shapeless: &6Novice Spell Book&r, &e1 obsidian&r, &e3 diamonds&r, &e2 quartz blocks&r, &e2 blaze rods&r. Glyphs and saved spells move along.
Formlos: &6gebratenes Hähnchen&r, zwei &: Shapeless: &6cooked chicken&r, two &6baked potatoes&r, two &6carrots&r, &6onion&r, &6egg&r, &6bread&r and &6bowl&r.
Formlos: &e4 Lapislazuli&r, &e4 Quelljuw: Shapeless: &e4 lapis lazuli&r, &e4 Source Gems&r, &6Blank Parchment&r.
Formlos: ein &6Dislocator&r, ein &6Draco: Shapeless: a &6Dislocator&r, a &6Draconium Core&r and a &6ghast tear&r. With two Dislocators instead of one it becomes the point to point version that links two Dislocators with each other.
Formlos: eine &6Erde&r, zwei &6Stroh&r,: Shapeless: one &6dirt&r, two &6straw&r, two &6bone meal&r, four &6tree bark&r. Or dirt, two straw, two rotten flesh and four bone meal.
Framed Drawers in your building style.
Freezing friert Lava und Wasser vor dem: Freezing freezes lava and water in front of the laser, &d100 FE&r per block. Light Placer puts the &6Miner's Light&r into dark tunnels while mining, also &d100 FE&r per light.
Freies, flaches Feld weit weg von Basen,: An open, flat field far from bases, no lava. &eProjectile, Lightning, Amplify&r, Linger fields and bows keep you at a distance.
Freunde in deine Chunks lassen, ohne ein: Let friends into your chunks without sharing a team.
Friedliche Tiere aus großer Entfernung l: Peaceful animals from far away slowly walk to the brazier.
Eats flowers, the more colorful the better.
Frisst Laub in 8 Blöcken Umkreis, &d160: Eats leaves within 8 blocks, &d160 mana per block&r, without saplings or apples. When everything is gone, it pauses for 80 seconds.
Eats wool in the right color.
Froststahlwaffen verlangsamen jedes Ziel: Froststeel weapons slow every target they hit. That is worth a lot against fast enemies. There are also armor and tools made of Froststeel.
Früher oder später schaust du ohnehin in: Sooner or later you will look into the three big chapters anyway: &6Create&r, &dArs Nouveau&r and &aBotania&r. Have fun in the Kronwerke.
Sparks that carry items instead of mana.
Funktioniert wie das Glas der Leere: In: Works like the Void Jar: in the hotbar it destroys the items on its list as you pick them up. Instead of mana it gives a little &dexperience&r for them.
Funktionsblumen ziehen Mana aus dem näch: Functional flowers draw mana from the nearest &6Mana Pool&r within &e10 blocks&r. A spreader can't supply them directly.
Fusion, Stufe Draconium: eine &6Truhe&r: Fusion, Draconium tier: a &6chest&r in the core. In ten injectors: &65 furnaces&r, &62 Draconium Cores&r, &62 crafting tables&r and &61 Draconium Block&r. Costs 2 million energy.
Fusion, Stufe Wyvern: &6Dislocator&r im: Fusion, Wyvern tier: &6Dislocator&r in the core, in eight injectors &63 ender pearls&r, &64 Draconium Ingots&r and &61 Wyvern Core&r. Costs 1 million energy.
Fusioniere den &6Drakonischen Bogen&r au: Fuse the &6Draconic Bow&r from your Wyvern Bow and fit it with Draconic projectile modules. Recipe and modules are in the chapter &5Draconic: Awakened and Chaos&r.
Fusionskern, Injektoren, Generator, Pylo: The Fusion Crafting Core, injectors, Generator, pylons, Particle Generator and all cores of the Wyvern tier need one or more of them. Make eight right away.
Fäll &616 Lunar Logs&r. Die hohen Lunar-: Fell &616 Lunar Logs&r. The tall Lunar trees stand in almost every forest.
Fäll &616 Smogstielstämme&r. Das ist das: Fell &616 Smogstem Logs&r. That is the building wood of the Undergarden.
Fäll &e16 Karmesinstiele&r im &6Karmesin: Fell &e16 crimson stems&r in the &6crimson forest&r. The wood doesn't burn and is good building timber.
Fell &e16 warped stems&r in the &6warped forest&r. This wood doesn't burn either.
Fängt Schleime, die in einem &eSchleimch: Catches slimes that spawn naturally in a &eslime chunk&r. Small &d2,400&r, medium &d4,800&r, large &d19,200 mana&r.
Fängt ein Wesen in &e3 Blöcken&r Umkreis: Catches a creature within &e3 blocks&r and puts it into a jar next to it. Creatures in jars count as neighbours for the Drygmy.
Führ das Band im Kreis, dann drehen unfe: Run the belt in a loop, then incomplete parts do their three rounds on their own. A funnel with a filter pulls off finished mechanisms.
Füll Wasser mit dem Eimer in den Akkumul: Fill water into the accumulator with a bucket. Blue bubbles mean it is working, yellow ones mean with a crystal.
Füll den Censer und zünde ihn an. Restor: Fill the censer and light it. Restoration heals the living nearby and harms the undead. In the Crucible you brew more kinds: Tough for more armor, Bloodlust for more melee damage, Soul Harvest for more loot and experience.
Füll ihn an einem Fass oder Tank, aus de: Fill it at a barrel or tank, it does not scoop from the world. Jerrycan and drill put into the crafting table together refill the drill without a trip to the Refinery.
Füll ihn mit einer Flüssigkeit oder eine: Fill it with a fluid or a gas, right click sprays it. Sneak and right click toggles the pilot flame: with creosote or Biodiesel it becomes a flamethrower. With Liquid Concrete you build quick platforms.
Füll ihn wie das Jetpack in einem Chemik: Fill it like the jetpack in a Chemical Tank. One of its modes smelts what it hits.
Füllen: in den Itemslot eines Chemikalie: Filling: put it into the item slot of a Chemical Tank full of hydrogen. It has the modes normal and hover.
Fünf &6Andesitlegierungen&r in U-Form er: Five &6Andesite Alloys&r in a U shape make a &6Basin&r. It takes items and fluids, by hand, through a chute, a funnel or a pipe.
Fünf &6Biostahl&r oben und an den Seiten: Five &6Biosteel&r at the top and sides, a &6Flux Gate&r in the middle, at the bottom coil, &6Basic Generator&r, coil make the &6Bio Generator&r. It needs &etwo cores&r.
Fünf &6Bretter&r oben und an den Seiten,: Five &6planks&r at the top and sides, a &6Processing Unit&r in the middle, at the bottom plank, &6plating&r, plank make the &6Item Filter&r.
Fünf &6Eisenbleche&r und zwei &6Andesitl: Five &6Iron Sheets&r and two &6Andesite Alloys&r make a &6Whisk&r: alloy at the top, sheet, alloy, sheet in the middle, three sheets at the bottom.
Fünf &6Electrum&r oben und an den Seiten: Five &6Electrum&r at the top and sides, a &6Motor&r in the middle, at the bottom &6iron axe&r, plating, iron axe make the &6Tree Cutter&r.
Five &6Electrum&r at the top and sides, a &6Magnetic Coil&r in the middle, at the bottom plating, &6Basic Generator&r, plating make the &6Lava Generator&r.
Fünf &6Feldfrüchte&r oben und an den Sei: Five &6crops&r at the top and sides, a &6cooked beef&r in the middle, at the bottom &6redstone&r, &6Simple Frame&r, redstone.
Fünf &6Flüssigkeitsrohre&r, ein &6Kupfer: Five &6Fluid Pipes&r, one &6copper ingot&r in the middle, at the bottom Adamant, plating, Adamant.
