Fünf &6Kohlefaser&r, eine &6Verarbeitung: Five &6carbon fibre&r, one &6Processing Unit&r in the middle, at the bottom Motor, plating, Motor.
Five &6carbon fibre&r, one &6Processing Unit&r in the middle, at the bottom chest, Motor, chest.
Fünf &6Kupferbarren&r oben und an den Se: Five &6copper ingots&r at the top and sides, a &6Motor&r in the middle, at the bottom &6Silicon&r, &6Copper Reinforced Plating&r, Silicon make the &6Pump&r.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, ein &6Eisenschwert&r i: Five &6plastic&r, one &6iron sword&r in the middle, at the bottom Motor, plating, Motor.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, ein &6Electrum&r in de: Five &6plastic&r, one &6Electrum&r in the middle, at the bottom carbon fibre, plating, carbon fibre.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, ein &6Energite&r in de: Five &6plastic&r, one &6Energite&r in the middle, at the bottom Electrum, plating, Electrum.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, ein &6Flux Gate&r in d: Five &6plastic&r, a &6Flux Gate&r in the middle, at the bottom Motor, plating, Motor. It needs &eseven cores&r and draws &e256 RF/t&r.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, ein &6Stahl&r in der M: Five &6plastic&r, one &6steel&r in the middle, at the bottom coil, plating, coil. Place the addon on one of the machine's &eaddon slots&r, the tooltip names the slots.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, eine &6Diamantspitzhac: Five &6plastic&r, one &6diamond pickaxe&r in the middle, at the bottom Motor, plating, Motor.
Five &6plastic&r, one &6diamond pickaxe&r in the middle, at the bottom wool, plating, wool.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, eine &6Enderische Lins: Five &6plastic&r, one &6Enderic Lens&r in the middle, at the bottom Electrum, plating, Electrum.
Fünf &6Plastik&r, eine &6Magnetspule&r i: Five &6plastic&r, one &6Magnetic Coil&r in the middle, at the bottom Energite, plating, Energite. The Foundry casts &6Energite&r from nickel and Fluxite.
Fünf &6Redstone&r, ein &6Komparator&r in: Five &6redstone&r, one &6comparator&r in the middle, at the bottom repeater, plating, repeater.
Fünf &6Redstoneblöcke&r oben und an den: Five &6redstone blocks&r at the top and sides, a &6lava bucket&r in the middle, at the bottom &6redstone&r, &6Advanced Frame&r, redstone.
Fünf &6Schleimblöcke&r oben und an den S: Five &6slime blocks&r at the top and sides, a &6milk bucket&r in the middle, at the bottom &6redstone&r, &6Advanced Frame&r, redstone.
Fünf &6Stahlstäbe&r und drei &6Stahlgerü: Five &6Steel Rods&r and three &6Steel Scaffolding Slabs&r make six &6Steel Catwalks&r. &e24&r of them and &64 steel fences&r in the shape from the manual, then the hammer on it.
Five ingots from one raw piece.
Fünf Barren einer Legierung als Plus gel: Five ingots of one alloy laid out as a plus make &e24&r grinding balls. A ball goes into the SAG Mill's own slot.
Five Chaos Shards, only after the victory.
Fünf Dynamische Tanks um zwei Einfache C: Five Dynamic Tanks around two Basic Chemical Tanks give the &6Basic Mid Chemical Tank&r. With five more Dynamic Tanks around it it becomes the &6Max&r tank.
Five ores at once into the Purification Chamber.
Five groups, one chapter per mod.
Fünf Teile, dann Patronen am Arbeitstisc: Five parts, then cartridges at the workbench.
Five by five, and it waters by itself.
Fifty ingots, each half a pool.
Für &d100 Mana&r bekommst du den &6Bogen: For &d100 mana&r you get the &6Bow of Weapon Projectiles&r. It shoots tools and weapons from your inventory instead of arrows. Sneaking and right clicking switches modes, then it only takes projected weapons and Scrolls of Projection.
Für &d900 Mana&r wirst du kurze Zeit vie: For &d900 mana&r you become much faster and stronger for a short time. Monsters you hit fly through walls. Holding jump jumps farther, held in the air you stick to the surface you land on.
Für 64 Blöcke sind das &e16 Fusionen&r,: For 64 blocks that is &e16 fusions&r, so 16 Dragon Hearts and 32 Gaia Spirit Ingots. Each block counts 50 points at the obelisk.
Für Calx, den Spirit Crucible und den Im: For Calx, the Spirit Crucible and the Impetus.
Für Diamanten reicht es, bis knapp über: For diamonds it is enough to dig to just above the bedrock.
For ore, but also for carbon.
Für Gourmaryllis, Narglibbe, Exoflamme,: For Gourmaryllis, Narslimmus, Exoflame, the Pyroclast Pendant and the Terrasteel Chestplate.
Für Jaded-Amarant, Agrarnelke, Engelsblü: For Jaded Amaranthus, Agricarnation, Fallen Kanade, the Benevolent Goddess' Charm and the Terrasteel Helmet.
Für Klingen: Gezackt erhöht den Schaden,: For blades: Jagged raises the damage the more worn the blade is.
Für Obelisken, Soulwoven Silk und Totemb: For obelisks, Soulwoven Silk and totem bases.
For the port, melter and chemical reactor.
For the pressurizer, assembler and hastener.
Für Seelenstahl, Calx, Impetus und die R: For Soulstained Steel, Calx, Impetus and the armor.
Für Terraplatte, Rosa Arcana, Botanische: For the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate, Rosa Arcana, Botanical Brewery and the Band of Aura. Keep at least two.
Für Terraplatte, Runenkern, Thermalilie,: For the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate, Rune Core, Thermalily, Gourmaryllis, Exoflame. The engineers need one per &6Brass Heart&r: a good trade for casings.
Für Terraplatte, Runenkern, Trichtermalv: For the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate, Rune Core, Hopperhock, Daffomill, Tangleberrie, Jiyuulia and several pieces of jewellery.
Für Tigerauge, Cyazinthe, das Zirrus-Amu: For Tigerseye, Hyacidus, the Cirrus Amulet, the Rune of Sloth and the Terrasteel Leggings.
Für beide Richtungen bekommt jedes Ende: For both directions each end gets its own. A &6seat&r right in front of them is the place for the conductor.
Für den &6Natural Altar&r brauchst du dr: The &6Natural Altar&r needs three. How to get the daisy is at the very beginning of the chapter &aBotania&r.
Für den Obelisken zählt jede Seele: wer: For the obelisk every spirit counts: whoever lands the last hit gets two more.
Enough room for the rest of the season.
Für den Spirit Crucible, Arcane Charcoal: For the Spirit Crucible, Arcane Charcoal and the Rite of Quickening.
Für den, der den Chaoswächter tatsächlic: For whoever actually slays the Chaos Guardian. Everyone else can safely leave this quest empty.
Für die Präzisionslinie brauchst du drei: For the precision line you need three: cogwheel, tube, nugget.
Für die Welt musst du dir keine Sorgen m: You don't need to worry about the world: &6FTB Backups&r backs up the server every &e2 hours&r while someone is online and keeps the last twelve backups.
Für ein &6Steinwerk-Getriebe&r brauchst: Besides the &6Infused Iron&r, a &6Stoneworks Gearbox&r needs four &6Andesite Casings&r, a &6Large Cogwheel&r, a &6Mechanical Press&r, a &6Millstone&r and a &6Water Wheel&r.
Für ein kleines Netz reicht das im Leerl: For a small network that is enough when idle. If you need more, stay with the Energy Acceptor.
Für einen Hochofen: &e36 Netherziegel, 3: For one blast furnace: &e36 nether bricks, 36 bricks, 9 magma blocks&r. Magma blocks lie at lava lakes in the Nether, or you craft them from four magma cream. The Nether chapter shows the way there.
Für einen Ofen sind das neun Rezepte: &e: For one oven that is nine recipes: &e36 clay, 36 bricks, 9 sandstone&r. Clay is found in rivers and swamps, bricks you fire in the furnace from clay balls.
For a rod made entirely of iron.
Für viel Mana ruft das Loonium Beute her: For a lot of mana the Loonium summons loot as if from a dungeon. But each piece is carried by an especially strong monster you have to defeat first.
Für weite Wege: Die &6Schlauchrolle&r sa: For long distances: the &6Hose Pulley&r sucks up to 128 blocks deep, and a lake with over 10,000 blocks counts as infinite. Pipes and pump are in the &6Create&r chapter (fluids).
Gadget in den Tisch, Upgrade auf den fre: Gadget into the table, drag the upgrade onto the free slot. Every upgrade raises the power draw per block, look at the tooltip. &65x5&r follows from the 3x3.
Gaia-Seele oben, Elementium, &5Reine End: Gaia Spirit at the top, Elementium, &5Pure Ender Essence&r, Elementium in the middle, Elementium at the bottom.
Ganz in der Mitte des Meteoriten steht d: Right in the middle of the meteorite sits the &6Mysterious Cube&r. Break it and you have all four presses: &6Silicon&r, &6Logic&r, &6Calculation&r and &6Engineering&r.
Whole chunks down to the bottom.
Gase laufen nur in Druckschläuchen, Flüs: Gases only run in Pressurized Tubes, fluids only in Mechanical Pipes. A tank can vent its gas with the button in the window if you don't need it.
Gebündelt, getrocknet und angezündet häl: Bundled, dried and lit, sage keeps monsters away. It is also in the Mindful Trance Blend.
Gedüngtes Ackerland mit Grün gibt mehr E: Farmland fertilized with green gives more yield. Both fertilizers together make the best field.
Dyed sparks form separate networks. Corporea Blocks carry sparks without a chest and extend the network.
Gegen die &5Lunar Monstrosity&r ist Feue: Against the &5Lunar Monstrosity&r fire is worth gold, against the Freezes and the Permafrost too.
Against the dose you already have.
Gegenmittel ist &6Rogdorium&r aus den Ti: The antidote is &6Rogdorium&r from the Depths, see below.
Gegenstände einer Stufe, die noch nicht: Items of a stage that is not open yet are drawn &eveiled&r: a dark slot with a question mark, whether in your inventory, a chest or EMI. The tooltip says &7???&r, with &cOpens in stage 2 (Brass Works).&r and &8You can carry it, not use it yet.&r below.
Gegenstände von einer Blockseite zur and: Items from one block face to another.
Gegenstände, Mobs und Flüssigkeiten auf: Items, mobs and fluids on the move.
Gegessen geben sie Mana-Regeneration. Al: Eaten, they give mana regeneration. As &6Sourceberry Pie&r or &6Sourceberry Roll&r they are the best food for the Mycelial Sourcelink, and Starbuncles harvest ripe bushes on their own.
Geh durch das &6Portal am Spawn&r. Es wu: Go through the &6portal at spawn&r. It was lit on stream with the event for &estage 2&r, and since then the Nether is open to everyone.
Geh in eine &6Taverne&r von Dungeons and: Go into a Dungeons and Taverns &6tavern&r. A villager there trades &e14 emeralds&r and a &6compass&r once for a map to a structure.
Geh mit einem &6Leeren Lohenbrenner&r in: Walk up to the spawner with an &6Empty Blaze Burner&r in hand and right click a live &6blaze&r. It lands in the cage, and you have a &6Blaze Burner&r.
Geh zum &6Altar der Leere&r tief in der: Go to the &6Altar of Void&r deep in the citadel. As soon as you are close enough, the &cEnder Guardian&r appears: &e333 health&r, armor 20.
Gehäuse als Kasten, Ports in die Hülle,: Casings as a box, ports in the shell, coil on a port, power to the coil, polonium into the input port.
Gehäuse und ein &6Elite-Schaltkreis&r ge: Casing and an &6Elite Control Circuit&r give two &6Fission Reactor Ports&r. You need four: fuel, coolant, steam and waste.
Geister aus der Anderswelt arbeiten für: Spirits from the Otherworld work for you.
Spirits dig for you, without lag.
Geladenen Redstone-Kristall unter dem En: A charged Redstone Crystal under the Energy Press, then finish it like every processor with redstone and Printed Silicon.
Geladener Certus ist der Anfang jedes ME: Charged certus is the start of every ME network. Whoever has an orb takes a lot of work off the storage builders.
Yellow lets spirits enter living creatures. Possessed creatures drop rare loot much more often. Glowstone comes from the Nether, which is open from stage 2.
Gelbkuchen in den &6Chemischen Oxidierer: Yellow Cake into the &6Chemical Oxidizer&r. One piece gives &e250 mB of uranium oxide&r.
Genau richtig für Netherquarz, den du fü: Just right for nether quartz, which you need in bulk for fluix.
Genau richtig für die langen Grabungen n: Just right for the long digs for nickel and silver.
Genau so ist es gemeint: Aufheben und la: That is exactly how it is meant: you may pick up and store everything. Holding, wearing, placing or crafting only works once the stage is open. If such an item lands in your hand, it moves back into your inventory by itself.
Genauso werden aus Arrow Sulfur auch Loh: Arrow Sulfur also becomes blaze rods and slime balls the same way. A skeleton farm thus becomes a pearl farm.
Genauso wie beim Werkzeug: ein &6Diamant: Just like the tool: a &6diamond armor piece&r in the middle, &e2 Inferium Ingots&r left and right, &e2 Inferium Gemstones&r top and bottom.
Genug für Infusionsanlage, Generator und: Enough for the infuser, generator and circuits.
Geschwindigkeit: der Fortschritt läuft +: Speed: progress runs +1 per tick faster. Processing: +1 operation per run. Tier 2, with Diamond Gears instead of gold, gives +2. &6Range&r (glass, redstone and four cobblestone, lapis and so on up to tier 11) grows the work area by 1 per tier.
Gesperrte Essenz kannst du lagern, aber: Locked essence can be stored but not processed, the tooltip tells you the stage. Everything you grow in stage 1 stays and keeps counting.
Gesperrte Items zeigen im Tooltip, wann: Locked items show in the tooltip when they open. You may already collect them.
Gestartet wird mit dem Afrit-Buch, 300 S: It is started with the Afrit book, 300 seconds per ritual.
Gestartet wird mit dem Djinni-Buch, 150: It is started with the Djinni book, 150 seconds per ritual.
It is started with the Djinni book.
Gestartet wird mit dem Foliot-Buch. Hera: It is started with the Foliot book. Out comes no spirit, but an item.
Gestartet wird mit dem gebundenen Foliot: It is started with the bound Foliot book, like Aviar's Circle.
Gesät wird einmal von Hand. Danach läuft: You sow once by hand. After that the field runs as long as the bearing turns. Bearing, gantry and harvester are in the &6Create&r chapter (contraptions).
Getragen fängt das Amulett ein Geschoss: Worn, the amulet catches a projectile that would hit you. After that it recharges for about &d10 seconds&r. Skeletons and blazes lose much of their terror.
Getragen gibt jede zerbrochene Seele ein: Worn, every shattered soul gives one extra arcana. Worth it mostly for rare kinds like Eldritch.
Getrocknete Kräuter stecken in der Repla: Dried herbs are in the Replacer Satchel and in the crow ankh.
Gain or loss at a glance.
Geworfen durchschlägt ein Chakram Gegner: Thrown, a chakram pierces enemies, can poison them, bounces off walls and returns after about three seconds. Up to &e6&r stack, and the Flare Chakram also sets enemies on fire.
Geworfen hinterlässt es an der Wand, wo: Thrown, it leaves a track of solid vines on the wall where it hits, which you can climb up. Handy on cliffs and in caves.
Geworfen schlägt dort, wo er auftrifft,: Thrown, it strikes &elightning&r where it lands. That way you make a charged creeper from a creeper, a Zombified Piglin from a pig and a witch from a villager, with no thunderstorm at all.
Gezielt findest du sie erst mit Enderaug: You only find them on purpose with eyes of ender, and those need blaze powder from the Nether (stage 2). The End portal inside only opens in stage 4.
Gib &e600 Manaperlen&r, &e50 Terrastahlb: Hand in &e600 Mana Pearls&r, &e50 Terrasteel ingots&r and &e8 Rune Cores&r at the obelisk. Right click puts the stack in, a sneaking right click everything.
Gib dem Pylon Arcana und das passende Re: Give the pylon arcana and the matching repair material. It looks for damaged items on pedestals, stands and in the Crucible nearby and repairs them without experience: normal tools to half, Malum gear to three quarters.
Hand in the staffs at the obelisk by hand. &e/kw goals&r shows the progress.
Gib einem &6Stranghoul&r eine Schüssel &: Give a &6Stranghoul&r a bowl of &6Pungency Stew&r. Then it fights for you for a day.
Gib einem Alakarkinos am Strand eine &6T: Give an Alakarkinos on the beach a &6pottery sherd&r and it gives you a token. In the apparatus with a &6brush&r and &e3 pottery sherds&r it becomes the charm.
Gib einem wilden &dFlashjack&r (Archwood: Give a wild &dFlashjack&r (archwood forests, high peaks) a &6Flashpine&r. In the apparatus: token, &e2 Air Essences&r, &e2 gold ingots&r.
Gib einer wilden &dSirene&r in warmen Me: Give a wild &dSiren&r in warm oceans a &6sea pickle&r and it drops tokens. In the apparatus with prismarine shards, 3 fish and &e3 Source Gems&r it becomes the charm.
Gib ihm einen Filter mit einem Tag, etwa: Give it a filter with a tag, like &ec:ingots/copper&r, and pick with the arrows which ingot should come out. Everything with this tag is then swapped into exactly this kind. With the Dictionary in hand, right click shows you the tags of any item.
Gib ihm einen Namen, den andere wiederer: Give it a name others will recognise. It also comes mossy, in sandstone, deepslate and more; EMI shows every variant.
Gib ihn dem Brenner, und er ist eine Wei: Give it to the burner, and it is &csuperheated&r for a while. An arm or a funnel tops it up.
Gib jedem Connector einen Namen. Im Cont: Give every connector a name. In the controller you create a channel, click the channel's field at the connector and set &einsert&r or &eextract&r, priority and filter. &6Facades&r hide cables behind blocks.
Glas in die Ecken, Schaltkreise oben und: Glass in the corners, circuits top and bottom, a Chemical Tank on the left, an Energy Tablet in the middle, a Fluid Tank on the right.
Glas oben und unten, Infundierte Legieru: Glass top and bottom, Infused Alloy left and right, &6osmium dust&r in the middle. Up to 8 per machine; eight make it &eten times&r as fast.
Glas, &6Eisenblech&r, Glas oben, drei &6: Glass, &6Iron Plate&r, glass on top, three &6Vacuum Tubes&r in the middle, &6Treated Wood&r, &6Copper Coil Block&r, Treated Wood at the bottom make the &6Charging Station&r.
Glas, &6Glühbirne&r, Glas oben, Glas, &6: Glass, &6Incandescent Light Bulb&r, glass on top, glass, &6Iron Mechanical Component&r, glass in the middle, a &6Basic Engineering Block&r at the bottom. Light bulbs: Components blueprint, glass, three paper, one copper, gives three.
Glas, Glaskabel, ein &6ME-IO-Port&r, Eis: Glass, glass cable, an &6ME IO Port&r, iron and an Engineering Processor. It hangs in the same network as the pylons, only one setup per network.
Glas, Legierung und &6Diamantstaub&r in: Glass, alloy and &6diamond dust&r in the middle. It keeps the machine's chunk loaded. Ideal for the Digital Miner in stage 3.
Glas, Legierung, ein Wasser- und ein Lav: Glass, alloy, a water and a lava bucket. It makes stone or cobblestone where a machine needs it, for example in the Combiner, which builds ore blocks from raw ore and cobblestone in stage 4.
Gleiche Art, gleiche Stufe, eins zu eins: Same kind, same tier, one to one.
Same table, new book in hand. Every tier 2 glyph costs &e55 experience points&r, about &e5 levels&r, plus its ingredients.
Gleicher Weg am Schmiedetisch: Vorlage,: Same path at the smithing table: template, &6Cloggrum Sword&r and Forgotten Ingot make the &6Forgotten Sword&r.
Same recipe, diamond sword in the core.
Gleise funktionieren auch in Gegenden, i: Tracks also work in areas where no player is at the moment. Trains keep running there without problems and stop at stations and red signals.
Gleiten oder der Faden des Gleitens helf: Glide or the Thread of Gliding help against ramming and dives. The tribute lies longer than normal loot, but pick it up at once.
Glowstone, &6Menril Glass&r (Glas im Dry: Glowstone, &6Menril Glass&r (glass in the Drying Basin with 1,000 mB of resin), both transformers and a Display Panel give the &6Storage Terminal&r.
Glyphen damit: &dZähmen&r (Anima, Golden: Glyphs with it: &dCharm&r (Anima, golden carrot, Sourceberry Pie, cake) turns enemies into allies for a while. &dPhantom Grasp&r (Anima, 2 phantom membranes) heals undead and drains the living. &dArc Propagation&r (Manipulation Essence, Arc Projectile) fires the rest of the spell anew.
Glück für Erz, Behutsamkeit für Glas und: Fortune for ore, Silk Touch for glass and ore blocks. Per block Fortune I costs &d30 FE&r extra, Silk Touch &d100 FE&r. &cStage 4:&r Fortune III, 7x7, Battery III, Range III and Efficiency III.
Glück wirkt wie Glück auf der Spitzhacke: Fortune works like Fortune on the pickaxe, also on loot from monsters, up to 4 times behind Break. Extract works like Silk Touch. &cBoth together don't work&r; make yourself two spells.
Gold am Kopf, Schild in der Hand, Bruchs: Gold on your head, shield in hand, cobblestone in the bag.
Gold ist hier unten Währung: Piglins tau: Down here gold is currency: piglins trade all sorts of things for it (bastions section).
Gold and redstone become a conductor.
Gold und Silber, das Metall der Mittelsp: Gold and silver, the metal of medium voltage.
Gold, Spender, Gold oben, &6bemooster Br: Gold, dispenser, gold at the top, &6mossy cobblestone&r, redstone, mossy cobblestone in the middle, mossy cobblestone, iron and a &6Marker&r at the bottom.
Goldene Äpfel, Heiltränke, Stärke und Wi: Golden apples, healing potions, strength and resistance from the brewery help. The Guardian takes at most &e32 damage&r per hit, many fast hits beat one big one.
Goldnuggets, ein Tintenbeutel, eine &6En: Gold nuggets, an ink sac, an &6ender pearl&r and paper make three &6Warp Scrolls&r. Each opens the list of all your waystones once.
Gold powder in a circle, stands around it.
Grab &616 Rohes Nickel&r aus. Nickelerz: Mine &616 Raw Nickel&r. Nickel ore lies between &eY 40&r and the bottom of the world, densest around &eY -12&r. Smelt it into &6Nickel Ingots&r in a furnace.
Grab &664 Andesit&r. Er liegt in großen: Dig &664 andesite&r. It sits in large veins in the stone, often next to granite and diorite. Any pickaxe will do.
Grab auf &eY 15&r lange Tunnel und bau &: Dig long tunnels at &eY 15&r and mine &e4 ancient debris&r. It doesn't glow, is blast proof and floats on lava as an item.
Grab dich mit der Vergessenen Spitzhacke: Dig through the &6Dreadrock&r at the bottom of the world with the Forgotten Pickaxe. Below lie the &5Depths&r and the &5Infected Depths&r. Mine &68 Rogdorium&r.
Grab eine große &6Erzader&r an und bring: Dig into a large &6ore vein&r and bring a &6block of raw copper&r along. The veins run through the stone as long bands, in the farm world too.
Grab ganz unten, knapp über dem Grundges: Dig all the way down, just above bedrock, until you have &e8 diamonds&r. Ultimine takes the whole vein in one go.
Grab im End nach &5Ender-Draconiumerz&r,: Dig for &5Ender Draconium Ore&r in the End, in end stone between height 0 and 70, in veins of up to eight blocks. Bring a pickaxe with &6Fortune III&r.
Graphit steckt in Platten, Hard Carbon u: Graphite goes into plates, Hard Carbon and the reactor's moderators. Build up a large stock.
Grass, leaves and flowers gone in one sweep.
Greift aus der Ferne auf dein Aufbewahru: It accesses your Storage Lectern from afar, in the same dimension. With a netherite ingot, Nether Star and ender chest it becomes the &6Stabilized Warp Index&r for every dimension.
Große Fische geben mehr Filets. &6Gräten: Big fish give more fillets. &6Fish bones&r, which you sometimes pull out, turn into bone meal in the crafting table.
Große Fragmente brauchst du für Injektor: You need large fragments for injectors and cores, small ones for modules and the Chaotic Energy Controller.
Große Kontraptionen ohne Kleber an jeder: Big contraptions without glue at every corner.
Große Maschinen wollen Kerne direkt um s: Large machines want cores right around them: furnace, centrifuge and laser one, Foundry and Assembler three, Fragment Forge seven, Atomic Forge eight. If one is missing, the machine says so.
The base for pasta and stew.
Grundlage für Podeste, Arkanen Kern und: The base for pedestals, Arcane Core and apparatus. The stonecutter has many variants for building, and with Ars Additions also doors, buttons and walls.
Grundwert: &e8 Blöcke pro Tick&r, solang: Base rate: &e8 blocks per tick&r, as long as the power lasts. It loads the chunk it is digging in by itself. Its own chunk has to be loaded.
Gräbt wie die Schaufel, aber 3x3. Ideal: Digs like the shovel, but 3x3. Ideal for building sites and sand deserts.
Bigger, and the Elder Guardians are waiting.
Größere Stöße, weiter, mit weniger Verlu: Bigger bursts, farther, with less loss, but less often. At the strongest flower or over long distances.
A bigger battery for everything portable.
Favor, souls and a shadow stone.
Gut als Puffer neben einer einzelnen Fun: Good as a buffer next to a single functional flower. Wherever the Lexica talks about Mana Pools, it always means the big one.
Gut für Teleport oder Items bewegen aus: Good for teleporting or moving items from a distance.
Gut zum Einebnen eines Bergs. Für Erz ni: Good for leveling a mountain. For ore, use the Quarry Card instead.
HDPE Platten in die Ecken, eine Truhe ob: HDPE Sheets in the corners, a chest at the top, Ultimate Control Circuits left and right, Steel Casing in the middle, a Polonium Pellet at the bottom.
HEU macht viel mehr Hitze als LEU. Erst: HEU makes much more heat than LEU. Switching only pays off once your cooling runs with reserve. The controller shows at once whether the net heat stays at zero.
HV-Draht trägt &d32 768 FE/t&r, ein HV-A: HV wire carries &d32,768 FE/t&r, an HV connector &d4,096 FE/t&r, exactly a Diesel Generator's output. The &6HV Transformer&r steps directly from HV down to LV or MV.

Check off each ore once. The world goes from &eY -64&r to &eY 319&r.

Halt Rechtsklick gedrückt, und alles Gew: Hold right click, and all plant growth around you is torn out and drops what it would drop by hand: tall grass, flowers, ripe crops.

Halt die Becken am Portal mit Elfen-Verb: Keep the pools at the portal full with Elven Spreaders and strong flowers. Every trade costs 500 mana.

Halt eine leere &6Glasflasche&r in die v: Hold an empty &6glass bottle&r into the dragon's purple clouds until you have &e4 dragon's breath&r.

Halte &e4 gebundene Djinni-Bücher&r und: Keep &e4 bound Djinni books&r and &e2 Lime Chalk&r ready. That is your stock for the start of stage 3.
Halte &e8 Afrit-Essenzen&r und eine &9Bl: Keep &e8 Afrit Essences&r and a &9Blue Chalk&r ready. With that you are through everything stage 3 offers in Occultism.

Trade, beds and often a waystone.
