Im Apparat: ein Robenteil der &eStufe 3&: In the apparatus: a &etier 3&r robe piece, &6Mark of Mastery&r, &6netherite ingot&r, &e2 essences&r of the element, &d7,000 source&r.
In the apparatus: a &etier 3&r robe piece, &6Mark of Technomancy&r, &6netherite ingot&r, &e2 brass ingots&r (for the helmet brass and engineer's goggles), &d7,000 source&r.
Im Arbeitstisch: &6Großer Panzer&r für m: At the workbench: &6Large Tank&r for more contents, &6Focused Nozzle&r for more range, &6Multitank&r for three fluids.
Im Assembler: eine &6Elektrum-Platte&r,: In the assembler: an &6electrum plate&r, &6bioplastic&r, &6Energetic Blend&r, &6redstone&r and a &6Coil Copper&r.
Im Auflösungsapparat mit &e1 000 mB Late: In the Dissolution Chamber with &e1,000 mB of latex&r, two &6redstone&r, two &6glass panes&r, two &6Gold Gears&r each, plus: two &6sugar&r for speed, two &6blaze rods&r for efficiency, &6furnace&r and &6crafting table&r for processing.
Im Auflösungsapparat: drei &6Diamantblöc: In the Dissolution Chamber: three &6diamond blocks&r, a &6diamond shovel&r, the addon &6Range Tier 12&r (redstone, glass panes and four emeralds in latex), three &6Gold Gears&r and &e2,000 mB of Pink Slime&r.
Im Auflösungsapparat: vier &6Glasscheibe: In the Dissolution Chamber: four &6glass panes&r, one &6dye&r and &e250 mB of latex&r make a &6Laser Lens&r in the dye's color.
Im Auflösungsapparat: zwei &6Erde&r, zwe: In the Dissolution Chamber: two &6dirt&r, two &6rotten flesh&r, one &6Pity Frame&r and &e1,000 mB of Liquid Meat&r.
Im Auflösungsapparat: zwei &6Kunststoff&: In the Dissolution Chamber: two &6Plastic&r, one &6Simple Frame&r, two &6netherite scrap&r, two &6gold ingots&r, one &6Diamond Gear&r and &e500 mB of Pink Slime&r.
In the Dissolution Chamber: two &6Plastic&r, one &6Advanced Frame&r, two &6netherite ingots&r, two &6diamonds&r, one &6Diamond Gear&r and &e135 mB of Ether Gas&r.
In the Dissolution Chamber: two &6Plastic&r, one &6Pity Frame&r, two &6Nether bricks&r, two &6iron ingots&r, one &6Gold Gear&r and &e250 mB of latex&r.
In the Dissolution Chamber: two &6Plastic&r, one &6Supreme Frame&r, two &6netherite ingots&r, two &6Diamond Gears&r, one &6Nether Star&r and &e500 mB of Ether Gas&r.
Im Auswahlrad stellst du Reihenfolge und: In the selection wheel you set the order and the multi mode. In multi mode, a sneaking right click connects all connected blocks, handy for ten chambers at once.
Im Bezaubernden Apparat von &dArs Nouvea: In the &dArs Nouveau&r Enchanting Apparatus: &6Golden Ritual Bowl&r in the middle, &e4 silver ingots&r, &e2 sourcestone&r, a &6Drygmy Shard&r and a &6Containment Jar&r, plus 5,000 Source.
Im Buch malst du auf den Seiten, auf dem: In the book you paint on the pages, on the Altar or in your hand. A &6Canvas&r (a &6painting&r, &e4 Dried Sage&r around it) transfers a section: right click on a picture in the book, drag the area, close the window. Then you hang it up like a painting.
Im Buch zeigt eine Taste über jedem Item: In the book a key above every item shows the recipe in EMI. Bookmarks you set at the top left.
Im Controller veröffentlichst du einen K: In the controller you publish a channel, the router passes it on to other controllers, up to &e32&r channels per router. The &6Wireless Router&r with an antenna on top does that without cables.
Im Crafting-Feld &e3 Burnt Otherstone&r: In the crafting grid &e3 Burnt Otherstone&r in one column, &e3 Otherworld Ashes&r in the column next to it. That makes an &6Impure White Chalk&r.
Im Crucible mit unterschiedlichen Arcana: In the Crucible with different arcana it turns into powders and reagents, EMI shows which.
Im Crucible steckt ein Katalysator, um d: The Crucible holds a catalyst around which arcana are focused. Each run costs it durability.
Im Crystal Assembler: Maschinenrahmen, a: In the Crystal Assembler: a machine frame, eight Engineering Processors, all four presses, an &6Inscriber Concurrent Press&r (three eyes of ender, four Entro Crystals, a Silicon Press) and a stonecutter.
Im Crystal Assembler: ein &6Extended Mac: In the Crystal Assembler: an &6Extended Machine Frame&r, four certus quartz and two quartz fibers.
Im Crystal Assembler: ein &6ME Extended: In the Crystal Assembler: an &6ME Extended Interface&r, an &6ME Ingredient Buffer&r (iron, 1k components, quartz glass), two Concurrent Processors and two Annihilation and two Formation Cores.
Im Crystal Assembler: ein &6ME-Laufwerk&: In the Crystal Assembler: an &6ME Drive&r, two glass cables, a Capacity Card and a &6Concurrent Processor&r give the &6ME Extended Drive&r. The &6ME Extended Pattern Provider&r has many more slots than a normal one.
Im Crystal Assembler: ein Importbus (ode: In the Crystal Assembler: an import bus (or export bus), three Acceleration Cards, two pistons and an Annihilation Core (a Formation Core for export).
Im Crystal Assembler: eine Gravurmaschin: In the Crystal Assembler: an Inscriber, three Capacity Cards and a Concurrent Processor.
Im Crystal Assembler: vier &6Molekularas: In the Crystal Assembler: four &6Molecular Assemblers&r, four Concurrent Processors, four fluix dust, three Engineering Processors and an Acceleration Card.
Im Fenster der Karte stellst du Form, Gr: In the card's window you set shape, size and offset. Faster: card in hand, sneak right click the Builder, then right click two opposite corners. Up to &e512&r blocks per side, up to &e260&r blocks away from the Builder.
Im Fenster einer Ender Cell macht eine B: In an Ender Cell's window a Battery makes the storage larger with a shift click.
Im Fenster füllst und leerst du Eimer. E: In the window you fill and empty buckets. A fluid conduit set to extract pumps it out. The &6Drain&r sucks fluid from a source block below it.
Im Fenster legst du 1, 10 oder alle Leve: In the window you deposit 1, 10 or all levels and take them back the same way. It stores them as liquid experience, which the Soul Binder drinks too.
Im Fenster legst du ein Rezept fest. Zut: In the window you set a recipe. Ingredients come in by conduit or hopper, the result goes out, as long as there is power.
Im Fenster stellst du den Bereich in jed: In the window you set the area in every direction, up to &e256&r blocks away, without placing four Markers. You also set the machine's spot there. For the Chunk Destroyer it is the most comfortable way.
Im Fenster wählst du, wann er ein Signal: In the window you choose when it gives a signal: &eReady for Ignition&r as soon as the core is hot enough, or &eInsufficient Fuel&r when the D-T Fuel runs out. A signal to a lamp or to the Laser Amplifier, and you do not have to stand next to it.
Im Incubator wird es mit Mineral Salt un: In the Incubator it becomes a &6netherite ingot&r directly with Mineral Salt and a Mercury Shard. You save four netherite scrap and four gold ingots.
Im Incubator wird jedes Sulfur mit einem: In the Incubator each Sulfur becomes one &6Iesnium ingot&r with a Mineral Salt and a Mercury Shard. Five ingots instead of one from the furnace.
Im Inventar gibt es links den Knopf &eMe: In the inventory there is a &eMy Team&r button on the left, or you use the command &e/ftbteams party create <name>&r. You invite others with &e/ftbteams party invite <player>&r. Team size is not limited.
Im Kapitel &eSigns&r des Codex singst du: In the Codex chapter &eSigns&r you will later sing your chants. Take good care of the book.
Im Kessel mit &e1 000 mB&r Dickflüssigem: In the cauldron with &e1 000 mB&r of Thick Potion (water bottle plus glowstone dust): a &6Medium Satchel&r, dried &6Mandrake, Belladonna, Mugwort&r and &6Yellow Dock flowers&r, a &6Broom Brush&r and &e2 ender pearls&r.
Im Kessel mit Lava: &e5 Eisenbarren&r un: In the cauldron with lava: &e5 iron ingots&r and &e3 iron nuggets&r. Out comes the &6Candle Dipper&r.
Im Kopfplatz fliegst du mit Mana, etwa &: In the head slot you fly on mana, about &e30 seconds&r at a time. The sprint key without sprinting gives a dash (every 2 s), sneaking while falling lets you glide, without fall damage.
Im Labeller gibst du einer Variable Card: In the Labeller you give a Variable Card a name. With twenty cards in the Variable Store you know which one counts the coal and which one the tank.
Im Laufwerk gibt sie unbegrenzt Bruchste: In a drive it gives out unlimited cobblestone or water and swallows both without end. No more stone farm or water source for machines that need them.
Im Meka-Werkzeug bringt dich ein Rechtsk: In the Meka-Tool a right click takes you to the block you are looking at, per the config up to &e100 blocks&r away. Across the factory hall, over ravines, onto roofs.
Im Menü gibst du ihm einen Namen für die: In the menu you give it a name for the schedules. In &eassembly mode&r the track in front of it becomes the building site for a train, up to &e128 blocks&r long.
Im Mercury Catalyst gibt ein Shard &e800: In the Mercury Catalyst a shard gives &e800&r flux, a crystal &e3,200&r, both at &e20&r flux per tick. The same energy, but a quarter of the space in chests and hoppers.
Im Montagemodus rechtsklickst du mit ein: In assembly mode you right click the track in front of the station with a &6Railway Casing&r: a &6bogey&r appears there. The wrench switches between small and large.
Im Mörser werden &e5 Beeren&r zu &e4 sch: In the mortar &e5 berries&r become &e4 black dye&r. Berries and flowers make the Mindful Trance Blend. &cCareful:&r Eaten raw the berries are poisonous.
Im Mörser: &6Belladonna Flowers&r, &e3 B: In the mortar: &6Belladonna Flowers&r, &e3 Belladonna Berries&r, &6Sage&r.
Im Mörser: je ein &6Weizen-, Kürbis-, Me: In the mortar: one each of &6wheat, pumpkin, melon&r and &6beetroot seeds&r and a &6Sage Seed&r.
Im Ofen wird jeder Block zu einer &6Neth: In the furnace each block becomes a &6netherite scrap&r.
Im Ofen wird sie zu &6Schlackeglas&r, da: In the furnace it becomes &6Slag Glass&r, which HV relays take too. In stage 3 it goes into industrial fertiliser and concrete. So put it in a chest, not in the lava.
Im Programmer baust du eigene Karten: fe: In the programmer you build cards of your own: fixed numbers, items, lists and operators such as addition or comparison. Cards that other cards refer to have to lie in the network, best in the Variable Store.
Im Rad rennt ein Sternbunkel und treibt: A Starbuncle runs in the wheel and drives your Create machines, without any water. Good for the first andesite line in the middle of your base.
Im Reaktor kühlt Trockeneis mit -32 Grad: In the reactor Dry Ice cools with -32 degrees and 712 units. For comparison: Blue Ice -17 degrees and 568, normal ice -5 degrees and 48.
Im Rezept stecken &6Amethyst&r, &6Prisma: The recipe holds &6amethyst&r, &6prismarine shards&r, a &6Marker&r and &6dragon's breath&r.
Im Roh-Hochofen reicht &eein Koks für ei: In the Crude Blast Furnace &eone coke is enough for one steel ingot&r. Charcoal works too, but burns only a quarter as long there. Every coal you find now is a steel ingot later.
Im Räucherofen wird daraus Räucherschink: In the smoker it becomes smoked ham for the honey glazed ham. At the cutting board, ham gives pork and a bone.
Im Schnitt kostet ein Getriebe &e1,25 Me: On average a mechanism costs &e1.25 brass sheets&r and just under &efour&r each of cogwheels, tubes and iron nuggets. The tubes are the bottleneck.
Im Slot macht er die Maschine schneller: In the slot it makes the machine faster and gives it more storage. It also goes into the Advanced Capacitor Bank.
Im Umkreis von &e32 Blöcken&r spawnen ke: Within &e32 blocks&r no hostile monsters spawn naturally. Each rotten flesh as an addition gives &e+1&r block, up to &e128&r. It only costs Source when it prevents a spawn, at most once per minute.
Im Upgrade-Platz einer Maschine arbeitet: In a machine's upgrade slot it makes the machine work faster, and it uses more fuel for that. The upgrade's tooltip shows the factors.
Im Wasserkessel (1 500 mB): deine &6Broo: In the water cauldron (1 500 mB): your &6Broom Brush&r, &6Belladonna Flowers&r and &6Berries&r, &e2 Mandrake Roots&r, &6Mandrake&r, &6Mugwort&r and &6Yellow Dock Flowers&r.
Im Wasserkessel: &6Bottle of Blood&r, &e: In the water cauldron: &6Bottle of Blood&r, &e2 Willow Logs&r, &e2 gold blocks&r, &e2 wheat&r, a &6Mandrake Root&r.
Im Wasserkessel: &e2 Mandrake Roots&r, &: In the water cauldron: &e2 Mandrake Roots&r, &e4 wheat&r, &6Mugwort Leaves&r, &6Yellow Dock Leaves&r make a &6Wet Broom Brush&r.
Im Wasserkessel: &e2 schwarzer Farbstoff: In the water cauldron: &e2 black dye&r, &e4 leather&r, &e2 strings&r make &e2 Infused Fabric&r.
Im Wasserkessel: &e5 Mahagoniplanken&r u: In the water cauldron: &e5 mahogany planks&r and &e3 gold ingots&r. That is the &6Coffer&r.
Im Wasserkessel: &e6 Leder&r, ein &6Fade: In the water cauldron: &e6 leather&r, a &6string&r, a &6gold nugget&r. The &6Small Satchel&r gives a broom &e9 slots&r.
Im Wasserkessel: ein &6Diamant&r, &e2 Wi: In the water cauldron: a &6diamond&r, &e2 Witch Hazel Logs&r, &e2 Bottles of Blood&r, &e2 wheat&r, a &6Mandrake Root&r.
Im Wasserkessel: ein &6Netheritbarren&r,: In the water cauldron: a &6netherite ingot&r, &e2 Mahogany Logs&r, &e2 Bottles of Blood&r, &e2 wheat&r, a &6Mandrake Root&r.
Im Wasserkessel: eine &6Kette&r, &e4 Ker: In the water cauldron: a &6chain&r, &e4 candles&r, &e3 iron ingots&r. That is the &6Candelabra&r.
Im Wirrwald laufen fast nur &6Endermen&r: Almost only &6endermen&r wander the warped forest. For a base in the Nether this is the safest place, and you take the ender pearls along right away.
Im beheizten Kessel mit &e1 000 mB&r Tra: In the heated cauldron with &e1 000 mB&r of Potion of Swiftness: a &6Coffer&r, an &6echo shard&r, &e2 eyes of ender&r, &e4 Moon Dust&r. Out come &e2&r Entangled Coffers.
Im beheizten Kessel mit &e500 mB Lava&r:: In the heated cauldron with &e500 mB of lava&r: a &6Medium Satchel&r, &e6 obsidian&r and an &6eye of ender&r.
Im beheizten Kessel wird es zu Talg, aus: In the heated cauldron it becomes tallow, from tallow you dip candles. Honeycomb and old candles melt just the same. Whoever has an animal farm collects the fat on the side.
Im beheizten Lavakessel: &e4 Redstone&r: In the heated lava cauldron: &e4 redstone&r and &e4 polished blackstone&r make the &6Blood Sigil&r. Put it into the sigil slot at the top left of the cauldron menu.
Im beheizten Lavakessel: &e5 Stein&r, &e: In the heated lava cauldron: &e5 stone&r, &e2 iron ingots&r, a &6nether quartz&r.
Im beheizten Lavakessel: &e8 Goldbarren&: In the heated lava cauldron: &e8 gold ingots&r. Right click with a &6Dried Sage Bundle&r puts it on the plate, a flint and steel lights it.
Im beheizten Lavakessel: ein &6Diamant&r: In the heated lava cauldron: a &6diamond&r, &e6 glass&r, a &6stone&r. That is the &6Crystal Ball&r.
Im beheizten Lavakessel: eine &6Mandrake: In the heated lava cauldron: a &6Mandrake Root&r, &e5 gold nuggets&r, &e2 gold ingots&r. The &6Crow Blank Amulet&r you put around a crow's neck.
Im eigenen Tab liegen Eingang, Brennstof: In its own tab there are input, fuel and output like in a furnace, just as fast. Raw iron smelts on the way home that way.
Always the right tool in hand.
Always to the same destination, without levels.
Import and export in one part.
Importer and Exporter in one block.
In &6Stufe 5&r will der Obelisk &e64 Wil: In &6stage 5&r the obelisk wants &e64 Wilden Tributes&r, a fixed number, each one a Chimera fight. Whoever practices now manages that later in a few evenings.
In EMI siehst du nur die &enächste&r Stu: In EMI you only see the &enext&r stage, veiled but with its recipe. Later stages stay completely hidden. So you can already stock up on zinc for brass.
In EMI siehst du vielleicht die &6Ackerb: In EMI you may see the &6Farming Station&r. In this version Ender IO only ships it as an &cexperimental data pack&r marked as unfinished. It is not active on Kronwerke, so the station can neither be crafted nor placed.
In Essenzrüstung verbessert es die Beute: In essence armor it improves the loot from fishing and chests. You put it in at the &6Tinkering Table&r, and that needs Soulium from &cstage 2&r. Until then it waits.
In Höhlen siehst du so den Weg, ohne gle: That way you see the path in caves without placing torches everywhere straight away. Monsters still spawn in moving light: where you stay, place real torches.
In Schiffswracks und Ozeanruinen liegen: Shipwrecks and ocean ruins hold &6treasure maps&r. Follow one to the red cross and dig there for the buried chest. It always contains a &6Heart of the Sea&r.
In Spiritfire geworfen wird sie zu &6Oth: Thrown into Spiritfire it becomes &6Otherworld Essence&r, without the bad side effects. You need that later for traders, repairs and Susje's Circle.
In Stufe 1 setzt du die Setzlinge noch v: In stage 1 you still replant the saplings by hand. The &6Deployer&r from stage 2 takes that over, see the right side. For small amounts, the pots are quieter and cheaper.
In Stufe 1 sind zwei offen, alle anderen: In stage 1 two are open, all others need runes:
In Stufe 1 will das Ziel &6Bruchstein&r,: In stage 1 the goal wants &6cobblestone&r, &6Andesite Alloy&r and &6Source Gems&r. Everyone has cobblestone, so don't throw it away. You see how far along it is on the &eboss bar&r at the top and with &e/kw goals&r.
In Stufe 2 schießt die &6Lebeholzschleud: In stage 2 the &6Livingwood Slingshot&r (with a Rune of Air) shoots the balls straight ahead without gravity.
In Stufe 2 stecken in jedem Messingbarre: In stage 2 every brass ingot has two copper in it. Hoarding copper pays off.
In Stufe 2 steckt in jeder der vier Elem: In stage 2 there is a powder in each of the four elemental runes. Spare petals become dye, dye becomes powder.
In Stufe 2 verbindet &6Create Central Ki: In stage 2, &6Create Central Kitchen&r connects the kitchen with Blaze Burner, Mechanical Arm and Deployer.
In Stufe 2 wird aus Zink und doppelt so: In stage 2 zinc and twice as much copper make &6brass&r, and the obelisk then wants 2,000 ingots. A chest of raw zinc now is a head start later.
In Stufe 2 wird ein Tank mit Lohenbrenne: In stage 2 a tank with Blaze Burners under it becomes a steam boiler.
In Stufe 3 reparieren Afrit mit ihr auch: In stage 3, Afrit also repair tools, armour and miners with it. Keep a small stock.
In Stufe 3 wird er zum Zauberkatalysator: In stage 3 it becomes the Conjuration Catalyst, see &aBotania: Alfheim&r.
In Stufe 4 steckt es im Wyvern-Schildmod: In stage 4 it goes into the Wyvern shield module, in &estage 5&r into every awakened draconium.
In Stufe 5 öffnen Spaltreaktor, SPS und: In stage 5 the fission reactor, SPS and antimatter open in the chapter &5Mekanism: Antimatter&r.
In deinen Chunks kann niemand außer dein: In your chunks nobody outside your team can break blocks or open chests. How many chunks you have and how to keep them loaded is in the chapter &6Tips and Tricks&r.
In den &eSteuerungseinstellungen&r gibt: Thanks to &6Controlling&r, the &econtrols settings&r have a &esearch bar&r at the top. Type part of the name, like &ebackpack&r or &eUltimine&r, and you immediately see the matching key.
In den Kern kommt der &eKatalysator&r, d: The &ecatalyst&r goes into the core, the part that gets transformed. Around it stand &einjectors&r with one ingredient each. The injectors get the power, not the core. In the core's window you press &eCraft&r.
In den Steuerungseinstellungen löscht &6: In the controls settings &6KeybindsPurger&r clears all keys of one mod or of all mods at the push of a button, if you would rather start from zero.
In den Tiefen leben die &6Einwohner&r in: In the Depths the &6Denizens&r live in camps with a campfire. Find one.
In den Topf: &6Karotte&r, &6Kartoffel&r,: Into the pot: &6carrot&r, &6potato&r, &6beetroot&r and &6cabbage&r or a cabbage leaf. Plus a bowl.
In den Topf: &6Verrottetes Fleisch&r, &6: Into the pot: &6rotten flesh&r, &6bone meal&r, raw meat and &6rice&r.
In den Topf: ein &6Teigball&r, &6Weißkoh: Into the pot: a &6wheat dough&r, &6cabbage&r, an &6onion&r and raw chicken, pork, beef or a &6brown mushroom&r. Out come &etwo&r dumplings.
In den Topf: eine &6Milchflasche&r, &6Zu: Into the pot: a &6milk bottle&r, &6sugar&r and two &6cocoa beans&r.
In den Truhen der Camps liegen Geheimnis: The camp chests hold Mysterious Masks and totems. You can make a totem yourself too: an Ancient Root for 10 seconds in the Infuser.
In den Truhen: Gold, Diamantausrüstung,: In the chests: gold, diamond gear, ancient debris and the &6smithing template&r for netherite. Thanks to Lootr every player has their own loot.
In den Verbund am Lagerkern gesetzt, nim: Placed into the network at the Storage Controller, the I/O takes items from pipes and hands them out. Input only in, Output only out; both are easy on the server.
In der &6Crystallized Desert&r fliegen &: &6Crystallized Moths&r fly in the &6Crystallized Desert&r. Feed one enough meat until it is tame.
In der &6Druckreaktionskammer&r: &e1 000: In the &6Pressurized Reaction Chamber&r: &e1,000 mB of polonium&r, 1,000 mB of water and 1 fluorite dust give a &bPolonium Pellet&r. What remains is spent nuclear waste.
In der &6Isotopenzentrifuge&r geben &e10: In the &6Isotopic Centrifuge&r &e10 mB of nuclear waste&r give &e1 mB of plutonium&r. In the Pressurized Reaction Chamber 1,000 mB become a &cPlutonium Pellet&r with water and fluorite dust.
In der &6Legierungsschmiede&r von Silent: In Silent Gear's &6Alloy Forge&r an &6Azure Silver block&r, &62 gold ingots&r and an &6ender pearl&r make three &6Azure Electrum Ingots&r.
In der Abfüllanlage: &6Pressform: Platte: In the Bottling Machine: &6Metal Press Mold: Plate&r on the belt, &e250 mB of Phenolic Resin&r in the tank make a &6Duroplast Sheet&r. The mold comes back.
In der Abfüllanlage: &6Pressform: Stab&r: In the Bottling Machine: &6Metal Press Mold: Rod&r and &e4 HOP Graphite Dust&r on the belt, &e1,000 mB of Creosote Oil&r in the tank. Out comes a &6Graphite Electrode&r, the mold comes back.
In der Basis hebt sie das Gewicht ihres: In the base it raises the weight of its ore a lot and is not used up. &6Brown&r iron, &6Orange&r copper, &6Yellow&r gold, &6Light Gray&r osmium, &6Black&r coal, &6Lime&r uranium. EMI shows the rest.
In der Brauerei nimmt das Stäbchen ein G: In the brewery the stick takes up a brew like a vial, but costs about ten times as much mana. Put it on the plate and light it with flint and steel.
In der Brustplatte lässt es dich fliegen: In the chestpiece it lets you fly. You find elytra on the End Ships.
In der Drakonischen Spitzhacke baut es b: In the Draconic Pickaxe it mines up to &e7 x 7&r. Safe Mode protects your machines here too.
In der Hand zeigt der Halo einen Kranz a: In hand the halo shows a ring of recipe slots. Right click on the crafting table in the ring opens a crafting window. Right click on an empty slot saves the last crafted recipe, right click on a saved one crafts it from your inventory.
In der Haupthand sammelt er nichts. Schl: In your main hand it collects nothing. A sneaking right click on a chest empties it into the chest.
In der Imbuement-Kammer: &6Verzauberter: In the Imbuement Chamber: &6Enchanted Spell Turret&r in, &e3 essences&r of one element and the matching &6greater focus&r on the pedestals, &d5,000 source&r.
In der Kammer: &5Wilden-Tribut&r hinein,: In the chamber: &5Wilden Tribute&r in, all &e8 essences&r on the pedestals (earth, fire, water, air, abjuration, conjuration, manipulation, anima), &d10,000 source&r. Makes &e5 Marks&r.
In der Kammer: &6Amethystsplitter&r hine: In the chamber: an &6amethyst shard&r inside, &e3 essences&r of one element and &e3 gold ingots&r on the pedestals, &d5,000 Source&r.
In der Kammer: Quelljuwel hinein, &6With: In the chamber: Source Gem inside, &6wither skeleton skull&r, &6bone meal&r, &6golden apple&r on the pedestals, &d3,000 Source&r.
In der Legierungsschmiede gibt ein Purpu: In the Alloy Forge, a block of Crimson Iron with two blaze rods and magma cream gives &ethree&r ingots.
In der Legierungsschmiede: &6Purpur-Stah: In the Alloy Forge: &6Crimson Steel&r, &6Azure Electrum&r, &6crushed shulker shell&r and &6netherite scrap&r: four ingots.
In der MekaSuit lässt es dich fliegen wi: In the MekaSuit it lets you fly as in creative mode. Per the config it costs &d400 FE/t&r while you fly. The Jetpack Unit is retired with it.
In der Modifikationsstation stellst du e: In the Modification Station you set how strongly each module works. Full strength costs more power.
In der Raffinerie, ohne Katalysator: &e1: In the Refinery, without a catalyst: &e12 mB of Acetaldehyde&r and &e8 mB of Creosote Oil&r make &e8 mB of Phenolic Resin&r.
In der Raffinerie: &6Ethanol&r allein, m: In the Refinery: &6Ethanol&r alone, with a &6silver plate&r as catalyst, makes &6Acetaldehyde&r, 8 mB to 8 mB.
In der Reaktionskammer: eine &6Singulari: In the Reaction Chamber: a &6Singularity&r, two ender dust, two sky stone dust and some lava make two &6Shattered Singularities&r.
In der Rezeptkonsole legst du die Zutate: In the Pattern Grid you put the ingredients into the grid and press &eCreate Pattern&r. A &ecrafting pattern&r is a crafting table recipe. A &eprocessing pattern&r only says: these ingredients go into a machine, this comes back. The stonecutter and smithing table have their own pattern kinds too.
In der Schablonenkonsole Modus &eFertigu: In the pattern encoding terminal choose the mode &eCrafting&r, lay the recipe into the grid (from EMI with the plus), put in a blank pattern, press the arrow. Out comes a &6Crafting Pattern&r.
In der Schablonenkonsole Modus &eVerarbe: In the pattern encoding terminal, mode &eProcessing&r: &6Silicon&r at the top, &6Printed Silicon&r below as the result. Put the pattern into a provider that sits directly against an Inscriber with a Silicon Press.
In der Truhe liegen Kodex-Seiten mit zuf: The chest holds codex pages with random glyphs and Archwood fruit.
In der Truhe liegen oft Artefakte. &cAbe: The chest often holds artifacts. &cBut:&r About every third chest in a campsite is a Mimic (next quest).
In der engen Arena treffen sie viele Zie: In the tight arena they hit many targets at once.
In die Digestion Vat: &e4 Common Metals: Into the Digestion Vat: &e4 Common Metals Niter&r, a &6Sal Ammoniac Bucket&r and a &6Purified Gold&r. Out comes &e1 Rare Metals Niter&r.
In die Fermentation Vat: &6Sal Ammoniac: Into the Fermentation Vat: &6Sal Ammoniac Bucket&r, &6sugar&r and a crop. Out comes a big stack of &6Fermentation Starter&r.
In dieser Dimension halten brennende Ama: In this dimension burning Amaramber candles, Amaramber lanterns, Torreya campfires and Amaramber fire stop hostile monsters from spawning nearby. For a base here that is worth gold.
In einem &6Exporteur&r liefert er nur, s: In an &6Exporter&r it only delivers while the target holds less than set. In an &6Importer&r it only pulls while the target holds more. Exactly 16 coal in the furnace, never more.
In einem Bereich, in dem unterirdisch Sc: In an area where slimes spawn underground, the slime in the bottle wakes up and bounces around. That is how you find slime chunks for a slime farm or for the &6Narslimmus&r.
In einem Kessel mit &e250 mB&r Regenerat: In a cauldron with &e250 mB&r of regeneration potion it becomes the &6Crow Ankh Amulet&r with dried Mugwort and Yellow Dock herbs, &e2 glow berries&r and a &6Totem of Undying&r. That saves your crow like a totem.
In einem Node liest die Karte das Redsto: In a node the card reads the redstone signal at its side or gives one out. Sender and receiver find each other through their &eredstone channel&r, like Item Cards through their channel.
In einer 4M-Zelle stecken Dutzende Proze: A 4M cell holds dozens of processors, several singularities and four draconium ingots. &cStage 5:&r 16M to 256M and the bulk cell need Awakened Draconium.
In ihrer Nähe zieht der &6Ring der Magne: Near it, the &6Ring of Magnetization&r (from stage 2) pulls nothing in. Plant it next to the Endoflames, then your ring won't steal the coal.
Inferium hat &e2 000 Haltbarkeit&r statt: Inferium has &e2,000 durability&r instead of 1,561, mines at speed 9 instead of 8 and hits one point harder. It is repaired in the anvil with Inferium Ingots. The tool keeps its enchantments when upgraded to Prudentium later.
Inferium, der Infusionsaltar und die ers: Inferium, the Infusion Altar and the first resource seeds. Stone seeds and fire seeds help the stone pillar and the andesite line.
Inferiumbarren sitzen links und rechts i: Inferium Ingots sit left and right in every Inferium tool and armor piece, and later they repair the tool in the anvil. In &cstage 2&r a finished Inferium tool is upgraded further with Prudentium Ingots and Prudentium Gemstones and keeps its enchantments.
Inferiumrüstung hält länger als Diamant: Inferium armor lasts longer than diamond (factor 40 instead of 33) and gives &e21 armor points&r for the full set instead of 20, with the same toughness. It is repaired with Inferium Ingots, and every piece has an augment slot for stage 2. The &6Inferium Chestplate&r is the best start, it takes the most damage.
Inferiumsamen wachsen auf jedem Ackerlan: Inferium Seeds grow on any farmland. On Inferium Farmland there is a chance for a second seed.
Infundier &6Drachenatem&r am Zaubertisch: Infuse &6dragon's breath&r at the enchanting table into &e3 Infused Dragon's Breath&r. The recipe wants at least &b80&r Eterna, Quanta between &d15 and 30 percent&r and at least &560 percent&r Arcana. Eterna above 75 only becomes possible with the world tier Pinnacle, and the dragon brings that.
Infused Iron kommt vom &aNatural Altar&r: Infused Iron comes from the &aNatural Altar&r (15,000 aura per ingot). Hopper onto the altar, belt to the pool, and the Manasteel factory runs. Manasteel blocks now only come from nine ingots.
Infused Iron, der Rohstoff für Manastahl: Infused Iron, the raw material for Manasteel.
Innen eine Zelle in der Mitte, ein oder: Inside a cell in the middle, one or two graphite blocks next to it, water heat sinks on the remaining sides. Outside the shell, controller and port in the wall. LEU into the port, a redstone signal on the controller or port.
Innerhalb des Nethers billig, zwischen d: Cheap within the Nether, expensive between worlds.
Ins Becken werfen lädt sie, Schleich-Rec: Throwing it into the pool charges it, a sneaking right click on the pool with the wand switches the direction. In your inventory it supplies Manasteel tools, bow and robe.
Ins Becken über einem erhitzten Brenner:: Into the basin over a heated burner: &6leaves&r, &b250 mB water&r and &b250 mB milk&r. The mixer makes &b500 mB tea&r from it. A &6spout&r fills 250 mB each into a &6glass bottle&r: &6Builder's Tea&r.
Ins ME-Laufwerk gesteckt, speichert sie: Put into the ME Drive, it stores Mekanism's gases and other chemicals. AE2's import and export buses, storage buses and interfaces then work with chemicals too, and the terminal shows them next to items and fluids.
Interfaces an Truhen machen deren Inhalt: Interfaces on chests make their contents the network's storage. An importer with an empty Variable Card fetches everything from its target, an exporter delivers what is on its card.
Isolierter Draht trägt Strom wie Kupferd: Insulated wire carries power like copper wire, but hurts nobody who touches it. Use it everywhere players or animals get to: in the base, along paths, above the pasture.
Iss ein Stück &6Rogdorium&r oder einen &: Eat a piece of &6Rogdorium&r or a &6Rogdorium Nugget&r when the infection rises. One Rogdorium makes 9 nuggets.
Ist der Drache tot, rufen &e4 Endkristal: Once the dragon is dead, &e4 End Crystals&r on the rim of the exit portal summon it again. With &6stage 4&r the archmage book still lacks Linger, Wall and Glide, and the Sorcerer's robes, the third armor tier and a few things from the addons come along.
Ist der Knopf rot, fehlt dir etwas. Fahr: If the button is red, you are missing something. Hover over it and it tells you what.
Ist der Manager aktiv, ist im Netz erst: Once the manager is active, &ceverything is forbidden&r in the network at first. With Security Cards you allow individual players what they may do: insert, extract, build devices. The fallback card applies to everyone without a card of their own.
Ist der Verbrauch größer als die Quellen: If the usage is higher than the sources give, the network is &coverstressed&r and everything stops. Then more source, less speed or a second network helps.
Ist der Wächter tot, lässt sich der &5Ch: Once the Guardian is dead, the &5Chaos Crystal&r in the middle of the island can be mined. It gives &e5 Chaos Shards&r, the Guardian itself a Dragon Heart.
Ist eine Quest erledigt, bekommst du obe: When a quest is done you get the message &eQuest completed!&r at the top right. The reward does not come to you by itself though: open the quest and &eclick the reward&r at the bottom right.
Ist eine Zelle leer, gibt ein Rechtsklic: When a disk is empty, right clicking with it in hand gives the storage part back.
Items, fluid and power in one.
Items on request in the chat.
Items auf dem Boden verschwinden nach fü: Items on the ground disappear after five minutes. A Create belt ending over the bed works just as well.
Items fügst du hinzu, indem du das Glas: You add items by using the jar with the item in your off hand, or by putting the jar on the Scribe's Table and clicking the item onto it.
Items schreibst du ein, indem du die Rol: You write items in by putting the scroll on the Scribe's Table and clicking items onto it while sneaking. With Allow the Starbuncle only takes these items, with Deny everything except these.
Items and rotation on one track.
Je &e8 Segel&r bringen &d1 RPM&r, und je: Every &e8 sails&r give &d1 RPM&r, and each RPM carries &d512 SU&r. 32 sails run at 4 RPM and carry 2,048 SU, as much as eight water wheels.
Je ein Block aus &6Cloggrum&r, &6Frostst: One block each of &6Cloggrum&r, &6Froststeel&r, &6Utherium&r, &6Regalium&r and &6Rogdorium&r, each from 9 ingots or crystals.
Je ein Gaiapylon &e4 Blöcke diagonal&r v: One Gaia Pylon each &e4 blocks diagonally&r from the beacon and &e1 block higher&r, in all four directions. Around it a clear, flat area with a &e12 block radius&r, with no blocks in the way and no holes.
Je einen &6Manastahlbarren&r, eine &6Man: Throw one &6Manasteel ingot&r, one &6Mana Pearl&r and one &6Mana Diamond&r onto the finished plate. It draws &d500,000 mana&r, then a &aTerrasteel ingot&r lies there.
The harder the block, the faster.
Je mehr Strom er gespeichert hat, desto: The more power it has stored, the higher its tier can be, from &ePoor&r to &eArtifact&r, seven tiers. Higher tiers drill larger areas. Sneak and right click to open its window.
Je mehr fließendes Wasser um das Rad läu: The more flowing water runs around the wheel, the faster it turns. Up to three wheels in a row drive one shared shaft. It does not care about the weather.
Je tiefer der Fall, desto härter der Sch: The deeper the fall, the harder the blow.
Jede Baugruppe erhöht Brennrate und Plat: Each assembly raises the burn rate and the room for fuel and waste. Leave air between the columns, the coolant needs surface.
Jede Elektrode hält &e80 Minuten&r Dauer: Each electrode lasts &e80 minutes&r of continuous running, then it breaks. Refilling is by hand only. Always keep three in reserve.
Jede Ender-IO-Maschine hat einen &eKonde: Every Ender IO machine has a &ecapacitor slot&r. If it is empty, the machine does nothing and says so in its window.
Jede Endoflamme liefert etwa 60 Mana pro: Each Endoflame supplies about 60 mana per second. Eight of them fill a pool (1,000,000 mana) in a little over half an hour and eat about 420 charcoal for it, roughly 100 logs.
Jede Ernte kostet die Hacke 1 Haltbarkei: Each harvest costs the hoe 1 durability, Unbreaking enchantments count. A redstone signal stops it.
Jede Essenz hat ihre Rezepte an der Werk: Every essence has its recipes in the crafting table, the Guide and EMI show them all. The most important ones for stage 1:
Jede Essenzpflanze außer Inferium lässt: Every essence crop except Inferium has a &e10 percent&r chance to drop a &6Fertilized Essence&r when harvested. Stone Seeds are the easiest source.

Every essence crop except Inferium has a &e10 percent&r chance to drop a &6Fertilized Essence&r when harvested. It works like bone meal, but on essence crops too, and with 4 Fertilized Essence instead of bone meal the recipe gives &e8 fertilizer&r instead of 4.
Jede Explosion, die du auslöst, wirkt wi: Every explosion you set off works like Fortune III. Valuable finds also give you &eAvarice&r: each level brings a &d10 percent&r chance of one extra Fortune level when mining.
Jede Glyphe kostet dazu Erfahrung: Stufe: Each glyph also costs experience: tier 1 &e27 points&r, tier 2 &e55&r, tier 3 &e160&r. The finished glyph drops as an item, right click learns it for good.
Jede Herkunft hat echte Stärken und eine: Every origin has real strengths and a real weakness. The role (&6Engineer&r, &6Arcanist&r, &6Builder&r, &6Explorer&r, &6Keeper&r, &6Provider&r, &6Trader&r) gives small bonuses that fit a pillar. A group with different roles gets ahead faster.
Jede Kammer lässt die Maschine ein Rezep: Each chamber lets the machine process one more recipe at the same time, for &e50 percent&r more usage. Better than speed for long recipes.
Jede Kesselstufe trägt eine Maschine meh: Every boiler level carries one more engine.
Jede Leitung besteht zu zwei Dritteln au: Every conduit is two thirds binder.
Jede Maschine hat einen Verbrauch pro RP: Every machine has a cost per RPM. &eUsage = value times speed.&r The press costs 8 SU per RPM, so 256 SU at 32 RPM: exactly one water wheel.
Jede Maschine nach der Infusionsanlage b: Every machine after the infuser needs some. A dozen in stock saves many switches of the infusion type.
Jede Maschine von Mystical Agriculture s: Every machine of Mystical Agriculture sits in such a frame: the furnace now, later the Harvester, the Seed Reprocessor and the Soul Extractor.
Jede Mod bringt ihre Tasten mit, das Buc: Every mod brings its keys, the book shows yours.
Jede Moderatorseite an einer Zelle gibt: Each moderator side on a cell gives about &e17 percent more power&r and &e33 percent more heat&r. One between two cells counts for both.
Jede MoreMachine-Maschine hat eigene Fab: Every MoreMachine machine has factories of its own. Elite and ultimate come in stage 4.
Jede Pflanze und jeder Baum, der im Umkr: Every plant and tree growing within &e15 blocks&r brings Source. Magebloom, Sourceberries and archwood saplings bring extra.
Jede Pylonenreihe muss mindestens zwei B: Each row of pylons has to be at least two blocks long and needs a channel. The more of the shell you fill, the more efficient. A separate subnetwork is easiest.
Every quartz kind, a pair of wings.
Jede Quest hat &eAufgaben&r (unten links: Every quest has &etasks&r (bottom left in the quest window) and &erewards&r (bottom right). Item tasks complete themselves as soon as the item is in your inventory. It is not taken from you unless the quest says so explicitly.
Jede Quest hier ist ein kurzer Text und: Every quest here is a short text and a checkmark. Read what interests you, check it off, take the reward. Five rows, top to bottom: &eQuest book&r, &eJEI and Jade&r, &eMap and team&r, &eRules&r, &eWhen something goes wrong&r.
Jede Quest in diesem Kapitel ist &eeine: Every quest in this chapter is &eone farm&r: what you need, how to set it up, what comes out at the end. Everything in the left half works in &6stage 1&r with andesite, flowers, pots and seeds. The right column tells you how to upgrade the same farm in &6stage 2&r.
Every school of magic has its powder.
Jede Seite hat eine Farbe und eigene Fil: Every side has a colour and its own filter slots. What comes in goes to a side whose filter matches, otherwise to a side without a filter. If nothing matches at all, it does not accept it.
Jede Sorte &6Bruchstein&r zählt, je ein: Every kind of &6cobblestone&r counts, one point each. The pillar for everyone: anybody can help from the first minute, without machines or magic.
Jede Sorte Kühlkörper hat ihre eigene Kü: Each kind of heat sink has its own cooling rate and its own rules where it may sit. The tooltip shows the rate in H/t, EMI shows the rule under &eHeat Sink Placement&r. With several kinds you cool denser reactors.
Jede Sorte ändert Hauptausgabe, Bonus un: Each kind changes main output, bonus and usage differently and wears down while doing it. The ball's tooltip shows its values.
Jede Stufe hebt die Mana-Regeneration un: Each tier raises mana regeneration and gives more and larger thread slots. The third tier needs chorus fruit and comes with stage 4.
Every chest, new for every player.
Jede Zelle im Reaktor macht Hitze und St: Every cell in the reactor makes heat and power. More cells means more of both and faster consumption.
Jede Zelle, egal wie groß, hat &e63 Type: Every cell, however large, has &e63 types&r. The large cells are in the chapter &bAE2: Advanced&r.
Jede formlos aus &6Feenstaub&r, &6Manast: Each shapeless from &6Pixie Dust&r, &6Manasteel&r and a rune: &eDispersive&r (water) charges mana items of nearby players, &eDominant&r (fire) pulls mana from pools with normal sparks, &eRecessive&r (earth) spreads its mana to the others, &eIsolated&r (air) stays out of everything.
Jede formlos aus Manalinse und einer Run: Each shapeless from a Mana Lens and one rune:
Jede mit Rezept und Zweck als Checkliste: Each with recipe and purpose as a checklist in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter. Orechid, Bubbell and a few others need Pixie Dust from Alfheim, see &aBotania: Alfheim&r.
Jeder Barren hier fehlt dem Obelisken. E: Every ingot here is missing from the obelisk. Only after the goal.
Jeder Barren ist eine Aufwertung. Die Sp: Every ingot is one upgrade. The pickaxe is a must, everything else comes after.
Jeder Beschleuniger bringt 8 Threads. Ei: Each accelerator brings 8 threads. A Multi-Threader quadruples them, a Data Entangler the storage, one each per computer. The parts need singularities from Advanced AE's Reaction Chamber.
Jeder Beschleuniger gibt der Pflanze übe: Each accelerator gives the plant above it a growth tick every &e10 seconds&r, stacked up to 9 blocks high. Bone meal does not work on essence crops, the watering can does. Harvest with the &6Sickle&r, 7 by 7 crops per click.
Jeder Block Volumen gibt laut Config &d6: By the config every block of volume adds &d6.4 million FE&r of buffer.
Jeder Block gibt rund &d13 Mana&r, bei R: Each block gives about &d13 mana&r, 20 in rain, and the water flows back right away. After &c72,000 ticks&r (one hour, three Minecraft days) it withers into a dead bush.
Jeder Block kostet &edoppelt&r so viel S: Every block costs &etwice&r as much power. You find Dimensional Shards as ore in all three dimensions.
Jeder Block von RS, der kein Kabel ist,: Every RS block that is not a cable has a casing in the middle: Controller, Grid, Disk Drive, Interface, Wireless Transmitter, Autocrafter. Four are enough for the first network.
Jeder Brennstoff gibt &e30 FE&r pro Bren: Every fuel gives &e30 FE&r per burn time tick, so one coal gives 48,000 FE in every tier. Higher tiers only burn faster. The Starter makes &e20 FE/t&r.
Jeder Drache bringt dazu etwa 64 Draconi: Every dragon also brings about 64 draconium dust and, on this server, a new &5dragon egg&r every time.
Jeder Energy Port gibt bis &e25 000 RF/t: Each Energy Port puts out up to &e25,000 RF/t&r, the buffer holds 50 million. The checklist &ePower&r compares it with other power plants.
Every trip counts for the whole server.
Jeder Generator, jedes Werkzeug, jeder W: Every generator, every tool, every path.
Jeder Haken ändert etwas am Angeln, der: Each hook changes something about fishing; the tooltip says what. Put it into the rod.
Jeder Injektor zeigt mit der Spitze zum: Each injector points its tip at the core, &eat least 2&r and &eat most 16 blocks&r away. Too close and the core reports &e"One or more injectors are too close!"&r. Every injector needs a power cable.
Every fight eats six Wilden parts.
Jeder Kern kostet einen &5Wither&r. Für: Every core costs a &5Wither&r. To start you need two: one for the Wyvern injector, one for the Energy Core.
Jeder Klumpen kostet 750 mB Latex. Bei 1: Each piece costs 750 mB of latex. At 1 to 4 mB per extractor operation the extractor is the bottleneck, not the machine. More extractors on acacia or mangrove, more rubber.
Jeder Kondensator braucht einen. In Stuf: Every accumulator needs one. In stage 3 the Mixer mixes the acid from one redstone per 250 mB of water, so much cheaper.
Jeder Manastoß, der das &6Mana-Flussfeld: Every mana burst that hits the &6Mana Fluxfield&r becomes Forge Energy and goes to cables or machines right next to it. A spreader in front of a row of Endoflames becomes a small generator that way.
Jeder Platz fasst das &eDoppelte&r, 128: Every slot holds &etwice&r as much, 128 stone instead of 64. Expensive in stage 1, but it makes the leather backpack as big as two chests. Tier 2 (fourfold) comes with the Brass Works.
Jeder Platz fasst das &eDoppelte&r. Ein: Every slot holds &etwice&r as much. An iron barrel with this upgrade holds as much as four chests. At most &etwo stack upgrades&r per chest or barrel.
Jeder Rotfaden-Block bindet sich an den: Every Red String block binds to the next matching block it points at, up to about &e8 blocks&r away and through walls. The container passes everything that goes in on to the bound inventory, from the same side.
Jeder Samen frisst eine Basis, also 4 Sp: Every seed eats one base, so 4 shards. Make a small stock, then you do not have to keep going back to the crafting table for the checklist at the end of the chapter.
Jeder Samen rechts ist ein Haken. Du mus: Every seed on the right is a checkmark. You only have to have held it once. What the essence can do afterwards is under Turn Essence into Blocks, the element seeds only become really important in stage 4.
Jeder Schnitt kostet einen Punkt Haltbar: Every cut costs one point of durability. Make two right away. A Silent Gear knife (blade plus rod) carves the same way and can be repaired.
Jeder Setzling im Pack geht, auch &dArch: Every sapling in the pack works, including &darchwood&r for Ars Nouveau. One pot gives about 75 logs per hour; four pots next to the kitchen supply furnace, casings and Endoflames.
Jeder Sprung kostet &d1 000 µI&r aus dem: Each jump costs &d1,000 µI&r from the staff, which stores 100,000. You charge it in the Wired Charger.
Jeder Sprung kostet Strom, je weiter, de: Every jump costs power, the further the more, into another dimension a good deal more.
Jeder Stabilisator legt drauf: Stufe 1 &: Each stabiliser adds: tier 1 &e64 types&r and 512,000 items, tier 2 &e128&r and 1,024,000, tier 3 &e256&r and 2,048,000. You bind tier 4 with a Marid (Uphyxes Inverted Tower).
Jeder Stamm am Gänseblümchen wird zum &6: Every log at the daisy becomes a &6Livingwood log&r. Every kind of wood works, including from other mods.
Every stack counts, even a small one.
Jeder Tribut zählt am Obelisken 50 Punkt: Each tribute counts 50 points at the obelisk, 64 is the fixed goal.
Jeder Vorgang gibt &e10 mB Ethergas&r. D: Each operation gives &e10 mB of Ether Gas&r. You hold the wither in place with a Stasis Chamber. The same base drills lava in the Nether with an Orange Lens, and oil for PneumaticCraft above ocean or desert with a Black Lens.
Jeder Zauber kostet Mana, jede Glyphe gi: Every spell costs mana, every glyph gives some.
Jeder abgebaute Stein wächst sofort nach: Every mined stone grows back instantly. Several drills on the same shaft multiply that; a drill costs 4 SU per RPM, a water wheel supplies 256 SU.
Each ingot handed in counts 25 points. The fights are in the chapter &aBotania: Gaia&r.
Jeder einfache Speicher mit Legierung un: Every basic storage with alloy and osmium around it becomes advanced. &6Fluid Tank&r 64,000 mB, &6Chemical Tank&r 256,000 mB, &6Bin&r 8,192 items.
Jeder erhitzte Brenner zählt eine Stufe: Every heated burner counts one level of heat, a superheated one two. The smallest of the three values sets the level, and every level lets one more engine run at full power.
Jeder höhere Stab: ein &6Quarzblock&r ob: Every higher rod: a &6quartz block&r at the top, the new tier's capacitors left and right of the casing, the old rod at the bottom.
Jeder lässt einen &6Nassen Schwamm&r fal: Each drops a &6wet sponge&r. Only when all three are dead can you clear out the monument in peace.
Every new broom already has a brush. It has &e100&r durability and wears down while flying. Unbreaking and Mending can be enchanted onto brushes.
Jeder weitere geladene Kristall im Wasse: Every further charged crystal in the water lifts the budding block one level, up to flawed. Every grown bud can throw it back one level. A finished cluster gives four crystals, Fortune helps.
Every biome has its own plants.
Every biome has its own village style.
Jedes Blei zählt: das von Eidolon, Mekan: Any lead counts: from Eidolon, Mekanism or the mining dimension. Almost every device of the mod is made of Pewter.
Every ore of the Undergarden with its height.
Every ore with location and height.
Jedes Essenzwerkzeug hat &e1 Platz für e: Every essence tool has &e1 slot for an augment&r (Luck, Absorption, Path area). You can already build augments from shards, iron and essence, but the &6Tinkering Table&r to put them in needs Soulium and comes in &cstage 2&r.
Jedes Gebet geht einmal am Tag und bring: Each prayer works once a day and brings favor. In return your patron gives &bmana&r for chants, the altar's Power decides how much, its Capacity how much you hold.
Jedes Gefäß: vier &6Kupferbarren&r auf d: Each vessel: four &6copper ingots&r over three &6stone&r, a Salt, a Sulfur or a Mercury in the top middle. All three right next to the Incubator.
Jedes Glas fasst nahezu unbegrenzt viele: Each jar holds a nearly unlimited number of arcana, but only one kind. Eight jars next to the altar keep your inventory free.
Jedes Juwel kostet &d500 Quelle&r. Gespe: Each gem costs &d500 Source&r. The jar is fed by your Sourceberries, Sourcelinks and whatever other Source you have.
Jedes Juwel zählt 4 Punkte. Eine kleine: Each gem counts 4 points. A small setup with a source link makes a few dozen an hour. See the chapter &dArs Nouveau&r.
Jedes Kapitel ist ein Mod oder ein Thema: Every chapter is a mod or a topic and starts with the easiest step. Quests are connected by lines: what depends on a quest only becomes visible or doable once it is done.
Jedes MEGA-Gerät braucht diesen Prozesso: Every MEGA device needs this processor.
Jedes Mal, wenn du Arcana aufsammelst, h: Every time you pick up arcana it heals you a little. Living Flesh: four rotten flesh, 2 Sacred, 2 Wicked.
Every material with all its stats.
Jedes Modul ist ein Basismodul plus Legi: Every module is a Module Base plus alloys and the part it imitates: a jetpack, a Geiger counter, a pickaxe.
Jedes Portal in drei Zeilen steht in der: Every portal in three lines is in the &6Checklist: Dimensions and Travel&r, and every world has its own chapter: &cThe Nether&r, &bThe Aether&r, &2The Undergarden&r, &3Deeper and Darker&r, &5The End&r, &bEternal Starlight&r.
Jedes Präzisionsgetriebe beginnt auf ein: Every precision mechanism starts on a brass sheet. A press of its own just for brass pays off.
Every ritual in a quarter of the time.
Jedes Ritual ist eine &6Ritualtafel&r au: Every ritual is a &6ritual tablet&r made from a coloured archwood log and ingredients. Tablet on the brazier, throw additions onto it, start with an empty hand. Source comes from jars nearby, redstone stops it.
Jedes Ritual kostet einen &aTerrastahlba: Every ritual costs one &aTerrasteel Ingot&r, the beacon uses it up.
Jedes Ritual verbraucht ein Bindungsbuch: Every ritual uses up a book of binding, make several sets right away. Black dye also comes from Hexerei belladonna berries. Shapeless together, the three make an empty book of binding.
Jedes SPS-Gehäuse braucht eins in der Mi: Every SPS casing needs one in the middle.
Jedes Samenrezept ist gleich aufgebaut:: Every seed recipe is built the same way: the seed base in the altar, on the pedestals alternating &e4 essence&r and &e4 material&r. Then activate it, with the Wand or a redstone signal.
Jedes Teil hält einen Teil der Strahlung: Each piece blocks part of the radiation, only all four together protect fully. The &6Dosimeter&r (lead in a cross around a redstone) shows with a right click how much you have already taken. The dose wears off again over time.
Jedes Teil ist ein &6Lederteil&r mit &6P: Each piece is a &6leather piece&r with &6phantom membranes&r around it. The helmet keeps radioactive gases out of your lungs. More pieces protect more.
Jedes Teil nimmt an der Schmiede eine St: At the smithing table each piece takes a radiation shielding plate from Nuclear Radiation, see the radiation section.
Jedes Teil verstärkt und verbilligt die: Each piece strengthens and cheapens the glyphs of its school and lowers matching damage, such as lava and dragon's breath for fire. Full set: blocked damage turns into mana. Threads and enchantments are kept.
Jedes Teil wird wie Eisenrüstung aus &6N: Each piece is made from &6Neptunium ingots&r like iron armour and has its own effect under water: the &6helmet&r improves sight, the &6chestplate&r lets you breathe, the &6leggings&r make you weightless, the &6boots&r faster at swimming.
Jedes Teil: oben &6Lebeholzzweig&r, Jahr: Each piece: top &6Livingwood Twig&r, season rune, twig, middle Terrasteel, the matching &6Manasteel piece&r, Terrasteel, bottom one Terrasteel. Helmet with Spring, chestplate with Summer, leggings with Autumn, boots with Winter.
Jedes Wyvern-Werkzeug und die Brustplatt: Every Wyvern tool and the chestpiece need two. The crystals are really a wireless power network you link with the Crystal Binder. Here you only need them as an ingredient.
Jedes Ziel hat zwei Säulen, &6Technik&r: Every goal has two pillars, &6Tech&r and &dMagic&r, plus &7Stone&r in stage 1. All of them have to fill up. A server that only builds machines gets nowhere, and neither does one that only casts spells.
Jedes braucht ein Cloggrumteil, eine &6S: Each needs a Cloggrum part, a &6Smithing Template&r and a &6Forgotten Ingot&r. The tools mine Undergarden blocks &e1.5 times&r as fast.
Jedes davon hat sein eigenes Kapitel, so: Each of them has its own chapter as soon as the stage is open. Until then: everything here keeps running for the whole season.
Jedes drakonische Werkzeug und die Brust: Every Draconic tool and the chestpiece need one. Do not confuse it with the big Energy Core: its tier 8 wants 378 Awakened and 786 normal Draconium Blocks and stores without limit.
Jedes gibt &e2 000 000 RF&r Speicher und: Each gives &e2,000,000 RF&r of storage and &e2,000 RF/t&r more input. For machines with many Speed Addons.
Jedes hat Spawner. Lass sie stehen, wenn: Each has spawners. Leave them standing if you plan a farm, or take them with Apotheosis (&6Apotheosis&r and &6First Farms&r chapters).
Jedes mB Brennstoff wird ein mB Atommüll: Every mB of fuel becomes one mB of nuclear waste. For antimatter you mostly want polonium, so set up many activators.
Jedes senkt den Verbrauch um &e20 Prozen: Each lowers usage by &e20 percent&r without making the machine slower. Goes well with Speed Addons.
Jetzt alles zusammen. &eSo sieht eine Fa: Now everything together. &eThis is what a farm looks like:&r a field of &6Inferium Farmland&r, a column of &6Growth Accelerators&r under every block, on it Inferium Seeds and your resource seeds. The &6Inferium Watering Can&r runs, and every few minutes you click through once with the &6Scythe&r.
Jetzt alles zusammen: Lass das Netz &6Fo: Now everything together: let the network build &6Advanced Control Circuits&r for the obelisk.
Jetzt hast du Zeit für den Chat. Die Far: Now you have time for the chat. The farms fill chests, one trip to the obelisk counts them for the goal, and whatever is left you trade with the others: Create players need logs and coal, magicians need Source Gems and mana.
Jetzt hängst du Wagen an, tauschst Kiste: Now you add carriages, swap chests for vaults or build a second set of Train Controls at the end. Then assemble again.
Juwelen stecken in Quellstein, Podesten,: Gems go into sourcestone, pedestals, apparatus, every link and every piece of jewellery. Whatever is left belongs in the &eobelisk&r at spawn.
Juwelen-Nachschub und ein Lager für alle: Gem supply and storage for everything.
Kabel bilden das Netz, an das du alle Te: Cables form the network you plug all parts into. A Variable Card stores a reference to a value: a number, an item, a list or a rule for a calculation. From cards, chunks and pistons you build the &6Variable Transformers&r that go into every reader and writer.
Kabel verbinden alle RS-Blöcke und brauc: Cables connect all RS blocks and need no power. There are &eno channels&r: a single cable carries a hundred disk drives if the Controller has enough power.
Kabel verbinden sich mit allem, was Stro: Cables connect to anything that takes or gives power. With the Configurator you set a side to &eNone&r if it shouldn't connect.
Kalkulationsprozessoren brauchst du für: You need Calculation Processors for 4k and 16k cells, cards, crafting units and the access point.
Kann alles, was das Pickup-Upgrade kann,: Does everything the Pickup Upgrade does and pulls items in from a &e3 block&r radius. Perfect with FTB Ultimine.
Kanäle laufen vom Controller den kürzest: Channels run the shortest way from the controller, first through dense, then through normal cables. If that way is full, devices stay dark, even when an empty cable lies next to it.
Kapitel späterer Stufen erscheinen, soba: Chapters of later stages appear as soon as the stage is open. In stage 1 there are seven chapters, by the end of the season about 45.
Kappung: 25 pro Treffer, 20 pro Sekunde,: Cap: 25 per hit, 20 per second, barely any damage from 18 blocks away. Fire resistance is a must, netherite armour or Ignitium strongly recommended.
Kaputte Werkzeuge aus der Mobfarm gehöre: Broken tools from the mob farm do not belong in it: every durability is a type of its own. Empty cells come apart with sneak and right click.
Kapuze aus &e5&r, Robenoberteil aus &e8&: Cowl from &e5&r, Robe Top from &e8&r Manaweave Cloth, Robe Bottom and Boots the same as with leather.
Kapuze, Robenunterteil und Stiefel aus &: Cowl, Robe Bottom and Boots from &6Manaweave Cloth&r. For the whole set you need &e24 cloth&r.
Karmesinwald: rote Pilzbäume, Hoglins un: Crimson forest: red fungus trees, hoglins and piglins.
Card in, chest on, power on.
Karten kommen auch hier in die Zelle: di: Cards go into the cell here too: the &6Equal Distribution Card&r splits the room across all types, the &6Overflow Destruction Card&r deletes what no longer fits. Use that one only with a filter.
Kasten aus Gehäuse, innen die Säulen, Sc: A box of casing, the columns inside, ports in the shell. Water in, fuel in, then start at &e0.1 mB/t&r.
Katalysator I: &6Leuchtender Staub&r (St: Catalyst I: &6Glowing Dust&r (stick, two glowstone, quartz, gives four). II: Blaze Gold dust and two glowstone.
Katalysator für Völlerei, Zorn und Neid,: Catalyst for Gluttony, Wrath and Envy, plus the Snowflake Pendant and Terrasteel Boots.
Catalyst: a &6Draconium Fusion Crafting Injector&r. In eight injectors: &61 Wyvern Core&r, &62 Draconium Cores&r, &64 diamonds&r, &61 Draconium Block&r. Costs 32,000 energy.
Katalysator: ein &6Wyvern-Kern&r. In ach: Catalyst: a &6Wyvern Core&r. In eight injectors: &64 Wyvern Energy Controllers&r and &64 Draconium Ingots&r. Costs 8 million energy.
Kein Altar: &e8 Inferiumessenz&r um ein: No altar: &e8 Inferium Essence&r around wheat seeds in the crafting table.
No belt needed, up to 32 blocks far.
No fall damage, no step too high.
Kein Malum-Spieler in der Nähe? Frag im: No Malum player nearby? Ask in chat. Four ingots for a stack of conduits is a fair trade.
Kein Springen mehr. Das mechanische Basi: No more jumping. The mechanical basin dries Menril Glass in 20 ticks in place of 200.
Kein Vorteil, nur Ehre. Mach es live, so: No advantage, only honor. Do it live, otherwise nobody will believe you.
Kein Wasser, das wegläuft, keine Lava, d: No water that runs off, no lava that sets something on fire. More catalysts are in &6Create: Addons&r.
Kein fester Aufbau, alles nur wenige Blö: No fixed layout, everything just a few blocks apart. Recipes in EMI.
Keine Herkunft kann fliegen oder überspr: No origin can fly or skip a stage. &eO&r shows your powers, more in &6Tips and Tricks&r.
No origin can fly or skip a stage. If your choice really doesn't fit, talk to the team.
Kern deaktivieren, im Fenster mit &eTier: Deactivate the core, raise it one tier with &eTier Up&r in its window, turn on &eToggle Build Guide&r and place the blocks: &6150 Draconium Blocks&r and &6178 redstone blocks&r.
Deactivate the core, raise it one tier with &eTier Up&r in its window, turn on &eToggle Build Guide&r and place the blocks: &6210 Draconium Blocks&r and &6328 redstone blocks&r.
Deactivate the core, raise it one tier with &eTier Up&r in its window, turn on &eToggle Build Guide&r and place the blocks: &626 Draconium Blocks&r as a full cube around the core.
Deactivate the core, raise it one tier with &eTier Up&r in its window, turn on &eToggle Build Guide&r and place the blocks: &654 Draconium Blocks&r outside, &626 redstone blocks&r inside.
Deactivate the core, raise it one tier with &eTier Up&r in its window, turn on &eToggle Build Guide&r and place the blocks: &66 Draconium Blocks&r, one on each side of the core.
Deactivate the core, raise it one tier with &eTier Up&r in its window, turn on &eToggle Build Guide&r and place the blocks: &690 Draconium Blocks&r and &680 redstone blocks&r.
Kerzen verlangsamen den Essenzzerfall de: Candles slow down the essence decay of the summoned spirit. Large candles count like bookshelves at the enchanting table and can be dyed in 16 colours.
Candles, herbs, a broom at the door.
Kerzen, Schädel von Untoten und seltene: Candles, skulls of the undead and rare herbs in a pot on the altar raise &ePower&r and &eCapacity&r. Only the best piece of each kind counts.
Candle dipping like in the old days.
Kessel mit &e250 mB&r Trank der Regenera: A cauldron with &e250 mB&r of Potion of Regeneration: the &6Crow Blank Amulet&r, dried &6Mugwort&r and &6Yellow Dock&r leaves and flowers, &e2 glow berries&r, a &6Totem of Undying&r.
Kessel mit Wasser füllen, von unten heiz: Fill the cauldron with water, heat it from below, &e8 Animal Fat&r (or candles and honeycomb) in. The water becomes liquid &6tallow&r.
Kies in Ecken und Mitte, &6Ton&r oben un: Gravel in the corners and middle, &6clay&r at the top and bottom, &6sand&r left and right: eight &6Conduit Binder Composite&r. In a furnace each piece becomes &6two binders&r.
Kies vor einen &6Lüfter&r mit Wasser (Ki: Gravel in front of a &6fan&r with water (gravel washing): flint and iron nuggets, the nuggets for your andesite alloy. Sandstone in the millstone turns back into sand.
Kipp Trankflaschen in einen Kessel (eine: Tip potion bottles into a cauldron (one bottle is &e250 mB&r) or brew up to &e2 buckets&r of potion at once in the heated cauldron.
Kiste mit Eisen, Transporter zur &6Infus: Chest with iron, transporter to the &6Infusing Factory&r with carbon (enriched iron), on to the second Infusing Factory (steel dust), on to the Smelting Factory, then into the chest. Auto eject everywhere, power by cable.
Kiste oder Transporter an die Rückseite,: A chest or a transporter at the back, auto-eject on, an Anchor Upgrade in it, then it keeps running while you are away.
Klares Glas steckt in der Flüssigkeitsle: Clear Glass goes into the fluid conduit, Fused Quartz into the Soul Vial and the fast fluid conduits. With glowstone added it glows, with amethyst it turns dark.
Kleb &6Mechanische Bohrer&r vorn an dein: Glue &6Mechanical Drills&r to the front of your train and chests or a vault behind them. When the train moves they drill what is in the way, and what they mine lands in the chests.
Klebe beide an einen Portalkran oder Kol: Glue both to a gantry or piston that moves slowly over the field. The harvest lands in chests on the contraption.
Klein und groß, und dazwischen die Drehz: Small and large, and the speed in between.
Small finds all over the Nether.
Small treasures with a big effect.
Klettere auf einen &6Feuerwachturm&r von: Climb a Dungeons and Taverns &6fire watchtower&r and tick this off. It comes in nine biome styles, from birch to mangrove.
Klick damit auf Ackerboden. Er wird zu g: Click farmland with it. It becomes fertilized farmland on which everything grows faster.
Klick damit auf einen Block. Er meldet E: Click a block with it. It reports ores up to &e16 blocks&r away.
Klick das an, das du willst. Bekommst du: Click the one you want. If the crafting table gives you something other than expected, look there first.
Klick den Mob an: du siehst alles im Net: Click the mob: you see everything in the network and order. The packagers send the goods to the address you give.
