Klick es an, um es zurückzuholen. Dabei: Click it to get it back. It may break while doing so. Seekers, Thirst Walkers and Twilight Gazes drop eyes too.
Klick ihn mit Shards an. Er wandelt sie: Click it with shards. It slowly turns them into &bMercury Flux&r, the sides get bluer the fuller it is. A redstone signal stops the output.
Klick mit dem Athame auf Pflanzen: Farn: Click plants with the Athame: fern gives Avennian Sprig, oxeye daisy or lily of the valley Merammer Root, lily pad Oanna Bloom, jungle leaves Sildrian Seed, Nether fungi Mirecap.
Klick mit dem Emitter das Gerät an, bis: Click the device with the emitter until it glows, and place it on a Mercury Catalyst. It heats up to &e8 blocks&r away as long as there is flux.
Klick mit dem Link erst das Ziel an, dan: Click the target with the link first, then place it at the source, up to &e64 blocks&r away. Fill levels, SU or departure times appear on the board.
Klick sie mit einer &6Welle&r an, das is: Click it with a &6shaft&r, that is its output. A fully supplied engine supplies &d1,024 SU per RPM&r, 32 times as much as a water wheel.
Klickst du mit etwas auf den Obelisken,: If you click the obelisk with something it does not need, it tells you in chat what it wants right now.
Klärkammer mit dem Einfachen, dann dem F: A Purification Chamber with the basic, then the Advanced Tier Installer, or at the crafting table: the Basic Purifying Factory in the middle, osmium, circuits, alloy.
Knochenmehl, das auf Essenzpflanzen wirk: Bone meal that works on essence crops.
A button instead of the wand.
Knöpfe über jedem Filter: nach Tag filte: Buttons above every filter: filter by tag (all ores, all ingots), ignore durability, respect enchantments. The &6Fluid Router&r does the same with fluids, with a Fluid Pipe instead of the Conveyor Belt.
Kochtisch, Pflanztöpfe und die Mahlzeite: Cooking table, planting pots and the meals with the most saturation. A kitchen saves you a lot of walking on long streams.
Kohle in der Manufactory gibt Kohlenstau: Coal in the Manufactory gives coal dust, coal dust gives &6graphite dust&r. In a furnace it becomes a &6graphite ingot&r, nine ingots a &6graphite block&r.
Coal in on the left, the bar rises.
Coal in, 32 RF per tick out.
Coal into diamond, egg into dragon egg.
Kohle, ein Stock und &6Seelensand&r erge: Coal, a stick and &6soul sand&r make &6soul torches&r. Eight iron nuggets around a torch make a &6soul lantern&r.
Kombinierst du zwei Gegenstände, bleiben: If you combine two items, the enchantments of the upper one stay. The repair gives the durability of both plus &d20 percent&r.
Kommt dieselbe Eigenschaft aus mehreren: If the same trait comes from several parts, its level rises. Some cancel each other out: Malleable against Brittle.
Kommt ein Spieler in die Nähe, taucht de: When a player comes near, the train appears again. Only machines on the train, such as drills, do not work in unloaded chunks.
Komponente und &6ME-Speichergehäuse&r an: Component and &6ME Storage Housing&r at the crafting table. A Crafting Unit and the component make a &664k Crafting Storage&r for your CPU.
Kondensator auf Modus &eSingularität&r,: Condenser in &eSingularity&r mode, a &664k component&r or larger in the component slot, then &e256,000 items&r in. With 16k the buffer is not enough, that is why singularities only come now.
Konstruktionsprozessoren stecken im ME-L: Engineering Processors go into the ME Drive, the controller, P2P tunnels and the pattern encoding terminal.
Contraptions cost as much as a millstone.
Kopf plus Stiel, das Material entscheide: Head plus rod, the material decides.
Kostet einen Anteil deiner Leiste, der S: Costs a share of your bar, the damage grows with your mana. Your negative effects jump over to the enemy.
Power without water, only with space.
Chalk from the essence of the Afrit themselves.
Kreis ohne Tuch: &e2 Diamant, 1 Smaragd&: Circle without cloth: &e2 diamond, 1 emerald&r. It creates a lake, each extension costs &d30 mana&r. Throw an &eenchanted sword&r in, and for &d5,000 mana&r &6Caliburn&r comes back.
Circle without cloth: &e2 emerald, 1 quartz&r. For twelve hours around the time it was placed it gives &d10 mana per second&r, the other twelve it takes the same amount.
Kreosot wird zu Behandeltem Holz und bre: Creosote becomes Treated Wood and burns in the Diesel Generator if need be. Empty the tank regularly, or the oven stops when it is full.
Kronwerke hat &efünf Stufen&r, und keine: Kronwerke has &efive stages&r, and no single player unlocks any of them. Each opens for the whole server at once as soon as the &ecommunity goal&r at the obelisk is fulfilled.
Kronwerke legt keine eigenen Tasten fest: Kronwerke sets no keys of its own, every mod brings its own. Some are therefore bound twice, they show red in the &econtrols settings&r. Rebind what you need: this book always shows the key that is set on your side. With &6KeyBind Bundles&r you put several actions on one key as a radial menu.
Kronwerke: das ME-Netz braucht einen Mag: Kronwerke: the ME network needs a mage.
Krähen leben in Wäldern. Wirf &6Seed Mix: Crows live in forests. Throw &6Seed Mixture&r on the ground, then they fly over, and the chance is higher than when feeding by hand. Build the &6Crow Flute&r for it: &e3 mahogany planks&r and &e2 dyes&r.
Kunststoff in die Ecken, &6Stämme&r an d: Plastic in the corners, &6logs&r on the sides, a &6Gold Gear&r in the middle, the &6Simple Frame&r at the bottom make the &6Fermentation Station&r.
Kunststoff, &6Blumentopf&r, Kunststoff o: Plastic, &6flower pot&r, plastic at the top, &6pistons&r left and right of the Pity Frame, &6Iron Gears&r and redstone at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Braustand&r, Kunststoff ob: Plastic, &6brewing stand&r, plastic at the top, &6Gold Gear&r, &6Advanced Frame&r, Gold Gear in the middle, repeater, Gold Gear, repeater at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Diamantspitzhacke&r, Kunst: Plastic, &6diamond pickaxe&r, plastic at the top, &6iron ore&r left and right of the &6Advanced Frame&r, &6Diamond Gears&r and redstone at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Diamantzahnrad&r, Kunststo: Plastic, &6Diamond Gear&r, plastic at the top, &6pistons&r left and right of the &6Simple Frame&r, &6Gold Gears&r and redstone at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Eisenhacke&r, Kunststoff o: Plastic, &6iron hoe&r, plastic at the top, &6iron axes&r left and right of the Pity Frame, &6Gold Gears&r and redstone at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Eisenschwert&r, Kunststoff: Plastic, &6iron sword&r, plastic at the top, &6books&r left and right of the &6Advanced Frame&r, Gold Gears and redstone at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Goldzahnrad&r, Kunststoff: Plastic, &6Gold Gear&r, plastic at the top, &6iron swords&r left and right of the Pity Frame, &6iron axes&r and redstone at the bottom make the &6Mob Slaughter Factory&r.
Kunststoff, &6Holztruhe&r, Kunststoff ob: Plastic, &6wooden chest&r, plastic at the top, &6Fluid Tank&r from Create, Pity Frame, tank in the middle, &6gold ingot&r, &6Diamond Gear&r, gold ingot at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Netherwarze&r, Kunststoff: Plastic, &6Nether wart&r, plastic at the top, &6magma cream&r left and right of the Advanced Frame, &6emeralds&r and redstone at the bottom.
Kunststoff, &6Pinker Schleimball&r, Kuns: Plastic, &6Pink Slime&r ball, plastic at the top, three &6iron bars&r in the middle, &6Gold Gears&r around the &6Advanced Frame&r at the bottom.
Copper with granite, iron with tuff.
Copper is copper, no matter which mod.
Copper is made for exactly this.
Kupfer oben und an den Seiten, ein &6Flu: Copper at the top and on the sides, a &6fluix block&r at the top centre, a &6Charged Certus Quartz Crystal&r in the middle, three iron at the bottom.
Kupfer, &6Redstonesäureeimer&r, Kupfer o: Copper, &6Bucket of Redstone Acid&r, copper on top, &6Lead Plate&r, &6Basic Engineering Block&r, Lead Plate at the bottom make the &6LV Accumulator&r.
Copper, zinc and a breath of blaze.
Kupferkabel sind der Rohstoff für LV-Dra: Copper Wire is the raw material for LV Wire Coils and for Vacuum Tubes.
Kurbeln macht hungrig. Gut, um einen Auf: Cranking makes you hungry. Good for testing a setup before the water wheel stands.
Kurze Wagen brauchen eins, längere zwei,: Short carriages need one, longer ones two, &e20&r per train at most. What you build on them you fix with &6Super Glue&r.
Bugs of the citadel, some with jaws.
Käufer nehmen eine &6Einkaufsliste&r und: Buyers take a &6Shopping List&r and pay at the seller. Your network ships the goods, the payment lands in your storage.
Grains of Infinity from a fire.
Kühe, Schweine und Schafe lassen manchma: Cows, pigs and sheep sometimes drop a &6Sinew&r. In the furnace it becomes &6Dried Sinew&r, in the grid &ethree Sinew Fiber&r.
LV and MV in one grid.
LV- und MV-Anschluss oben, &6Elektronikk: LV and MV connector on top, &6Electronic Component&r and &6Electrum Coil Block&r in the middle, two iron ingots at the bottom. The component: Components blueprint, Treated Wood Slab, quartz, redstone, Electrum Wire.
Lade ihn mit Leuchtsteinblöcken auf, bis: Charge it with glowstone blocks, up to &d4&r charges, and click it. If you die, you wake up in the Nether next to it; every respawn costs one charge.
Lade ihn vorher auf. Ein Sprung nach Hau: Charge it first. A jump home from the mine saves the way back.
Laden geht im &6Ausrüstungsladegerät&r (: You charge it in the &6Equipment Charger&r (steel, dispenser, block of redstone, Energy Pipes, chest). That is also where you fill in &6Turbofuel&r, which makes it fly faster. There is no hovering.
Laden geht im Ausrüstungsladegerät oder: You charge them in the Equipment Charger or with the Exo Chestplate worn. They accept enchantments such as Efficiency and Fortune.
Lager Klumpen, Barren und Blöcke zusamme: Store nuggets, ingots and blocks together
Bearing, chassis and saws in a circle.
A Stock Link on the packager.
Lange Drähte haben mehr Widerstand, die: Long wires have more resistance, the lost power becomes heat, and too much of it burns the wire through. A &6connector&r (three copper nuggets, alloy) is a post to hang them on.
Langsamer als die Feuersamen, aber ohne: Slower than fire seeds, but without field and essence. For a cobblestone generator a single lava block is enough anyway, it is not used up.
Langsamer als die Spitzhacke und jeder B: Slower than the pickaxe, and every block costs durability. A sinew binding and a leather grip pay off the most here.
Langweiliges Schmuckstück in den Apparat: Dull Trinket into the apparatus. &e3 diamonds, 5 Source Gems&r make the &6Amulet of Mana Boost&r, &e2 diamonds, 2 gold ingots, 4 Source Gems&r the &6Amulet of Mana Regeneration&r.
Lapislazuli geht auch: die Kammer macht: Lapis lazuli works too: the chamber turns one piece of it into a Source Gem as well.
Laser zerstören Blöcke in ihrem Weg. Sch: Lasers destroy blocks in their path. Fire them into the tractor beam: it focuses and directs them like an amplifier, and everything its beam mines lands in its inventory instead of on the ground.
Laserbohrer, Düngemaschine, Hydrokultur-: The Laser Drill, Plant Fertilizer, Hydroponic Bed, Fermentation Station and Marine Fisher sit in this frame. Make two right away.
Lass deinen Steinbruch eine Weile laufen: Let your quarry run for a while and collect what it brings. With a Void Module and a storage bus on the ME network only the ore lands in storage.
Lass den Kondensator Tag und Nacht laufe: Let the condenser run day and night.
Lass den Kristallisator in eine Kiste la: Let the crystallizer run into a chest and bring the pellets to the obelisk yourself. &e/kw goals&r shows the status.
Lass den Roh-Hochofen mit &6Eisen&r und: Let the Crude Blast Furnace run on &6iron&r and &6coke&r until &e16 steel ingots&r are done.
Lass den Rucksack selbst schmelzen: Let the backpack smelt on its own
Lass dich von Shulkergeschossen treffen,: Let shulker projectiles hit you until you have floated &e50 blocks&r up.
Lass die Extraktoren laufen, bis &e1 000: Let the extractors run until &e1,000 mB of latex&r has come together and fill it into a bucket. Each extractor has a tank for 1,000 mB.
Lass die Kammer am Glas laufen, bis du &: Let the chamber run at the jar until you have &e16 Source Gems&r. A &6block of amethyst&r turns straight into a &6Source Gem Block&r for &d2,000 Source&r.
Lass die Latexverarbeitung laufen, bis &: Let the latex processing run until &e16 Dry Rubber&r are done.
Lass die Schublade selbst schieben: Let the drawer push on its own
Lass die Schublade selbst ziehen: Let the drawer pull on its own
Lass die Terraplatte aus Stufe 2 weiterl: Keep the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate from stage 2 running. Sixteen fights for the obelisk are sixteen ingots.
Lass einen Baum neben einem wilden &dWir: Let a tree grow next to a wild &dWhirlisprig&r and it gives shards. In the apparatus with a Source Gem, Magebloom seeds, Magebloom, diamond, oak, spruce and birch saplings and wheat seeds it becomes the charm.
Latex brauchst du für Gummi, für das Ein: You need latex for rubber, for the Simple Frame, for laser lenses and for all addons. A ring of four to eight extractors around a column of logs is a good start.
Latex, Strom und Werkstatt, mit Stromver: Latex, power and workshop, with power use.
Lauf in ein neues Biom und lies den Name: Walk into a new biome and read the name that &6Traveler's Titles&r shows.
Laufen die FPS hoch, aber Blöcke kommen: If the FPS are high but blocks come back after mining and doors react late, it is the &eserver&r. Nothing on your side helps then; say so in chat, and the team checks whose machine is slowing the world down.
Laut Handbuch ein Kampf für Magier mit S: According to the handbook a fight for mages with tier 2 spells and good gear. It resists cold. Go in twos or threes, bring Heal, Slowfall and Dispel.
Lava aus dem Nichts, langsam, aber für i: Lava out of nothing, slowly, but forever.
Lava brauchst du öfter, als du denkst: a: You need lava more often than you think: at the cobblestone generator, in front of the fan for smelting, and the &6Mechanical Press&r over a basin compacts 2 flint, 1 gravel and some lava into new &6andesite&r, the raw material of the tech pillar.
Lava for drills, fans and andesite.
Lava macht sie stärker, Ertrinken und Er: Lava makes it stronger, drowning and suffocation do not hurt it, cold works more weakly.
Lava in, a lot of mana out.
Lava und Wasser so, dass dazwischen Bruc: Lava and water so that cobblestone forms between them, a &6Mechanical Drill&r in front. Every stone it breaks forms again at once; a funnel collects.
Lava unendlich: eine &6Schlauchrolle&r ü: Infinite lava: a &6Hose Pulley&r over the lava ocean in the Nether, over 10,000 blocks count as infinite. Next to a &6Heat Generator&r every adjacent lava brings 12 FE/t without being used up.
Livingwood, glimmer and two full pools.
Leder oben, drei &6Stahl&r in der Mitte,: Leather at the top, three &6steel&r in the middle, at the bottom &6blaze powder&r, &6block of redstone&r, blaze powder. It holds &e100,000 RF&r and needs &e128 RF/t&r under thrust.
Leder: +15 Prozent Abbautempo, +0,15 Ang: Leather: +15 percent mining speed, +0.15 attack speed, Flexible III. Wool: +10 percent mining speed, +0.2 attack speed, Flexible II.
Leer &6Milcheimer&r in einen &6Abfluss&r: Empty &6milk buckets&r into an &6Item Drain&r; a pipe brings the milk to the &6Spout&r. A &6bread&r below it becomes a &6Sweet Roll&r with &b250 mB milk&r.
Leer lädt die Imbuement-Kammer sie wiede: Empty, the Imbuement Chamber recharges them.
Leere Charms lädt die Imbuement-Kammer m: The Imbuement Chamber recharges empty charms with Source.
Leere Felder deckst du mit einer &6Handw: You cover empty slots with a &6Crafter Slot Cover&r. They cost &d2 SU per RPM&r.
Leerenkern und Handschuh auf dem Fusions: Void Core and gauntlet on the Fusion Anvil.
Leg &5Draconiumstaub&r in einen Ofen ode: Put &5draconium dust&r into a furnace or an Energized Smelter. One dust becomes one &5Draconium Ingot&r.
Leg &64 Endkristalle&r auf den Rand des: Place &64 End Crystals&r on the rim of the exit portal, one on each side. A crystal is &67 glass&r, an &6eye of ender&r and a &6ghast tear&r.
Leg &6Eisenbarren&r, &6Kupferbarren&r un: Put &6iron ingots&r, &6copper ingots&r and &6gold ingots&r on the depot under the press. Every ingot becomes a sheet.
Leg &6Kohle&r in den Koksofen und nimm &: Put &6coal&r into the Coke Oven and take &6Coal Coke&r out.
Leg &6Kohle&r in den linken Slot der Inf: Put &6coal&r into the left slot of the infuser. &eCarbon:&r coal 10 mB, charcoal 20 mB, block of coal 90 mB, block of charcoal 180 mB, enriched carbon 80 mB.
Put &6brass ingots&r under the press. Each becomes a &6Brass Sheet&r.
Leg &6Netherquarz&r in den Ofen oder Sch: Put &6Nether quartz&r into a furnace or blast furnace, out comes &6Silicon&r. One quartz, one silicon.
Leg &6Osmiumbarren&r in den Chemikalien-: Put &6Osmium Ingots&r into the chemical slot, each gives &e200 mB&r of osmium. The machine uses it up while it presses.
Leg &6Rohes Eisen&r in die Fragment Forg: Put &6Raw Iron&r into the Fragment Forge. Each becomes one &6Iron Clump&r, three &6Small Iron Clumps&r and three Small Nickel Clumps. Nine small ones make a whole one at the crafting table.
Leg &6Samen&r in ein Nest der &6Starfire: Put &6seeds&r into a nest of the &6Starfire Birds&r. The nests sit in the crowns of Lunar trees. The birds reward you, among other things with &6Starfire&r.
Leg &6Stahlaxt&r, &6Stahlspitzhacke&r un: Put the &6steel axe&r, &6steel pickaxe&r and &6steel shovel&r next to each other in the top row, two &6iron ingots&r below as the handle. Out comes the &6steel paxel&r.
Leg &6Wellen&r neben den Rotor und klick: Lay &6shafts&r next to the rotor and click two of them with a &6copper coil&r: they become a &6winding&r. Windings next to each other connect in series.
Build up a stock of &e16 Source Gem blocks&r.
Leg &e32 Quelljuwelblöcke&r auf Vorrat u: Stock up &e32 source gem blocks&r and build a spell with tier 3 glyphs.
Leg Pfeife und Besen zusammen ins Crafti: Put whistle and broom together into the crafting grid, then it is bound. Right click calls the broom over when it is in range. Put into the crafting grid alone once more, it undoes the binding.
Leg Rüstung oder Werkzeug hinein, dann d: Put armor or a tool in, then the module. In the station's window you turn each module on and off and adjust it.
Leg am &6Schmiedetisch&r eine &6Schmiede: At the &6smithing table&r put in a &6smithing template&r, a &6diamond pickaxe&r and a &6netherite ingot&r. Enchantments are kept.
Leg das Book of Shadows darauf, dann lie: Put the Book of Shadows on it, then you read it standing. It displays other items. Burning candles nearby float around it.
Leg das Rezept ins Raster, die Formel in: Put the recipe into the grid, the formula into its slot, and it crafts with power from its stock as long as ingredients keep coming. Ideal for steel casings off the line.
Leg das Werkzeug in den Verzauberer, wir: Put the tool into the enchanter, throw &6enchanted books&r into the obsidian circle and click with the wand. It transfers the first enchantment of each book, the books are kept. It is paid with mana, fastest through a spark.
Leg den Builder mit &6Dimensionsscherben: Put the Builder with &6Dimensional Shards&r into RFTools Base's &6Machine Infuser&r. It gets infused bit by bit.
Leg den Efeu zusammen mit einem Gegensta: Put the ivy together with an item into the crafting table. If you die, that item stays in your inventory, and the ivy is used up.
Leg den Hohlraum in einen Chemikalienbeh: Put the Hohlraum into a Chemical Tank with D-T Fuel, it holds &e10 mB&r. Filled, it goes into the reactor controller and ignites.
Leg die &6Brennende Asche&r auf den &6Al: Put the &6Burning Ashes&r on the &6Altar of Fire&r in the arena. &cIgnis&r appears: &e450 health&r, armour 10, heavy sword blows and fireballs.
Leg die &6Oxidized Golem Steel Ingots&r: Put the &6Oxidized Golem Steel Ingots&r into a blast furnace. Out come clean &6Golem Steel Ingots&r.
Leg die Fassade und einen beliebigen Blo: Put the facade and any block into the Painting Machine: the facade takes on that block's look, for &d2,400 µI&r. Right click a conduit with it to cover it.
Leg ein &6Artefakt&r in einen der eigene: Put an &6artifact&r into one of the extra slots next to your armour. You open the menu for it with the button in the inventory.
Leg ein Buch, eine Zutat und Lapis hinei: Put in a book, an ingredient and lapis and pay experience levels: out comes an enchanted book. Redstone gives Efficiency, slime Silk Touch, emerald Fortune, obsidian Unbreaking. More ingredient means a higher level, EMI shows the amounts.
Leg ein Item per Rechtsklick darauf. Sta: Put an item on it with a right-click. Instead of a depot a running belt works too: then it presses everything that passes underneath.
Leg ein verzaubertes Teil und Bücher hin: Put in an enchanted item and books and choose an enchantment. It moves onto a book, which costs &eexperience levels&r. That way you save enchantments from old gear before you fuse it into Wyvern gear.
Leg eine &6Managlasphiole&r hinein (3 Ma: Put in a &6Managlass Vial&r (3 Managlass in a V shape give 3), then the ingredients, and aim a spreader at it. Brews have fixed recipes and several sips per vial; the Lexica lists them all.
Leg eine &6Pewter Inlay&r auf den Boden,: Place a &6Pewter Inlay&r on the ground, look at it and sing &5Wicked, Soul, Wicked, Soul&r. It becomes the &5Unholy Symbol&r.
Leg eine Blaupause auf den Zeichentisch: Put a blueprint on the drawing table and choose the part. &eIn:&r ingredients through the two blue hatches, power above them. &eOut:&r at the end of the belt. That way steel components and Vacuum Tubes run without you.
Leg eine Schallplatte in den Tab, und de: Put a record into the tab and your backpack plays it wherever you go.
Leg eine Verarbeitungsschablone in den &: Put a processing pattern into the &6Advanced Pattern Encoder&r (right click in hand), choose a side for every ingredient and take out the new pattern. No more pipe tangle on Mekanism machines.
Leg eine Zelle hinein und zieh die Gegen: Put a cell into it and drag the items it should take from EMI into the filter slots. After that only those land in it. A button takes the current contents as the filter.
Leg eine Zutat mit Rechtsklick darauf un: Put an ingredient on it with right click and click it with the tool. Knife: cabbage becomes cabbage leaves, beef becomes minced beef, rice panicles become rice and straw. Axe: logs are stripped and give tree bark.
Leg einen &6Amethystsplitter&r oder &6La: Put an &6amethyst shard&r or &6lapis lazuli&r into the chamber and wait. At &d500 Source&r the &6Source Gem&r is done, right click takes it out.
Leg einen &6Eisenbarren&r auf den &aNatu: Put an &6iron ingot&r on the &aNatural Altar&r from Nature's Aura. For &d15,000 aura&r it becomes &6Infused Iron&r, a block of iron becomes a Block of Infused Iron for 135,000 aura.
Leg einen &6Eisenbarren&r auf den fertig: Put an &6iron ingot&r on the finished altar. Once it has gathered enough aura (&e15,000&r per ingot), it turns into &6Infused Iron&r. An iron block works the same way.
Leg einen &6Holzstamm&r auf den Steinamb: Put a &6log&r on the stone anvil and click it with the &6Crude Knife&r: &esix Template Boards&r.
Leg einen &6Holzstamm&r aufs Schneidebre: Put a &6log&r on the cutting board and click it with an &6axe&r. You get the stripped log and &6tree bark&r.
Leg einen &6Menril Log&r auf den Squeeze: Put a &6Menril Log&r on the Squeezer and jump on it until it is flat. That gives &d1,000 mB of Menril Resin&r, which flows into the Drying Basin next to it and dries to a &6Crystalized Menril Block&r. At the crafting table the block gives nine &6chunks&r.
Leg einen &6Soul Gem&r mit einem gefange: Put in a &6Soul Gem&r with a captured mob, a &6weapon&r and spirit fuel: Demon's Dream Seeds, Fruit, Essence or Otherworld Essence. The Afrit clones the mob and defeats it again and again, the loot lands in the block.
Leg einen &6leeren Eimer&r in den Platz: Put an &6empty bucket&r into the slot in the Coke Oven's window, below it you take out a &6Bucket of Creosote Oil&r.
Leg einen Block mit &eRechtsklick&r dara: Put a block on it with &eright click&r and then click it with the matching tool. With a hammer, one cobblestone becomes &enine pebbles&r that way.
Leg einen Kanal vom Typ &6Logic&r an. Ei: Create a channel of the type &6Logic&r. A connector as a &esensor&r measures items, fluid, energy or redstone in the block next to it and sets a colour. A connector as an &eoutput&r gives out redstone at that colour.
Leg einen Vorrat an. Seelenstahl will vi: Build up a stock. Soulstained Steel wants four Refined Soulstone per ingot, the Impetus and the better scythe four each as well.
Leg einen Vorrat von &e8 Quelljuwelblöck: Build up a supply of &e8 Source Gem blocks&r.
Leg einen ganzen Stapel in einen Ofen un: Put a whole stack into one furnace and the result straight into a second. You also need Otherstone for bowls, take plenty.
Leg es deiner Krähe um. Würde sie sterbe: Put it around your crow's neck. If it were to die, the amulet saves it like a totem.
Leg es vor die Tür der Werkstatt, dann i: Put it in front of the workshop door, then the tablet is full every time you go out.
Leg im Filter fest, welche Items du imme: In the filter you set which items you always want to have with you. When a stack of them gets smaller in your inventory, the upgrade tops it up from the backpack. Torches, building blocks, food: you never notice something running out.
Leg in aufeinanderfolgende Plätze eine K: Put a chain of the same kind into consecutive slots, like iron nuggets, iron ingots and block of iron. The upgrade then presses and breaks down back and forth on its own, up to &e5 slots&r long. You simply take out whichever level you need right now.
Leg mit Rechtsklick einen &6Kompass&r hi: Right click to put a &6compass&r inside, sneak right click takes it out again. A plain compass leads to the world spawn, a compass bound to a &6lodestone&r to the lodestone. You may even mine the lodestone afterwards.
Leg mit dem Buch Arbeitsbereich und Abga: Set the work area and the delivery chest with the book. It fells every tree in the area, carries the wood away and replants the saplings.
Leg rohes Fleisch oder Fisch aufs &6Schn: Put raw meat or fish on the &6Cutting Board&r and click it with the knife. A &6pork chop&r gives two &6bacon&r, a &6cod&r two &6cod slices&r and a bone meal. Chicken and mutton turn into cuts the same way.
Leg sie in den Brustplatz, spring und dr: Put them in the chest slot, jump and press jump again while falling. &6Firework rockets&r give thrust. Repair with &6phantom membrane&r or Mending.
Leg sie mit dem Werkzeugtausch-Upgrade i: Put them in the backpack with the Tool Swapper Upgrade, then you always have the right one in hand.
Leg zur Blaupause zum Beispiel &6zwei Ei: Put, for example, &6two iron&r and &6one gold&r with the blueprint. The head averages the stats and takes along the traits of both.
Leg zwei verschiedene Materialien in den: Put two different materials into the &6Crude Mixer&r, like copper and iron. Out comes a &6crude alloy&r that goes into heads like a material of its own.
Legierung in die Ecken, Fortgeschrittene: Alloy in the corners, Advanced Control Circuits at the top and bottom, buckets left and right, a Steel Casing in the middle.
Alloys without the grid, more per ore.
Legierungsschmelze, Stirling Generator u: The Alloy Smelter, Stirling Generator and SAG Mill each want two.
Light armor made of silk cloth.
Leistung in jeder Stufe wie beim Furnato: Output in every tier as with the Furnator: Starter 20 up to Spirited 8,000 FE/t. Next to a lava pump from the Nether it runs without a break.
Leite die überzähligen Samen aus deinen: Route the surplus seeds from your pots and the harvester into it. You need bone meal for saplings, flowers and the &aRitual of the Forest&r from Nature's Aura.
Letzter Treffer mit einer &dElementiumax: Last hit with an &dElementium Axe&r: about a &e7.7 percent&r chance for the head, 15.4 percent with Looting I, each further level 7.7 more.
Leuchtstein ist Licht, Trankverstärker,: Glowstone is light, a potion booster, fuel for the &6Respawn Anchor&r and the frame of the &bAether portal&r (&bThe Aether&r chapter).
Leylinien verbinden Punkte etwa 300 Blöc: Leylines connect points about 300 blocks apart. Near a line mana comes back much faster. With elytra along a line you get a boost. Build the workshop on a ley point.
Lieber ohne Kanäle und Typen? Das Kapite: Rather without channels and types? The chapter &3Refined Storage&r is the simpler alternative.
Liefere &6256 Messingbarren&r und &632 P: Deliver &6256 brass ingots&r and &632 precision mechanisms&r. They are handed in by hand at the obelisk; sneak and right-click hands in everything that fits.
Liegen alle Kreiden, Kerzen, Crystals un: If all chalks, candles, Crystals and skulls are inside, the Afrit draws the whole pentacle at once. Right click on the golden bowl of a finished pentacle packs everything back in. For the many Kandar summonings that saves minutes every time.
Liegt das Glas in der &eHotbar&r, vernic: If the jar is in your &ehotbar&r, it destroys the items on its list as you pick them up and gives you a little mana for them. Used while sneaking it switches on and off.
Lies das Kapitel &cBosse der Oberwelt&r,: Read the &cOverworld Bosses&r chapter before you enter a pyramid in the desert, a prison in the snow, a sunken city, an old factory or an acropolis above the sea.
Lies, was die nächsten Stufen bringen: Read what the next stages bring
Limette gibt einem Pentakel die Rufkraft: Lime gives a pentacle the calling power for Djinni. Ophyx' Calling needs &e36 signs&r of it, so several pieces of chalk.
Links bis zu sechs Zutaten, daneben der: Up to six ingredients on the left, next to them the container, usually a &6bowl&r. Finished servings stay in the pot until you take them out.
Links im Buch sind die Kapitel in Gruppe: On the left of the book the chapters are sorted into groups: &6Start&r, &6Tech&r, &dMagic&r, &aWorld and Exploration&r and &6Storage and Tools&r. Clicking the group name folds it in and out.
Links im Buch stehen die Kapitel in Grup: On the left of the book the chapters are in groups: &6Tech&r, &dMagic&r, &aWorld and Exploration&r, &6Storage and Tools&r and &6Checklists&r. To the right of here every chapter of stage 1 is a checkmark.
Links und rechts je &e3 Lebeholzstämme&r: Left and right &e3 Livingwood logs&r each, top and bottom middle &6leather&r, the &6Horn of the Wild&r in the middle.
Linsen kommen auf das &6Fortgeschrittene: Lenses go on the &6Advanced Prism&r and change what it does with projectiles. Most are made in the Imbuement Chamber: &6quartz&r in, &6Manipulation Essence&r and a glyph on the pedestals, &d2,000 source&r. The glyph stays where it is.
Linsen unten, &6Lens Frame&r (6 Othersto: Lenses at the bottom, &6Lens Frame&r (6 Otherstone, 2 silver) above, &e3 leather&r added: the goggles.
Linsen, die abbauen, anziehen und anzünd: Lenses that mine, attract and ignite.
Lithium aus der Wärmeverdampfungsanlage: Lithium from the Thermal Evaporation Plant (stage 3) into the &6Chemical Crystallizer&r: &e100 mB&r become one &6Lithium Dust&r.
Lithiumstaub in die Ecken, Energietablet: Lithium Dust in the corners, Energy Tablets on the sides, a Basic Energy Cube in the middle. A &6Basic Induction Cell&r stores &d3.2 billion FE&r.
Lithiumstaub in die Ecken, Schaltkreise: Lithium Dust in the corners, circuits on the sides, a Basic Energy Cube in the middle. A &6Basic Induction Provider&r manages &d102,400 FE/t&r.
Lockt seine Angriffe auf einen Kristall,: Lure its attacks onto a crystal, then strike.
Logikprozessoren stecken in Zellen, Kons: Logic Processors go into cells, terminals and the formation and annihilation cores.
Lohen und ihre Ruten findest du in &cNet: You find blazes and their rods in &cNether fortresses&r. Take fire resistance along, blazes shoot fireballs. More in &6The Nether&r chapter.
Lohnend wird er mit &bEthen&r aus der nä: It pays off with &bethene&r from the next quest, or with hydrogen that is left over anyway.
Lohnt sich nur, wenn Essenz vom Feld im: Only worth it when essence comes from the field in abundance. The higher essence coals each burn twice as long as the previous one and come with their stages.
Lohnt sich vor allem bei Limetten- und v: Worth it above all for lime and purple chalk, whose ingredients are costly. White chalk is cheaper to make new.
Lohnt sich, wenn zwei Eigenschaften zusa: Worth it when two traits should go together. For pure stats a single material head is better. The real alloy forge comes in stage 2.
Depart at the push of a button.
Luft, Erde, Wasser und Feuer in Lehm gep: Air, earth, water and fire pressed into clay.
Luftschiffe und Festungen über den Wolke: Airships and fortresses above the clouds.
Lässt Tiere in der Nähe regelmäßig Junge: Makes animals nearby have young regularly as long as there is Source. From &e20 animals&r nearby it pauses. With a Vitalic Sourcelink next to it, Source comes back.
Lässt mit Mana auf Erde in seiner Nähe s: With mana it keeps growing new Mystical Flowers of every colour on dirt near it. With a Hopperhock and a chest the supply collects itself.
Läuft deine Draconium-Straße aus Stufe 4: If your draconium line from stage 4 is still running, keep it running.
Läuft ein Rohr leck oder fliegt ein Tank: If a pipe leaks or a tank blows up, the radiation contaminates the area. A source of 1,000 Sv/h takes about ten hours to decay.
Lüfter, davor ein &bWasserblock&r, und &: A fan, a &bwater block&r in front of it, and &6gravel&r on a belt through the air stream. Each gravel gives flint with &e25 percent&r and an iron nugget with &e12.5 percent&r.
M for FTB Chunks, J for JourneyMap.
M, then C, then drag across the chunks.
MV-Draht trägt &d8 192 FE/t&r über 16 Bl: MV wire carries &d8 192 FE/t&r over 16 blocks, an MV connector &d1 024 FE/t&r. The loss per stretch is four times smaller than with copper.
Mach &e16 Fortgeschrittene Steuerschaltk: Make &e16 Advanced Control Circuits&r. The bottleneck is Printed Silicon: trade with an AE2 player or build the CNC Stamper further down.
Turn a mana burst into a tool.
Mach das über festem Boden, am besten an: Do this over solid ground, ideally at an End City, not over the void. A water bucket or a potion of slow falling breaks the landing.
Mach mit einem einzigen &6Tiefkieselstei: Deal &d20&r damage or more with a single &6Depthrock Pebble&r from the slingshot.
Macht Stein zu Kies, Kies zu Sand, Blume: Turns stone into gravel, gravel into sand, flowers into double dye, with Sensitive items too. Especially strong against swimming creatures.
Macht aus Quelle aus einem Glas daneben: Turns Source from a jar next to it into rotational force for Create. The sides set the speed, the front the ratio of stress to speed. More force costs more Source.
Magic from blood, powder and cloth.
Magic is allowed to look good too.
Magmacreme ist die Zutat für den &6Trank: Magma cream is the ingredient for the &6Potion of Fire Resistance&r, four of them make a magma block. Nine magma blocks go into the blast bricks of a blast furnace.
Mahlstein, Presse, Mixer, Lüfter, Getrie: Millstone, press, mixer, fan, gearbox, piston and depot all have a casing in their recipe. A stack of logs in stock saves walking.
Mahou Tsukai öffnet in &6Stufe 4&r. Kein: Mahou Tsukai opens in &6stage 4&r. No machines, no altars: a circle of your own blood, three powders in, and the scroll is done. The compendium shows every spell with this server's costs.
Malarit wird zu Waffen, Werkzeugen, Pfei: Malarite becomes weapons, tools, arrows and a spear. &6Pungency Fruit&r grows all over the swamp, smells like garlic and works as a weapon too.
Male brauchst du für die großen Foki, di: You need Marks for the greater foci, the elemental armors from stage 4 and the Nullify Defense glyph.
Mana from the time of day.
Mana comes from flowers, not from cables.
Mana without a beam and without loss.
Mana that comes out of your tree pots.
Mana, das fließt, während du etwas ander: Mana that flows while you do something else.
Managlas brauchst du für Phiolen der Bra: You need Managlass for the brewery's vials and as trade goods for Alfheim in stage 3.
Manastahl und &6Lebeholzzweige&r, Muster: Manasteel and &6Livingwood Twigs&r, pattern like iron. The armour from Manasteel alone.
Manaverbreiter plus &e1 Redstone&r. Er f: Mana Spreader plus &e1 redstone&r. It fires one burst on every &eredstone pulse&r, even without a target.
Manche &6Verschollene&r in den Katakombe: Some &6Forgotten&r in the catacombs carry a &6Cloggrum Battleaxe&r. Slay them until one drops it. You cannot craft it.
Manche Skelette tragen einen &6Köcher&r: Some skeletons carry a &6quiver&r on their back. Kill one of them and take it along. The harder the area, the more often you see them.
Material plus Katalysator rein, heraus k: Material plus catalyst in, and it comes out with a grade. The average is &eC&r.
Material: &e4 Eis&r, mit Behutsamkeit au: Material: &e4 ice&r, with Silk Touch from a cold biome.
Material: &e4 Erd-Agglomerat&r (Gras, Ki: Material: &e4 Earth Agglomeratio&r (grass, gravel, dirt, clay).
Material: &e4 Feuer-Agglomerat&r (Lavaei: Material: &e4 Fire Agglomeratio&r (lava bucket, gravel, dirt, clay).
Material: &e4 Luft-Agglomerat&r (Glasfla: Material: &e4 Air Agglomeratio&r (glass bottle, gravel, dirt, clay).

With dragon's breath in the damage module.

With a normal bow in the core.

Muscle power for trying things out.

Mythologia's End, only for the insane.

Netherödnis, Karmesin, Wirr, Seelensand,: Nether wastes, crimson, warped, soul sand, basalt.

Neue Biome, Wegsteine, Bauwerke voller B: New biomes, waystones, structures full of loot and the mining dimension for digging without holes in the landscape.

Nothing is removed from the pack, some things just come later. Vanilla is open, except the &cNether&r (stage 2) and the &dEnd&r (stage 4). Both open with an event.

Only one material for the head.
Only one of the two fits in.
Only in the Shiverstone of the cold biomes.
Nur im Schlotterstein steckt &6Froststah: Only Shiverstone holds &6Froststeel&r. Remember the place.

To the other end of the world without cables.
Ohne Karten bewegen sie wenig, siehe näc: Without cards they move little, see the next quest.
Ohne Kristall gibt 1 000 mB Wasser nur &: Without a crystal 1,000 mB of water gives only &e100 mB&r. With a crystal &e1,000 mB&r.
Without a log, nobody can help you.
Ohne Lohenbrenner kein Messing, ohne Mes: No Blaze Burner, no brass; no brass, no stage 2 goal. The engineers need your gems: build burners or trade gems for brass.
Ohne Runen offen sind &6Tolldorn&r, &6Sc: Open without runes are &6Bellethorne&r, &6Dreadthorne&r, &6Bergamute&r and &6Solegnolia&r. All the others are listed as a checklist in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter.
Ohne Steuerstab zählt die Säule nicht. W: Without a control rod the column does not count. How well it cools, the reactor shows later as boil efficiency.
No pot, straight from the grid.
Ohne Zusatz klares Wetter, mit Schwarzpu: Without an addition clear weather, with gunpowder rain, with a lapis block a thunderstorm. Coordinate with each other, the weather is the same for everyone.
Ohne Zusätze ruft das Ritual eine Gruppe: Without additions the ritual summons a group of Wilden. Throw one &espike&r, one &ehorn&r and one &ewing&r onto the brazier, then the &5Wilden Chimera&r comes. Only it gives the &5Wilden Tribute&r for the archmage book.
Nothing in Botania works without this flower.
Without an outside power source, with a rheostat.
Ohne geladenen Certus kein Fluix und kei: Without charged certus no fluix and no ME network. Powah's Energizing Orb later makes two per run, but the chamber makes the start. Several chambers on the relay network and a hopper make you the most important supplier.
Ohne ihn keine Elite-Maschinen und kein: Without it no Elite machines and no way to the Ultimate Control Circuits (chapter &bMekanism: Elite&r).
Opfer sind dem Patron viel wert, gehen a: Sacrifices are worth a lot to the patron, but they also only work once a day.
Osmium, Infundierte Legierung, zwei Ener: Osmium, Infused Alloy, two Energy Tablets and a circuit. It supplies &d24 FE/t&r from Y 24 and more the higher it stands, up to &d192 FE/t&r.
Otherworld-Setzlinge fallen nur aus Blät: Otherworld saplings only drop from leaves you break by hand. Wild trees grow in &eOtherworld Groves&r, caves deep below the overworld.
Pack Kreiden, Kerzen und Schädel hinein: Pack chalks, candles and skulls into it (sneaking right click). Pick a pentacle in the Dictionary through the eye, fix the preview with right click, and then every click with the satchel on a preview sign places the right part.
Pack die Brustplatte damit voll. Jeder T: Pack the chestpiece full with them. Every hit the shield swallows does not hit you.
Pack einen &6Geschnitzten Kürbis&r, eine: Pack a &6carved pumpkin&r, a &6bow&r and &e64 arrows&r. With the pumpkin on your head, endermen do not attack when you look at them.
Packt gleiche Items am Boden in ihr 2x2-: Packs identical items on the ground into their 2x2 recipe, like snowballs into snow. The only Ars Technica glyph already open in stage 1. The rest comes with brass in stage 2.
Pakete mit fremder Adresse nimmt der näc: Packages with a foreign address are taken along by the next train that stops, matching ones it unloads there. In the schedule there are &eDeliver Package&r and &eRetrieve Package&r for that.
Pandas, Schnüffler und Eisengolems auf B: Pandas, sniffers and iron golems on order.
Papier in die Ecken, &6Kunststoff&r oben: Paper in the corners, &6Plastic&r at the top and sides, &6redstone&r in the middle and bottom middle make the &6Machine Settings Copier&r.
Paste plus Staub im Crafting-Feld gibt d: Paste plus dust in the crafting grid gives back the block: amethyst, obsidian, calcite, ice, emerald, lapis and more. With impure chalk it becomes &7Gray Chalk&r, the dark foundation for the Afrit pentacles.
Paste und &6Eisengitter&r: drei Gitter i: Paste and &6iron bars&r: three bars in a column, paste left and right, gives eight vertical &6Dielectric Rods&r. As a row with paste above and below it gives eight horizontal ones.
Paxel gibt es für jedes Material von Mek: Paxels exist for every Mekanism Tools material, also for wood, stone, iron, diamond and netherite.
Pellets brauchst du für SPS-Gehäuse (4): You need pellets for SPS casings (4) and coils (3). The polonium for antimatter stays a gas and runs straight into the SPS. In stage 4 pellets only came through NuclearCraft, see the chapter &dMekanism: Elite&r.
Pergamente füttern ab Stufe 2 die Zauber: From stage 2, parchments feed the spell turrets. Shapeless with a chest, a blank one becomes an &6Allow Item Scroll&r, with cobblestone a &6Deny Item Scroll&r. Both are filters for Starbuncles.
Perlen brauchst du für Enderaugen, Warpp: You need pearls for eyes of ender, warp dust and warp stones, for Draconic Evolution and for the gateway portals of the next sections.
Perlen lassen Endermen fallen, Amethyst: Endermen drop pearls, amethyst grows in the geodes deep down. The dust goes into the Warp Stone and the Warp Plate.
Perlen, Runen und Terrastahl brauchen di: Pearls, runes and Terrasteel need the technology.
Pflanz &6Demon's Dream Seeds&r auf Acker: Plant &6Demon's Dream Seeds&r on farmland like wheat. Ripe, the plant gives &6Demon's Dream Fruit&r and new seeds.
Pflanz die vier Elementsamen und sammle: Plant the four element seeds and collect &e40&r of each essence: Air, Earth, Water, Fire.
Plant a few saplings at home. Chamber, jar, table and pedestals all need archwood.
Pflanzen auf Reichhaltiger Erde wachsen: Plants on Rich Soil grow faster. With a hoe it becomes Rich Soil Farmland.
Pflanzen in ihrer Nähe wachsen mit Mana: Plants near it grow much faster with mana: fields, sugar cane, trees, flowers. Under a Create harvester it saves every bone meal.
Plants and animals, with power use.
Phantomhaut brauchst du für die Gray Pas: You need phantom membrane for the Gray Paste. You summon random animals with 8 ingredients (seeds and crops, feathers and sugar, seagrass and mud) and an egg or snowball instead of a sacrifice.
Pickup and Magnet Upgrade for chests.
Piglins meiden Seelenfeuer, Seelenfackel: Piglins avoid soul fire, soul torches, soul lanterns and soul campfires. Hoglins avoid warped fungi. Put both at your Nether portal and around your outpost, and it stays quieter.
Pilze wachsen in der Pilzkolonie, Kaninc: Mushrooms grow in the mushroom colony, rabbits you find in deserts and snowy areas.
Pinker Schleimball: eine Glasscheibe und: Pink Slime ball: a glass pane and 300 mB of Pink Slime in the Dissolution Chamber.
Pirates, illagers and a sea monster.
Platin steckt im &6Flux Gate&r (Zusammen: Platinum goes into the &6Flux Gate&r (Assembler: Processing Unit, two Fluxite, one platinum ingot) and into Duratium. Flux Gates start the second half of Oritech.
Platinerz liegt zwischen &eY -20&r und &: Platinum ore lies between &eY -20&r and &eY -60&r. Mine &616 Raw Platinum&r and smelt it into ingots.
Platten tragen fast jede Maschine, jedes: Plating carries almost every machine, every addon and the Exo armor. The Assembler makes eight from two steel, one copper and one Plastic Sheet.
Plätze und Upgrade-Plätze auf einen Blic: Slots and upgrade slots at a glance.
Plünderung bringt mehr Beute, Schärfe ma: Looting brings more loot, Sharpness makes it faster. A redstone signal stops it. Empty it with a hopper, full slots throw loot away.
Ports sitzen in der Hülle. Mit dem Konfi: Ports sit in the shell. With the Configurator you switch them to input or output.
Power Grid rechnet mit &dVolt&r, &dAmper: Power Grid calculates with &dvolts&r, &damps&r and &dohms&r. Current only flows in a &eclosed circuit&r: every device has plus and minus, and it needs a way there and back.
Power Grid: Strom im geschlossenen Kreis: Power Grid: power in a closed circuit.
Praktisch beim Erzsuchen: Diamanten lieg: Handy when looking for ore: diamonds lie all the way down, copper veins between Y 0 and 50, iron veins between Y -60 and -8.
Praktisch ist die &6Paxel&r: Spitzhacke,: The &6paxel&r is handy: pickaxe, axe and shovel in one, from the three tools and two ingots.
Praktisch, solange der Warpstein fehlt o: Handy while the Warp Stone is missing or cooling down.
Praktisch, wenn jemand im End verloren g: Handy when someone gets lost in the End or the group gathers before a fight.
Press im Fass zu Blöcken: Press into blocks in the barrel
Press, Polish und Whirl laufen &edoppelt: Press, Polish and Whirl run &etwice as fast&r, Press and Polish process &etwice as many&r items. Random yields from Crush and Whirl are twice as likely. On top of that every glyph in the spell counts as an extra &dFortune&r augment.
Presse über Becken: &6Aschenmehl&r, &6Zu: Press over basin: &6cinder flour&r, &6sugar&r and an &6egg&r make the &6Blaze Cake Base&r. A &6spout&r fills &b250 mB lava&r into it: the &6Blaze Cake&r is done.
Presst Items am Boden wie eine Presse, B: Presses items on the ground like a press, ingots into sheets. With AOE more at once, with Extract compacting instead of pressing, with Smelt heated.
Presses dust with osmium into ingots.
Pro 16 Blöcke Kupferdraht gehen 1,25 Pro: Per 16 blocks of copper wire 1.25 percent are lost. Uninsulated wires under power hurt everyone who touches them.
Pro Byte passen &d1 048 576 FE&r hinein,: &d1,048,576 FE&r fit into one byte, so the 1k cell swallows about a billion FE. The &6Flux Accessor&r is the socket: power in through a cable, power out to machines next to it. The &6Induction Card&r does the same from an interface or a provider.
Pro Chimäre: &e3 Teile&r für die Tafel &: Per Chimera: &e3 parts&r for the &5Summon Wilden&r tablet (plus Vexing log, lapis block) and one &espike&r, &ehorn&r, &ewing&r each as additions.
Pro Durchgang &edrei Iron Nodes&r, der I: Each run gives &ethree Iron Nodes&r, the Impetus loses 2 durability. You smelt nodes into nuggets. Copper, gold, lead, osmium and more have their own Impetus.
Pro Fusion also vier Kerne, zwei Gaia-Ba: So per fusion four cores, two Gaia ingots and one heart: seven injectors of the Wyvern tier.
Pro Präzisionsgetriebe brauchst du im Sc: Per precision mechanism you need over eight tubes on average. Without this line the precision line soon stands still.
Pro Stück zwei Fortgeschrittene Schaltkr: Each needs two Advanced Control Circuits, two Reinforced Alloys, one draconium dust. Make &e16&r.
Sample drill and Ore Vein Atlas.
Probier jeden neuen Ritus mindestens ein: Try every new rite at least once. Sometimes only that opens the next step.
Productive Bees: Waben aus Eisen, Kupfer: Productive Bees: combs of iron, copper and zinc.
Projektil, Brechen. Klick, und der Block: Projectile, Break. Click, and the block is gone.
Trial chambers lie deep in the stone.
Puls-Timer, Pulsierender Verstärker, Pul: Pulse Timer, Pulse Repeater, Pulse Extender.
Pulsierende Legierung, &6Erleuchtetes Qu: Pulsating Alloy, &6Enlightened Fused Quartz&r, Pulsating Alloy at the top, Photovoltaic Plate, &6Powdered Coal&r, Photovoltaic Plate in the middle, &6Double-Layer Capacitor&r, an &6Energetic Photovoltaic Module&r, Double-Layer Capacitor at the bottom.
Pulverisierter Obsidian aufs Depot oder: Powdered Obsidian onto a depot or belt under a &6spout&r. It pours &b500 mB of lava&r on it, out comes an &6Unprocessed Obsidian Sheet&r.
Pulverizer, Gießerei, Zusammenfüger, Las: The Pulverizer, Foundry, Assembler, laser and frame machines need two each. In the Assembler you get two motors from nickel, steel and two coils.
Pump den &2Atommüll&r aus der Abfall-Sch: Pump the &2nuclear waste&r from the waste port into a &6Solar Neutron Activator&r. &e10 mB of nuclear waste&r give &e1 mB of polonium&r. It needs open sky and works by day.
Pylons: eine Hacke im Block, eine Truhe: Pylons: a hoe in a block, a chest above it.
Quarz ist der Anfang der Elektronik von: Quartz is the start of Create's electronics, plus comparators, observers and quartz blocks.
Quarz mit Redstone, poliert, auf Eisenbl: Quartz with redstone, polished, on an iron sheet.
Quarz und Schwarzstein kommen aus dem Ne: Quartz and blackstone come from the Nether, hence stage 2.
Quelle fließt, der Apparat steht, der Se: Source flows, the apparatus stands, the server waits.
Quelle über 30 Blöcke, ohne Gläser zu sc: Source over 30 blocks, without carrying jars.
Quellen liefern SU, Maschinen verbrauche: Sources give SU, machines use them.
Quelllinks füllen Gläser, Kammern machen: Sourcelinks fill jars, chambers make gems, a Starbuncle collects them. &6Stage 2&r opens the &6Mage's Spell Book&r, the relays, the ritual brazier and the spell turrets. Continue in the &dArs Nouveau: Mage&r chapter.
Questbuch, EMI, Karte, Claims, Regeln un: Quest book, EMI, map, claims, rules and keys. For everyone who has never played a modpack.
Questbuch, EMI, Karte, Team, Sprachchat,: Quest book, EMI, map, team, voice chat, death.
R for the recipe, U for its uses.
Radius bis &e32 Blöcke&r, Y-Bereich und: Set the radius up to &e32 blocks&r, the Y range and filters (an ore tag, for example), start. &e80 ticks&r per block without upgrades, &d400 FE/t&r. Silk Touch costs twelve times as much power.
Raffiniertes Obsidian in die Ecken, Ulti: Refined Obsidian in the corners, Ultimate Control Circuits at the top and bottom, Atomic Alloy left and right, a diamond block in the middle.
Raffiniertes Obsidian ist das stärkste M: Refined Obsidian is the strongest material of Mekanism Tools and goes into the Teleporter Frame and the Robit.
Rahmen aus Steinziegeln, Katalysator dra: A stone brick frame, Catalyst on it.
Rahmen: &68 Lebeholz&r und &63 Schimmern: Frame: &68 Livingwood&r and &63 Glimmering Livingwood&r, the core in the bottom middle. Plus &62 Mana Pools&r with a &aNatura Pylon&r on each, within 5 blocks.
Space chambers and the space card.
Raus aus den violetten Wolken aus Drache: Get out of the purple clouds of dragon's breath. Its head butt throws you far, in the worst case over the edge. Beds explode here as in the Nether, only with distance and agreement.
Expect traps, puzzles and enemies. Go slowly and watch the floor.
Rechne vorher nach. Ein Laufwerk voller: Do the math first. A drive full of 16M cells already carries a lot.
Rechnung und Mischung mit Energie-Upgrad: The maths and the mix with Energy Upgrades: &5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r chapter.
Rechte Maustaste auf einem Baum gedrückt: Holding right click on a tree fells it completely. The module reaches &e16 blocks&r and manages &e5 blocks per second&r. It takes leaves along if you set it to.
Rechte Maustaste halten, und der Laser b: Hold the right mouse button and the laser mines what you aim at. It holds &d1,000,000 FE&r, one block costs about 200 FE. It recharges, for example, in the charging slot of a Mekanism Energy Cube. Sneak and right click opens size, range and mode.
Rechts findest du eine Checkliste der Ba: On the right you find a checklist of the structures in the pack, mod by mod. There are chests almost everywhere; some places are harmless, others guarded.
Rechts stehen alle Addon-Sorten, eine pr: On the right are all kinds of addons, one per quest. Each is a checkmark of its own.
Rechtsklick auf den Robit öffnet sein Fe: A right click on the Robit opens its window. The tabs: &6Inventory&r, &6Crafting&r, &6Smelting&r (a furnace) and &6Repair&r (an anvil).
Rechtsklick auf den reifen &6Mugwort&r g: Right click on the ripe &6Mugwort&r gives &6Mugwort Leaves&r and &6Mugwort Flowers&r.
Rechtsklick auf den reifen &6Yellow Dock: Right click on the ripe &6Yellow Dock&r gives &6Yellow Dock Leaves&r and &6Yellow Dock Flowers&r.
Rechtsklick auf die Verbindung zu einer: Right click the connection to a chest to turn on extraction: &e8 items every 5 ticks&r from the first filled slot. A &6Motor&r, set into the pipe with a right click, pulls from all slots.
Rechtsklick auf die reife &6Belladonna&r: Right click on the ripe &6Belladonna&r gives &6Belladonna Berries&r and &6Belladonna Flowers&r.
Rechtsklick auf die reife &6Mandrake&r g: Right click on the ripe &6Mandrake&r gives &6Mandrake Root&r and &6Mandrake Flowers&r.
Rechtsklick auf ein Tier steckt es hinei: Right click an animal to put it inside, right click the ground to let it out. That is how you get cows into the barn, and the Mob Duplicator needs a captured mob as a template.
Rechtsklick auf ein Wesen fängt es, noch: Right click on a creature catches it, another right click releases it. Bosses don't fit in. That way you bring animals, villagers or spirits to their destination without a lead.
Rechtsklick auf ein leeres Feld öffnet e: Right-click an empty field to open a grid where you set the recipe. Right-click a filled field to craft it from the ingredients in your inventory, sneaking for up to a whole stack.
Rechtsklick auf eine &6Belohnungstafel&r: Right click a &6Bounty Board&r, take a bounty, collect what is asked for and click the board again with it.
Rechtsklick auf eine Verbindung zur Masc: Right click a connection to a machine to open it: insert, extract, channel, priority, round robin and a filter slot for each direction.
Rechtsklick auf eine platzierte Vanilla-: Right clicking a placed vanilla chest or vanilla barrel turns it into the Sophisticated version, everything stays inside. After that it goes on to copper and iron.
Rechtsklick auf einen &6Steingeborenen&r: Right click a &6Stoneborn&r to open trading. You pay with &6Regalium Crystals&r.
Rechtsklick auf einen &6Wegstein&r aktiv: Right click a &6Waystone&r to activate it. From any waystone you travel to all the ones you have already activated.
Rechtsklick auf einen Block legt die Sor: Right click a block to set the kind, sneak right click into the air to turn it on. Then it sucks those blocks out of your inventory. Right click places them again.
Rechtsklick auf einen Block zeichnet ein: Right click on a block draws a sign. For rituals only &ecolour&r and &eposition&r count, not the symbol. Every chalk wears out.
Rechtsklick auf einen Mob steckt ihn hin: Right click a mob to put it inside, right click the ground to let it out. Players and bosses do not work.
Rechtsklick auf einen Speicher zeigt den: Right click on a storage shows how full it is. Clicked on two connectors while sneaking, it shows the loss on the stretch between them.
Rechtsklick bindet ihn an dich. Gib ihn: Right click binds it to you. Give it to a fellow player: with a right click they land next to you, as long as you are online. The number of jumps is limited.
Rechtsklick bringt dich sofort zum Spawn: Right click takes you straight to the world's spawn point if you are at least &e24 blocks&r away from it. The seed is used up.
Rechtsklick holt das Ergebnis heraus, ei: Right-click takes the result out; an Andesite Funnel on the side pulls it off. Ores are only crushed by the Crushing Wheels from stage 2.
Rechtsklick legt das Item in deiner Hand: Right-click puts the item in your hand into it. Sneak and right-click puts in everything that is not in your hotbar.
Rechtsklick legt ein Item ab, leere Hand: Right click puts an item down, an empty hand takes it back. The apparatus needs up to &e8&r of them, the chamber &e3&r for essences.
Rechtsklick legt ein Item hinein, schlei: Right click puts an item in, sneaking a stack. Once all ingredients of a recipe are in, it grinds them by itself and you can take nothing out any more. Five Belladonna Berries become four black dye that way.
Rechtsklick lässt dich bluten, schon has: Right click makes you bleed, and you have the damage for the circle. The dagger also cuts the spell cloth.
Rechtsklick mit &6Redstone&r, einem &6He: Right click a placed &6ME P2P Tunnel&r with &6redstone&r, a &6lever&r or a &6redstone torch&r, and it turns into this type. Breaking it gives you the tunnel as an item of its own.
Rechtsklick mit &eFarbstoff&r auf einen: Right clicking a brown or red &6mushroom&r with a &edye&r turns it into a &6Shimmering Mushroom&r of that colour. It counts as a petal of the same colour in every recipe.
Rechtsklick mit Amethyst legt ihn hinein: Right click with amethyst puts it inside. The chamber gathers Source very slowly on its own, or quickly from a &6Source Jar&r no more than &e2 blocks&r away.
Rechtsklick mit Juwelen auf den &eObelis: Right click the &eobelisk&r at spawn with gems; sneaking hands in everything that fits.
Rechtsklick mit dem &6Target Designator&: Right click a block with the &6Target Designator&r to store it, &eShift&r right click the laser to give it the direction. It fires up to &e128 blocks&r and mines everything in that direction, it passes through glass.
Rechtsklick mit dem &aStab des Waldes&r: Right click the core with the &aWand of the Forest&r. Opening costs &d200,000 mana&r from the pools with pylons.
Rechtsklick mit dem Band auf eine volle: Right click a full chest with the tape, then mine it. It drops as one item with its contents. One roll holds several uses; the tooltip shows what is left.
Rechtsklick mit dem Stab auf den gefüllt: Right clicking the filled altar with the wand starts the infusion. The pedestals send their items into the altar one after another, and at the end the seed lies in it. A button or lever on the altar does the same, but the wand is handier.
Rechtsklick mit dem Startitem (meist ein: Right click with the activation item (usually a bound book of binding) starts the ritual. A hopper can also put the activation item in. A sacrificial bowl upside down up to three blocks above catches the result.
Rechtsklick mit dem Upgrade auf die Schu: Right clicking the drawer with the upgrade installs it. It pulls &e4 items every 4 ticks&r from the block on one side. You choose the side in the menu (right click the frame) by right clicking the upgrade.
Rechtsklick mit dem Upgrade auf ein Band: Right click a belt with the upgrade to install it. Extraction pulls items and fluids from the inventory next to it, even from player inventories. Insertion pushes them in. In the window you filter what may pass.
Rechtsklick mit der &bOrb of Prophecy&r: Right click the frame of Chiseled Voidstone with the &bOrb of Prophecy&r. Walk through.
Rechtsklick mit einem &6Chemikalientank&: Right click a placed &6ME P2P Tunnel&r with a &6Chemical Tank&r from Mekanism, and it turns into this type. Breaking it gives you the tunnel as an item of its own.
Rechtsklick mit einem &6Eimer&r auf eine: Right click a placed &6ME P2P Tunnel&r with a &6bucket&r, and it turns into this type. Breaking it gives you the tunnel as an item of its own.
Rechtsklick mit einer &6Energiezelle&r o: Right click a placed &6ME P2P Tunnel&r with an &6Energy Cell&r or an &6Energy Acceptor&r, and it turns into this type. Breaking it gives you the tunnel as an item of its own.
Rechtsklick mit einer &6Fackel&r oder &6: Right click a placed &6ME P2P Tunnel&r with a &6torch&r or &6glowstone&r, and it turns into this type. Breaking it gives you the tunnel as an item of its own.
Rechtsklick mit einer &6Photoelectric Pa: A right click with a &6Photoelectric Pane&r on an &5enderman&r or an endermite turns it into the &6Lens Of Ender&r. A right click with a &6Binding Card&r makes the &6Binding Card (Dimensional)&r.
Rechtsklick mit einer &6Truhe&r, einem &: Right click a placed &6ME P2P Tunnel&r with a &6chest&r, a &6hopper&r or a bus, and it turns into this type. Breaking it gives you the tunnel as an item of its own.
Rechtsklick mit leerer Hand holt das zul: Right click with an empty hand takes back the last thing thrown in. Lexica and EMI show which flower needs which petals.
Rechtsklick schaltet eine Barriere an un: Right click turns a boundary on and off, a redstone signal flips the state.
Rechtsklick speichert all deine Erfahrun: Right click stores all your experience, sneaking right click gives it back. With very large amounts a small rest is lost to rounding. This way you can also pass experience on to other players.
Rechtsklick wechselt den Befehl: Folgen,: Right click changes the command: follow, sit, wander, help. When helping, the crow gathers items into a Coffer or Herb Jar, harvests fields or steals something from villagers (every 90 seconds).
Rechtsklick öffnet deine Endertruhe, wo: Right click opens your ender chest wherever you are. Sneaking right click binds the satchel to you: whoever uses it then opens your ender chest. This way you send items to other players over any distance.
Rechtsklick öffnet die Einstellung: Reds: Right click opens the settings: redstone at the addon turns the machine off, a comparator reads power, inventory or progress. The laser handles redstone by itself already.
Rechtsklick öffnet die Liste aller Biome: Right click opens the list of all biomes. Pick one, and it shows direction, distance and coordinates of the nearest. It doesn't wear out.
Rechtsklicke die Zugsteuerung. &eW&r und: Right click the Train Controls. &eW&r and &eS&r drive, at junctions &eA&r and &eD&r choose the direction, the mouse wheel limits the speed.
Rechtsklicke ein &6Andesitgehäuse&r mit: Right click an &6andesite casing&r with a &6zinc ingot&r, or let a deployer do it. It becomes a &6conductive casing&r.
Rechtsklicke eine &6Lohe&r mit dem leere: Right click a &6blaze&r with the empty burner in hand, right at the spawner in the fortress too. You are holding a &6Blaze Burner&r.
Rechtsklicke einen gesetzten &6Messingra: Right click a placed &6brass casing&r with a &6Sturdy Sheet&r. It becomes a &6Railway Casing&r. A deployer does that at the belt too.
Rechtsklicke einen gesetzten, entrindete: Right-click a placed stripped log with a &6copper ingot&r: it becomes &6Copper Casing&r. It goes into the spout, the drain and the hose pulley.
Right click a placed stripped log with a &6brass ingot&r: it becomes a &6Brass Casing&r.
Redstone hält sie an. Rechtsklick mit de: Redstone stops it. Right click with the wand changes the speed, a sneaking right click the direction.
Redstone in die Ecken, Eisen oben, links: Redstone in the corners, iron on top, left and right, a &6furnace&r at the bottom, the upgrade base in the middle.
Redstone in die Ecken, eine &6Enderperle: Redstone in the corners, an &6ender pearl&r at the top, &6gold&r left and right (&6lapis&r for fluids, hoppers instead of gold and dispensers instead of pistons for the World Transporter), a &6piston&r at the bottom, the Pity Frame in the middle. That gives two.
Redstone, Gold und &6Infundierte Legieru: Redstone, gold and &6Infused Alloy&r make an &6Energy Tablet&r. It charges in any energy slot.
Redstone, Schaltkreise, Schüsseln und ei: Redstone, circuits, bowls and a Steel Casing. It turns any food into &6Nutritional Paste&r, &e50 mB&r per hunger point.
Redstone when someone looks at you.
Redstone when a burst flies past.
Redstone-Signal der Schale: &e1&r wartet: Redstone signal of the bowl: &e1&r waits for a sacrifice, &e2&r waits for a used item, &e8&r running.
Reformier es mit einem &6Diamond Sulfur&: Reform it with a &6Diamond Sulfur&r on the target into Diamond Sulfur, the Incubator makes a diamond from it. With an Emerald Sulfur on the target it becomes an emerald.
Reformier es mit einem Gold Sulfur auf d: Reform it with a Gold Sulfur on the target into &6Gold Sulfur&r, the Incubator makes gold from it. Going down works without gold, one becomes four.
Regalium ist kein Werkzeugmetall. Es ist: Regalium is not a tool metal. It is the currency of the Stoneborn, 9 crystals make a block.
Reichhaltige Erde wächst 10 Prozent schn: Rich soil grows 10 percent faster than dirt, a tool with &6Efficiency&r in the tool slot another 5 percent per level. Tomatoes, cabbage, onions and rice from Farmer's Delight work the same way.
Reicht dein Mana, wird jeder Pfeil zum Z: If your mana suffices, every arrow becomes a spell arrow with the inscribed spell. In the chamber you make &6augment arrows&r (Amplify, Pierce, Split) for more effect.
Into the core, out of the core.
Onto the belt, out of the chest.
Into the network, out of the network.
Rein mit Brennstoff und Wasser, raus mit: In with fuel and water, out with steam and waste.
Reines Gänseblümchen, erzeugende Blumen,: Pure Daisy, generating flowers, Mana Spreaders, Mana Pools. In stage 1 up to the pool, enough for the Mana Diamonds in the Source Keystone.
Reisen mit Schriftrollen kosten auf Kron: Travelling with scrolls costs no levels on Kronwerke. One belongs in every bag that goes into a cave.
Relais tragen Quelle, Rituale ernten und: Relays carry Source, rituals harvest and protect, turrets fire, a motor drives Create. &6Stage 3&r brings the Archmage's Spell Book, flight, Awakening and the robes. Continue in the &dArs Nouveau: Master&r chapter.
Repair with arcana instead of experience.
Repariert dich und verbessert die andere: Repairs you and improves the others.
Repariert wird mit einem &6Reparaturkit&: Repairs are done with a &6Repair Kit&r. The anvil with the head material works too, but costs levels and is only half as effective.
Rezept, Filter und Upgrades: Kapitel &dM: Recipe, filters and upgrades: chapter &dMekanism: Advanced&r. It knows no Fortune, so feed the ore back into the ore ladder.
Rezepte an der Wand, ein Klick pro Stape: Recipes on the wall, one click per stack.
Rezepte mit &cErhitzt&r oder &cÜberhitzt: Recipes marked &cHeated&r or &cSuperheated&r in EMI need a &6Blaze Burner&r under the basin. It comes in stage 2, and brass with it.
Rezepte, die nicht auf die Werkbank pass: Recipes that do not fit on the crafting table.
Serious power from water and heat.
Rinde ist die Hauptzutat für Organischen: Bark is the main ingredient of Organic Compost.
Ring plus &e1 Terrastahlbarren&r an der: Ring plus &e1 Terrasteel ingot&r at the crafting table:
Rissige, bemooste und gemeißelte Steinzi: Cracked, mossy and chiseled stone bricks work too, as do deepslate bricks and deepslate tiles.
Rite of the Howling Gale und Flowing Gra: Rite of the Howling Gale and Flowing Grasp.
Rite of the Stone Ward und Burning Fervo: Rite of the Stone Ward and Burning Fervor.
Ritual &6Beschwöre Wilden&r am Kohlenbec: The ritual &6Summon Wilden&r at the brazier on an open field, defeat the &5Wilden Chimera&r, pick up the &5Wilden Tribute&r.
Ritual des Waldes mit einem &6Eichensetz: Ritual of the Forest with an &6oak sapling&r: 3 &6Livingrock&r (from Botania's Pure Daisy), a Gold Leaf, a gold ingot and a Token of Joy. Out comes the &6Natural Altar&r.
Start the ritual outside on an open field. &cWhen it appears the Chimera destroys the blocks around the brazier&r, and so does its dive on this server.
Ritual: Item auf die Brazier, weitere Zu: Ritual: item on the brazier, further ingredients on Stone Hands around it, light it with &6flint and steel&r. An empty hand puts it out and ends the ritual.
Rituale, Türme und Roben ohne Erzmagier-: Rituals, turrets and robes without the archmage book.
Robe auf den Ständer, Faden auf die Tafe: Robe on the stand, thread on the table, take the robe off. The same threads on two pieces do nothing.
Robit in der Mitte, Stahlblöcke drumheru: Robit in the middle, steel blocks around it.
Robuste Bleche stecken in jedem Zugrahme: Sturdy Sheets are in every Railway Casing and in the schedules.
Roherz vervielfachst du am besten in Mek: You multiply raw ore best in Mekanism instead of just smelting it. How is in the Mekanism chapters.
Rohes &6Rindfleisch&r, eine &6Karotte&r: Raw &6beef&r, a &6carrot&r and a &6potato&r into the pot, plus a bowl.
Raw ore becomes an ore block again.
Rohes Uran und Lithiumstaub von Mekanism: Raw uranium and lithium dust from Mekanism work too. Grind raw ore in the Manufactory, one ore gives two dust. You need lead in large amounts.
Rohkupfer gibt gewaschen Ton dazu, Rohei: Raw copper gives clay on top when washed, raw iron redstone. Ore blocks mined with Silk Touch give 1.75 crushed ores.
Rohmaterial, Metall, Silizium, Redstone,: Binding, metal, silicon, redstone, then into the furnace.
Rohre allein bewegen nichts, dafür brauc: Pipes alone move nothing; for that you need a pump. An open end in water pulls it from the world. A &6Fluid Valve&r (pipe and Iron Sheet) closes the line.
Rohre und Schläuche docken an die Ventil: Pipes and tubes dock onto the valves. It holds one fluid or one gas, according to the server config &e350,000 mB of fluid&r per block of volume.
Rohstoff für Graphit und Stahl im Lichtb: Raw material for graphite and steel in the Arc Furnace.
Raw material for tallow and candles.
Scrolls that are not used up.
Rosenquarz aufs Band, ein &6Einsatzgerät: Rose quartz on the belt, a &6deployer&r with sandpaper polishes it, two &6crafters&r on top of each other put it on an iron sheet.
Rotation, Förderbänder und die ersten Ma: Rotation, belts and the first machines of the Stone Works.
Rotoren erzeugen Strom, wenn sie sich im: Rotors make power when they turn in a magnetic field. Up to &e8&r rotor parts per generator, each costs &d32 SU per RPM&r.
Rucksack in der Hand, &eSchleich-Rechtsk: Backpack in hand, &esneaking right click&r on a chest, and whatever is in the filter moves into the backpack. Before building: pack torches, slabs and building blocks with one click.
Rucksack in die Hand, &eSchleich-Rechtsk: Backpack in hand, &esneaking right click&r on a chest, barrel or drawer, and the matching items move in. In the filter you set that only items already there are deposited.
Rucksäcke, Schubladen, Truhen und Tresor: Backpacks, drawers, chests and vaults for the first week.
Rucksäcke: Leder 27 und 1, Kupfer 45 und: Backpacks: leather 27 and 1, copper 45 and 1, iron 54 and 2 (stage 2), gold 81 and 3, diamond 108 and 5 (stage 3), netherite 120 and 7 (stage 4).
Ruf den &5Enderdrachen&r zurück: vier &6: Summon the &5Ender Dragon&r again: four &6End Crystals&r on the rims of the exit portal. When it dies, a &cDragon Heart&r floats above the portal. It does not disappear.
Summon it, beat it, take its essence.
Ruft einen Blitz. Getroffene bekommen &e: Calls a lightning bolt. Those hit get &eShocked&r, which grows up to level III and strengthens further lightning damage. Wet enemies are hit harder. &eProjectile, Lightning, Amplify&r is simple and strong.
Ruinen gibt es in Ebenen, Savannen, Wäld: Ruins appear in plains, savannas, forests, deserts, the jungle and cold biomes.
About 640 spirits, that is many evenings.
Rund elf Staub pro Pellet. Der Irradiato: About eleven dust per pellet. The Irradiator needs a running fission reactor, see the chapter &aNuclearCraft&r. Mekanism's own path through nuclear waste only comes in stage 5.
Rund um die Segel darf nichts im Weg ste: Nothing may be in the way around the sails. You set the direction in the bearing's value box.
Runewood Logs senkrecht auf die Basis. R: Runewood Logs stacked upright on the base. Right click with an arcana carves a rune: one &dArcane&r and two &eSacred&r. Right click the base to start.
Runewood erkennst du an den orange-gelbe: You recognize Runewood by its orange and yellow leaves, mostly on large plains. Plant saplings at home.
Ruten für weitere Lohenbrenner und Braus: Rods for more Blaze Burners and brewing stands, quartz for electron tubes, glowstone for light and the Aether portal.
Incense for the altar and combat.
Rüste ihn mit drakonischen Projektil-Mod: Equip it with Draconic projectile modules. The Draconic Projectile Damage Module: six Awakened Draconium nuggets, two Wyvern Projectile Damage Modules and a Wyvern Core in the middle.
Rüstung und Werkzeug aus Starlit Diamond: Starlit Diamond armor and tools are the next step after Deepsilver.
Tell the laser what you want.
Sage Seeds findest du wie Weizensamen be: You find Sage Seeds like wheat seeds when breaking grass.
Sagt im Sprachkanal an, welcher Kristall: Call out in voice which crystal is open. As long as one stands, you cannot get at the Guardian's shield.
Sal Ammoniac Crystal, Gold, ein Sulfur u: Sal Ammoniac Crystal, gold, a Sulfur and stone, see EMI. Click every pedestal with it and then place it on a Mercury Catalyst.
Seeds and leftovers become bone meal.
Sammelt Items in der Umgebung in ein ang: Collects items nearby into an adjacent inventory. Mana is optional and increases the range. A frame with an item on a chest filters, labelled chests take priority.
Sammelt alle Items am Zielort ein. Setz: Collects all items at the target. Put it &ebehind&r the effect: &eProjectile, Break, Pickup&r. With AOE (tier 2) the radius gets bigger.
Picks everything up from the ground.
Sammle &664 Elementiumbarren&r aus einer: Collect &664 Elementium Ingots&r from an automatic line: Manasteel comes from the pool, gets pressed into blocks, blocks fly into the portal, a Hopperhock collects the Elementium.
Sammle &664 Zinkbarren&r und &6128 Kupfe: Collect &664 zinc ingots&r and &6128 copper ingots&r. Every brass ingot costs two copper and one zinc.
Sammle &68 Golem Steel Ingots&r und &632: Collect &68 Golem Steel Ingots&r and &632 Deepsilver Ingots&r. Golem, Permafrost and Monstrosity are defeated.
Sammle &e1 024 Stahlbarren&r und &e32 Sc: Collect &e1,024 steel ingots&r and &e32 Heavy Engineering Blocks&r.
Collect &e16 slag&r from the blast furnace.
Sammle &e24 Gaia-Seelen&r. Fast alles hi: Collect &e24 Gaia Spirits&r. Almost everything here costs one or more.
Sammle &e64 Gaia-Seelen&r für den Obelis: Collect &e64 Gaia Spirits&r for the obelisk. The goal wants &e128&r (a fixed number) and &e30 Mystic Staffs&r from Mahou Tsukai.
Sammle &e64 Stahlbarren&r. Roh-Hochofen,: Collect &e64 steel ingots&r. Crude Blast Furnace, Improved Blast Furnace or Mekanism, everything counts.
Sammle &e9 Magmablöcke&r an Lavaseen ode: Collect &e9 magma blocks&r at lava lakes or in the basalt deltas and &e4 magma cream&r from the bouncing &6magma cubes&r.
Sammle Stahl und Schaltkreise in Kisten: Collect steel and circuits in chests and hand them in by hand at the obelisk, sneak and right click takes everything that fits. &e/kw goals&r shows the state.
Sammle beim Graben &6Blei&r, &6Uran&r, &: While digging, collect &6lead&r, &6uranium&r, &6fluorite&r and &6salt blocks&r (in clay under water) in a chest of their own. For the tick: eight lead ingots.
Sammle die Zutaten für das &aRitual des: Collect the ingredients for the &aRitual of the Forest&r: &e4 Infused Iron&r, &e2 Livingwood Twigs&r, &e1 Mana Diamond&r, &e1 Gold Leaf&r.
Sammle je einen &6Indigopilz&r und einen: Collect one &6Indigo Mushroom&r and one &6Blood Mushroom&r each from the bogs.
Sammle schon beim ersten Kampf, danach m: Collect during the first fight already, after that you have to summon the dragon again.
Sand gibt beim Waschen Ton, roter Sand G: Washing sand gives clay, red sand gold nuggets, flour turns into dough.
Sauerstoff aus Wasser, Essen aus der Pas: Oxygen from water, food from paste.
Saugt Erfahrung von Spielern direkt dane: Drains experience from players right next to it, eats experience orbs and pulls the enchantments out of enchanted items on the ground. &d50 mana per experience point&r.
Damage at the push of a button.
Schaltkreise oben links und rechts, daru: Circuits top left and right, two &6Infused Alloys&r below them, two &6Energy Tablets&r at the bottom, the middle stays empty.
Treasure loot for mana, with guards.
Schau dir einen Ort erst von außen an, b: Look at a place from the outside first before you storm in, and tick this off.
Schaufel &e16 Seelensand&r im &6Seelensa: Shovel &e16 soul sand&r in the &6soul sand valley&r. Nether wart grows on soul sand, and it belongs under the Wither.
Schaufel, Axt, Hacke, Schwert und Bogen: Shovel, axe, hoe, sword and bow work the same from their Wyvern counterpart. Take the modules out first if you want to keep them.
Schaust du beim Benutzen ein Wesen an, k: If you look at a creature while using it, it comes along. Then only one comes back: one has to die. Alone, taking damage is enough to return.
Schick die &eDatei&r in den Discord, nic: Send the &efile&r to the Discord, not a screenshot of it. Add two sentences: what were you doing, and does it keep happening? Most crashes are sorted out within minutes that way.
Schieß jeden &dEndkristall&r auf den Obs: Shoot every &dEnd Crystal&r on the obsidian pillars with the bow. As long as one stands, the dragon heals from it.
Shoots mana from A to B.
Schild herunterschießen, dann die letzte: Shoot the shield down, then the last &e1,000&r health. Whoever dies comes back by Dislocator. Stay together until it falls.
Shield, flight and a second life.
Schilder für Shops, Wappen für die Basis: Signs for shops, a coat of arms for the base, a portrait of the crow: all painted by yourself.
Schlag &6Leuchtstein&r von der Decke, bi: Knock &6glowstone&r from the ceiling until you have &e32 glowstone dust&r. Without Silk Touch each block gives 2 to 4 dust.
Schlagen hebt sie samt Inhalt auf. Ist d: Hitting it picks it up with its contents. If the crow button in the menu is on, gathering crows bring everything to it that already lies in the Coffer. Dyeing and renaming work as with leather armour.
Schleich-Rechtsklick auf einen Block wäh: Sneak right click a block to choose it, sneak right click into the air for the amount. Right click builds the preview with mana and blocks from your inventory, also from the Black Hole Talisman.
Schleich-Rechtsklick in die Luft wechsel: A sneaking right click into the air switches the mode. &eBind mode:&r sneak click a spreader, then the target. &eFunction mode:&r a sneak click turns a spreader towards the clicked side.
Sneak and right click the obelisk.
Schleichen und Rechtsklick mit leerer Ha: Sneak and right-click with an empty hand switches between sending and receiving. That way you switch a clutch at the other end of the base.
