Schleichen und Rechtsklick speichert Ort: Sneak and right click stores place, view direction and dimension. After that a right click takes you back there. It only has a limited number of charges.
Schleichend Rechtsklick setzt ihn oben a: Sneaking right click puts it on top of the cauldron. It has three places for one item each and dips it into the fluid below until the recipe is done.
Schleichend Rechtsklick wechselt zwische: Sneaking right click switches between swamp and jungle, right click looks for a new target. Healthy leaves on the rod mean: right direction. Wilted ones mean: wrong.
Schleichend Rechtsklick öffnet die Tromm: Sneak and right click opens the drum. Shots are loud and attract monsters.
Schleichend auf den Storage Actuator kli: Click the Storage Actuator while sneaking to link the wormhole, then place it anywhere in the base. It opens the same storage as the Actuator. With Otherrock instead of Otherstone you get the dark variant.
Sneaking click on the Storage Actuator links it. After that you open your storage from anywhere, even from another dimension.
Schleichend auf einen Block klicken stel: Clicking a block while sneaking sets it: andesite looks for Otherstone, oak wood for Otherworld Logs, oak leaves for Otherworld leaves, netherrack for Iesnium. Then hold right click until the animation is done.
Schleichend auf einen Block klicken stim: Clicking a block while sneaking attunes it. Holding right click searches, a short right click shows the last find without using durability. Finds iron and coal.
Schleichend benutzen speichert den Ort,: Using it while sneaking saves the location, using it normally takes you there and uses up the scroll. Not across dimensions.
Schleichend mit Rechtsklick wechselst du: Sneaking and right clicking changes the fire mode: one big explosion (&d5,000 mana&r, thunderstorm afterwards), many small ones (&d600&r per volley), beam (&d500 per tick&r, destroys blocks).
Schleichend mit Rechtsklick öffnest du e: Sneaking and right clicking opens it, the key &eChange Mystic Code&r jumps between the scrolls, right click uses the chosen one.
Schleichend mit dem Buch auf eine Truhe: Clicking a chest with the book while sneaking sets where it takes from, the target the same way. It also delivers into spirits, for example ore straight into the Crusher.
Schleichend mit dem Zauberstab gebunden: Bound with the wand while sneaking, it reverses: then it gives a signal as long as there is less in the chest.
Schleusen füllen die Einsatzgeräte nach,: Funnels refill the deployers, the scrap runs back, the mechanisms go into a chest.
Schlitz'und'Spleiß, Seelenbinder, Seelen: Slice'N'Splice, Soul Binder, Soul Engine and XP Obelisk need one each.
Schlägst du auf einen Block, nimmt es da: When you hit a block, it takes the matching tool from the backpack into your hand: pickaxe, axe, shovel, sword. Works with Silent Gear too.
Smelting in a tenth of the time.
Schmiede &6Helm&r, &6Harnisch&r, &6Beins: Forge &6helmet&r, &6chestplate&r, &6leggings&r and &6boots&r from Deepsilver Ingots, like iron. It makes you immune to certain harmful effects, the tooltip shows which and whether the full set is needed.
Schmiede alle vier Teile aus &6Glacite S: Forge all four pieces from &6Glacite Shards&r, like iron. Worn, it freezes enemies that damage you.
Schmiede alle vier Teile aus &6Thermal S: Forge all four pieces from &6Thermal Springstone Ingots&r, like iron. Worn, it sets enemies that damage you on fire.
Schmiedetisch: &6Flowglaze Upgrade Smith: Smithing table: &6Flowglaze Upgrade Smithing Template&r, &6Glacite Scythe&r, &6Flowglaze&r. Out comes the &6Flowglaze Scythe&r.
Smithing table: &6Flowglaze Upgrade Smithing Template&r, &6Glacite Shield&r and &6Flowglaze&r make the &6Flowglaze Shield&r.
Schmiedetisch: &6Schmiedevorlage&r, &6Cl: Smithing table: &6Smithing Template&r, &6Cloggrum Pickaxe&r, &6Forgotten Ingot&r. Out comes the &6Forgotten Pickaxe&r.
Schmiedetisch: &6Starfire Upgrade Smithi: Smithing table: &6Starfire Upgrade Smithing Template&r, &6Thermal Springstone Scythe&r, &6Starfire&r. Out comes the &6Starfire Scythe&r.
Schmilzt Blöcke und Items in der Welt. &: Smelts blocks and items in the world. &eProjectile, Break, Smelt, Pickup&r delivers ingots right away. With AOE more at once, with Amplify harder blocks.
Schmuck mit den Eigenschaften des Metall: Jewellery with the traits of the metal.
Schnell gemacht und ein Snack für unterw: Made quickly and a snack for the road.
Schnell, leicht, und es schnitzt Vorlage: Fast, light, and it carves Template Boards on the stone anvil. Unlike the crude knife, it can be repaired.
Schneller als Weide, langsamer als Mahag: Faster than willow, slower than mahogany, and without netherite.
Schneller geht es mit TNT: Netherrack fl: It goes faster with TNT: netherrack flies away, the debris stays. Keep your distance and secure against lava.
Schneller graben, ganze Adern auf einmal: Dig faster, whole veins at once.
Faster, or more efficient, or both.
Faster, more efficient, more per operation.
Faster, above all at full moon.
Schreckdorn und Vitalic-Quelllink arbeit: Dreadthorne and Vitalic Sourcelink work together.
Schreib am Tisch einen Zauber &eohne For: Inscribe a spell &ewithout a form&r at the table, for example &eHeal, Amplify&r. The horn casts it on you and every creature nearby. The longer you hold it, the bigger the range, fully charged it also gives you spell damage.
Schreiter laufen auf Lava herum, oft in: Striders wander around on lava, often in groups. You find saddles in fortresses and bastions.
Schriftrollen, gewöhnliche Tinte und der: Scrolls, common ink and the first spellcaster. A second magic next to Ars Nouveau that already gets going in stage 1.
Schwefelsäure und die Kammer kennst du a: You know sulfuric acid and the chamber from the 5x line in the chapter &5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r. Fluorite comes as ore deep down.
Pork and leather in the Nether.
Heavier and stronger than a sword.
Sword, axe and sickle in one.
Schwächt das Glied links davon. Gedämpft: Weakens the link to its left. Dampened Magelight is weaker, dampened Smelt cooks food instead of ore, with Burst the sphere becomes hollow.
Schön, aber nicht nötig. Wer Blöcke für: Nice, but not needed. Whoever wants to save blocks for the obelisk leaves it out.
Schützt wenig, aber mit allen vier Teile: Protects little, but with all four pieces Botania's tools and rods cost much less mana and the rods get stronger. It repairs itself with mana from your inventory as soon as you carry a Mana Tablet from stage 2.
Sechs &6Eisenbleche&r ergeben acht &6Flü: Six &6Iron Plates&r make eight &6Fluid Pipes&r. An Iron Plate on top, plate, &6Iron Mechanical Component&r, plate in the middle and three pipes at the bottom make the &6Fluid Pump&r.
Sechs &6Kunststoff&r, zwei &6Eisen&r und: Six &6Plastic&r, two &6iron&r and one &6redstone&r make six &6Conveyor Belts&r.
Sechs &6Robustes Gewebe&r ergeben ein &6: Six &6Tough Fabric&r make a &6Windmill Sail&r. Right click with the sail on the Windmill puts it on a blade.
Sechs &6Stahlblöcke&r an die Seiten, obe: Six &6steel blocks&r on the sides, a &6Wind Generator&r in the top middle, a &6Robit&r in the middle, an &6Ultimate Induction Cell&r at the bottom.
Sechs &6getrockneter Seetang&r ergeben e: Six &6dried kelp&r make a &6Belt Connector&r. Click two parallel shafts with it one after the other, up to &e20 blocks&r apart, level or at a 45 degree angle.
Sechs Bretter und Sägemehl aus jedem Sta: Six planks and sawdust from every log, without power.
Six dimensions open with the stages.
Six rings, one line per ring.
Six sides, each with its own filter.
Six stacks of arrows in one slot.
Sechs Stücke für Kopf, Körper und Talism: Six pieces for head, body and charm.
Sechs Wyvern-Injektoren. Katalysator: ei: Six Wyvern injectors. Catalyst: a &6diamond pickaxe&r. Into the injectors: &61 Draconium Core&r, &62 Draconium Ingots&r, &62 relay crystals&r, &61 Wyvern Energy Controller&r. Costs 8 million energy.
Sechs kurze Schritte bis zur ersten Abga: Six short steps to your first delivery at the obelisk.
Sechs waagerechte &6Dielectric Rods&r ob: Six horizontal &6Dielectric Rods&r at the top and bottom, iron nugget, Tiny, iron nugget in the middle: twelve &6Starter cables&r. Basic: iron in place of nuggets and a Basic capacitor.
Sechs waagerechte Dielectric Rods oben u: Six horizontal Dielectric Rods at the top and bottom, Blazing Crystal, &6Blazing Capacitor&r, Blazing Crystal in the middle: twelve &6Blazing cables&r with &e20,000 FE/t&r. Hardened cables go the same way with Energized Steel, 5,000 FE/t.
Sechshundert Perlen wollen verdient sein: Six hundred pearls have to be earned.
Sixteen colours, two petals per flower.
Sechzehn Funktionsblumen warten auf Stuf: Sixteen functional flowers wait for stage 2.
Soul fire instead of water or lava.
Seelensand bremst dich. Skelette und Gha: Soul sand slows you down. Skeletons and ghasts see you from far away here, so work quickly and look for cover.
Seelensandtal: langsam, offen und voller: Soul sand valley: slow, open and full of skeletons.
Seelenstahl als Rüstung berührt die eige: Soulstained Steel as armor touches your own soul. The silk cloth is the way out.
Seelenstahl-Waffen lassen auch ohne Sens: Soulstained Steel weapons drop arcana even without a scythe.
Sehnenfaser ist Flexibel IV, als Bogense: Sinew Fiber is Flexible IV, as a bowstring Flexible II and +20 percent ranged damage.
Sei zur Startzeit am &eTreffpunkt&r, den: Be at the &emeeting point&r the team announces on Discord at the start time, with your gear in your inventory. The team leads you to the &5Chaos Island&r itself, there is no teleport at the obelisk.
Seile über einer Tomatenrebe lassen sie: Rope above a tomato vine lets it climb up. You climb it yourself into shafts, and four rope become a &6Safety Net&r against falls.
Sein Schild ist unzerstörbar und er bewe: Its shield is indestructible and it does not move. When it overheats and charges, switch off the &eEnergy Blocks&r nearby. Then the shield drops and you strike.
Sein wichtigstes Produkt ist die &6Verar: Its most important product is the &6Processing Unit&r: plastic, carbon fibre, Electrum and redstone. The order in the slots does not matter, AE2 pattern providers work directly.
Seine Drehzahl hängt von der Spannung ab: Its speed depends on the voltage, it supplies &d64 SU per RPM&r. That way a power plant at the river drives a factory at the other end of the base through wires.
Seine Schläge machen Prozente deiner Ges: Its blows deal a percentage of your health (uppercut and rocket punch 10 percent), plus void runes with 9 damage. It smashes blocks around itself. Damage cap: 22 per hit, 13 per second, almost no damage from beyond 12 blocks, so get close.
Selenit wird Sockel für Kerzen und steck: Selenite becomes a base for candles and is in the netherite tip for brooms.
Rare and all the way down.
Rare, and better kept in the cupboard.
Rare, and only from the Denizens.
Seltene Pflanzen für Altar und Räucherwe: Rare plants for the altar and incense.
Sensen sind eine eigene Waffenart neben: Scythes are a weapon type of their own next to sword and axe. You put accessories into them like into a bundle. If the item breaks, the accessories are gone.
Sensors and redstone in the controller.
Setz &6Reis&r in Wasser, das genau einen: Put &6rice&r into water exactly one block deep with dirt underneath. You find wild rice in swamps and on riverbanks.
Setz den &6Gallkürbis&r auf zwei überein: Put the &6Fel Pumpkin&r on two stacked &6iron bars&r, like a snow golem. A &cblaze&r appears. It is weaker than a real one and drops some &6blaze powder&r instead of a blaze rod.
Setz den Besen ab wie ein Boot, Rechtskl: Set the broom down like a boat, right click puts you on it. It is the slowest, good for building. Sneaking right click opens three slots: accessory, satchel, brush.
Setz den Extractor an den &6Sal Ammoniac: Attach the extractor to the &6Sal Ammoniac Tank&r and an inserter to every Liquefaction Cauldron, connect them with copper wire. Then the solvent flows to the cauldrons on its own, as long as the accumulator has water.
Setz den Zerstörer an den Rahmen, auch a: Place the Destroyer against the frame, a corner works too. Its arm mines the layer &ebelow&r the frame. The &6Placer Block&r and &6Fertilizer Block&r work on the same frame too.
Setz die &6Brilliant Fiber&r in die Kron: Put the &6Brilliant Fiber&r into the crown of a tree. Over time the leaves turn golden. Fully golden leaves drop &6Gold Leaf&r when broken.
Setz die &6Presse&r über ein &6Becken&r: Put the &6press&r over a &6Basin&r instead of a depot. Two &6flint&r, one &6gravel&r and &b100 mB lava&r get compacted into one &6andesite&r.
Setz die acht Ecken eines Quaders: siebe: Place the eight corners of a cuboid: seven space chambers and one controller. Sneak right click the controller with the card to remember the chamber, a right click into the air shows what is inside. Up to &e128&r blocks per side.
Setz dir &eWegpunkte&r an Basis, Erzfund: Set &ewaypoints&r at your base, ore finds, villages and portals. With &eF3&r you see your coordinates; write them down before you go down anywhere.
Setz ein &6Fluid Addon&r an die Zentrifu: Put a &6Fluid Addon&r on the centrifuge (five carbon fibre, one Fluid Pipe, two Electrum, one silicon) and pump water into the centrifuge itself.
Setz ein Gleis, rechtsklicke es mit Glei: Place a track, right click it with tracks in hand and click on the end point. The preview shows green for possible, red for too steep or too tight.
Setz einem &6Schreiter&r einen &6Sattel&: Put a &6saddle&r on a &6strider&r and steer it with a &6warped fungus on a stick&r (fishing rod plus warped fungus). That way you cross whole lava lakes.
Setz einen &6Anzeige-Link&r an den Bahnh: Put a &6Display Link&r on the station and point it at a &6Display Board&r. Choose the train information in the link: the board shows which train comes when and where it goes.
Setz einen &6Geschnitzten Düsterkürbis&r: Put a &6Carved Gloomgourd&r on a &6Block of Forgotten Metal&r. The block costs 9 Forgotten Ingots.
Setz einen &6entrindeten Stamm&r ab und: Place a &6stripped log&r and right-click it with &6Andesite Alloy&r. It becomes &6Andesite Casing&r. Stripped wood works the same way.
Setz einen E/A-Kristall an den Pylon, ei: Put one I/O crystal on the pylon, one on the machine. Sneak right click the first with the binder, then right click the second: the power flows through the air. Relay crystals pass it on, a &6Wireless Energy Crystal&r supplies blocks without any crystal on them.
Setz einen Funken auf jede Truhe, die zu: Put a spark on every chest that belongs to the network. Sparks connect within about 8 blocks. Every network needs &eexactly one&r master spark.
Setz einen Mob auf den Sitz vor der Zugs: Put a mob on the seat in front of the Train Controls, or place a &6Blaze Burner&r in the same spot. Right click it with the schedule: it takes over.
Setz einen braunen oder roten Pilz auf R: Put a brown or red mushroom on Rich Soil. It grows into a &6mushroom colony&r.
Setz ihn so, dass seine Vorderseite auf: Place it so that its front faces a &6Budding Certus Quartz&r, and give it power. A right click with a &6Charged Certus Quartz Crystal&r fills it up. It repairs the budding block and lifts it level by level.
Setz sie in den Luftstrom eines Lüfters: Put it into a fan's air stream and give it enough power: the air stream gets hot. With higher voltage it smelts items like lava in front of the fan, and faster. The Ponder scene (&eW&r) shows the setup.
Setz sie in einen Kräutergarten vor dein: Plant them in a herb garden in front of your hut. Fully grown you harvest them with a right click like sweet berries, then they grow back. The four quests on the right are the checklist: what each plant gives and what for.
Setzt Wasser am Ziel oder löscht brennen: Places water at the target or puts out burning creatures, you included. In the Nether, the rescue after falling into lava.
Setzt ausgewachsene Eichen und Birken in: Places fully grown oaks and birches in a round 7x7 area and fertilises. Each Source Gem as an addition gives +1 radius, a brown mushroom makes taiga, glow berries jungle. Mendosteen grows on archwood trees.
Setzt du mitten auf einer Strecke an, en: If you start in the middle of a line, a junction is made. Moving trains hurt whatever stands on the track.
Setzt einen leuchtenden Block, der nach: Places a glowing block that disappears after a short time. With &dAmplify&r it stays, &dDispel&r removes it. &eProjectile, Mageblock&r builds steps onto any wall.
Shulker kommen nicht wieder, aber sie te: Shulkers do not come back, but they split.
Shulker kommen nicht wieder. Mit Occulti: Shulkers do not come back. With Occultism you make new ones: the Afrit ritual &ePossessed Shulker&r (dragon's breath, end stone, purple glazed terracotta).
Sie angelt wie die Vanilla-Angel, hält a: It fishes like the vanilla rod but lasts as long as its material and can be repaired instead of rebuilt.
Sie baut Iesnium und andere Otherworld-E: It mines Iesnium and other Otherworld ores and lasts long. You need three more for the mining spirits: Foliot, Djinni and Afrit Miner each eat one.
Sie baut Stein, Holz und Erde gleich sch: It mines stone, wood and dirt equally fast; you never switch tools while digging again. You can enchant it like any pickaxe.
Sie behält die Zutaten im Raster, wenn d: It keeps the ingredients in the grid when you close it, and it has a drawer. It is also the ingredient for the Engineer's Workbench.
Sie braucht viel freien Raum vor sich, j: It needs a lot of free space in front of it, every block in the way slows it down. Completely free and without sails it makes about &d17 FE/t&r. Above the ocean it turns 15 percent faster, in rain and thunderstorms too.
Sie bringt dich einmal genau zu diesem W: It takes you once to exactly this waystone, without choosing and, like all scrolls, without level cost. Bind a few to your base and give them to friends.
Sie deckt nur ein Viertel der Fläche ein: It covers only a quarter of the area of a normal map. Open it at your mining level, then you see where you have already been.
Sie dreht Stangen: Stahl und Aluminium f: It turns rods: steel and aluminum for Immersive Engineering, copper, gold, brass and electrum for Create Crafts & Additions, &etwo&r per ingot.
Sie drückt einen &eInfusionsstoff&r (Koh: It presses an &einfusion type&r (carbon, redstone, later diamond and obsidian) into an item. That makes steel, alloys and circuits. It needs &d20 FE/t&r, which the Heat Generator supplies right away.
Sie erntet reife Pflanzen und fällt Bäum: It harvests ripe plants and fells trees with everything hanging on them, &d400 FE&r per operation. It produces &6Sludge&r while doing it. With a little Ether Gas it replants right away.
Sie fasst weit mehr als eine Doppeltruhe: It holds far more than a double chest and has a built in furnace on power. &eAuto-Smelt&r sends everything smeltable into it, or only what is already being smelted. You set the color in the window.
Sie frisst &eWolle&r in der Farbe, die s: It eats &ewool&r in the color it wants right now, then the next color around the wheel. The Dandelifeon needs a Gaia Spirit and comes in stage 4.
Sie frisst Blumen aus der Apotheke, die: It eats apothecary flowers you plant around it. The more different ones in a row, the more mana.
Sie frisst Essen direkt neben sich, eins: It eats food right next to it, one after another. Mana: &dnutrition times nutrition times 70&r, a steak (8) gives 4,480 after 4 seconds. Always the same food brings less and less; up to seven different ones in a row up to 1.8 times.
Sie fällt ganze Bäume, auch große Dschun: It fells whole trees, even big jungle trees. With the &6Rockcutter Blade&r (diamonds and steel plates) it cuts stone out cleanly, as if with Silk Touch.
Sie füllt Löcher bis 12 Blöcke tief. Ein: It fills holes up to 12 blocks deep. A train with two rollers levels its own track bed.
Sie gehören in die &6Drachenei-Kruste&r,: They go into the &6Dragon Egg Chunk&r, the base of the dragon egg seeds. That only comes in &estage 5&r, so put the scales aside.
Sie gießt &e5 mal 5&r Felder mit &e30 Pr: It waters &e5 by 5&r tiles with a &e30 percent&r chance per tick instead of 25. And it can water &eautomatically&r: shift and right click into the air toggles it, then it waters as long as you hold it and look at the field.
Sie greift deine Gegner mit Schallwellen: It attacks your enemies with sound waves. A companion that fights along in this dimension is worth a lot.
Sie hat &e54&r Plätze wie eine große Tru: It has &e54&r slots like a large chest. Who may open it you set in the security tab. Mined, it keeps its contents, and as an item you open it with right click right from the inventory: a backpack.
Sie hat ein &eFilterfeld&r für ein Item: It has a &efilter slot&r for an item or a filter and an adjustable &ecount&r. An &6Attribute Filter&r (brass nugget and wool) filters by properties, such as everything enchanted.
Sie heizt mit Strom aus deinem Netz. Mit: It heats with power from your grid. With enough power it reaches the highest heat level, &csuperheated&r, without any blaze cake.
Sie hält &e200&r statt 100, also doppelt: It lasts &e200&r instead of 100, so twice as long.
Sie hält Haken, Köder, Leinen und Schwim: It keeps hooks, bait, lines and bobbers together, and you fit out the rod in it.
Sie hält mehr aus als Eisen und kostet d: It takes more than iron and only costs you steel from the blast furnace. Good for the time before you get to diamonds or better armour.
Sie hält so viel wie acht dichte Zellen: It holds as much as eight dense cells in one block. Spatial storage and the Reaction Chamber draw their power all at once, that is what it is for.
Sie hält wie die Enhanced Brush &e200&r,: Like the Enhanced Brush it lasts &e200&r, but it makes the broom faster, most of all at full moon.
Sie hängen hoch über Ebenen, Wäldern und: They hang high above plains, forests and deserts. Build yourself a pillar up and take Feather Falling or a water bucket along.
Sie hängt direkt an einem LV-Draht und r: It hangs straight on an LV wire and passes the power on, so you can connect several in a row. It draws only &d1 FE/t&r.
Sie ist das einzige Rüstungsteil der Wyv: It is the only armor piece of the Wyvern tier and carries a &eshield&r that absorbs damage with power. How strong depends on the modules in it.
Sie ist die ganze Rüstung. Ihre Stärke k: It is the whole armor. Its strength comes from the modules of the next quests.
Sie koppelt Netz und Generatorwelle nur: It only weakly couples grid and generator shaft; a redstone signal changes the strength. It costs &d32 SU per RPM&r.
Sie kostet &d8 SU pro RPM&r. Plan für ei: It costs &d8 SU per RPM&r. For one press at 32 RPM plan a whole water wheel, better two.
They charge every laser base in range.
Sie leuchtet wie eine Fackel und schadet: It glows like a torch and harms rotspawn nearby. A ring of them around the portal, bed and shaft, and things get calmer.
Sie lädt jeden Gegenstand, der Strom spe: It charges any item that stores power with up to &d256 FE/t&r. Power comes from below or from behind, the item you put in by right click or push in with a hopper.
Sie lässt &6Böenruten&r fallen. Vier &6W: It drops &6Breeze Rods&r. You can throw the four &6wind charges&r from one rod yourself: thrown at the ground, they fling you up.
Sie läuft mit &6Biodiesel&r. Füll sie an: It runs on &6Biodiesel&r. Fill it at the Refinery, a barrel or a tank. While sneaking it drills only one block.
Sie läuft mit Strom und geht nicht kaput: It runs on power and never breaks. &e{key:key.draconicevolution.tool_modules}&r (the Tool Modules key) opens its module grid.
Sie löscht alles, was hineinkommt, per H: It deletes everything that comes in, by hand, hopper or belt. Its filter has &e9 slots&r as whitelist or blacklist.
Sie macht 64 Fluix, 64 Himmelsstahl, 64: It makes 64 fluix, 64 sky steel, 64 entro or a singularity from 64 Matter Balls, each with a fluid and &d100,000 to 1 million AE&r per recipe.
Sie macht Purpur-Stahl, Lohengold, Azur-: It makes Crimson Steel, Blaze Gold, Azure Electrum and Tyrian Steel. Plus &6High-Carbon Steel&r: one iron and three coal, 420 durability and +4 damage.
Sie macht aus &e750 mB Latex&r und &e500: It turns &e750 mB of latex&r and &e500 mB of water&r into one &6Dry Rubber&r and draws &d20 FE/t&r. Place it right next to the extractors and give it a water source.
Sie mahlt Erze, Barren und Kohle zu Stau: It grinds ores, ingots and coal into dust, with power from your grid. NuclearCraft opens fully in &6stage 4&r. This chapter leads up to the first running fission reactor.
Sie passt in tragbare Zellen und drahtlo: It fits into portable cells and wireless terminals like the normal Energy Card, only with much more buffer. Portable MEGA cells only take this card.
Sie presst mit einer Form im Formslot. M: It presses with a mould in the mould slot. With the &6Silicon Press&r from AE2 it turns silicon into &6Printed Silicon&r, with the other presses the processor parts, with moulds from Immersive Engineering plates, rods and wires.
It pulls in items near it. You set the range in the window and can have it shown. Good under a mob farm or at the end of a harvester.
Sie schiebt ein Rohr nach unten, bis sie: It pushes a pipe downward until it hits fluid, then drains the whole connected lake, up to &e100,000 blocks&r. It pulls &e4 buckets per second&r and needs &e512 RF&r per block.
Sie schießt wie eine Vanilla-Armbrust. M: It shoots like a vanilla crossbow. With Sinew Fiber or Fluffy String as the cord it hits harder.
Sie schützt wie Manastahl und repariert: It protects like Manasteel and repairs itself with mana from your inventory. When you are hit, a &dfairy&r sometimes appears and attacks the attacker. The more pieces, the more often.
Sie spawnt Mobs in schnellem Takt, für &: It spawns mobs at a fast pace, for &d1,000 FE&r and &e20 mB of Liquid Meat&r per operation. The normal spawn rules apply: light level 7 or lower, and the chunk has to be loaded.
Sie speichert &e100 Millionen FE&r, mehr: It stores &e100 million FE&r, more than both Blazing cells together (80 million). Put it behind the reactor, then nothing goes to waste in auto mode.
Sie speichert eine einzige Sorte, davon: It stores a single kind, of that almost any amount. The &6Compression Card&r converts between ingots, blocks and nuggets.
Sie stecken in der Ladestation und in St: They are in the Charging Station and in stage 3 in the Advanced Electronic Component. Create's electron tube is a different part.
Sie stecken in jedem Kondensator, in der: They are in every accumulator, in the Garden Cloche and in the routers. The Light and Heavy blocks are something else, they only open in stage 3.
Sie steckt im Dynamo, in der Pumpe, der: It is in the dynamo, the pump, the Garden Cloche and in stage 3 in every Light Engineering Block. Make a few more right away.
Sie steckt im Energietablett, in den Upg: It goes into the energy tablet, the upgrades, the electrolytic separator, the pump and almost every generator. You have enough copper, make a stack.
Sie steckt in Einsatzgerät, Messingschle: It goes into deployer, brass funnel, train signal and display board. Every round of the precision mechanism eats one, and Mekanism makes its first circuit from it.
Sie steckt in Nudeln mit Fleischbällchen: It goes into pasta with meatballs, pasta with mutton chop and fish stew.
Sie steckt in Plate Advanced, Chassis, R: It goes into Plate Advanced, the chassis, armor, heat sinks and the reactor ports.
It goes into almost every functional flower. A flower with a root in its recipe rests as long as it gets a redstone signal. You harvest grass and ferns with shears.
Sie steht für sich allein: über eine Flü: It stands on its own: placed over a fluid, it pumps the whole area empty. With &eDelete On&r the fluid is destroyed, good against groundwater in the quarry hole. With &eDelete Off&r it lands in its tank, and you pump off lava.
Sie tragen Gegenstände und Tiere bergauf: They carry items and animals uphill and downhill. Upgrades by right click: extraction, insertion, detection, dropping, bouncing, splitting, blinking. Almost all of them can be filtered.
Sie tragen Gegenstände und Tiere und sch: They carry items and animals and push into any inventory at the end. The hammer turns them, sneaking it sets the slope. For more belts see the chapter &6Transport&r.
Sie tut nichts. Rechtsklick streichelt s: It does nothing. Right click pets it, at the anvil it gets a name. Every botanist needs one.
Sie verschiebt Inhalt zwischen Netz und: It moves contents between the network and the disks you put in: empty a full disk into the network, or fill an empty disk with certain things, for moving house or as a package for a fellow player. It needs 6 FE/t plus 4 per disk.
Sie verstärkt das erste Ding deiner Schn: It strengthens the first thing in your hotbar or the one in your offhand: unbreakable for a while, more damage, faster mining. Costs &d50 mana&r.
Sie walzt Barren zu Drähten von Immersiv: It rolls ingots into Immersive Engineering wires: copper, steel, lead, aluminum, &etwo&r per ingot.
Sie wandelt &eNetherrack&r in ihrer Nähe: With mana it gradually turns &enetherrack&r near it into Nether ores. It only works in the &cNether&r, so bring pools and spreaders.
Sie wirkt wie Knochenmehl, aber auch auf: It works like bone meal, but on essence crops too. Four of them instead of bone meal in the Mystical Fertilizer recipe give 8 fertilizer instead of 4.
Sie zeigen auf die Matrix, höchstens &e5: They point at the matrix, at most &e5 blocks&r away, in a straight line.
Sie zeigt die Mondphase, tagsüber die So: It shows the moon phase, during the day the sun. Handy for the Moon Dust Brush, which flies fastest at full moon.
Sie ziehen nichts von selbst aus einer K: They don't pull anything out of a chest on their own: either auto eject on the machine, or set the transporter side to &epull&r with the Configurator. Coloured transporters only connect to the same colour.
Sie öffnet mit Stufe 3 und steckt in Tes: It opens with stage 3 and goes into the Tesla coil, the Railgun, the turret and the Resonanz Engineering Blocks.
Sieben &6Eisenbarren&r um eine &6Truhe&r: Seven &6iron ingots&r around a &6chest&r, a &6Pulsating Crystal&r in the bottom middle.
Sieben &6Pewter&r in Kesselform. Über ei: Seven &6Pewter&r in a cauldron shape. Place it over a campfire, fill it with water, wait until it boils.
Sieben mal sieben Felder mit einem Klick: Seven by seven tiles with one click.
Siehe Kapitel &5Mekanism&r (Rohre und Ta: See the &5Mekanism&r (pipes and tanks) and &cThe Nether&r chapters.
Siehe Kapitel &6Create: Messing&r (Einsa: See the &6Create: Brass&r (Deployer) and &5Mekanism&r (Precision Sawmill) chapters.
Siehe Kapitel &6Create: Messing&r (Mahlw: See the &6Create: Brass&r (crushing wheels) and &5Mekanism&r (Crusher) chapters.
See the &6Create: Brass&r (crushing wheels, Mechanical Spawner), &6Create: Add-ons&r (spawn fluid) and &6Apotheosis&r (runes) chapters.
Siehe Kapitel &aBotania: Runen&r. Der &6: See the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter. The &6Kekimurus&r, which eats cake, comes with Alfheim in stage 3.
Looks like an oak, isn't one.
Signale teilen die Strecke in &eAbschnit: Signals divide the line into &esections&r. A train only enters a free section. On double track lines each direction needs its own signals.
Silber geht in Elektrum, Nickel in Const: Silver goes into electrum, nickel into constantan and Vacuum Tubes, lead into the accumulator. Smelt raw ores in the furnace or send them through Mekanism's Enrichment Chamber.
Silent-Gear-Werkzeug &everschwindet nich: Silent Gear tools &edon't disappear&r when they break. They stay in your inventory as broken until you repair them.
Silizium steckt in jedem Prozessor, im K: Silicon goes into every processor, the Controller and every 1k Storage Part. A stack is enough to start, two are better.
Sind Technik und Magie voll, öffnet &6St: When tech and magic are full, &6stage 3 (Steel Works)&r opens with a stream event, and with it the elven portal, see &aBotania: Alfheim&r.
Sind alle Teile einer Bestellung da, pac: Once all parts of an order are there, it packs them into one new package. That way an order arrives complete and in a fixed order, which matters for machines that need ingredients exactly like that.
Sind auch Draconium und Elite-Schaltkrei: Once the techs' draconium and Elite Control Circuits are in too, &6Stage 5 (Chaos Works)&r opens.
Sind die Kristalle weg, hat der Wächter: Once the crystals are gone, the Guardian still has a shield of &e16,000&r and below it &e1,000 health&r. The shield can be hit as fast as you like: Draconic bows with damage and speed modules, all at once.
Singularitäten brauchst du für die Quant: You need singularities for the quantum bridge, the Accumulation Press, Quantum Alloy and the setup kit of the wireless connectors.
Skelett-Türme und Skelett-Lager gibt es: Skeleton towers and skeleton camps come in four styles depending on the biome: wastes, crimson, warped and soul sand. All chests are Lootr chests, so new for every player.
So baust du es: je eine Kiste Andesit un: This is how you build it: one chest each of andesite and nuggets with an Andesite Funnel that puts them on the belt to the basin. A funnel on the side of the basin loads the alloy into an output chest.
So bekommt die Werkstatt eines Mitspiele: That way a fellow player's workshop only gets to see ores and coal from your network. It needs 8 FE/t on each side.
That way you are right there with the others. If you need help, ask in chat or in voice chat.
That way your coal stock stays for the furnace. Against rotspawn only the Shard Torch helps, though.
So bringt ein Tankzug Lava zu deinen Lüf: That way a tank train brings lava to your fans or water to the steam boiler.
So fahren zwei Züge auf einer Strecke, d: That way two trains run on a line that is only one track wide.
So geht es mit jedem Ofen, jeder Mekanis: It works the same with every furnace, every Mekanism machine and every mixer.
So geht jede Infusion: Gegenstand hinein: Every infusion works like this: item in, and as long as there is enough mana it is transformed piece by piece. EMI shows every recipe with its price under the Mana Pool.
So groß wie die Medium Satchel. Bricht d: As big as the Medium Satchel. If the active brush breaks, the broom puts in the brush from the top left of the bag. On long flights you never fall from the sky again.
So holst du zum Beispiel einen &6Makello: That is how you bring, for example, a &6Flawless Budding Certus Quartz&r from a meteorite into your base.
So holt ein Kolben einen Block ab und se: That way a piston picks up a block and sets it down somewhere else, for sliding doors or a storage that swaps chests.
That way your Impetus lasts longer too.
So hängt die Erzfabrik am Rand der Welt: That way the ore factory at the edge of the world hangs on your storage at home.
So kommt Sauerstoff oder Wasserstoff aus: That way oxygen or hydrogen comes from the network straight into your machines. How ME networks are built is in the chapter &bApplied Energistics 2&r.
So läuft dein Netz über Köpfe und Wege h: That way your grid runs above heads and paths instead of straight through the base.
So läuft der Reaktor teilweise aus seine: That way the reactor partly runs on its own waste.
So läuft ein Mixer nur alle paar Minuten: That way a mixer only runs every few minutes, or a dispenser fires on a fixed beat.
So läuft eine Bruchsteinmaschine nur, so: That way a cobblestone machine only runs while there are fewer than 10,000 cobblestone in storage.
So merkst du, ob eine Leitung überhaupt: That way you notice whether a line carries any mana at all, or count bursts with a counter.
So schaltet ein Hebel in der Werkstatt d: That way a lever in the workshop switches off the machines at the other end of the laser network.
So schaltet sich die Stahlstraße ab, wen: That way the steel line switches off when 10,000 ingots are there, and on again when storage shrinks.
So siehst du beim Spielen, wie viele Bar: That way you see how many ingots are still missing while you play, without opening the book. &eUnpin&r removes it again.
So speist eine Mine am Kartenrand deine: That way a mine at the edge of the map feeds your factory, or your zinc and copper mine the brass mixers.
So stark wie Netherit und heilt Schaden: As strong as netherite and heals damage with mana from the inventory. The full set costs &e12 Terrasteel&r.
So trägst du Strom ohne Kabel: Batteries: That is how you carry power without cables: charge Batteries at the power plant with the hopper, carry them to the building site, empty them in the discharger.
So verbindest du die Basis eines Mitspie: That is how you link a team mate's base without a single cable across the landscape.
So verschwinden deine Leitungen in Wand: That way your conduits disappear into walls and floors and keep running. The Yeta Wrench still reaches them.
So weißt du vor dem ersten Spatenstich,: That way you know before the first dig whether osmium, diamond or just stone lies under the base.
So wird Lapis auch zu &6Certus Quartz&r: That is also how lapis becomes &6Certus Quartz&r for AE2. EMI shows all sources at the target Sulfur.
So wird die Spitzhacke vom ersten Tag St: That way the day one pickaxe gets better piece by piece. Only the head can't be swapped like this.
So wächst deine Certusfarm ohne Nachwerf: That way your certus farm grows without throwing more into the water.
Solange es brennt, spawnen im Umkreis vo: As long as it burns, no monsters spawn naturally within &e48 blocks&r. Right click with an empty hand changes the smoke, one mode shows the range.
Sun on the helmet, heat on the legs.
Sonnenlicht in der Flasche, dann das ers: Sunlight in a bottle, then your first ritual.
Soularium, &6Kaputter Spawner&r, Soulari: Soularium, &6Broken Spawner&r, Soularium at the top, Soularium, &6Ensouled Chassis&r, Soularium in the middle, &6Vibrant Crystal&r, &6Z-Logic Controller&r, Vibrant Crystal at the bottom. In the Soul Binder it gets its mob from a full Soul Vial.
Soulwood bekommst du mit dem &eUnchained: You get Soulwood with the &eUnchained Rite&r, it transforms Runewood. You make the totem base from Soulwood in spirit infusion.
Spawner stehen in Verliesen, Minen und a: Spawners stand in dungeons, mines and as rogue spawners freely in caves. Runes and spawn eggs are in the &6Apotheosis&r chapter.
Spieler in der Nähe bekommen beim Spring: Players nearby get the &eFlight&r effect when jumping, and the ritual refreshes it as long as they stay nearby. Each time it costs source from the jars.
Spirit Altar: ein Eisenbarren, vier Refi: Spirit Altar: one iron ingot, four Refined Soulstone, three &cWicked&r, one &2Earthen&r, one &dArcane Spirit&r. See the &5Malum&r chapter.
Spirited-Kristalle, zwei Spirited-Konden: Spirited Crystals, two Spirited Capacitors, a casing and the &6Niotic Furnator&r at the bottom.
Spiritfire verletzt keine Lebewesen. Wei: Spiritfire doesn't hurt living things. More recipes: diorite becomes Otherrock, an oak sapling becomes an Otherworld sapling, feather, black dye and book become book of binding ingredients, flowers become Otherflowers (a dye tripler).
Spiritfire, Otherstone und die Kreidezut: Spiritfire, Otherstone and the chalk ingredients (the quests on the right) already work in stage 1. Chalk, bowls and books of binding open with &6stage 2&r, Afrit and Marid with &6stage 3&r.
Spitzen Tropfstein findest du in Tropfst: You find pointed dripstone in dripstone caves. Several dripstones next to each other, each over its own cauldron, and an &6Item Drain&r or a bucket collects the lava.
Spitzhacke, Axt und Schaufel aus &6Raffi: A pickaxe, an axe and a shovel of &6Refined Obsidian&r, then all three in a row at the top, two sticks below in the middle.
Pickaxe, axe and shovel in one.
Spitzhacke, Axt, Schaufel, Hacke und Sch: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword on power. Modules for mining speed, Silk Touch, Fortune and vein mining. The Teleportation Unit needs antimatter from stage 5.
Spitzhacke, Axt, Schwert und Hammer, all: Pickaxe, axe, sword and hammer, all from Silent Gear. You decide the material.
Splitter stecken in allem, was nicht Ess: Shards go into everything that is not essence: the seed base for the altar, the Infusion Crystal, ingots and gemstones for tools and Growth Accelerators. One stack is plenty for this chapter.
Sprecht euch ab: ein gemeinsames Netz mi: Agree among yourselves: a shared network with cleanly named stations helps everyone.
Spring &edreimal&r in den Kessel, dann i: Jump into the cauldron &ethree times&r, then there is enough in it for a &6Bottle of Blood&r. A glass bottle fills it.
Spring in das &5Endportal&r. Es wurde mi: Jump into the &5End portal&r. It was activated on stream with the event for &estage 4&r, and since then the End is open to everyone.
Spule in die Hand, erst einen Anschluss: Coil in hand, click one connector first, then the next. One stretch may be &e16 blocks&r long at most, and no block may stand in the way.
Spulen stecken im Motor, im Generator, i: Coils go into the motor, the generator, the furnace and many addons. Later the Assembler makes six from one steel, two nickel and one copper.
Spulen, Motoren und Platten werden hier: Coils, motors and plating are much cheaper here than at the crafting table.
Später wird er im Apparat zum &6Ring des: Later, in the apparatus, it becomes the &6Ring of Greater Discount&r.
Stachel, Horn und Flügel in einem Körper: Spike, horn and wing in one body.
Stack-Upgrades ändern nicht die Zahl der: Stack upgrades don't change the number of slots but how much fits into &eeach&r. The starter tier takes &e1.5 times&r as much; 64 stone per slot become 96.
Stahl brauchst du hier reichlich. Deine: You need plenty of steel here. Your steel line from stage 3 has work to do again.
Stahl in Mengen, Erzverdreifachung, Lage: Steel in bulk, ore tripling, storage networks with Applied Energistics and Refined Storage, Alfheim, Afrit and Marid, machines that run around the clock.
Stahl steckt in jedem Gehäuse, Kabel und: Steel goes into every casing, cable and pipe. &eKronwerke:&r The stage 3 goal wants &e4,000 steel ingots&r. Steel from the Immersive Engineering blast furnace counts just the same.
Stahl und Bausteine liefert dieses Kapit: This chapter supplies steel and blocks. Let the steel line run into chests and bring the ingots to the obelisk.
Stahl, &6Spender&r, Stahl oben, &6Energi: Steel, &6dispenser&r, steel at the top, &6Energy Pipe&r, &6block of redstone&r, Energy Pipe in the middle, three &6chests&r at the bottom make the &6Equipment Charger&r.
Stahl, Elektrum und ein Präzisionsmechan: Steel, Electrum and a Precision Mechanism.
Stahl, ein Crafter, Schaltkreise, ein St: Steel, a crafter, circuits, a steel casing and a chest. A &6Crafting Formula&r (paper and circuit) stores a recipe.
Stahlgehäuse in der Mitte, Elite-Schaltk: Steel Casing in the middle, Elite Control Circuits at the top and bottom, Bio Fuel left and right, Reinforced Alloy in the corners.
Stahlgehäuse in die Mitte, Stahl links u: A Steel Casing in the middle, steel left and right, circuits at the top and bottom, redstone in the corners.
Stahlgehäuse in die Mitte, zwei &6Robits: A Steel Casing in the middle, two &6Robits&r left and right, circuits at the top and bottom, redstone in the corners.
Stahlgehäuse, Schaltkreise, Eisen und Br: Steel casing, circuits, iron and planks. A log becomes &esix planks&r instead of four, plus some &6sawdust&r now and then.
Stapel in die Hand, Rechtsklick auf den: Stack in hand, right-click the obelisk.
Starfire wirfst du als Waffe, damit wert: You throw Starfire as a weapon, use it to upgrade Thermal Springstone gear, and thrown on Twilight Sand it creates &6Raw Flowglaze&r.
Strong as a god, for a short time.
Starte das Ritual und gewinne. &eJeder M: Start the ritual and win. &eEvery fighter gets 6&r Gaia Spirits, &ewhoever lands the last hit 8&r. With a 20 percent chance a music disc drops too.
Starter-Blöcke nehmen Tiny, Basic die no: Starter blocks take Tiny, Basic the normal ones. From Hardened on you build one of each: a Large in the middle, paste in the corners, the tier's material on the sides. Hardened and Blazing give two, Niotic and Spirited one.
Startet das Rezept nicht, öffne die Zent: If the recipe does not start, open the centrifuge once after adding the addon.
Statt Wasser kannst du &6Natrium&r in di: Instead of water you can pump &6sodium&r into the coolant port. The reactor turns it into &6superheated sodium&r instead of steam. Sodium cools better than water.
Statt eines Feldes steht eine Wand, die: Instead of a field a wall stands, which casts the rest of the spell on everything that passes through. The augments work as with Linger. &eWall, Ignite, Extend Time&r across a corridor.
Statt eines geraden Luftstroms verteilt: Instead of a straight air stream the nozzle spreads the fan's effect all around onto mobs and players. Good for keeping mobs away from a spot or sucking them together.
Statt einzelner Gegenstände gibst du ein: In place of single items you enter a tag, asterisks are allowed. &ec:raw_materials/*&r sends all raw ores into the chest behind it, &ec:ingots/* | c:gems/*&r all ingots and gems: &e|&r means or.
Statt mit dem Hammer gibt jedes Stück da: Instead of the hammer, each piece gives two powders with it. For thirty staffs that pays off quickly.
Statt nur zu sagen, &ewelche&r Items dur: Beyond saying &ewhich&r items may pass, it also sets &ehow many&r. In an insert card the node fills the target only up to that number: exactly 64 coal in the generator, exactly 16 ore in every machine.
Steck die Steinbruchkarte in den Builder: Put the Quarry Card into the Builder, place a chest or an AE2 import bus right next to it and give it power.
Steck ein Schaf in den Rucksack: Put a sheep in the backpack
Steck es in die Brustplatte. Fünf kleine: Put it into the chestpiece. Five small ones make a large one through a recipe with Draconium Cores, and a large one can be split back into five.
Steckt die Karte im Builder, kopiert ode: With the card in the Builder, it copies or moves the contents to its target area. That way you move a workshop without breaking a single block by hand.
Steckt eine Kerze im Dipper über einem T: If a candle is in the dipper above a potion, it dips it &e3 times&r, &e100 mB&r per candle. Burning, it gives the effect to everyone nearby. The five quests below are the checklist of all candle potions.
Steckt im &6Energetisierten Bimetallzahn: It goes into the &6Energized Bimetal Gear&r (alloy around an Infinity Gear), the Double-Layer Capacitor and the fast conduits.
Goes into generator, motor and magnet.
Steckt in Terraplatte, Runenkern, Nargli: Goes into the Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate, Rune Core, Narslimmus, Jiyuulia and is the catalyst for Spring and Winter.
Steckt in Totembasen, Spirit Crucible, I: It goes into totem bases, the Spirit Crucible, the Impetus and the better scythe. Make a stack.
Steckt in der Soul-Hunter-Rüstung und im: It goes into the Soulhunter armor and the Soulwoven Pouch.
Steh an einer &6Werkbank&r, such das Rez: Stand at a &6crafting table&r, find the recipe with &eR&r and click the small &e+&r at the bottom right of the recipe. EMI puts the ingredients from your inventory into the right slots. &eShift&r-click fills a whole stack.
Steh davor und schreib in den Chat, zum: Stand in front of it and write in the chat, for example &e"64 cobblestone"&r. The items drop out in front of you. In the inventory it also works with the mouse on an item and the Corporea key.
Stehen sie sich mit ein bis zwei Blöcken: When they face each other one or two blocks apart, the contraption stops and swaps items. A funnel on the fixed one pulls them off. In stage 2 freight trains load this way too.
Steht eine Wand aus Providern und Assemb: When a wall of providers and assemblers stands packed together, you cannot reach the middle ones any more. The terminal shows every provider in the network, and you put patterns straight into them.
Steht es in einem großen Bauwerk, etwa e: If it stands in a large structure, such as a stronghold or a temple, it gives that structure's loot.
Stein am Gänseblümchen wird zu &6Lebeste: Stone at the daisy becomes &6Livingrock&r. You need &e5&r for every Mana Pool, &e4&r for the Runic Altar in stage 2, &e8&r for every Mana Tablet.
Endless stone, even while you talk.
Stein und Erde werden zu &e17 Prozent&r: Stone and dirt become &6scrap&r at &e17 percent&r, substrate at 43 percent. Scrap is the raw material for the replicators, which open only in stage 5. Until then it is a trash can with a bonus.
Stone to gravel, gravel to sand.
Stein, Holz, Weizen und Leder, ohne dass: Stone, wood, wheat and leather, without you standing next to it.
Stein, Redstone und ein Schaltkreis. Die: Stone, redstone and a circuit. The &6Basic Bin&r holds &e4,096&r of one kind; left click takes, right click puts in.
Stein, der halb in einer anderen Welt st: Stone that is half stuck in another world.
Steinbruchkarte, &6Dimensionsscherben&r,: Quarry Card, &6Dimensional Shards&r, &6diamonds&r and a &6Nether Star&r. Every block comes back as it was.
Steinsamen wachsen wie Weizen und geben: Stone Seeds grow like wheat and give &6Stone Essence&r. &e8 Stone Essence&r in a ring give &e24 cobblestone&r, 8 Stone Essence with a Coal Essence in the middle 20 stone, but that only comes in stage 2.
Stell &64 Dampfmaschinen&r an einen groß: Place &64 Steam Engines&r on a big boiler and &64 Blaze Burners&r below. The Engineer's Goggles show the &eboiler level&r and what is missing: heat, water or size.
Stell &64 Seelensand&r als T auf und set: Set up &64 soul sand&r as a T and put &63 wither skeleton skulls&r on top. The &cWither&r appears, explodes and flies off. It drops a &6Nether star&r.
Stell &6Endstein&r um ein &6Reines Gänse: Place &6end stone&r around a &6Pure Daisy&r. It turns it into &6cobbled deepslate&r and releases a cloud of &5Pure Ender Essence&r while doing it. Catch it with an Alfglass Flask.
Stell &6Tropfsteinblöcke&r um das Reine: Put &6dripstone blocks&r around the Pure Daisy, they become &6calcite&r.
Stell &bSeelenfeuer&r direkt vor einen &: Put &bsoul fire&r right in front of an &6Encased Fan&r: fire on &6soul sand&r or a &6soul campfire&r. The air stream &5haunts&r whatever flies through.
Stell &cLava&r direkt vor den Lüfter und: Put &clava&r right in front of the fan and send items on a belt through the stream. They are smelted like in a furnace: raw zinc into zinc ingots, sand into glass.
Stell Glas und Link höchstens &e5 Blöcke: Place jar and link no more than &e5 blocks&r apart, the chamber no more than &e2 blocks&r next to the jar. Throw logs next to the link.
Stell Kompost hin und warte. Pilze, Pods: Place compost and wait. Mushrooms, podzol, mycelium or more compost nearby speed it up.
Stell Mineshaft, Battlefield oder einen: Place a Mineshaft, Battlefield or a working spirit on the Extractor and a storage below it. The Djinni picks up the results quickly and puts them in below.
Stell Tresore aneinander, sie verschmelz: Place vaults against each other, they merge into one. Footprint up to &e3 by 3&r, length up to three times the width. That is up to 81 blocks and &e1,620 stacks&r in one inventory.
Stell das Item und den Vorrat ein. Fällt: Set the item and the stock. If it drops below, the gauge orders the ingredients from the network and sends them by package. Several gauges connected make whole chains.
Stell den &6Netzwerkempfänger&r an das e: Place the &6Network Receiver&r at the remote network, sneak and right click it with the card to bind the card to it. Put the card into the &6Network Transmitter&r at the main network: both are now one network. The transmitter needs 32 FE/t, the receiver 8.
Stell den Catalyzer neben den Crucible:: Place the Catalyzer next to the Crucible: it heats the catalyst and speeds up focusing. In return the Impetus wears out a little faster, so combine it with a Repair Pylon right away.
Stell den Probebohrer über eine Ader, se: Place the sample drill over a vein, put a &6copper backtank&r with air on top and click it. When it is done, click it with the atlas. Clicking a running drilling machine with the atlas works too.
Stell den Pylon in die Nähe des Kerns un: Place the pylon near the core and put a &eglass block&r directly above or below it. A pylon takes power in or gives it out, you switch the direction at the pylon. A comparator on it shows how full the core is.
Stell den Tank auf und treib ihn an (4 S: Place the tank and power it (4 SU per RPM) until it holds &e900&r air. With helmet and boots you breathe under water and sink quickly to the bottom.
Stell den Vibrator auf und gib ihm Strom: Set up the vibrator and give it power. It makes its whole chunk vibrate. Stand in the same chunk and use the charged reader: it shows you every block of the column below you down to bedrock, with how often each kind appears.
Stand in the portal for a moment.
Stell dich so, dass der Wächter beim Ang: Position yourself so the Guardian hits a &5Guardian Crystal&r when it attacks you. Once that crystal's shield is unstable, you have &e10 seconds&r: everyone on that crystal.
Stell die &627 Koksziegel&r als &e3x3x3-: Set the &627 Coke Bricks&r up as a &e3x3x3 cube&r and hit the middle of one side with the hammer.
Stell die &627 Sprengziegel&r als &e3x3x: Set the &627 Blast Bricks&r up as a &e3x3x3 cube&r and hit the middle of one side with the hammer.
Stell die &627 Verstärkten Sprengziegel&: Set the &627 Reinforced Blast Bricks&r up as a 3x3x3 cube, put a &6hopper&r on top in the middle and hit the block the manual shows with the hammer.
Stell die &68 Legierungsziegel&r als &e2: Set the &68 Kiln Bricks&r up as a &e2x2x2 cube&r and hit one of the blocks with the hammer.
Stell die &6Divination Rod&r schleichend: Set the &6Divination Rod&r to &6netherrack&r while sneaking, hold right click in the Nether and follow the glow. With the goggles you see the ore, with the Infused Pickaxe you mine it.
Stell die Stäbe im Umkreis von &e4 Blöck: Put the rods within &e4 blocks&r around the orb and give each power from below: a cable, a cell or a generator. If a rod does not join in, link it with the &6Wrench&r in the mode &eLink&r.
Stell ein &6Quellglas&r in höchstens &e5: Place a &6Source Jar&r within &e5 blocks&r and the animal farm supplies Source for your Imbuement Chamber on the side. You find the link in the &dArs Nouveau&r chapter.
Stell eine &6Fackel&r unter den Block, a: Put a &6torch&r below the block the &5dragon egg&r sits on, and break the block. The egg falls onto the torch and becomes an item.
Stell eine &6Sacrificial Bowl&r darauf:: Put a &6Sacrificial Bowl&r on it: every item that goes into the bowl transforms right away. With a hopper above it this becomes a small Otherstone or chalk factory.
Stell einen &6Wegstein&r an einen sicher: Place a &6Waystone&r in a safe spot, for example next to your portal or at a fortress.
Stell einen &6Werfer&r vor das Schneideb: Place a &6dispenser&r in front of the cutting board and put a &6knife&r in it. Every redstone signal uses the knife on whatever is lying on the board.
Stell ihn direkt neben die Infusionsanla: Place it right next to the infuser; power goes across without cables too.
Stell ihn hin und schneide Stücke mit de: Place it and cut slices off with the knife. Four milk bottles come from one milk bucket and four glass bottles.
Stell ihn neben einen verbundenen Marker: Place it next to a connected Marker, then it takes over the area. Power through FE cables, the loot goes to a chest or a pipe next to it.
Stell ihn so ein, dass er den Reaktor be: Set it to shut the reactor down at too high a temperature or on damage, and test that once at a low burn rate. That is the most important quarter hour of this chapter.
Stell ihn vor das Ziel-Inventar, die and: Place it in front of the target inventory with the differently colored side pointing at it. On five sides it only accepts what matches the filter in its window, and passes it on to the target. It pulls nothing out by itself.
Stell in den oberen Plätzen ein, was sie: Set in the upper slots what it should keep in stock, then it fills itself from the network. What you push into it and is not set moves on into the network. It needs one channel and is the ingredient for the storage bus.
Stell mindestens &e4 Opferschalen&r im U: Put at least &e4 sacrificial bowls&r within 8 blocks with it. The preview in the Dictionary shows every sign.
Stell sie als Raster auf, eine pro Rezep: Set them up as a grid, one per recipe slot, and point their arrows at an output crafter with the wrench. Ingredients in, rotation on, and when every slot is filled they start.
Stell sie dort auf, wo ihr kämpft oder e: Set them up where you fight or gather: at the Afrit arena, at the boss spawn, in the farm.
Stell sie statt der goldenen Schale in d: Place it in the middle instead of the golden bowl. It works like the golden one, only every ritual runs &d4 times&r as fast. The Unbound Afrit for the essence then comes after less than 40 seconds instead of two and a half minutes.
Stell sie zwei Blöcke hoch neben die End: Place it two blocks high next to the Endoflames, chest and hopper above it.
Stellst du den Reaktor-Port auf den Sied: If you set the reactor port to boiling mode, the reactor makes steam instead of power. The turbine turns that steam into power. For large plants there is also a multiblock turbine.
Stellt die Zeit auf Tag oder Nacht. Mond: Sets the time to day or night. Moonfall is the fastest way to Wilden and witches.
Sternbunkel leben in bewaldeten Gegenden: Starbuncles live in wooded areas, often in archwood forests.
Stirbst du, bleibt dein &6Körper&r mit a: When you die, your &6body&r stays where it is with everything you had on you. Walk back, &eright click&r the body, take your things. It never disappears as long as something is in it, and turns into a skeleton after an hour, contents and all.
Stirbt ein Vertrauter, bleibt ein Seelen: When a familiar dies, a Soul Shard remains. With it you bring it back in Susje's Simple Circle.
Stolper über eine &6Festung&r und hak ab: Stumble upon a &6stronghold&r and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Strongholds&r builds them bigger, with libraries, prisons and traps.
Stranghouls leben im Sumpf in eigenen Hö: Stranghouls live in their own caves in the swamp and also trade for Malarite. But: anyone standing near them badly hurt looks like food to them. They fear silver weapons.
Strom (FE oder AE) kommt per Kabel. Mit: Power (FE or AE) comes by cable. With &6Acceleration Cards&r it works faster.
Power from anything that burns in a furnace.
Strom aus heiß und kalt, ohne bewegte Te: Power from hot and cold, without moving parts.
Power needs a processor of its own.
Power for items on the belt.
Power for everything in your hands.
Strom geht direkt ins Addon statt in die: Power goes straight into the addon instead of the machine: &e500,000 RF&r buffer, &e5,000 RF/t&r input. For when the machine's sides are already taken.
Strom ist freiwillig, &d500 FE&r pro Vor: Power is optional, &d500 FE&r per operation makes it faster. Several extractors may tap the same log.
Power without a cable, costs 2.5 percent.
Power instead of rotation, 80 blocks far.
Strom und Fleisch teilt sie mit allen an: It shares power and meat with all adjacent blocks of Mechanical Dirt. Lay out an area, put a Mob Crusher above it, and the mob farm is done.
Strom und Treibstoff für deine Ausrüstun: Power and fuel for your gear.
Power from the sky, by day only.
Strom, Gegenstände, Flüssigkeit in einem: Power, items, fluid in one block.
Strom, Werkzeug und Rüstung, Transport u: Power, tools and armor, transport and storage, dimensions and travel: one line per thing, one checkmark, sorted by stage. For looking things up, not for working through.
Power that hurts nobody any more.
