Stufe 2 der Robe: 2 Lohenruten, 2 500 Qu: Tier 2 of the robe: 2 blaze rods, 2,500 source.
Stufe 2 ist offen, Create bekommt seine: Stage 2 is open, Create gets its second half.
Stufe 2 ist offen, jetzt zeigt Botania,: Stage 2 is open, now Botania shows what it can do.
Stufe 2. Das zweite Buch, Relais, Ritual: Stage 2. The second book, relays, rituals, familiars, turrets and Create.
Stufe 2. Kräuter, Kessel, Kerzen und Bes: Stage 2. Herbs, cauldrons, candles and brooms.
Stufe 2. Manastahl, Runen, Terrastahl un: Stage 2. Manasteel, runes, Terrasteel and the Rune Core.
Stufe 2. Spiritfire, Kreide, Foliot und: Stage 2. Spiritfire, chalk, Foliot and Djinni.
Stufe 2: Gleise, Bahnhöfe und Züge, die: Stage 2: tracks, stations and trains that run by themselves.
Stufe 2: Koksofen, Stahl, Legierungen, W: Stage 2: Coke Oven, steel, alloys, wind and wire, tank and silo.
Stufe 2: Lohenbrenner, Messing, Präzisio: Stage 2: Blaze Burner, brass, precision mechanisms, the Brass Heart and the Create addons.
Stufe 2: Osmium, Stahl, Generatoren, Tan: Stage 2: osmium, steel, generators, tanks, gases and the first factories.
Stufe 2: hinein, Rohstoffe, Biome, Festu: Stage 2: in, resources, biomes, fortresses, bastions and the bosses Ignis and Netherite Monstrosity.
Stufe 3 gibt die meiste Mana-Regeneratio: Tier 3 gives the most mana regeneration and the largest thread slots. A whole set costs &d30,000 source&r from tier 1 on.
Stufe 3 und alles danach bleibt unsichtb: Stage 3 and everything after it stays invisible until its turn. That way you always see how much is coming, but the list is not flooded with things that are still weeks away.
Stufe 3. Das Elfenportal, jeder Tausch,: Stage 3. The elven portal, every trade, Elementium, fairies, ender essence, Corporea and the Elven Star.
Stufe 3. Die Chimäre, das Erzmagier-Buch: Stage 3. The Chimera, the archmage book, tier 3 glyphs, rituals and robes.
Stufe 3. Iesnium, Afrit-Essenz, gebunden: Stage 3. Iesnium, Afrit Essence, bound Afrit and the Marid.
Stufe 3. Seelen ernten, acht Arcana, Alt: Stage 3. Harvesting souls, eight arcana, altar, Crucible and totems.
Stufe 3. Seelen, Rituale, Zeichen, Gebet: Stage 3. Souls, rituals, signs, prayers and a dark patron.
Stufe 3. Spagyrik, Erzvermehrung, Logist: Stage 3. Spagyrics, ore multiplication, logistics and transmutation.
Stufe 3: Energizing Orb, Kristalle bis S: Stage 3: Energizing Orb, crystals up to Spirited, every generator tier, the reactor, cables and cells.
Stufe 3: Integrated Dynamics, XNet, Lase: Stage 3: Integrated Dynamics, XNet, LaserIO and Mining Gadgets.
Stufe 3: Katalysator und Portal, vier ne: Stage 3: Catalyst and portal, four new ores, the rotspawn, the catacombs and the way into the Depths.
Stufe 3: Latex und Kunststoff, vier Gehä: Stage 3: latex and plastic, four frames, fields, mobs, lasers and ore meat.
Stufe 3: Legierungen, Kondensatoren, Säg: Stage 3: alloys, capacitors, SAG Mill, conduits and the soul machines.
Stufe 3: Meteoriten, Prozessoren, das ME: Stage 3: meteorites, processors, the ME network up to 16k and autocrafting.
Stufe 3: Quarzeisen, Prozessoren aus dem: Stage 3: Quartz Enriched Iron, processors from the furnace, the network up to 16k, autocrafting and Cable Tiers.
Stufe 3: Schaltkreise mit Silizium, Tele: Stage 3: circuits with silicon, teleporter, Digital Miner, turbine and thermal evaporation.
Stufe 3: Stahl und Nickel, die Erzstraße: Stage 3: steel and nickel, the ore line, the laser, addons, Exo armor and the reactor.
Stufe 3: alle großen Multiblöcke, vom Ze: Stage 3: all the large multiblocks, from the Crusher to the Excavator.
Stufe 4. Blutkreise, Pulver und Rollen,: Stage 4. Blood circles, powders and scrolls, mana, the Fae, the Reality Marble and the Mystic Staff.
Stufe 4. Das Ritual von Gaia, der Wächte: Stage 4. The Ritual of Gaia, the Guardian and what its spirits become.
Stufe 4. Der Gatekeeper, das Portal, die: Stage 4. The Gatekeeper, the portal, the biomes, ores, scythes and the three bosses of the star dimension.
Stufe 4. Draconium aus dem End, Fusion S: Stage 4. Draconium from the End, fusion step by step, the Energy Core and the Wyvern tier.
Stufe 4. Glyphen aus dem End, Roben der: Stage 4. Glyphs from the End, third tier robes and the Chimera in detail.
Stufe 4: Elite und Ultimativ, Induktions: Stage 4: Elite and Ultimate, Induction Matrix, QIO, fusion and the MekaSuit.
Stufe 4: Uran, die Maschinen von Nuclear: Stage 4: uranium, NuclearCraft's machines, the fission reactor step by step and protection from radiation.
Stufe 4: der Drache, die äußeren Inseln,: Stage 4: the dragon, the outer islands, the citadel with the Ender Guardian and the draconium for the stage goal.
Stufe 4: der RFTools Builder, Quarry Plu: Stage 4: the RFTools Builder, Quarry Plus, the other ways and everything that keeps them running.
Stufe 4: große Zellen, Quantenbrücke, Ra: Stage 4: large cells, quantum bridge, spatial storage, MEGA Cells and Advanced AE.
Stufe 5: Brennstoff, Spaltreaktor, Polon: Stage 5: fuel, the fission reactor, polonium and plutonium, the SPS, antimatter and the millions in the ME network.
Stufe 5: Erwachtes Draconium, drakonisch: Stage 5: Awakened Draconium, Draconic gear, the Chaos Guardian and the reactor.
Stufe 5: das letzte Ziel, der Chaoswächt: Stage 5: the last goal, the Chaos Guardian and the end of the season.
Stufe 8 braucht 378 Erwachte und 786 nor: Tier 8 needs 378 Awakened and 786 normal Draconium Blocks and has no limit anymore. It comes in stage 5.
Stäbe machen Hitze. &6Heat Vents&r ziehe: Rods make heat. &6Heat Vents&r draw it off, &6Heat Absorbers&r below a &6Coolant Port&r with ice cool everything around them. All inner layers have to look the same.
Stäbe mit Strom auf Höchstgeschwindigkei: Rods with power at top speed.
Logs on the ground, the bar goes up.
Stämme durch heiße Luft, Kohle für die E: Logs through hot air, coal for the Endoflames.
Stämme geben mehr Bretter als in der Wer: Logs give more planks than in the crafting table, and it can do every stonecutter recipe. With several results you choose with a &6List Filter&r (iron nuggets and wool).
Stürzt das Spiel ab, öffne im Launcher d: If the game crashes, open the &einstance folder&r in the launcher. In it is &elogs/latest.log&r with everything the game did last, and in the &ecrash-reports&r folder a file with the date and time of the crash.
Substrat vermehrt sich in derselben Kamm: Substrate multiplies in the same chamber with water and ethene, one becomes eight. How ethene is made is in the chapter &5Mekanism&r.
Such auf den äußeren Inseln die drei End: Look for the three End biomes of Biomes O' Plenty on the outer islands and check off once you have entered one.
Such auf den äußeren Inseln eine &dEndsi: Look for an &dEnd City&r on the outer islands: tall towers of &6purpur&r with bridges and chests.
Such dir einen Platz, bau was Festes hin: Pick a spot, build something solid and secure it: &eM&r opens the map, &eC&r the claim view. Hold the &eleft mouse button&r and drag across the chunks of your base.
Such eine &6Netherfestung&r und bring &e: Look for a &6Nether fortress&r and bring &e16 Nether bricks&r out. Keep a lookout from above for dark walls over the lava lakes.
Such mit dem Kompass der Natur einen &dA: Look for an &darchwood forest&r with the Nature's Compass and tick this off when you stand in it.
Suppen und Eintöpfe geben meist Komfort,: Soups and stews usually give Comfort, big meals usually Nourishment. The duration is in the tooltip.
Suppen und Eintöpfe geben meist den Effe: Soups and stews usually give the &dComfort&r effect, see the quest after this one.
Säulen, Kristalle und Käfige kommen zurü: Pillars, crystals and cages come back, the dragon appears, the bell of YUNG's Better End Island rings.
Tafel aus Stufe 2: &5Ärgerlicher Stamm&r: Tablet from stage 2: &5Vexing log&r, &6compass&r, &6source gem&r, &6wayfinder&r. As an addition throw a &5purpur block&r onto the brazier.
Day or night at the push of a button.
Day, night and weather at the push of a button.
Tagsüber gezündet, spult es die Zeit vor: Lit during the day, it fast forwards time until sunset.
Talg im Kessel, Dipper darauf, &e3 Fäden: Tallow in the cauldron, dipper on it, &e3 strings&r on the dipper. Each string becomes a &6candle&r with &e50 mB&r of tallow. With an empty hand you take it off.
Tattered Cloth lassen &5Wraiths&r fallen: &5Wraiths&r drop Tattered Cloth. Their claws give Chilled, then you do not heal. Whatever undead the scythe kills leaves Soul Shards behind.
A thousand ingots for the tech pillar.
A thousand k in one cell.
Thousands of one kind in one block.
Technik braucht Magie, Magie braucht Tec: Tech needs magic, magic needs tech.
Technik, Magie oder beides. Der Server b: Tech, magic or both. The server needs both.
Technikblöcke aus Immersive Engineering: Engineering blocks from Immersive Engineering (with a Precision Mechanism), processors from AE2 or the CNC Stamper, elementium from a botanist. The obelisk wants &e8 Steel Cores&r.
Teil die Oberwelt-Koordinaten deines Zie: Divide the overworld coordinates of your destination by &e8&r, go there in the Nether and build a portal. One block in the Nether counts as eight up top.
Teilen verschießt mehrere Projektile mit: Split fires several projectiles with the whole spell. Orbit is a form: three orbs circle you and hit everything that gets too close, with Sensitive blocks too.
Teleporter, Miner und Maschinen haben im: Teleporters, miners and machines have a security switch in their window: &6Public&r, &6Private&r or &6Trusted&r (only players on your list).
Teleporter, Tragbarer Teleportierer und: The Teleporter, the Portable Teleporter and the Digital Miner need one, the miner even two. In stage 4 the Quantum Entangloporter and QIO come along.
Speed II from a little friend.
Termine für die Finale der Stufen und Ev: Dates for the stage finales and events are posted there first.
Terrastahl brauchst du für Terraklinge u: You need Terrasteel for the Terra Blade and armour, one per Rune Core, 50 for the obelisk and in stage 3 as nuggets for the portal and Natura Pylons.
Thoriumstaub im &6Irradiator&r zu TBP, d: Thorium dust in the &6Irradiator&r to TBP, then to protactinium 233. The &6Decay Hastener&r makes uranium 233, then &6bismuth dust&r. Bismuth in the Irradiator gives &6polonium dust&r. The &6Melter&r makes 90 mB per dust, the &6Crystallizer&r one &6Polonium Pellet&r from 1,000 mB.
Tiara plus eine &6Quarzsorte&r an der We: Tiara plus a &6quartz kind&r at the crafting table changes the wings. You can swap them back any time.
Tief in den Katakomben steht der &4Verge: Deep in the catacombs stands the &4Forgotten Guardian&r, a colossus of old metal. Slay it, ideally with two or three people.
Deep down, fireproof, worth every effort.
Deep down, for the Flux Gate.
Deep down, and not finished yet.
Tief unter der Erde findest du sie manch: Deep underground you sometimes find them in small patches too.
Tiere in der Nähe altern bei jedem Puls: Animals nearby age by &d25 seconds&r with every pulse. Young animals grow faster, chickens lay eggs more often, sheep eat grass more often, bees pollinate faster.
Tiere in der Nähe fressen daraus und ver: Animals nearby eat from it and breed on their own. Leather, meat and wool come along on the side.
Tomaten klettern an Strohseilen hoch und: Tomatoes climb up rope and bear fruit along their whole height. You need them for sauce, salad and burgers.
Trag ihn auf dem Rücken oder in der Hand: Wear it on your back or carry it in your hand; &eB&r opens it. How to make it bigger later is in the chapter &6Storage&r.
Potion clouds at the push of a button.
Transporter rein, Janitor raus: Das ist: Transporter in, Janitor out: that is your first automatic ore line. The brush itself wipes chalk signs away quickly.
Traumholz leitet Mana besser als Lebehol: Dreamwood conducts mana better than Livingwood. You need it for the Elven Mana Spreader and the Dreamwood Twigs.
Treffer über 20 werden gekappt, mehr als: Hits over 20 are capped, no more than 14 per second get through, and from 15 blocks away you barely do damage. It heals from its hits. Fire resistance, golden apples and lots of people.
Treppen, Türen und Truhen zerlegt es wie: It breaks stairs, doors and chests back down into wood. Sawdust becomes the Cardboard Box, with which you move blocks with their contents.
Tresore haben keine Oberfläche. Du fülls: Vaults have no screen. You fill and empty them with funnels, chutes, belts or packages.
Tribute wollen auch das Erzmagier-Buch,: Tributes are also wanted by the archmage book, the Marks of Mastery and Technomancy, the Focus of Summoning and the third level of Ars Additions' Spellweave enchantment. Build up a stock early.
Trichter am Boden sammeln Knochen, Pfeil: Hoppers on the floor collect bones, arrows, flesh and gunpowder. An &6Encased Fan&r pushes hesitant monsters to the hole.
Trichter oben, Trichter unten, und du ge: Hopper on top, hopper below, and you go to sleep.
Trichter oder Rohre füllen Eisen und Kok: Hoppers or pipes refill iron and Coke Dust from above, a chest at the front takes the steel. The Crusher supplies the Coke Dust.
Triff den &5Enderdrachen&r im Flug mit P: Hit the &5Ender Dragon&r with arrows while it flies. When it lands on the fountain in the middle, it is the sword's turn.
Trifft ein Manastoß die Trommel, reißt s: When a mana burst hits the drum, it tears out all plant growth around it, just like the horn. It stores no mana, so it needs a &6Pulse Mana Spreader&r on a redstone clock.
Trifft ein Shulker-Geschoss ein Monster: If a shulker projectile hits a monster within its radius, both die and it gives &d75,000 mana&r. Its buffer has to be empty for that. Loot and experience are lost.
Trifft es etwas Brennendes, explodieren: If it hits something burning, sparks explode and hit everything nearby. &eProjectile, Ignite, Flare&r is the classic combat spell.
Drinks water and turns it into mana.
Trog, Nest und Markt stehen im Kapitel &: Trough, nest and market are in the &6Food and Farming&r chapter (animals and market).
Truhe, Trichter, Offene Kiste über den E: Chest, hopper, Open Crate above the Endoflames. A &6pressure plate&r under the drop spot locks the hopper while coal is still lying there, so never too much falls.
Truhen und Fässer nehmen fast dieselben: Chests and barrels take almost the same upgrades as the backpack. A finished upgrade can be converted between backpack and storage; EMI shows the recipes.
Potions automatically, and Source from them.
Potions with mana instead of a brewing stand.
Tränke werfen, ohne Spritztränke zu brau: Throw potions without brewing splash potions.
Tut ein Zauber nicht, was er soll, schau: If a spell doesn't do what it should, check the order of the augments first.
Töpfe, Böden und Werkzeugplatz stehen im: Pots, soils and the tool slot are in the &6Cooking&r chapter (botany pots).
Töte &65 Moderlinge&r und sammle &68 Uth: Kill &65 Rotlings&r and collect &68 Utheric Shards&r. All rotspawn drop shards.
Killing without mana, spawning without a spawner.
Türme, die von selbst feuern und überall: Turrets that fire by themselves and aim anywhere.
Ultimative Schaltkreise stecken in QIO,: Ultimate Control Circuits go into QIO, the Quantum Entangloporter, fusion, the MekaSuit and the machines of ore quintupling. Make more right away.
Um die Ecke kommst du nur mit Zahnrädern: You only get around a corner with cogwheels or a gearbox. The wrench turns a placed shaft.
Um ihn liegt ein Feld von &e25x25&r. Mit: Around it lies a &e25x25&r field. With a redstone signal it calculates one step twice per second: cells with 2 or 3 neighbors survive, empty ones with exactly 3 come alive.
Umgekehrt macht der Oxidierer aus einem: In reverse the Oxidizer turns a pellet back into 1,000 mB of gas. That is how you store antimatter.
Und umgekehrt: Wenn dich jemand im Chat: And the other way round: if someone asks you in chat how a water wheel works, answer. That is how Kronwerke works.
Unreine weiße Kreide ist die Basis aller: Impure white chalk is the base of all 16 chalk colours. Each is mixed with additives and finally purified in Spiritfire.
Unten &6Stahlgerüst, Redstone-Ingenieurs: At the bottom &6Steel Scaffolding, Redstone Engineering Block, Steel Scaffolding&r, in the middle &6conveyor belt, piston, conveyor belt&r in the same direction, on top of the piston a &6Heavy Engineering Block&r. Hammer on the piston.
Under swamps lie &6selenite geodes&r. Break the clusters off, then you get &6Selenite Shards&r.
Unter ein Manabecken gestellt, macht das: Placed below a Mana Pool, the pool makes two of each from &eredstone&r, &eglowstone dust&r, &equartz&r, &ecoal&r, snow, netherrack, soul sand, gravel, leaves or grass.
Unter einem Becken glimmt er nur. Mit Of: Under a basin it only smoulders. With furnace fuel (coal, wood) it is &cheated&r, with a &6Blaze Cake&r &csuperheated&r for a while. A funnel or an arm feeds it.
Unter einem Becken heizt er den Mixer fü: Under a basin it heats the mixer for &6brass&r. How it continues is in the &6Create: Brass&r chapter.
Unter einem Becken nimmt das Becken imme: Under a pool, the pool always accepts and destroys whatever no longer fits. That way Endoflames keep running instead of leaving coal lying around.
Unterm Strich gibt ein Rohes Eisen hier: All in all one raw iron gives &e2 ingots&r here, 1.33 in the Pulverizer, 1 in the furnace. Plus nickel on the side. Gold, copper, nickel and platinum run the same way.
Unterwegs schlafen, ohne den Spawnpunkt: Sleep on the road without losing your spawn point.
Unbreakable as long as there is power.
Fit upgrades, and the first one right away.
Upgrades stecken links neben dem Rucksac: Upgrades go left of the backpack inventory. The leather backpack has only one slot, so you swap them depending on the day: mining, building, farming.
Upgrades steckst du in die vier Plätze r: You put upgrades into the four slots on the right of the window of the Importer, Exporter and so on. Speed: faster, 4 FE/t more. Stack: a whole stack per operation instead of one item, 16 FE/t more.
Uran kommt aus der Erzleiter, siehe Kapi: Uranium comes from the ore ladder, see the chapter &5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r.
Uranhexafluorid in die &6Isotopenzentrif: Uranium hexafluoride into the &6Isotopic Centrifuge&r. 1 mB gives &e1 mB of fissile fuel&r.
Uraninit-Erz gibt es in drei Sorten: arm: Uraninite ore comes in three kinds: poor below &eY 64&r, normal below &eY 20&r, dense below &eY 0&r. &6Raw Uraninite&r gives two &6Uraninite&r in the orb for 2,000 FE. An ore block mined with Silk Touch gives 3, 5 or 10 there, depending on the kind.
Uranoxid und Flusssäure in den &6Chemisc: Uranium oxide and hydrofluoric acid into the &6Chemical Infuser&r. 1 mB of each gives &e2 mB of uranium hexafluoride&r.
Uranoxid, Uranhexafluorid, Flusssäure, S: Uranium oxide, uranium hexafluoride, hydrofluoric acid, fissile fuel, nuclear waste, polonium, plutonium, antimatter and superheated sodium come with stage 5.
Uranstraße, Kühlung mit Reserve, eine Ki: A uranium line, cooling with reserve, a chest for spent fuel far away from you. Check every change at the controller first, then leave.
Utheriumwaffen machen gegen Moderwesen &: Utherium weapons deal &e1.5 times&r as much damage against rotspawn. There are also tools and armor made of Utherium. Old Utherium parts turn back into crystals in a blast furnace.
Verabredet feste Abende für Kämpfe gegen: Agree on fixed evenings for fights against the &aGuardian of Gaia&r. Every player in the fight gets &e6 Gaia Spirits&r, whoever lands the last hit &e8&r.
Verarbeitungsschablone an der Gravurmasc: A processing pattern at the Inscriber.
Verarbeitungsschablonen für Gedrucktes S: Processing patterns for Printed Silicon (Inscriber), Infused Alloy and Basic Control Circuits (two Metallurgic Infusers), and a crafting pattern in the assembler for the &6Advanced Control Circuit&r. Order 64.
Verbinde sie mit dem &6Dominion-Zauberst: Connect it to your Petal Apothecary (or a cauldron) with the &6Dominion Wand&r. When the apothecary is empty, the urn refills it for a little Source.
Verbindet, dreht und misst alles in Bota: Binds, rotates and measures everything in Botania.
Verbrenn &e32 Holzkohle&r. Holzkohle aus: Burn &e32 charcoal&r. Charcoal from tree farm and furnace is the fuel that never runs out.
Burn it or into the ender chest.
Verdächtige Samen fallen manchmal, wenn: Suspicious Seeds sometimes drop when you set bedrock on fire for Grains of Infinity.
Verdünnte Ender-Essenz mit dem Seelendol: Diluted Ender Essence with the Soulscribe.
Verfallene Warp-Portale stehen dort, wo: Ruined warp portals stand where normal ruined portals appear. Next to the portal is a chest with sourcestone, codex pages and an &6Explorer's Warp Scroll&r.
Vergessene Hallen unter dem Vergessenen: Forgotten halls below the Forgotten Field.
Vergessene Waffen machen gegen Undergard: Forgotten weapons deal &e1.5 times&r as much damage against Undergarden mobs (except bosses). The &6Forgotten Battleaxe&r needs a Cloggrum Battleaxe, which only the Forgotten drop.
Vergleich im Programmer mit einer festen: Compare it in the programmer with a fixed number, and a Redstone Writer switches a lamp as soon as enough steel is ready. Then the walk to the obelisk is worth it.
Vergrößert den Bereich um das Ziel. &ePr: Enlarges the area around the target. &eProjectile, Break, AOE&r mines 3x3, AOE twice 5x5. Each AOE costs more mana; don't try it under your own feet.
Verleg das Gleis bis in ein &cNetherport: Lay the track right into a &cNether portal&r. Create continues the line on the other side.
Verletzt mit Mana ständig alle Lebewesen: Constantly hurts all living things nearby with mana, except players. Under a spawner it kills without a weapon.
Verletzt nur &eausgewachsene Tiere&r, Ju: Only hurts &eadult animals&r, the young ones stay. In a pen with a hopper underneath it supplies meat and leather on its own. More animal farms in the &aFirst Farms&r chapter.
Verlängern streckt Tränke, Beschwörungen: Extend stretches potions, summons and buffs. Duration Down makes Delay and Redstone Signal shorter and expensive buffs cheaper.
Survey, drill, read the core sample.
Verschiedene Leitungen teilen sich &eein: Different conduits share &eone block&r without mixing. Energetic or Vibrant Alloy gives faster tiers. The numbers are in the checklist &eTransport&r.
Verschießt Tränke aus deinen Trankflasch: It fires potions from your potion flasks as a lingering cloud. Together with Wixie potions a good weapon against groups.
Verstärkte Legierung in die Ecken, Elite: Reinforced Alloy in the corners, Elite Control Circuits at the top and bottom, stone left and right, Steel Casing in the middle.
Vertraute folgen dir und geben Boni. Der: Familiars follow you and give bonuses. The Greedy picks up items within 32 blocks for you. In the &6Familiar Ring&r (Strigeor's Higher Binding) it increases your pickup radius.
Verwandelt Sand in der Nähe für etwas Ma: Turns sand nearby into clay balls for a little mana. With a Hopperhock next to it, the clay lands straight in the chest.
Verweilen, Wand und Gleiten brauchen Dra: Linger, Wall and Glide need dragon's breath or elytra and come in stage 4.
Verzauberte Bücher kosten viel Erfahrung: Enchanted books cost a lot of experience, but then one good enchantment is enough for the whole server.
Verzauberungen bleiben. Sie schlägt härt: Enchantments stay. It hits harder, lasts longer and still harvests arcana.
A lot of power, and it can explode.
Viele Dörfer haben einen &6Wegstein&r un: Many villages have a &6Waystone&r and a &6Bounty Board&r. Don't build right in the middle and keep the villagers alive; the rest of the server trades with them too.
Viele Quests geben &6Kisten&r: &7Steinki: Many quests give &6crates&r: &7Stone Crate&r, &fIron Crate&r and &6Gold Crate&r, better in that order. Right-click opens them. A Gold Crate waits at the end of this chapter.
Viele Waffen und Rüstungen aus Truhen un: Many weapons and armour pieces from chests and monsters carry Apotheosis &6affixes&r. The colour of the name shows the rarity: &7Common&r, &aUncommon&r, &9Rare&r, &5Epic&r, &6Mythic&r.
Vier &6Andesitgehäuse&r um ein &6Großes: Four &6Andesite Casings&r around a &6Large Cogwheel&r make two &6Chain Conveyors&r. Put them on powered shafts and connect them with &6chains&r, up to &e32 blocks&r, up to four connections per conveyor.
Vier &6Diamanten&r im Plus um einen &6Wy: Four &6diamonds&r in a plus around a &6Wyvern Energy Controller&r. Gives four &bBasic Energy Relay Crystals&r.
Vier &6Draconiumblöcke&r kommen als Stap: Four &6Draconium Blocks&r go into the Fusion Crafting Core as a stack. That is 36 ingots per fusion, 576 for the whole goal.
Vier &6Draconiumkerne&r: Draconiumbarren: Four &6Draconium Cores&r: Draconium Ingots in the corners, Deepsilver on the sides, diamond in the middle. They go into the injectors.
Vier &6Einfache Maschinenkerne&r in die: Four &6Basic Machine Cores&r in the corners, &6plating&r on the sides, one &6Duratium&r in the middle.
Vier &6Eisenbarren&r im Kreuz, Mitte fre: Four &6iron ingots&r in a cross, middle empty, make an &6Iron Gear&r. The same with four &6gold ingots&r and four &6diamonds&r.
Vier &6Eisenbarren&r im Quadrat oben rec: Four &6iron ingots&r in a square at the top right, a &6brick&r at the bottom left as the handle.
Vier &6Eisenbarren&r in die Ecken und vi: Four &6iron ingots&r in the corners and four &6Treated Wood Planks&r on the sides, middle empty, make four &6Basic Engineering Blocks&r.
Vier &6Eisenbarren&r in die Ecken, vier: Four &6iron ingots&r in the corners, four &6grains&r on the sides, the middle stays empty.
Vier &6Eisenbarren&r, zwei Paste und ein: Four &6iron ingots&r, two paste and a &6redstone block&r give four &6Basic Capacitors&r. One comes apart at the crafting table into two &6Tiny&r ones, two make a &6Large&r one.
Vier &6Eisenblechblöcke&r in die Ecken,: Four &6Iron Sheetmetal&r in the corners, four &6Iron Mechanical Components&r on the sides, a &6brass sheet&r in the middle make four &6Light Engineering Blocks&r.
Vier &6Eisenblechblöcke&r oben, darunter: Four &6Iron Sheetmetal&r on top, below a &6Fluid Pipe&r and an &6External Heater&r make the &6Blast Furnace Preheater&r.
Vier &6Eisenbleche&r in die Ecken, ein &: Four &6Iron Plates&r in the corners, one &6copper ingot&r in the middle make an &6Iron Mechanical Component&r.
Vier &6Eisenbleche&r und vier &6Eimer&r: Four &6iron plates&r and four &6buckets&r make the &6Jerrycan&r. It holds &e10 buckets&r.
Vier &6Infundierte Legierungen&r im Kreu: Four &6Infused Alloys&r in a cross around a &6Basic Control Circuit&r.
Vier &6Kunststoff&r im Kreuz um eine &6G: Four &6Plastic&r in a cross around a &6ghast tear&r make the &6Mob Imprisonment Tool&r.
Vier &6Kupferdraht&r, zwei &6Karton&r un: Four &6copper wire&r, two &6cardboard&r and one &6stick&r make a &6copper coil&r.
Vier &6Kupferkabel&r um einen &6Stock&r: Four &6Copper Wire&r around a &6stick&r make four &6LV Wire Coils&r.
Vier &6LV-Drahtspulen&r an die Seiten, f: Four &6LV Wire Coils&r on the sides, five &6Tough Fabric&r in the corners and the middle make four &6Insulated LV Wire Coils&r.
Vier &6Messingbleche&r und eine &6Andesi: Four &6brass sheets&r and one &6andesite alloy&r make a &6Brass Hand&r: alloy on top, three sheets in the middle, one at the bottom.
Vier &6Netherquarz&r oder ein Quarzblock: Four &6Nether quartz&r or one quartz block give one &6Fused Quartz&r. A &6glass&r on its own becomes &6Clear Glass&r.
Vier &6Netherziegel&r in die Ecken, vier: Four &6nether bricks&r in the corners, four &6bricks&r on the sides, one &6magma block&r in the middle make three &6Blast Bricks&r.
Vier &6Osmiumbarren&r an die Seiten, Red: Four &6osmium ingots&r on the sides, redstone in the corners: a &6Basic Chemical Tank&r for &e64,000 mB&r of gas. Two steel and glass give eight &6Pressurized Tubes&r.
Vier &6Quantentunnelringe&r in die Ecken: Four &6Quantum Rings&r in the corners, an &6Advanced Card&r in the middle, a &6Quantum Link Chamber&r in the bottom middle.
Vier &6Redstone&r und ein &6Wassereimer&: Four &6redstone&r and a &6water bucket&r, shapeless in the crafting table, make a &6Bucket of Redstone Acid&r.
Vier &6Sand&r, zwei &6Tonklumpen&r, zwei: Four &6sand&r, two &6clay balls&r, two &6gravel&r and a &6water bucket&r make &e8 concrete&r. The Mixer makes &6Liquid Concrete&r: poured out it flows like water and sets after a while. Whoever stands in it then is stuck.
Vier &6Seelenketten&r in die Ecken, vier: Four &6Soul Chains&r in the corners, four &6Soularium Ingots&r on the sides, a &6Nether quartz&r in the middle. Soul Chain: one Soularium, two Soularium nuggets, two quartz dust, gives two.
Vier &6Solargeneratoren&r, zwei Legierun: Four &6Solar Generators&r, two alloys, three iron. It delivers &d120 FE/t&r by day, six times as much as a single one.
Vier &6Stahlbleche&r im Kreuz ergeben vi: Four &6Steel Plates&r in a cross make four &6Steel Sheetmetal&r. Three of them side by side make six slabs.
Vier &6Sägespäne&r aus dem Präzisionssäg: Four &6sawdust&r from the Precision Sawmill in a square make a &6Cardboard Box&r.
Vier &6Ton&r in die Ecken, vier &6Ziegel: Four &6clay&r in the corners, four &6bricks&r on the sides, one &6sandstone&r in the middle make three &6Coke Bricks&r.
Vier &6Wasserradsegmente&r (Behandeltes: Four &6Waterwheel Segments&r (Treated Wood and Treated Sticks) around a &6steel ingot&r make the &6Water Wheel&r.
Vier &6Zahnräder&r um ein &6Andesitgehäu: Four &6Cogwheels&r around an &6Andesite Casing&r make a &6Gearbox&r. It takes rotation on one side and passes it to the others, also at 90 degrees.
Vier &6Zirkoniumbarren&r in die Ecken, &: Four &6zirconium ingots&r in the corners, &6glass&r on the sides, middle empty. Gives one &6Solid Fuel Cell&r.
Vier &6Zuckerrohr&r, Bambus oder Setzlin: Four &6sugar cane&r, bamboo or saplings with &b250 mB water&r in the mixer make &6Pulp&r, the press turns it into &6Cardboard&r. Four cardboard are a &6Cardboard Block&r.
Vier &cPlutonium-Pellets&r in die Ecken,: Four &cPlutonium Pellets&r in the corners, four normal &6QIO Drives&r on the sides, a Teleportation Core in the middle.
Vier Abende, an denen der Server zusamme: Four evenings when the server comes together.
Vier Agglomerate einer Sorte sind das Ma: Four Agglomeratio of one kind are the material for the matching &eelement seed&r in the altar, together with 4 Inferium Essence. Water and Fire Essence already have recipes, Air and Earth you collect for the &6Awakening Altar&r in &cstage 4&r.
Four pendants for the neck slot.
Four blocks high, with an arm for the wire.
Vier Blöcke um einen Fortgeschrittenen S: Four blocks around an Advanced Control Circuit give a &6valve&r.
Vier Dinge, ohne die du nicht hinfliegst: Four things you do not fly there without.
Vier Eisenwerkzeuge werden zu einem Buch: Four iron tools become a book.
Vier Früchte, die du in den Truhen von N: Four fruits you find in the chests of Nexus towers and Arcane Libraries:
Vier Fächer mit je &e8 Stapeln&r, die be: Four compartments with &e8 stacks&r each, the best choice for many kinds: ores, ingots, dyes, mob drops. With the Deposit Upgrade in the backpack you stock the wall with one click per drawer.
Vier Gaia-Seelen um einen Terrastahlbarr: Four Gaia Spirits around a Terrasteel Ingot make the &dGaia Spirit Ingot&r. Offered to the beacon, it starts the &dRitual of Gaia II&r with a stronger Guardian.
Four gem blocks and a Source Jar.
Four crystals on the rim of the portal.
Vier Kupferkabel um eine &6leere Spule&r: Four copper wires around an &6empty spool&r (iron sheets and iron rod, 24 pieces) make a &6copper spool&r.
Vier Niotic-Kristalle in die Ecken, zwei: Four Niotic Crystals in the corners, two &6Niotic Capacitors&r at the top and bottom, two &6Blazing Energy Cells&r left and right, the casing in the middle.
Four scraps, four gold, one ingot.
Vier Plutonium-Pellets in die Ecken, vie: Four Plutonium Pellets in the corners, four &6Hyper-Dense Drives&r on the sides, a &bPolonium Pellet&r in the middle. It holds &e1,048,000 items&r in &e1,024 types&r.
Vier Polonium und ein Plutonium pro Bloc: Four polonium and one plutonium per block.
Vier Rahmen um einen Ultimativen Schaltk: Four frames around an Ultimate Control Circuit give two &6Fusion Reactor Ports&r. Plan on a few dozen frames.
Vier Reaktorblöcke der Stufe darunter in: Four reactor blocks of the tier below in the corners, four capacitors of the new tier on the sides (Basic: Large), one &6uraninite&r in the middle, gives four. For one reactor 36 again.
Vier Runen: &5Eldritch&r, &dArcane&r und: Four runes: &5Eldritch&r, &dArcane&r and two &cInfernal&r, but on a totem of &6Soulwood&r. On Runewood the same runes give the &eRite of Smelting&r, which smelts blocks below the spark.
Four coils from nickel and steel.
Vier Stabilisatoren sind vier Gaia-Seele: Four stabilizers are four Gaia Spirits. They only come from the &aGuardian of Gaia&r: every player in the fight gets 6, whoever lands the last hit 8. So one fight with the mages is enough.
Vier Stahl um einen Eimer geben vier &6D: Four steel around a bucket give four &6Dynamic Tanks&r, four of them around a circuit two &6Dynamic Valves&r. Build a hollow box, at least 3 by 3 by 3, walls also from Structural Glass.
Vier Stahl um einen Kupferbarren geben v: Four steel around a copper ingot give four &6Thermal Evaporation Blocks&r. For a small tower you need about three dozen.
Four pieces in a cross, one gear.
Vier Stück, für jeden Stabilisator einen: Four of them, one for each stabilizer. You get the blaze rods from the Nether.
Four pieces of lead, one dosimeter.
Four pieces, four kinds of radiation.
Vier Weizen ergeben &6Packed Wheat&r. Mi: Four wheat make &6Packed Wheat&r. With &e250 mB&r of water it becomes &6Raw Biopolymer&r, which with &e500 mB&r of water becomes a &6Plastic Sheet&r.
Four tools, all made of parts.
Four wool around an ingot or brick. It makes machines quieter, nothing more. Worth gold for streamers with many machines next to the microphone.
Four old blocks, four new ones.
Vier davon werden eine Graphitelektrode,: Four of them become one Graphite Electrode, one a HOP graphite plate for the HV Accumulator. So for three electrodes you need &e96 Coke Dust&r.
Vier davon werden in Stufe 3 zum Erweite: In stage 3, four of them become the Advanced Solar Generator with 120 FE/t.
Vier geplatzte ergeben vier &6Purpurblöc: Four popped ones make four &6purpur blocks&r, one with a blaze rod an &6End Rod&r. Eaten, a fruit teleports you randomly, a gamble over the void.
Four small ones become a large one.
Four times the power from iron.
Four times the room, the same types.
Four times the power of copper.
Forty of each element for later.
Violett bindet Geister in Gegenstände. D: Purple binds spirits into items. The first pentacle for that is Eziveus' Spectral Compulsion.
Voll geladen von den Laserbohrern erzeug: Fully charged by the Laser Drills, it produces one ore. Every ore has a weight depending on biome and the depth you set: raw iron between Y 5 and 68 weight 20, otherwise 3. EMI shows all values.
Voll ist er nach &e256 Scherben&r. Dann: It is full after &e256 shards&r. Then it needs less power and digs up to &e20&r more blocks per tick. The Infuser draws 600 RF/t.
Full batteries for the staff and friends.
Volle Schildmodule, ein Untod-Modul und: Full shield modules, an Undying Module and flight belong on everyone who fights along.
Vom Kristallwüstensand bis in den Abgrun: From crystal desert sand down into the abyss.
Vom Smogstielwald bis in die Infizierten: From the Smogstem Forest to the Infected Depths.
Vom ersten Quelljuwel zur ersten Ars-Bas: From the first Source Gem to the first Ars base.
From base to base in one step.
Von Bruchstein und Wasserrädern bis zur: From cobblestone and waterwheels to antimatter and chaos: you built this together. Thanks to everyone who played, watched and helped.
Von Gelbkuchen bis Brennstoff: ein Uranb: From Yellow Cake to fuel: one uranium ingot becomes 1,000 mB of fuel. At first the reactor burns 0.1 mB per tick.
Von Spawn bis zur ersten Abgabe in zehn: From spawn to your first delivery in ten steps, then obelisk, milestones, stages and every chapter of stage 1.
From the chamber into the chest.
Von oben siehst du weit. Dazu baut die M: From the top you see far. On top of that the mod builds wells, bunkers, a trident monument and small combat shrines in five tiers.
Von unten: &6Lohenbrenner&r mit Kohle, &: From the bottom: &6Blaze Burner&r with coal, &6basin&r, one block of air, &6Mechanical Mixer&r. In: &6two copper ingots&r, &6one zinc ingot&r, &6one blaze powder&r.
Vor allem ist es Zutat: Energie-Würfel,: Above all it is an ingredient: Energy Cube, Wind and Solar Generator, Rotary Condensentrator, laser and induction cells need it.
Vor dem Start einen Block auf das Becken: Before starting, throw a block onto the brazier, like zinc ore. After that you see every block of that kind through the ground: white close, green medium, blue far. With a Manipulation Essence added, for &e15 minutes&r.
Vor den Stundenzeiger kannst du ein zwei: In front of the hour hand you can place a second structure that turns as the minute hand. The two must not be glued together. Right click the bearing to start and stop the clock.
Place its front against a &6log&r. It pulls out &6latex&r: &eacacia and mangrove 4 mB&r per operation, cherry and dark oak 3, oak, birch, spruce and jungle 2, all other logs 1. The log is stripped first, then used up.
Völlerei brauchst du für den &6Mampftau&: You need Gluttony for the &6Munchdew&r, in stage 3 for Kekimurus and Loonium.
W, S, and A and D at junctions.
Growth by hand, three by three tiles.
Wagen, Sitze, Kisten, Deko: was auf den: Carriages, seats, chests, decoration: whatever is glued to the bogeys rides along.
Wann kommt der nächste Zug?: When does the next train come?
Warte auf einen &eMeteorschauer&r. Große: Wait for a &emeteor shower&r. Big meteors strike and leave &6Raw Aethersent&r behind. In a furnace it becomes an &6Aethersent Ingot&r. Collect 4.
Was Stufe 2 bringt und was du jetzt scho: What stage 2 brings and what you can already do now.
Was Verbündete in deinen Chunks dürfen,: What allies may do in your chunks is set in your team's settings, such as breaking blocks or opening chests. That way your neighbour can supply your factory with ore without sharing your quests or your 500 chunks.
What lies on the ground comes to you.
Was anbeißt, kommt als lebender Fisch he: Whatever bites comes out as a live fish: &6Searing Cod&r, &6Bonefish&r, &6Glowdine&r, lava pufferfish and more. Some kinds only live in certain biomes, like the &6Soul Sucker&r in the soul sand valley.
What the End gives for the stage goal.
Was der Ofen verschwendet, holst du zurü: What the furnace wastes, you get back.
Was der Reaktor übrig lässt, ist der Roh: What the reactor leaves behind is the raw material.
What the fission reactor brings along.
What the Chimera does in the fight.
What you pick up lands in the backpack.
What it throws away at once.
Was es sonst noch umwandelt: Eis zu Pack: What else it converts: ice to packed ice, packed ice to blue ice, a water source to snow, netherrack to cobblestone, soul sand to sand. The two Nether blocks are available from stage 2.
What else there is for Create.
Was hineingeht, ist egal. Bruchstein, Er: What goes in does not matter. Cobblestone, dirt, netherrack all count the same. A quarry and an export bus feed it without a break.
Was hineinkommt und ein 2x2-Rezept hat,: Whatever comes in and has a 2x2 recipe, it presses into a block right away: quartz, clay, snow. 3x3 like ingots into blocks needs the &6Advanced Compacting Upgrade&r.
What waits behind the steel goal.
What the archmage book is still missing.
Was im Filter steht, wird beim Ankommen: Whatever is in the filter is destroyed on arrival. Good for dirt, gravel, diorite.
Was in dem Block liegt, siehst du in der: What lies in that block shows in the terminal, and the network stores into it. Drawers count no types, so a drawer wall with a storage bus is often better than a cell. How to build the wall is in the chapter &6Storage&r.
Was jede erzeugende Blume pro Stück brin: What each generating flower brings per piece.
Was man aus den Samen der Stufe 1 bauen: What you can build from the stage 1 seeds.
Was man aus den Scherben baut, steht im: What you build from the shards is in the chapter &5Draconic: Awakened and Chaos&r. Whoever builds something from them writes the last chapter of this world.
What already works before the fight.
Was sie liefern, trägst du zum Obelisken: What they yield you carry to the obelisk.
Was sie mit Erz macht, steht im Kapitel: What it does with ore is in the &5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r chapter. Here you need it for enriched carbon, redstone and diamond, which give eight times as much infusion type.
What else walks in the dark.
What opens when, and what fits in.
What, where to, on which channel.
Wasser auf dem Spawnerboden schwemmt die: Water on the spawner floor washes the monsters to the shaft. With &6spawner runes&r you change rate, count and range; the &6Frontiersman's Rune&r makes 7 monsters per spawn at 24 blocks activation.
Wasser durch ein Ventil hinein, Wärme da: Water in through one valve, heat added, &bsteam&r out of another valve that you set to output with the Configurator. The steam drives the Industrial Turbine.
Wasser durchs Ventil hinein: &e10 mB Was: Water in through the valve: &e10 mB of water&r become &e1 mB of brine&r, and brine sent in a second time gives lithium, also 10 to 1. The higher the tower and the warmer it is, the faster.
Water and lava out of the area.
Water and lava, with power only.
Water becomes brine, brine becomes lithium.
Wasser wird zu Dampf. Den schickst du in: Water becomes steam. You send it into the &6Industrial Turbine&r from stage 3. Only raise the burn rate once cooling and turbine keep up.
Wasserrad, Wellen und Zahnräder treiben: Water wheel, shafts and cogwheels drive millstone, press and mixer. In stage 1 it goes up to andesite, and that is exactly what fills the tech pillar.
Weck die &cNetherite Monstrosity&r in de: Wake the &cNetherite Monstrosity&r in the forge and defeat it: &e600 health&r, armour 12, lava bombs, flame beam and flare bombs.
Weich bremst das Tempo, je abgenutzter d: Soft slows the speed the more worn the tool is. Enchants well (15).
Weich seinen Fangzähnen aus dem Boden au: Dodge its fangs from the ground and kill the Vexes first. It always drops a &6Totem of Undying&r. Hold it in your off hand and it saves you from death once.
Soft fibers for cord and binding.
Weichen, Kuppler, Dieselmotoren, Spawnfl: Switches, couplings, diesel engines, spawn fluids and the rest are in &6Create: Addons&r.
Weit draußen im End liegt die &5Chaosins: Far out in the End lies Draconic Evolution's &5Chaos Island&r. For the finale in &estage 5&r the obelisk takes everyone there (chapter &5The Finale&r).
On as soon as nobody is looking.
Weitere Inseln liegen 10 000 Blöcke weit: More islands lie 10,000 blocks further, each with a Guardian of its own.
Weitere Pfeifen auf die gesetzte gesteck: More whistles stacked onto the placed one lower the tone, the wrench switches between 3 octaves.
Weitere Verbindungen stimmst du ab, inde: You tune further links by clicking an old one with them before placing. All of this already works in stage 1, without any power.
Weißt du nicht mehr, wo das war: &eU&r ö: If you can't remember where it was: &eU&r opens the &edeath history&r with dimension, position and time of every death. Write down the coordinates or set a waypoint.
Wenn das Ritual die letzte Zutat verbrau: When the ritual uses up the last ingredient, it destroys all undead nearby and leaves &dSoul Shards&r behind. Set it up at night or trap zombies in a pit next to it.
Wenn dich ein Pfeil treffen würde, sprin: When an arrow would hit you, you jump to a random spot nearby instead, like an enderman. Costs &d50 mana&r and gives a fixed number of jumps, not a fixed time.
Wenn du nicht weiterkommst: Erst &eR&r u: If you get stuck: first &eR&r and &eU&r in EMI, then the matching &echapter&r in the book, then &echat&r or &evoice chat&r. Thirty people on the server, one of them has surely built that machine already. For anything technical (crash, installation, whitelist) there is the &9Discord&r, and &ekronwerke.com&r has the most common questions and the state of the obelisk.
If it flows, it belongs in a pipe.
Wenn sich das Glas sichtbar füllt und di: When the jar visibly fills and the chamber works faster, your first Source is running. From now on amethyst is the only bottleneck.
Wer Kronwerke schon kennt, überfliegt di: If you already know Kronwerke, skim the &eRules&r row and pick up the rest along the way.
Wer die MekaSuit trägt, nimmt statt des: Whoever wears the MekaSuit takes the Radiation Shielding Unit instead of the suit: Infused Alloy, a lead block, Module Base and HDPE.
Who you are changes how you play.
Wer hindurchläuft, nimmt Schaden. Als Za: Whoever walks through takes damage. As a fence around the base it stops monsters, in a mob farm shaft it helps finish them off.
Wer ihn besiegt, bekommt ein Artefakt. S: Whoever defeats it gets an artifact. Hit a campsite chest once as a test before you open it.
Wer jetzt Messingbleche und Präzisionsme: Whoever puts brass sheets and precision mechanisms aside now builds the large machines at once in stage 3. Trade your coke and steel for the brass of the Create players.
Wer lieber mit Strom gräbt, nimmt den At: If you would rather dig with power, take the Atomic Disassembler further down.
Wer noch nie ein Modpack gespielt hat, l: If you have never played a modpack, read all of it. Everyone else should at least look at the &ekeys&r; some are bound twice.
Wer näher als &e48 Blöcke&r ist, hört di: Anyone closer than &e48 blocks&r hears you, quieter with distance. Whispering reaches 24 blocks. In the menu you create &egroups&r, then your team hears you over any distance.
Wer schon in &6Season 1&r dabei war, nut: If you played in &6Season 1&r, use &e/link&r with your Minecraft name in the Discord and get two spots of your own for friends.
Wer sie hat, entscheidet gemeinsam, was: Whoever has them decides together what goes first: into the Fusion Crafting Core or into the obelisk. Both count for the same goal.
Wer sie macht und wofür: Kapitel &5Mekan: Who makes them and what for: chapter &5Mekanism: Antimatter&r.
Wer später einsteigt, bekommt die &6Star: Whoever joins later gets the &6starter kits&r of every stage that is already open. With stage 2 that is 16 brass ingots, a Blaze Burner, a Source Jar and 8 Mana Pearls.
Whoever joins later gets the &6starter kits&r of every stage that is already open and catches up quickly. Nobody starts from zero in week four.
Wer später kommt, fängt nicht bei null a: Whoever comes later does not start from zero.
Wer vorsorgt, baut am ersten Tag Messing: Plan ahead and you build brass on day one.
A crafting table with storage behind it.
Werkbank oder Steinschneider machen aus: Crafting table or stonecutter turn Livingrock into &6Livingrock Bricks&r, polished and mossy variants, slabs, stairs and walls.
Crafting table, furnace and anvil on wheels.

Werkbank: &62 Froststahlbarren&r über &6: Crafting table: &62 Froststeel Ingots&r over &61 stick&r make the &6Froststeel Sword&r.

Werkbank: &62 Traumholzstämme&r übereina: Crafting table: &62 Dreamwood Logs&r on top of each other make &61 Dreamwood Twig&r.
Werkbank: &62 Utheriumkristalle&r über &: Crafting table: &62 Utherium Crystals&r over &61 stick&r make the &6Utherium Sword&r.
Werkbank: &63 Cloggrumbarren&r und &62 S: Crafting table: &63 Cloggrum Ingots&r and &62 sticks&r like an iron pickaxe. Plus a &6Cloggrum Chestplate&r from 8 ingots.

Werkbank: &63 Thermal Springstone Ingots: Crafting table: &63 Thermal Springstone Ingots&r at the top, &62 sticks&r below, like a pickaxe. That makes the &6Thermal Springstone Scythe&r.
Werkbank: &64 Tenacious Petals&r und &62: Crafting table: &64 Tenacious Petals&r and &62 Tenacious Vines&r make the &6Petal Scythe&r. With Soul Dew, Petals and Vines become the Moonring Greatsword.
Werkbank: &65 Furchtfels&r, &61 Rogdoriu: Crafting table: &65 Dreadrock&r, &61 Rogdorium&r and &61 Utheric Cluster&r make the &6Infuser&r. It runs on Rogdorium.

Werkbank: &66 Lebeholzstämme&r an den Se: Crafting table: &66 Livingwood Logs&r on the sides, &63 Terrasteel Nuggets&r in the middle column. One Terrasteel ingot gives 9 nuggets.
Werkbank: &67 Corporea-Blöcke&r, &61 End: Crafting table: &67 Corporea Blocks&r, &61 ender essence&r, &61 redstone&r. That makes the &6Corporea Funnel&r.
Werkbank: &68 Starlight Flowers&r um ein: Crafting table: &68 Starlight Flowers&r around an &6ender pearl&r make &616 Seeking Eyes&r. Right click opens a star map, where you choose a target. The eye floats ahead.
Werkbank: &69 Vergessene Klumpen&r ergeb: Crafting table: &69 Forgotten Nuggets&r make &61 Forgotten Ingot&r.
Werkbank: &6Manafunke&r, &6Feenstaub&r u: Crafting table: &6Mana Spark&r, &6Pixie Dust&r and &6ender essence&r make &64 Corporea Sparks&r. A spark and a Dragonstone make the &6Master Corporea Spark&r.

Werkbank: Elementiumbarren in Rüstungsfo: Crafting table: Elementium Ingots in armor shape, &624 ingots&r for all four pieces.
Werkbank: eine &6Utherische Scherbe&r au: Crafting table: a &6Utheric Shard&r on a &6stick&r makes a &6Shard Torch&r.
Werkbank: oben und unten je &63 Traumhol: Crafting table: &63 Dreamwood Logs&r each at the top and bottom, &61 Elementium Ingot&r and &61 petal&r in the middle.
Crafting table recipes with no hands at all.
Werkzeug aus Teilen, Materialstufen bis: Tools made of parts, material tiers up to Tyrian Steel.
A tool with power and modules.
Werkzeug plus neues Teil ins Raster: das: Tool plus new part in the grid: the part is fitted, the old one comes back.
Werkzeug, Waffen und Rüstung aus Teilen,: Tools, weapons and armor from parts whose material decides the stats. Even the iron tier beats every vanilla iron tool.
Werkzeuge an und aus, auch während der F: Tools on and off, even while moving.
Werte wie beim Holzstiel, Flexibel II. D: Stats like the wooden rod, Flexible II. The difference is the look.
Wesen darüber schweben nach oben, schlei: Creatures above it float upward, sneaking you sink slowly. Several on top of each other reach higher. As long as someone is in the updraft, it costs source.
When Dungeons Arise baut hoch über den I: When Dungeons Arise builds high above the islands.
Like amethyst, only faster with power.
Wie Basic, nur mit &6Energized Steel&r s: Like Basic, only with &6Energized Steel&r in place of iron, two &6Hardened Capacitors&r and the Basic Furnator at the bottom.
Wie Link und Tafel gebaut werden, steht: How link and board are built is in &6Create: Brass&r.
Wie Vanilla-Werkzeug: drei &6Seelenstahl: Like vanilla tools: three &6Soulstained Steel&r and two sticks for the pickaxe, two and one for the sword.
Wie bei allen Cataclysm-Bossen ist Schad: As with every Cataclysm boss, damage per hit and per second is capped, and whoever stands too far away barely hits. In a group they fall much faster. The rules are in the &cOverworld Bosses&r chapter.
Wie beides geht, steht im Kapitel &aBota: How both work is in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter. No pool of your own? Ask a magician, two ingots are quickly traded.
Wie beim Gold, nur zweimal: In der Diges: Like with gold, only twice: in the Digestion Vat &e4 Common Gems Niter&r with a &6Purified Gold&r and &e15 mB&r of Sal Ammoniac become &e1 Rare Gems Niter&r. From that, with &e4 Rare&r, a Purified Gold and &e50 mB&r, a &6Precious Gems Niter&r.
Wie beim Mugwort: Blätter in die normale: As with Mugwort: leaves into the normal brush, flowers into the Enhanced Brush, dried both into the crow ankh and into the Replacer Satchel.
Wie beim Wasser füllt sich die Schublade: As with water, the drawer fills on its own. You need obsidian for the backpack Void Upgrade and the drawer Void Upgrade.
Like the barrel, only as a chest.
Wie das Geschwindigkeitsupgrade, mit &6G: Like the Speed Upgrade, with &6gold dust&r in the middle. Eight lower the consumption to a tenth and enlarge the buffer.
Wie das Lager-Upgrade, nur mit einem &6K: Like the Deposit Upgrade, only with a &6sticky piston&r on top.
Wie das Warper-Relais, aber es verliert: Like the Warper Relay, but it no longer loses source even over long distances and holds more of it. Two of them connect the link farm at home with the base at the other end of the world.
Wie das normale Zeichen, aber &edie Roll: Like the normal code, but &ethe scrolls inside are not used up&r. In return the code has &e50 durability&r. Put a Scroll of Explosive Mana Condensation inside, and every right click calls a new staff as long as the mana lasts.
Wie der Apfelkuchen ein Block für den Ti: Like the apple pie, a block for the table. The knife cuts it into slices, four slices in a square make a whole pie again.
Wie der Blumenbeutel, nur mit &e1 Manapu: Like the Flower Pouch, only with &e1 Mana Powder&r in the middle: 5 wool, 1 petal, 1 powder.
Wie der Furnator, nur mit einem &6Eimer&: Like the Furnator, only with a &6bucket&r in place of the furnace. A bucket of lava gives &e10,000 FE&r.
Wie der Mülleimer, nur mit einem &6Eimer: Like the trash can, only with a &6bucket&r instead of the chest.
Wie der Vulkanische, aber &6Glitzernde M: Like the Volcanic one, but a &6glistering melon slice&r in the middle.
Wie der Vulkanische, aber &6Pilzsuppe&r: Like the Volcanic one, but &6mushroom stew&r in the middle.
Wie der Vulkanische, aber &6Weizen&r sta: Like the Volcanic one, but &6wheat&r instead of a lava bucket in the middle.
Wie der normale Item-Magnet zieht er Geg: Like the normal Item Dislocator it pulls items to you and can be switched on and off by key, only stronger. Two Awakened ingots are not much for a tool you wear every day.
Wie die Beeren selbst geben beide beim E: Like the berries themselves, both give mana regeneration when eaten. A pie before a long mining spell, and the bar fills faster.
Wie die Chimäre kämpft, steht im Kapitel: How the Chimera fights is in the chapter &dArs Nouveau: Epic&r.
Wie die Flüssigkeiten gemischt werden, s: How the fluids are mixed is in &6Create: Addons&r.
Wie die Glasrute, mit einem &6Amethystsp: Like the glass rod, with an &6amethyst shard&r in the middle and a &6gold nugget&r at the top right.
Wie die Spitzhacke, mit dem &6Wyvern-Bog: Like the pickaxe, with the &6Wyvern Bow&r as catalyst.
Wie die Spitzhacke, mit dem &6Wyvern-Sch: Like the pickaxe, with the &6Wyvern Sword&r as catalyst: 4 netherite ingots, a Wyvern Core, 2 Awakened ingots, a Draconic Energy Controller. Costs 32 million energy.
Wie die Spitzhacke, nur mit einem &6Boge: Like the pickaxe, only with a &6bow&r as catalyst.
Wie die Spitzhacke, nur mit einem &6Diam: Like the pickaxe, only with a &6diamond sword&r as catalyst. Axe, shovel and hoe work the same with the matching diamond tool.
Wie die Werkzeuge, mit der &6Wyvern-Brus: Like the tools, with the &6Wyvern Chestpiece&r as catalyst.
Wie die Werkzeuge, mit einer &6Diamantbr: Like the tools, with a &6diamond chestplate&r as catalyst.
Wie die anderen Charms lädt ihn die Imbu: Like the other charms, the Imbuement Chamber recharges it when it is empty.
Wie die der Plünderer, nur aus deinem Ma: Like the pillagers' one, only made of your material.
Wie du beides baust, steht im Kapitel &5: How to build both is in the chapter &5Draconic: Awakened and Chaos&r. Whoever has no Draconic armor takes totems along, see &ePack Your Bags&r.
Wie du dahin kommst, ist dein Rätsel. Di: How you get there is your puzzle. The slingshot can be enchanted: &eRicochet&r makes projectiles bounce off walls, &eLongevity&r gives more durability, &eSelf Sling&r shoots yourself instead of ammo.
Wie ein Lagerfeuer: &e3 Stämme&r unten,: Like a campfire: &e3 logs&r at the bottom, &e3 sticks&r, a &6Demon's Dream Fruit&r in the middle instead of coal. It burns with Spiritfire permanently.
Wie ein Netherportal, nur aus Grubenrahm: Like a Nether portal, only made of Mine Frames.
Wie ein Splitter, aber zwischen Warper-R: Like a splitter, but between Warper Relays with no range limit. Beyond &e30 blocks&r part of the source is lost. Ars Elemental turns it into the Wind Warper Relay with 2 Air Essences and 2 diamonds, which loses nothing anymore.
Like a blueprint, but only once.
Wie man einen Bruchsteingenerator, eine: How to build a cobblestone generator, an alloy line or a gem setup is shown in the chapter &6First Farms&r.
Wie schnell wächst der Bestand?: How fast does the stock grow?
Wie tief bist du gerade?: How deep are you right now?
Wie viel Leistung sie gerade zieht, zeig: A wattmeter in the line shows how much power it is drawing right now.
Wie viel Strom ist noch drin?: How much power is left in there?
Wie viel fehlt noch zum Obelisken?: How much is still missing for the obelisk?
Wie viele Inventare passen, bestimmen di: How many inventories fit is decided by the &dBookwyrms&r: each Bookwyrm Charm on the lectern allows &e8&r more. An unconnected chest right at the lectern becomes the input, everything in it goes into storage.
Wilde Geister brauchen kein Bindungsbuch: Wild spirits need no binding book, the start item is different for each ritual. &eWild Hunt&r: copper, silver, gold block, diamond, netherrack, soul sand, start skeleton skull, sacrifice villager. It brings wither skeleton skulls.
Wilde Geister schmieden dir einen &6Amet: Wild spirits forge a &6budding amethyst&r for you. You cannot mine it otherwise, not even with Silk Touch. Place it in your base and amethyst grows at your door.
Wilde Wegsteine gibt es auch im Nether,: Wild waystones exist in the Nether too, about one every 25 chunks.
Windmühle, Wasserrad, Werkbank, Pfosten: Windmill, Water Wheel, crafting table, posts and barrels need it. Count on three or four buckets for a start.
Wirf &62 Manastahlbarren&r ins Portal, e: Throw &62 Manasteel Ingots&r into the portal, &61 Elementium Ingot&r comes back.
Wirf &62 Manastahlblöcke&r ins Portal, e: Throw &62 Manasteel blocks&r into the portal, &61 Elementium block&r comes back, so 9 ingots in one trade.
Wirf &6Koks&r in den Zerkleinerer, herau: Throw &6coke&r into the Crusher, out comes &6Coke Dust&r, one to one, for 2,400 FE each.
Wirf &6Lebeholzstämme&r ins Portal. Für: Throw &6Livingwood Logs&r into the portal. A &6Dreamwood Log&r comes back for each, a Dreamwood for each Livingwood.
Wirf &6Manadiamanten&r ins Portal. Für j: Throw &6Mana Diamonds&r into the portal. A &dDragonstone&r comes back for each, a Dragonstone block for a Mana Diamond block.
Wirf &6Managlas&r ins Portal. Pro Block: Throw &6Managlass&r into the portal. One &6Alfglass&r comes back per block.
Wirf &6Manaperlen&r ins Portal. Für jede: Throw &6Mana Pearls&r into the portal. A &dPixie Dust&r comes back for each.
Wirf &6Netherquarz&r ins Portal. Pro Stü: Throw &6Nether quartz&r into the portal. One &6Elven Quartz&r comes back per piece.
Wirf &6Netherrack&r zwischen die Mahlwer: Throw &6netherrack&r between the crushing wheels. Each block gives one &6cinder flour&r, a second with 50 percent.
Wirf &6Obsidian&r zwischen zwei &6Mahlwe: Throw &6obsidian&r between two &6crushing wheels&r. Every block gives one &6Powdered Obsidian&r, and with 75 percent the obsidian comes back and goes through once more.
Throw &6Otherworld Logs&r into Spiritfire. They crumble into &6Otherworld Ashes&r, one ash per log.
Wirf deine &aLexica Botania&r durch das: Throw your &aLexica Botania&r through the portal. The elves write their knowledge into it and send it back.
Wirf deinem Crusher &6Antiken Schrott&r: Throw &6Ancient Debris&r to your Crusher. The Foliot makes &e2&r of it, the Djinni &e3&r &6Netherite Scrap Dust&r.
Wirf deinen &6Codex&r einer &5Hexe&r vor: Throw your &6Codex&r at a &5witch's&r feet. She writes the &5Wicked Sign&r into it and gives it back.
Wirf die &6Impure White Chalk&r in Spiri: Throw the &6Impure White Chalk&r into Spiritfire. Out comes &fWhite Chalk&r, usable from &6stage 2&r.
Wirf die Zutaten des ersten Schritts hin: Throw in the ingredients of the first step. When the color changes, the next one follows. If it says "stir", you stir with an empty hand as often as given.
Wirf ein &6Enderauge&r in die Luft, folg: Throw an &6eye of ender&r into the air, follow it, and dig down when it points downward. Below lies a &6stronghold&r from &eYUNG's Better Strongholds&r. Fill the 12 frame blocks with &e12 eyes of ender&r.
Wirf ein &6Wilden-Horn&r neben einen wil: Throw a &6Wilden Horn&r next to a wild &dDrygmy&r and it gives you &6Drygmy Shards&r. In the apparatus with fish, wheat, apple, carrot, seeds and &e3 Source Gems&r it becomes the charm.
Wirf eine &6Demon's Dream Essence&r in S: Throw a &6Demon's Dream Essence&r into Spiritfire. Out comes &6Otherworld Essence&r.
Wirf eine &6Demon's Dream Fruit&r auf de: Throw a &6Demon's Dream Fruit&r on the ground and light it with &6flint and steel&r. Then throw &6andesite&r in: out comes &6Otherstone&r.
Wirf eine &6Enderperle&r in das &5Transi: Throw an &6ender pearl&r into the &5gateway portal&r at the edge of the main island. A new one appears after every victory over the dragon.
Wirf eine &6Feder&r, &6schwarzen Farbsto: Throw a &6feather&r, &6black dye&r and a &6book&r into Spiritfire. Out come the &6Awakened Feather&r, &6Purified Ink&r and &6Taboo Book&r.
Wirf eine &6Singularität&r und eine &6En: Throw a &6Singularity&r and an &6ender pearl&r (or ender dust) on the ground together and blow them up. A creeper is enough.
Wirf einem &6Piglin&r einen &6Goldbarren: Throw a &6gold ingot&r to a &6piglin&r. After a few seconds it throws something back at you.
Wirf einen &6Certusquarzblock&r mit eine: Throw a &6Certus Quartz Block&r into water with a charged crystal, that gives a damaged &6Budding Certus Quartz&r. Put two &6Growth Accelerators&r next to it (iron, glass cable, quartz glass, a fluix block in the middle).
Throw a &6diamond&r into Spiritfire. Out comes a &bSpirit Attuned Gem&r.
Wirf einen &6Diamanten&r in ein &6Manabe: Throw a &6diamond&r into a &6Mana Pool&r with at least &d10,000 mana&r. It turns into a &bMana Diamond&r.
Wirf einen &6Eichensetzling&r in Spiritf: Throw an &6oak sapling&r into Spiritfire, plant the &6Unstable Otherworld Sapling&r and fell the tree &ewith the Third Eye&r. Without it you only get oak wood.
Wirf einen &6Geladenen Certusquarzkrista: Throw a &6Charged Certus Quartz Crystal&r, a &6redstone&r and a &6nether quartz&r into water together. A few seconds later &etwo Fluix Crystals&r lie there.
Throw a &6Charged Certus Quartz Crystal&r, an &6iron ingot&r and a &6sky stone&r into &clava&r together. Out come two &6Sky Steel Ingots&r.
Wirf einen &6Sal Ammoniac Crystal&r in d: Throw a &6Sal Ammoniac Crystal&r into the accumulator and wait. Then take &6Sal Ammoniac&r out of the tank with an empty bucket.
Throw an ingot, see what comes.
Wirf farbloses &6Glas&r ins Becken. Jede: Throw colourless &6glass&r into the pool. Each block costs &d150 mana&r and comes back as &6Managlass&r.
Wirf ihm &6Unstable Otherworld Saplings&: Throw &6Unstable Otherworld Saplings&r to it and it gives back &6Stable Otherworld Saplings&r. Anyone can fell their trees without the Third Eye, and they give stable saplings again.
Wirf ihm Erz oder Rohes Erz hin: &eein E: Throw ore or raw ore to it: &eone ore becomes two dusts&r. Dust in the furnace gives ingots, which doubles your yield. It works half as fast as the Djinni.
Wirf ihm Steinsorten hin, er tauscht sie: Throw kinds of stone to it, and it trades them for &6Otherstone&r, faster than Spiritfire. It decays after about an hour.
Wirf keinen Bruchstein weg. Der Obelisk: Don't throw any cobblestone away. In stage 1 the obelisk wants &e20,000&r from the whole server, and every kind counts: normal, mossy and cobbled deepslate.
Wirf passende Dinge hinein, dann verwand: Throw suitable things in and the pool transforms them (&emana infusion&r). Functional flowers within 10 blocks draw from it, a spreader right next to it fills itself from it.
Wirf sie in eine Gruppe Moderwesen, bevo: Throw them into a group of rotspawn before they reach you. Eight bombs around a &6Gloomgourd&r make a &6Boomgourd&r, an explosive block for bigger holes.
Wirkt Ernte immer wieder auf reife Pflan: Casts Harvest on ripe plants nearby again and again, for a little Source per round. A chest right at the brazier takes in the harvest.
Wirkt bei jedem Impuls den Zauber aus ei: On every pulse it casts the spell from an inscribed &6parchment&r, with Touch or Projectile, paid with Source from jars. With a chest next to it, Pickup and Place Block work too.
Wirkt den Rest des Zaubers auf alles in: Applies the rest of the spell to everything in a sphere around the target. AOE enlarges it, Sensitive hits blocks, Dampen makes it hollow. &eProjectile, Burst, Lightning&r against groups.
Wirrbeere hält drin, Freihut hält drauße: Tangleberrie keeps in, Jiyuulia keeps out.
Wirrwald: türkise Bäume, Endermen, der r: Warped forest: turquoise trees, endermen, the quietest place here.
Wither skeleton skulls without a Nether fortress.
Wo die drei Prinzipien wieder eins werde: Where the three principles become one again.
Wolle und Fleisch sammelt eine Andesitsc: An andesite funnel on the floor or the Hopperhock from Botania collects wool and meat.
Wolle, ohne die Schere in die Hand zu ne: Wool without picking up the shears.
Worauf du schaust, steht oben am Bildsch: What you look at is shown at the top of the screen.
Worktable: &6Eisenbrustplatte&r in die M: Worktable: &6iron chestplate&r in the middle, a &6Soul Shard&r above it, &e3 Enchanted Ash&r left, right and below, &e4 Pewter Inlay&r in the extra slots.
Worktable: &6Shadow Gem&r oben rechts, &: Worktable: &6Shadow Gem&r at the top right, &e2 Arcane Gold&r and a &6stick&r diagonally, Gold Inlay at the bottom left. Extra: &6Lesser Soul Gem&r and &e3 blaze powder&r.
Worktable: &6Stone Altar&r aus glatten S: Worktable: &6Stone Altar&r from smooth stone slabs, stone, Pewter Inlay, Soul Shard in the extra slot (gives three). &6Elder Statue&r from stone and smooth stone, Unholy Symbol and Gold Inlay extra.
Worktable: Buch, zwei &6Arcane Gold&r, v: Worktable: book, two &6Arcane Gold&r, four &6obsidian&r, extra two &6diamonds&r and two &6Gold Inlays&r.
Worktable: Enderperle oben, &e2 Federn&r: Worktable: ender pearl at the top, &e2 feathers&r next to the belt, &6Lesser Soul Gem&r at the bottom. Extra: &e2 Calx of End&r and &e2 Pewter Inlay&r.
Worktable: Pewter oben, &e2 Pewter Inlay: Worktable: Pewter at the top, &e2 Pewter Inlay&r on the sides, the Basic Amulet in the middle, &6obsidian&r at the bottom, &e2 Soul Shards&r in the extra slots.
Worktable: Pewter, Pewter Inlay, Enderpe: Worktable: Pewter, Pewter Inlay, ender pearl diagonally, plus &6gold nugget&r and &6silver nugget&r extra.
Worktable: Wraith Heart oben rechts, &e2: Worktable: Wraith Heart at the top right, &e2 Pewter&r and a &6stick&r diagonally, Pewter Inlay at the bottom left. Extra: &6Lesser Soul Gem&r and &e3 bone meal&r.
Worktable: drei &6Pewter&r und zwei Stöc: Worktable: three &6Pewter&r and two sticks, extra &5Unholy Symbol&r, two &6Tattered Cloth&r and a &6Soul Shard&r.
Worktable: oben &6Obsidian&r, &6Weinende: Worktable: at the top &6obsidian&r, &6crying obsidian&r, obsidian. Below that Pewter, then a Pewter Inlay as the handle.
Wyvern-Stufe. Katalysator: ein &6Nethers: Wyvern tier. Catalyst: a &6Nether Star&r. In eight injectors: &64 Wyvern Cores&r and &64 Awakened ingots&r. Costs 1 million energy.
Wyvern-Stufe. Katalysator: ein &6Wyvern-: Wyvern tier. Catalyst: a &6Wyvern injector&r. In seven injectors: &64 diamonds&r, &62 Wyvern Cores&r, &61 Awakened Draconium Block&r. Costs 256,000 energy.
Wyvern-Werkzeuge und die Brustplatte bra: Wyvern tools and the chestpiece need &esix&r Wyvern injectors, the capacitor eight. If some are missing, the core reports &e"Not enough wyvern tier injectors"&r.
Guardians from trees, golems from amethyst.
Wüste, Dschungel, Sumpf: YUNG's baut all: Desert, jungle, swamp: YUNG's rebuilds them all.
YUNG's Better Dungeons: Skelette, Zombie: YUNG's Better Dungeons: skeletons, zombies, spiders.
YUNG's Better Mineshafts: jedes Biom bau: YUNG's Better Mineshafts: every biome builds differently.
Gears and shafts in one part.
Zahnräder, Draht und Blöcke aus der Pres: Gears, wire and blocks from the press.
Zauber aus Glyphen, Quelle, Quelljuwelen: Spells from glyphs, source, Source Gems.
Zauber selbst zusammensetzen, Quellgläse: Build your own spells, Source Jars, Starbuncles and the &aImbuement Chamber&r, the only way to Source Gems for the magic pillar.
Ten buckets of fuel to take along.
Ten obsidian and a flint and steel.
Zehn Pellets sind zehn Millionen mB Polo: Ten pellets are ten million mB of polonium from your fission reactors, processed in the SPS. Once this is done, your antimatter line runs, and the rest is a matter of time.
Zehn Pellets, zehn Millionen mB Polonium: Ten pellets, ten million mB of polonium.
Zehn Uranstaub ergeben neun &6Uran-238&r: Ten uranium dust make nine &6uranium 238&r and one &6uranium 235&r. Thorium dust becomes thorium 232 and thorium 230.
Zeig acht 2x2-Schubladen, zwei Eisenfäss: Show eight 2x2 drawers, two iron barrels, a Storage Controller and an Item Vault.
Zeig, dass es läuft: ein Stapel Bruchste: Show that it runs: a stack of cobblestone from the generator, charcoal from the pots, wheat from the field and leather from the pen, all from farms that work without you.
Zellblöcke sind zerbrechlich, geben abge: Cellular blocks are fragile, give nothing back when mined and cannot be pushed. Two Dandelifeons with overlapping fields kill the cells in between.
Zelle hinein, Redstone-Impuls, und der I: Cell in, redstone pulse, and the contents of the pylons swap with the space in the cell. The port draws its power all at once.
Fill or empty cells in seconds.
Zellen stehen innen. Die höheren Stufen: Cells stand inside. The higher tiers are made from four cells of the tier below around a cube, the advanced one stores eight times as much.
Zellen, die ins 3x3 um die Blume wachsen: Cells that grow into the 3x3 around the flower become &d60 mana times age&r, age at most 100.
Zerkleinerer und Anreicherungskammer dah: The crusher and Enrichment Chamber behind it need the same speed, otherwise things back up. The line for it: chapter &5Mekanism: Ore Step by Step&r.
Zerkleinerer und Lichtbogenofen brauchen: The Crusher and Arc Furnace need &e10&r each, the Excavator 9. Build up a stock right away. The basics from stage 2 are in the &6Immersive Engineering&r chapter.
Zerkleinerer: ein Obsidian gibt &evier O: Crusher: one obsidian gives &efour obsidian dust&r. Metallurgic Infuser: dust with &e10 mB of diamond&r gives &6Refined Obsidian Dust&r. Compressor: dust with osmium gives the &6ingot&r.
Zerlegt Silent-Gear-Werkzeug und Vanilla: Breaks Silent Gear tools and vanilla tools down into material. &e0 to 50 percent&r is lost per part.
Zerstörer und Laser bauen Blöcke als sie: Destroyers and lasers mine blocks as themselves. Together with a Yield Addon, Silk Touch wins.
Zerstörer und Laser überspringen unreife: Destroyers and lasers skip unripe plants, the laser with a Hunter Addon skips young animals too. A frame over the field, a Placer for the seeds: the farm is done.
Zieh beides an und schalte die Flasche e: Put both on and switch the tank on. As long as there is oxygen inside, you don't drown. Ideal for ocean monuments and salt under water.
Drag instead of clicking a hundred times.
Zieht aus mehreren Gläsern und liefert a: Draws from several jars and delivers to several targets, with much more throughput than a relay. Ars Elemental turns it into the Water Relay with more storage and throughput with 2 Water Essences and 2 diamonds.
Zinkklumpen gehen statt Eisenklumpen in: Zinc nuggets go into Andesite Alloy instead of iron nuggets. That saves your iron for sheets and tools.
Zinn, Redstone, ein Stahlgehäuse und ein: Tin, redstone, a Steel Casing and an Energy Tablet. It turns power into heat, by the server config at &e60 percent&r efficiency.
Zinn, ein Chemikalienbehälter, ein Feuer: Tin, a Chemical Tank, a flint and steel, bronze and an Advanced Control Circuit. It shoots burning &bhydrogen&r.
Zirkonium, Beryllium und Arsen aus Geste: Zirconium, beryllium and arsenic from rock.
Zuerst &6Ether&r: &e4 Glowstonestaub&r a: First &6Ether&r: &e4 glowstone dust&r on the altar, a &6Blazing Quartz&r (Nether ore) on a stand, plus &e2 Infernal&r and &e1 Arcane&r. Gives two.
Zuerst &6Silizium&r: zwei Quarzstaub und: First &6Silicon&r: two quartz dust and two sand make three &6Raw Silicon&r, which the furnace turns into silicon. Furnace: copper at the top, silicon left and right, Electrum in the middle, at the bottom coil, furnace, coil.
Zug mit Frachtlager und Schnittstellen,: A train with cargo storage and interfaces, a schedule with two stations, condition &eCargo Idle&r: the train leaves as soon as loading or unloading has been done for a while.
Zuhause wachsen sie auf &6Seelensand&r,: At home it grows on &6soul sand&r, without light and without water, in the overworld too. A small field is enough for every potion.
Zum &6Utheriumkristall&r wird der Haufen: The cluster only becomes a &6Utherium Crystal&r in the &6Infuser&r, and you build that with Rogdorium from the Depths. Start collecting now.
Zum Beweis ein Eimer flüssiges Deuterium: As proof, a bucket of liquid Deuterium from the Rotary Condensentrator.
Zum Rechnen: Eine Reformation kostet &e1: For the math: one reformation costs &e100 to 200&r flux. So one crystal lasts for 16 to 32 conversions.
Zum Vergleich: Konsole 10 FE/t, Laufwerk: For comparison: Grid 10 FE/t, Disk Drive 10 FE/t plus 4 per disk, Importer and Exporter 2 FE/t each, Wireless Transmitter 16 FE/t. A small network runs on less than &d50 FE/t&r.
Zum Verkleiden im Raster: erster Platz d: To clad it in the grid: first slot the block for the outside, second for the inside, third the drawer, a fourth block colours the trim. Goes well with andesite casings or stone bricks.
Zum Üben: &6Kohle&r und &6Enchanted Ash&: For practice: &6coal&r and &6Enchanted Ash&r (bone in a furnace) make two Sulfur.
Zurück fährt er, wenn die Drehrichtung w: It retracts when the rotation changes direction, easiest with a gearshift. With a slime ball it becomes a &6Sticky Mechanical Piston&r.
Together they form the Spirit Crucible.
Zusammen mit Windkugeln wird er zur gefä: Together with wind charges it becomes the most dangerous melee weapon of the overworld.
Zusammen sind sie ein Bruchsteingenerato: Together they are a cobblestone generator without hoppers, an obsidian miner or an item thrower, because the Constructor can also drop items. With the Silk Touch Upgrade the Destructor even brings glass back whole.
Zusammenfüger: zwei Gems, eine Plastik P: Assembler: two gems, one Plastic Sheet and one nickel give two &6Uranium Pellets&r, three with Adamant instead of nickel.
Zutaten drauflegen, Verbreiter mit volle: Put the ingredients on, aim a spreader with a full pool at the altar, when the mana is in put a &6Livingrock&r on top, then right click with the wand. Runes in a recipe are catalysts and come back.
Zwei &6Andesit&r und zwei &6Eisenklumpen: Two &6andesite&r and two &6iron nuggets&r (or zinc nuggets) diagonally across in the 2 x 2 grid make one &6Andesite Alloy&r.
Zwei &6Andesitlegierungen&r über zwei &6: Two &6Andesite Alloys&r above two &6dried kelp&r make two &6Andesite Tunnels&r. Put one on top of a belt.
Zwei &6Andesitlegierungen&r übereinander: Two &6Andesite Alloys&r on top of each other make eight &6Shafts&r. A shaft passes rotation on in a straight line, without loss.
Zwei &6Andesitlegierungen&r, &6Redstone&: Two &6andesite alloys&r, &6redstone&r and two &6logs&r make the &6Cart Assembler&r. When a minecart with a redstone signal runs over it, it takes the glued blocks along.
Zwei &6Behandelte Holzbretter&r übereina: Two &6Treated Wood Planks&r on top of each other make four &6Treated Sticks&r.
Zwei &6Behandelte Holzzäune&r übereinand: Two &6Treated Wood Fences&r on top of each other on a &6stone brick&r make a &6Wooden Post&r.
Zwei &6Behandelte Stöcke&r, drei &6Stahl: Two &6Treated Sticks&r, three &6Steel Rods&r, two &6LV Wire Connectors&r, a &6leather&r and two &6Insulated LV Wire Coils&r make the frame. At the &6Engineer's Workbench&r you insert an &6accumulator&r.
Zwei &6Blaueis&r ergeben für &e10 000 FE: Two &6Blue Ice&r give one &6Dry Ice&r for &e10,000 FE&r. It also lies as a vein in stone below &eY 64&r, mine it with Silk Touch.
Zwei &6Bleibarren&r und zwei &6Graphitst: Two &6lead ingots&r and two &6graphite dust&r crosswise. Gives two &6Plate Basic&r.
Zwei &6Bücher&r, eine &6Enderperle&r und: Two &6books&r, an &6ender pearl&r and a &6Marker&r, shapeless. Right click opens its list. Whatever is on it, the quarry throws away at once.
Zwei &6Doppelschichtkondensatoren&r link: Two &6Double-Layer Capacitors&r left and right, a &6glowstone block&r in the middle, a &6Vibrant Alloy Ingot&r at the top and bottom.
Zwei &6Einfache Kondensatoren&r links un: Two &6Basic Capacitors&r left and right, a &6Powdered Coal&r in the middle, an &6Energetic Alloy Ingot&r at the top and bottom.
Zwei &6Eisenbarren&r und drei Paste, sch: Two &6iron ingots&r and three paste, laid diagonally.
